text: Ginbuksan ang ginakalangkagan nga 2022 World Cup sa Al-Bayt Stadium sa Qatar paagi sa isa ka madinuagon nga seremonya nga nagdala sang mensahe sang inclusion, paglaum, kag respeto sa isa kag isa.
english: The highly anticipated 2022 World Cup was opened at the Al-Bayt Stadium in Qatar with a colorful ceremony that carried a message of inclusion, hope, and mutual respect.

text:
Ginabanta 60,000 ka mga tawo ang nagdugok sa stadium kag nagsaksi sa extravaganza sang saot, kanta, kag pyrotechnics antes ang opening match sa tunga sang Ecuador kag host nga Qatar sa Group A.

Gin-feature sa seremonya ang legendary American actor nga si Morgan Freeman kag ang Qatari YouTuber nga si Ghanim Al-Muftah nga isa sa mga ambassador sang FIFA World Cup.
english:
An estimated 60,000 people packed the stadium and witnessed an extravaganza of dance, song, and pyrotechnics ahead of the opening match between Ecuador and host Qatar in Group A.

Featured at the ceremony were legendary American actor Morgan Freeman and Qatari YouTuber Ghanim Al-Muftah who was one of the FIFA World Cup ambassadors.

text: Ang 20-anyos nga si Muftah ang nagasuprer sang Caudal Regression Syndrome, isa ka kondisyon kun sa diin apektado ang development sa idalom nga bahin sang iya lawas, apang kilala siya sa bilog nga pungsod bangud sa iya nga motivational speeches.
english: The 20-year-old Muftah suffers from Caudal Regression Syndrome, a condition that affects the development of the lower part of his body, but he is known nationwide for his motivational speeches.

text: Paagi sa pag-recite sang verses halin sa Quran, gin-engganyo sang lamharon nga ambassador ang inclusion kag diversity sa amo nga football tournament.
english: By reciting verses from the Quran, the young ambassador encouraged inclusion and diversity at the football tournament.

text: Ang pagdungan kanday Freeman kag Al-Muftah sa stage amo ang pag-represent sang inclusion sa Qatar sa tunga sang ginapangatubang sini nga international criticism bangud sa indi maayo nga rekord sa pagtratar sini sa kinamatarong sang mga tawo.
english: Having Freeman and Al-Muftah on stage together is to represent inclusion in Qatar amid the international criticism it faces over its poor record in treating human rights.

text: Agaw-atensyon man ang South Korean pop star nga si Jung Kook nga amo ang nagkanta sang tournament song nga Dreamers kag gin-updan sang Qatari singer nga si Fahad Al Kubaisi.
english: Also attracting attention was South Korean pop star Jung Kook who sang the tournament song Dreamers and was accompanied by Qatari singer Fahad Al Kubaisi.

text: Lakip sa gin-feature sa saot sa opening ceremony amo ang giant walking kits sang 32 ka football teams nga naga-compete sa tournament kag ang mascots sang nagligad nga mga World Cups nga gin-updan sang 2022 mascot nga si La’eeb, ang puti, nagayuhom, kag soccer-playing turban nga nagakahulugan ‘skillful player’ kag inspired sa Qatari culture kag customs.
english: Among the featured in the dance at the opening ceremony were the giant walking kits of the 32 football teams competing in the tournament and the mascots of previous World Cups accompanied by 2022 mascot La’eeb, the white, smiling, and soccer-playing turban that means ‘skierful’ and player inspired and cultured in Qatar customs.

text: Ang nag-deliver naman sang opening speech amo si Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani.
english: The opening speech was delivered by Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani.

text: Wala sang major Western leaders nga nagtambong sa event, apang yara sanday United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres, Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Senegalese President Macky Sall, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, Rwandan President Paul Kagame, kag Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman sang Saudi Arabia.
english: No major Western leaders attended the event, but United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres, Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Senegalese President Macky Sall, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, Rwandan President Paul Kagame, and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia were present.

text: Nagtakop ang 30 ka minutos nga seremonya paagi sa fireworks display kag isa ka dance routine antes nag-warm up ang Qatar kag Ecuador para sa ila nga una nga hampang.
english: The 30-minute ceremony ended with a fireworks display and a dance routine before Qatar and Ecuador warmed up for their first match.

text: Madamo nga mga estudyante kag eskwelahan sa Western Visayas ang apektado bangud sa epekto sang Bagyo Crising nga may dala sang mabaskog nga ulan kag hangin sa rehiyon.
english: Many students and schools in Western Visayas were affected by the impact of Typhoon Crising which brought heavy rains and winds to the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson sang Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6, ginpahayag sini nga preparado na ang mga eskwelahan sa pagsabat sa epekto sang bagyo pinaagi sa pagpatuman sang module-based learning.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson of the Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6, said schools are ready to respond to the impact of the typhoon by implementing module-based learning.

text: Suno kay Escullar, naglab-ot na sa 731,982 ka mga school learners ang apektado sa bug-os nga Region 6.
english: According to Escullar, 731,982 school learners have been affected in the entire Region 6.

text:
Pinaka-apektado nga mga probinsya amo ang:

Antique – 505 ka public schools kag 122,873 ka mga learners

Capiz – 352 ka eskwelahan kag 60,741 ka mga learners

Guimaras – 87 ka eskwelahan kag 27,059 ka mga learners

Province of Iloilo – 981 ka eskwelahan kag 323,229 ka mga learners

Iloilo City – 66 ka eskwelahan kag 75,010 ka mga learners

Ginpahayag ni Escullar nga umpisa kahapon nga adlaw, Hulyo 18, gin-shift na ang klase sa Alternative Mode of Learning agud nga mapadayon ang edukasyon apisar pa may kalamidad.
english:
The most affected provinces are:

Antique – 505 public schools and 122,873 learners

Capiz – 352 schools and 60,741 learners

Guimaras – 87 schools and 27,059 learners

Province of Iloilo – 981 schools and 323,229 learners

Iloilo City – 66 schools and 75,010 learners

Escullar said that as of yesterday, July 18, classes have been shifted to Alternative Mode of Learning in order to continue education despite the disaster.

text: Suno sa iya, importante nga may preparasyon ang DepEd, ilabi na sa tion sang suspensyon sang klase bangud sa peligro nga dala sang bagyo.
english: He said it is important for the DepEd to be prepared, especially during the suspension of classes due to the danger posed by the typhoon.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang seguridad para sa mga estudyante kag manunudlo.
english: He also expressed that this move is part of security for students and teachers.

text: Sa ika-tatlo nga kahigayunan, nahulugan sang bata ang R&B singer-songwriter nga si Kyla Alvarez.
english: For the third time, the boy fell for R&B singer-songwriter Kyla Alvarez.

text: Ginbuyagyag ini mismo sang singer sa iya nga Instagram account sa diin iya ginpabutyag kun ano ka-sakit ang iya nabatyagan.
english: The singer himself revealed this on his Instagram account where he expressed how painful he felt.

text: Nagpangabay man si Kyla sa iya nga little angel nga giyahan siya kag ila nga pamilya.
english: Kyla also asked her little angel to guide her and their family.

text: Si Kyla kag bana nga si Rich ang may yara sang isa ka anak nga si Toby Elsiah.
english: Kyla and husband Rich share a son Toby Elsiah.

text: Madamo naman nga mga celebrities ang nag-offer sang support para sa R&B singer.
english: Many celebrities have offered support for the R&B singer.

text: Nahibaluan nga nahulugan man sang bata si Kyla sang makaduha ka beses sang tuig 2018.
english: It was learned that the child also dropped Kyla twice in 2018.

text: Ginbalabagan ang mga pulis nga nagtuyo nga mag-raid sa mga opisina ni South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: Police who tried to raid the offices of South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol were blocked.

text: Ini nga raid ang ginpatigayon agud imbestigaran ang iya gulpyada nga deklarasyon sang martial law nga gilayon man ginbawi bangud sa pag-alsa sang opposition kag sang publiko.
english: The raid was conducted to investigate his sudden declaration of martial law which was immediately withdrawn due to the uprising of the opposition and the public.

text: Antes sini, gindumilian na si Yoon sa pagbyahe sa iban nga pungsod bilang kabahin sang “insurrection” probe sa iya inner circle bangud sa drama nga natabo sang December 3-4 nga nagkibot indi lamang sa Seoul kundi pati sa ila nga mga kaalyado.
english: Earlier, Yoon was banned from traveling abroad as part of an “insurrection” probe in his inner circle over the December 3-4 drama that shocked not only Seoul but also their allies.

text: Suno sa South Korean police, pila ka oras nga ginbalabagan sang presidential staff and security ang special investigation team.
english: According to South Korean police, the special investigation team was blocked for several hours by presidential staff and security.

text: Sunod man nga nagpaandam ang main opposition nga Democratic Party nga maga-file sila sang kaso nga insurrection batok sa presidential staff and security kun padayon nila nga punggan ang law enforcement.
english: The main opposition Democratic Party also warned that it will file a case of insurrection against the presidential staff and security if they continue to obstruct law enforcement.

text:
Sa pihak nga bahin, gin-report naman sang mga otoridad sa presuhan nga nagtuyo nga maghikog si former defense minister Kim Yong-hyun matapos nga gindakop ini sang nagligad nga gab-i.

Si Kim ang gina-akusaran nga nagsuhestyon kay Yoon nga magpatuman sang martial law.
english:
Meanwhile, prison authorities reported that former defense minister Kim Yong-hyun attempted suicide after his arrest last night.

Kim is accused of suggesting to Yoon to impose martial law.

text: Una siya nga gin-detain sang Domingo kag pormal nga gin-aresto sang Martes sang gab-i bangud sa pagpahilabot sa critical duties sa tion sang insurrection” kag gin-alegar nga nagkomiter man sang “abuse of authority to obstruct the exercise of rights”.
english: He was first detained on Sunday and formally arrested on Tuesday night for interfering with critical duties during the insurrection” and was alleged to have also committed “abuse of authority to obstruct the exercise of rights”.

text: Sini lang nga Mierkules, gin-report naman sang justice ministry nga yara na ini sa maayo nga kondisyon.
english: On Wednesday, the justice ministry reported that he was in good condition.

text: Apektado ang pito ka mga pamalay sa nagluntad nga landslide nga tuga man sang pagtupa sang mamunog nga ulan dala sang Habagat nga ginpabaskog pa ni Bagyo Crising sa bahin sang Barangay Abiera, Sebaste, Antique.
english: Seven houses were affected by the landslide that was also caused by heavy rains brought by the Habagat monsoon that was intensified by Typhoon Crising in Barangay Abiera, Sebaste, Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Avigen Jonelas, residente sang amo nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga pasado ‘las 6:00 sa kaagahon sang nahulogan sang duta ang balay nga iya gina-ubrahan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Avigen Jonelas, a resident of the area, said the house where he was working collapsed around 6:00 am.

text: Suno kay Jonelas, gilayon nila nga ginbuligan sang iya bana nga sayluhon sa ila mismo puluy-an ang tag-iya sang ila nga gina-obrahan, bangud ini ang baldado na kag wala sang ikasarang mga maglakat.
english: According to Jonelas, they immediately helped her husband to move the owner of their workplace to their own house, because he is disabled and cannot walk.

text: Pahayag man ni Jonelas nga handa ang ila pamilya nga mag-evacuate kun kinahanglan, ilabi na nga nakit-an nila ang posibilidad nga madalahig man ang ila balay kun magpadayon pa ang pag-osos sang duta.
english: Jonelas said their family is ready to evacuate if necessary, especially since they see the possibility that their house will be involved if the landslide continues.

text: Sa subong, padayon nga nagapaandam ang local nga pamunuan sang Barangay Abiera sa mga residente bangud sang presensya sang litik nga nakita sa ibabaw sang bukid, isa ka indikasyon nga may posibilidad pa sang dugang nga landslide.
english: Meanwhile, the local government of Barangay Abiera continues to warn residents due to the presence of litik found on top of the mountain, an indication that there is a possibility of further landslides.

text: Nahibaluan nga mga landslide prone areas ang mga banwa sang Sebaste, Barbaza kag Patnongon sa probinsya sang Antique.
english: The towns of Sebaste, Barbaza and Patnongon in Antique province are known to be landslide prone areas.

text: Sa subong, naglab-ot na sa 56 ka mga pamalay ang naapektuhan sang landslide sa bug-os nga Probinsya sang Antique bangud sang wala untat nga pag-ulan ulan.
english: So far, 56 houses have been affected by landslides in the entire province of Antique due to continuous rains.

text: 16 ka balay ang totally damaged samtang 40 naman ang partially damaged.
english: 16 houses were totally damaged while 40 were partially damaged.

text: Ginlutos sang Ecuador ang host nation nga Qatar, 2-0, sa opening match sang 2022 FIFA World Cup sa Al Bayt Stadium.
english: Ecuador defeated host nation Qatar, 2-0, in the opening match of the 2022 FIFA World Cup at Al Bayt Stadium.

text: Ang duha ka goal sang Ecuador ang lunsay nagikan sa 33-anyos nga team captain nga si Enner Valencia nga amo ang all-time top scorer sang pungsod.
english: Both of Ecuador's goals came from 33-year-old team captain Enner Valencia, the country's all-time top scorer.

text: Natigayon ini nga duha ka goals sa first half sang hampang: una, paagi sa penalty kick sa ika-15 nga minuto bangud sa foul sang Qatar keeper nga si Saad Al Sheeb kag ang ikaduha naman amo ang 31st-minute header nga naghatag sang lead sa Ecuador.
english: These two goals were achieved in the first half of the match: first, through a penalty kick in the 15th minute due to a foul by Qatar keeper Saad Al Sheeb and the second was a 31st-minute header that gave Ecuador the lead.

text: Antes sini, may yara na kuntani sang goal halin kay Valencia sa ikatatlo nga minuto pa lang sang hampang apang gin-disallow kasunod sang ‘Video Assistant Referee’ review bangud sa marginal offside.
english: Earlier, there was supposed to be a goal from Valencia in the third minute of the game but was disallowed following a 'Video Assistant Referee' review due to marginal offside.

text: Ang pagdaog sang Ecuador sa first match sa 2022 World Cup amo ang labing-una nga tion sa World Cup history kun sa diin ang opening goal sa single edition sang tournament ang na-score pinaagi sa penalty spot.
english: Ecuador's victory in the first match of the 2022 World Cup was the first time in World Cup history that the opening goal in the single edition of the tournament was scored through the penalty spot.

text: Kun halimbawa wala gin-disallow ang una nga goal ni Valencia sa ika-tres minutos sang hampang, ini kuntani ang kabigon nga pinakadasig nga World Cup goal sa opening match.
english: If Valencia's first goal had not been disallowed in the third minute, it would have been the fastest World Cup goal in the opening match.

text: Kasunod sang duha ka goals ni Valencia, siya na ang all-time leading scorer sang pungsod Ecuador nga may 37 ka goals sa 75 ka national team appearances.
english: Following Valencia's two goals, he is now Ecuador's all-time leading scorer with 37 goals in 75 national team appearances.

text: Siya man ang highest-scoring player sang Ecuador sa World Cup history nga may apat na ka nahimo nga goals nga naglapaw sa tatlo nga rekord ni Agustin Delgado nga forward anay sang team kag amo man anay ang all-time top scorer sang pungsod.
english: He is also Ecuador’s highest-scoring player in World Cup history with four goals already surpassing the three records of Agustin Delgado, the team’s former forward and also the country’s all-time top scorer.

text: Ang daog sang Ecuador nagakahulugan man nga nahigkuan ang pangalan sang Qatar bangud ini ang labing-una nga host nation sa World Cup nga nalutos sa mismo opener.
english: Ecuador's victory also means that Qatar's name has been tarnished as it became the first host nation in the World Cup to lose the opener.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa FIFA rankings, yara ang Ecuador sa ika-44 nga pwesto samtang ang host naman nga Qatar ang yara sa ika-50 nga spot.
english: Ecuador is ranked 44th in the FIFA rankings while host Qatar is ranked 50th.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Ecuador ang Netherlands samtang atubangon naman sang Qatar ang Senegal sa ikaduha nga group stage match.
english: Ecuador will next face the Netherlands while Qatar will face Senegal in the second group stage match.

text: Naglaum si Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo nga kuntani gin-deactivate na lang niya ang iya social media accounts kadungan sang nangin kompetisyon sini sa 69th Miss Universe.
english: Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo hoped that she would have deactivated her social media accounts during her competition at the 69th Miss Universe.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang Ilongga beauty queen kadungan sang homecoming event sini matapos ang masobra isa ka semana nga pag-abot sa Pilipinas halin sa Estados Unidos.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen said this during her homecoming event after more than a week of arriving in the Philippines from the United States.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, sa mangin masunod nga Miss Universe Philippines, mas maayo nga indi siya anay magbukas sang social media bangud mabatyagan gid ang pressure halin sa mga fans.
english: According to Rabiya, in the next Miss Universe Philippines, it is better not to open social media because she will feel the pressure from the fans.

text: Mas maayo pahayag niya nga maglikaw na lang agud mapabilin ang inner peace.
english: He said it is better to avoid it to maintain inner peace.

text: Kinahanglan lang dugang sang Ilongga nga mag focus sa physical training, question and answer portion kag ang hollistic approach.
english: Ilongga just need to focus on physical training, question and answer portion and the holistic approach.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtakop ang journey ni Rabiya matapos nalakip sa Top 21 sa 69th Miss Universe.
english: Rabiya's journey ended after she was included in the Top 21 in the 69th Miss Universe.

text: Mas nagkusog pa kag nahimo na nga Severe Tropical Storm ang Bagyo Paolo samtang nagahinampot ini sa Northern Aurora kag Southern Isabela.
english: Typhoon Paolo strengthened into a Severe Tropical Storm as it approached Northern Aurora and Southern Isabela.

text: Sa latest nga weather bulletin, nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 150 km nasidlangan sang Casiguran, Aurora.
english: In the latest weather bulletin, the center of the typhoon was located 150 km east of Casiguran, Aurora.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 100 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 125 km/h.

Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan naaminhan nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Sa forecast sang weather bureau, mahimo nga mag-landfall ang bagyo sa northern Aurora ukon sa southern Isabela subong nga aga ukon karon sa udto.

SIGNAL NUMBER 1:

*The rest of mainland Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, the rest of Aurora, the northern portion of Quezon including Polillo Islands, Camarines Norte, the northern portion of Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, the rest of Apayao, the rest of Ilocos Norte, the rest of Pangasinan, the rest of Nueva Ecija, the Bulgarian portion Tarlac, the northeastern portion of Pampanga, and the northern portion of Zambales

According to the weather bureau's forecast, the typhoon could landfall in northern Aurora or southern Isabela this morning or this afternoon.

text: Pagkatapos maglaslas sa areas sa Northern Luzon, magatuhaw ini liwat sa West Philippine Sea karon sa hapon ukon sa gab-i kag magahulag pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan tubtub magguwa na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility buwas sa aga.
english: After breaking through areas in Northern Luzon, it will reappear in the West Philippine Sea this afternoon or evening and move west northwest until it leaves the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility tomorrow morning.

text: Padayon ini nga magabaskog samtang nga yara sa Philippine Sea.
english: It will continue to strengthen while in the Philippine Sea.

text: Wala man ginadula ang posibilidad nga mahimo ini nga Typhoon antes ang pag-landfall apang mas mataas ang tyansa nga malab-ot sini ang amo nga kabaskugon kun yara na ini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The possibility that it could become a typhoon before landfall is not ruled out but the chances of it reaching that strength are higher when it is in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Gina-trabaho subong ang collaboration sa tunga sang Philippine Basketball Association kag sang National Basketball League sang Australia — ang duha sa pinakagulang nga liga sa Asia-Pacific region.
english: Currently in the works is a collaboration between the Philippine Basketball Association and the National Basketball League of Australia — two of the oldest leagues in the Asia-Pacific region.

text: Suno kay Philippine Basketball Association commissioner Willie Marcial, mismo ang National Basketball League of Australia ang nagpakig-angot sa liga sang Pilipinas para sa posible nga partnership.
english: According to Philippine Basketball Association commissioner Willie Marcial, the National Basketball League of Australia itself contacted the Philippine league for a possible partnership.

text: Lakip sa lauman amo ang potential exhibition game ukon isa ka All-Star selection batok sa team sang Australia.
english: Among those to look forward to is a potential exhibition game or an All-Star selection against the Australian team.

text: Nadiskusyunan man suno kay Marcia ang pagbutang sang clinics kag outreach programs para sa coaches kag referees.
english: Marcia said they also discussed the setting up of clinics and outreach programs for coaches and referees.

text: Kun matandaan, ang National Basketball League amo ang nangin household name para sa Filipinos matapos nga naghampang si Kai Sotto sa Australia para sa Adelaide 36ers.
english: The National Basketball League became a household name for Filipinos after Kai Sotto played in Australia for the Adelaide 36ers.

text: Yara na subong si Sotto sa iya ikaduha nga season sang amo nga liga.
english: Sotto is now in his second season of the league.

text: Yara man si Brian Goorjian nga amo ang most successful coach sa National Basketball League history nga may anum ka championships kag subong naga-compete sa Philippine Basketball Association.
english: There is also Brian Goorjian who is the most successful coach in National Basketball League history with six championships and now competes in the Philippine Basketball Association.

text: 𝗦𝗔𝗡 𝗘𝗡𝗥𝗜𝗤𝗨𝗘, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Padayon pa nga ginapangita sang mga otoridad ang tatlo ka mga suspek nga nag-hold up sa fish vendor sa Barangay Camiri, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: 𝗦𝗔𝗡 𝗘𝗡𝗥𝗜𝗤𝗨𝗘, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Authorities are still searching for three suspects who held up in Barangay Rique Fish Vendor, San Enilo, Ilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Angelyn Pabilona, 42, residente sang Barangay Cabugao Viejo, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Angelyn Pabilona, ​​42, resident of Barangay Cabugao Viejo, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Kaupod man sini ang iya mga kabulig nga sanday Mark Serbesa kag John Biona.
english: He was also accompanied by his assistants Mark Serbesa and John Biona.

text: Suno kay Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, hepe sang San Enrique Municipal Police Station, naghalin sa Passi City ang biktima kaupod sang iya duha ka mga tinawo sakay sang tricycle.
english: According to Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, chief of the San Enrique Municipal Police Station, the victim was traveling from Passi City with his two men on a tricycle.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dalde nga ginbangga-an sang mga suspek ang mga biktima kag gintayaan sang armas kag espading.
english: Dalde said the suspects hit the victims and threatened them with guns and swords.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpalagyo ang mga suspek matapos nakuha ang kwarta nga nagadangat sa P159,000.
english: The suspects immediately fled the scene after recovering the money amounting to P159,000.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮
english: -Al 2014 2014 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮

text: Napabilin sang Bagyo Crising ang kabaskugon sini samtang amat-amat nga nagapalayo sa Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: Typhoon Crising maintained its strength as it slowly moved away from Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sini 125 km nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan ang Calayan, Cagayan.
english: Its center was last seen 125 km west northwest of Calayan, Cagayan.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 85 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 115 km/h.

Nagapabilin sa Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of 85 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 115 km/h.

Remains on Signal No.

text: Mahimo ini magguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility subong nga aga ukon sa temprano nga bahin karon sa hapon.
english: It could appear in the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility this morning or early this afternoon.

text: Antes magguwa, mahimo ini magbaskog pa kag maglab-ot anay sa Severe Tropical Storm category.
english: Before emerging, it may intensify and reach the Severe Tropical Storm category.

text: Excited na ang mga pageant fans subong nga adlaw para sa 57th Grand Coronation Night sang Binibining Pilipinas.
english: Pageant fans are excited today for the 57th Grand Coronation Night of Binibining Pilipinas.

text: 34 ka mga kandidata ang magabida kag maga-agaway para sa apat ka mga korona.
english: 34 contestants will star and fight for the four crowns.

text: Ini amo ang Miss International, Miss Grand International, Miss Globe kag Miss Intercontinental.
english: These are Miss International, Miss Grand International, Miss Globe and Miss Intercontinental.

text: Ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City amo si Binibini 15, Karen Laurrie Mendoza.
english: The representative of Iloilo City is Binibini 15, Karen Laurrie Mendoza.

text: Malantaw ang Binibining Pilipinas las 9:30 karon sa gab-i pinaagi sa livestreaming kag makit-an man diri sa facebook live sang Bombo Radyo.
english: Miss Pilipinas can be watched at 9:30 pm tonight via livestreaming and can also be found here on Bombo Radyo's facebook live.

text: Matandaan nga ginhatagan na sang green light sang Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) ang pagpatigayon sang Binibining Pilipinas coronation night sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: The Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) has given the green light to hold the Binibining Pilipinas coronation night at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text: Ang mga participants ang ginpaidalom sa reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) test bilang requirement man sang IATF.
english: The participants were subjected to a reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) test as a requirement of the IATF.

text: Target ng National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) Region 6 na mapalakas ang kaalaman ng publiko at ng mga lokal na sektor sa kaligtasan ng karne sa nakatakdang pagdiriwang ng 32nd Meat Safety Consciousness Week mula Oktubre 13 hanggang Oktubre 17, kasabay ng kanilang ika-53 anibersaryo.
english: The National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) Region 6 targets to raise public and local sector awareness on meat safety during the scheduled celebration of the 32nd Meat Safety Awareness Week from October 13 to October 17, in conjunction with their 53rd anniversary.

text:
Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Dr. April Chavez, kinumpirma niya na ang selebrasyon ngayong taon ay may temang “Karneng Ligtas at Sapat, tungkulin nating lahat tungo sa masaganang Bagong Pilipinas.”

Ayon sa kanya, nakatuon ito sa pagpapalakas ng sektor ng karne sa buong value chain, mula sa katayan hanggang sa hapag-kainan, kasama ang mga lokal na pamahalaan at iba pang katuwang.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. April Chavez, he confirmed that this year's celebration will have the theme “Safe and Sufficient Meat, our duty towards a prosperous New Philippines.”

According to him, it is focused on strengthening the meat sector along the entire value chain, from slaughterhouse to restaurant, with local government units and other partners.

text: Binanggit ni Chavez na pangunahing misyon ng ahensya ang pangangalaga sa kaligtasan ng konsumer na Pilipino sa pamamagitan ng pagtitiyak na malinis at ligtas ang karne na ibinebenta sa pamilihan.
english: Chavez said the agency's main mission is to protect the safety of Filipino consumers by ensuring that the meat sold in the market is clean and safe.

text: Gayunman, inamin din niyang nananatiling hamon ang pagpapabuti ng mga pasilidad sa katayan.
english: However, he also acknowledged that improving the facilities in the cemetery remains a challenge.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, dalawang lisensyadong slaughterhouse lamang ang mayroon sa Region 6, subalit may nakalatag nang plano na madagdagan pa ito sa tulong ng Department of Agriculture.
english: Currently, there are only two licensed slaughterhouses in Region 6, but there are plans to increase them with the help of the Department of Agriculture.

text:
Ipinaliwanag din niya na ang NMIS ang may responsibilidad sa paglilisensya at pagkilala sa mga slaughterhouse na nakapasa sa pamantayan ng meat safety and quality, at ito ay ikinoklasipika bilang Class A, Double A, o Triple A.

Dagdag pa ni Chavez, mahalaga ang patuloy na partisipasyon ng mga lokal na pamahalaan upang masiguro na ang sektor ng karne ay nananatiling ligtas, sapat, at maayos para sa lahat ng mamimili.
english:
He also explained that the NMIS is responsible for licensing and identifying slaughterhouses that pass meat safety and quality standards, and these are classified as Class A, Double A, or Triple A.

Chavez added that the continued participation of local government units is essential to ensure that the meat sector remains safe, sufficient, and efficient for all consumers.

text: (Interviewed By Bombo Donnie Degala/ Bombohanay Bigtime)
english: (Interviewed By Bombo Donnie Degala/ Bombohanay Bigtime)

text: Gintumod sang gobyerno nga ang mas maayo nga patubas kag manami nga buying prices ang nagpataas sang palay procurement sang National Food Authority (NFA) sang 263.9 percent sang October.
english: The government pointed out that better yields and favorable buying prices increased the rice procurement of the National Food Authority (NFA) by 263.9 percent in October.

text: Suno sa ahensya, nakabakal ini ang 2.5 million bags (123,561 metric tons) sang humay halin sa local farmers sang October gikan sa 679,024 bags (33,951.2 MT) sa amo man nga bulan sang 2023.
english: The agency said it purchased 2.5 million bags (123,561 metric tons) of rice from local farmers in October from 679,024 bags (33,951.2 MT) in the same month of 2023.

text: Ang volume ang katumbas sang 79.98 percent sa target nga 3.1 million bags (154,497.5 MT) para sa period.
english: The volume was 79.98 percent of the target of 3.1 million bags (154,497.5 MT) for the period.

text: Suno sa NFA, ang mas mataas nga procurement ang resulta sang produktibo ng harvest sang main cropping season kag ang pagpatuman sang NFA Council-approved Price Range Scheme (Pricers) para sa palay procurement activity.
english: According to the NFA, the higher procurement is the result of the productive harvest of the main cropping season and the implementation of the NFA Council-approved Price Range Scheme (Pricers) for rice procurement activity.

text: Ini nagabulig sa NFA nga matumod ang buying price sang palay per province sa competitive price level.
english: This helps the NFA to determine the buying price of rice per province at a competitive price level.

text: Ang buying price naga-range sa P23 tubtob P25 per kilogram agud mapanubo ang retail price sini samtang ginatungdan ang mandato sa pag- maintain sang national rice buffer stock para sa calamity response ukon disaster relief operations.
english: The buying price ranges from P23 to P25 per kilogram to reduce its retail price while meeting the mandate to maintain the national rice buffer stock for calamity response or disaster relief operations.

text: Ginakabig ni Argentinian football star Leonil Messi nga World Cup favorites ang team nagikan sa Brazil, France, kag Germany.
english: Argentine football star Leonil Messi considers the team from Brazil, France, and Germany to be World Cup favorites.

text: Ini nga mga pungsod ang makabig daku nga balabag sa handum ni Messi nga madugang na ang World Cup winners’ medal sa iya trophy cabinet.
english: These countries are considered a major obstacle to Messi's dream of adding the World Cup winners' medal to his trophy cabinet.

text: Ang 35-anyos nga Paris St.
english: The 35-year-old Paris St.

text: Germain forward amo ang magatib-ong sa pungsod Argentina sa World Cup sa Qatar.
english: The Germain forward will lead Argentina at the World Cup in Qatar.

text: Pananglitan sila ang magadaog, ini na ang third world title sang Argentina sa tournament kag una halin sang 1986.
english: If they win, it will be Argentina's third world title in the tournament and first since 1986.

text: Madumduman nga sang 2014, nakaabot na si Messi kag ang Argentina sa final game apang nag-suprer sang extra-time defeat sa Germany.
english: In 2014, Messi and Argentina reached the final game but suffered an extra-time defeat to Germany.

text: Una nga makasumpong sang Argentina ang Saudia Arabia sa Group C antes sini atubangon ang Mexico kag ang Poland.
english: Argentina will face Saudia Arabia first in Group C before facing Mexico and Poland.

text: Magabukas na ang tournament sa Nobyembre 20 sa Qatar.
english: The tournament will open on November 20 in Qatar.

text: Ginsabat sang aktor nga si Joem Bascon ang pamangkot kun bala nangin unfaithful ini sa isa ka relasyon.
english: Actor Joem Bascon answered the question of whether he was unfaithful in a relationship.

text: Suno kay Joem, sang lamharon pa ang iya edad, masiling niya nga may mga kahigayunan nga wala siya nangin tampad sa iya nga ka-relasyon.
english: According to Joem, when he was young, he can say that there were times when he was not honest with his relationship.

text: Apang sang yara na sa insakto nga edad ang aktor, ginpahayag sini nga kun magsulod siya sa relasyon, stick-to-one na lamang ini apang kun kinahanglan mag-move on, ginahimo niya ang masarangan agud nga padayunon ang iya kabuhi.
english: But when the actor reached the right age, he said that if he entered a relationship, it would be stick-to-one but if he had to move on, he would do his best to continue his life.

text: Matandaan nga nangin sentro si Joem sang pagpang-bash sang nagbulagay sila sang vlogger nga si Crisha Uy kag ginkakibot ang balita nga nagbalik ini sa iya sadto ex-girlfriend nga si Meryll Soriano kag nakaangkon sang anak.
english: Joem became the center of bashing when he broke up with vlogger Crisha Uy and was shocked by the news that he returned to his ex-girlfriend Meryll Soriano and had a child.

text: Matandaan nga sang Enero, ginkumpirma man ni Meryll nga nagbalikanay sila ni Joem.
english: In January, Meryll also confirmed that she and Joem were back together.

text: Nakadepende na sa tawo pahayag ni Joem kun ano man ang ihambal batuk sa iya bangud mas pilion niya nga maghipos kag indi na pag-isapubiliko ang iya nga rason.
english: Joem said it is up to the person whatever is said against him because he prefers to remain silent and not make his reasons public.

text: Sa subong, luyag lang sang aktor nga mangin maayo ang ikaayong lawas sang iya nga pamilya.
english: For now, the actor just wants his family to be healthy.

text: Dakop sa buybust operation ang isa ka High-Value Individual (HVI) sa Brgy.
english: A High-Value Individual (HVI) was arrested in a buybust operation in Brgy.

text: Poblacion South, Oton, Iloilo, pasado alas 12:50 sang udto, Hulyo 18, 2025.
english: Poblacion South, Oton, Iloilo, around 12:50 pm, July 18, 2025.

text: Ginkilala ang subject kay alyas “Juriel”, 30-anyos, may ka live-in partner kag residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The subject was identified as alias “Juriel”, 30 years old, has a live-in partner and resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga operasyon, narecover sa iya posesyon ang isa ka sachet nga buy-bust item, walo ka daku nga heat-sealed sachets sang suspected shabu, kag pila ka mga indi droga nga items.
english: During the operation, one sachet of buy-bust item, eight large heat-sealed sachets of suspected shabu, and several non-drug items were recovered from his possession.

text: Ginabulubanta may kabug-aton nga MOL 125 gramos ang nakuha nga suspected shabu nga nagakantidad sang P850,000 base sa standard drug price nga P6,800 kada gramo.
english: The suspected shabu weighed 125 grams and was worth P850,000 based on the standard drug price of P6,800 per gram.

text: Sa subong, gin ipadalum ini sa medical examination kag booking procedures antes pasakaan sang kaso sa paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act 2002.
english: He is currently undergoing medical examination and booking procedures before being charged with violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act 2002.

text: By: Bombo Krylle Melliza
english: By: Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Nagpalupad ang Israeli warplanes sang ginatos ka mga airstrikes sa palibot sang Syria kalakip na ang kapital sini nga Damascus.
english: Israeli warplanes have flown hundreds of airstrikes around Syria including its capital Damascus.

text: Suno sa UK-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR), nakarecord sila sang masobra 310 strikes sang Israel Defense Forces (IDF) humalin sang napahalin si Bashar al Assad.
english: According to the UK-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR), they have recorded more than 310 strikes by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) since Bashar al Assad was ousted.

text: Samtang, ginkumpirma sang Israel Defense Forces nga may mga tropa sila nga naga- operate sa Syrian territory sa gwa sang demilitarized buffer zone sa tunga sang Syria kag Israeli-occupied Golan Heights.
english: Meanwhile, the Israel Defense Forces confirmed that they have troops operating in Syrian territory outside the demilitarized buffer zone between Syria and the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights.

text: Gindugang sini nga ang strikes may katuyuan nga punggan ang mga armas nga magtupa sa kamot sang mga extremists samtang nga yara ang Syria sa transisyon padulong sa post-Assad era.
english: He added that the strikes aim to prevent weapons from falling into the hands of extremists as Syria is in transition towards the post-Assad era.

text: Ginreport man sang Syrian Observatory for Human Rights nga ang atake ang nagsakop sang Aleppo, Damascus kag Hama.
english: The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights also reported that the attack covered Aleppo, Damascus and Hama.

text: Gin-target nila ang military facilities sang Syrian Army, kalakip na ang weapon warehouses, ammunition depots, airports, naval bases kag research centres.
english: They targeted Syrian Army military facilities, including weapon warehouses, ammunition depots, airports, naval bases and research centres.

text: Suno pa sa reports, madamo nga mga pasilidad nga naigo ang naubos gid was-ag.
english: According to reports, many of the affected facilities were completely destroyed.

text: Magabisita si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will visit.

text: sa “ground zero” kun sa diin nag-igo ang magnitude 6.9 nga linog sa Cebu.
english: at ground zero where the magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck Cebu.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office Chief Dave Gomez, nauna na ang pila ka mga cabinet secretaries nagpadulong sa lugar agud maghatag sang nagakaigo nga bulig sa mga naapektuhan.
english: According to Presidential Communications Office Chief Dave Gomez, several cabinet secretaries have already visited the area to provide appropriate assistance to the affected.

text: Dugang pa ni Gomez nga ginakasubo sang presidente ang natabo nga insidente kag nagpalab-ot man ini sang simpatiya sa mga biktima.
english: Gomez said the president regrets the incident and expressed his sympathy to the victims.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang presidente nga magabulig ang national government sa local government units nga apektado sang linog.
english: The president also assured that the national government will assist local government units affected by the earthquake.

text: Gilayon man nga ginmanduan sang Presidente ang mga lideres sang frontline government agencies nga gilayon nga buligan ang mga apektado sang linog.
english: The President also immediately instructed the leaders of frontline government agencies to immediately assist those affected by the earthquake.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagsaka na sa 69 ang numero sang mga napatay sa nasambit nga linog.
english: The death toll from the quake has risen to 69.

text: Sa amo nga numero, 30 ang na-record sa Bogo, 22 sa San Remigio, 10 sa Medellin, kag isa sa Sogod, isa man sa Tabuelan, kag lima sa Tabogon.
english: Of these, 30 were recorded in Bogo, 22 in San Remigio, 10 in Medellin, and one in Sogod, one in Tabuelan, and five in Tabogon.

text: Suno sa Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), ginabulubanta 27 ka pamilya ang apektado sang linog sa Northern Cebu.
english: According to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), an estimated 27 families were affected by the earthquake in Northern Cebu.

text: Samtang, nagdangat naman sa P2 billion ang infrastructure damage nga ginbilin sang nasambit nga linog.
english: Meanwhile, the infrastructure damage caused by the quake reached P2 billion.

text: Ginlampaso liwat sang Pilipinas ang home team nga Saudi Arabia sa liwat nga pagkit-anay sa 2023 Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
english: The Philippines once again beat home team Saudi Arabia in a rematch in the 2023 Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers.

text: Kun sa una nga pagkit-anay sa Pilipinas, may 38 ka puntos ini nga abanse, wala naman nangin mahapos ang kadalag-an para sa Gilas sang yara na sa fifth window sang hampang batok sa home team sa Jeddah apang nagtapos sa gihapon ang match pabor sa Pilipinas, 76-63.
english: If in the first meeting with the Philippines, it had a 38-point lead, the victory was not easy for Gilas when it was in the fifth window of the game against the home team in Jeddah but the match still ended in favor of the Philippines, 76-63.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Roger Pogoy ang Filipinos paagi sa iya nga 13 points kag 4 rebounds.
english: Roger Pogoy led the Filipinos with 13 points and 4 rebounds.

text: Nagdugang si Kai Sotto sang 11 points, 9 rebounds kag 5 blocks samntang nag-chip naman si Scottie Thompson sang 9 points, 9 boards, 3 assists, kag 2 steals.
english: Kai Sotto added 11 points, 9 rebounds and 5 blocks while Scottie Thompson chipped in 9 points, 9 boards, 3 assists, and 2 steals.

text: Ini na ang ikalima nga daog sang Pilipinas sa walo ka hampang kag yara na sa ika-tatlo nga pwesto sa Group E sa likod sang co-leaders nga Lebanon kag New Zealand.
english: This is the Philippines' fifth win in eight games and is third in Group E behind co-leaders Lebanon and New Zealand.

text: Sang Agusto 29, matandaan nga ginlutos man sang Pilipinas ang Saudi, 84-46, sa 23-point performance ni Jordan Clarkson sa SM Mall of Asia Arena.
english: On August 29, the Philippines also defeated Saudi Arabia, 84-46, with a 23-point performance by Jordan Clarkson at the SM Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Nagalaum ang business sector nga matapna sang masunod nga administrasyon ang madata nga smuggling sang agricultural products sa Pilipinas nga direkta nga nagaapekto sa local farmers.
english: The business sector hopes that the next administration will stop the rampant smuggling of agricultural products in the Philippines that directly affects local farmers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Terence Uygongco, spokesperson sang business organization nga Iloilo Economic Development Foundation Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Terence Uygongco, spokesperson of the business organization Iloilo Economic Development Foundation Inc.

text: (ILEDF), iya ginpahayag nga may naga-eksister na nga layi agud ma-address ini nga problema apang kinahanglan nga pabaskugon ang enforcement.
english: (ILEDF), he said there is already an existing law to address this problem but enforcement needs to be strengthened.

text: Suno kay Uygongco, dapat nga mas mangin vigilante ang government agencies sa pag-check sang mga produkto nga naga-guwa sulod sa pungsod.
english: Uygongco said government agencies should be more vigilant in checking products coming out of the country.

text: Ginpaathag sini nga labi ini nga kinahanglanon sang mga mangunguma bangud mahal na nga daan ang presyo sang ila mga binhi kag ginagamit nga abono kag nagakadapat lang nga baklon man ang produkto sa husto nga presyo.
english: He explained that this is especially needed by farmers because the price of their seeds and fertilizers is already expensive and they should buy the product at the right price.

text: Ang Department of Justice (DOJ) ang una na nagpasalig nga gina-imbestigaran na ang ginapahayag smuggling sang agricultural products lakip na ang alleged misdeclaration sang goods kag undervaluation.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) earlier assured that it is investigating the alleged smuggling of agricultural products including alleged misdeclaration of goods and undervaluation.

text: Ang ARTA ukon Anti-Red Tape Authority ang nagabulig man sa pag-imbestigar sa government kag private sectors nga gin-alegar may partisipasyon man sa agricultural smuggling activities.
english: The ARTA or Anti-Red Tape Authority is also helping to investigate the government and private sectors that are allegedly involved in agricultural smuggling activities.

text: May yara man sang separado nga imbestigasyon batok sa ginapahayag iligal nga pagpasulod sang palm oil sa Pilipinas.
english: There is also a separate investigation into the alleged illegal entry of palm oil into the Philippines.

text: May mga opisyal pa sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga ginapahayag lakip sa mga kahimbon sang smugglers.
english: There are also officials of the Department of Agriculture (DA) who are allegedly among the accomplices of the smugglers.

text: Sa bahin ni presumptive president Bongbong Marcos, ginabulubantayan pa subong kun sin-o ang potential nominees ukon ang pinal nga iga-appoint nga magapamuno sa crucial agencies sa pagtapna sa sini nga problema — ang DA kag ang Bureau of Customs.
english: For the part of presumptive president Bongbong Marcos, the potential nominees or the final appointees to head the crucial agencies in tackling this problem — the DA and the Bureau of Customs — are still being monitored.

text: Ginakadlawan na lang sang aktres nga si Jessy Mendiola kun iya madumduman ang sadto nagapangaluyag sa iya sang siya ang ginregalohan sang underwear.
english: Actress Jessy Mendiola laughs when she remembers her boyfriend giving her underwear as a gift.

text: Suno kay Jessy, nakibot kag naweirduhan siya bangud nakahibalo mismo ang nagapangaluyag sa iya sang insakto nga size sang iya nga underwear apisar nga wala man niya ini ginhambalan.
english: According to Jessy, she was surprised and surprised because her boyfriend knew the exact size of her underwear even though she didn't tell him.

text: Ginpamangkot mismo sang aktres ang lalaki kun paano sini nahibaluan ang size sang iya underwear kag suno sa lalaki, ginlantaw niya mismo sa closet ang underwear ni Jessy.
english: The actress asked the man how he knew the size of her underwear and according to the man, he looked at Jessy's underwear in the closet.

text: Apisar nga weird pahayag sang aktres, ginbaton man niya ang underwear.
english: Despite the weird statement of the actress, she also accepted the underwear.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong kasal na ang aktres sa host kag actor nga si Luis Manzano.
english: The actress is currently married to host and actor Luis Manzano.

text: Patay ang 180 ka mga tawo sa Cite Soleil area sa Haiti bangud sa massacre nga ginaalegar nga ginmandu sang lider sang isa ka gang.
english: At least 180 people have been killed in Haiti's Cite Soleil area in a massacre allegedly ordered by a gang leader.

text: Kalabanan sa mga biktima amo ang mga tigulang suno sa data sang National Human Rights Defense Network.
english: Most of the victims were the elderly according to data from the National Human Rights Defense Network.

text: Suno sa opisina sang Prime Minister, ginhulag na nila ang tanan nga pwersa sang gobyerno para mapangita ang responsable sa krimen lakip na mismo ang Wharf Jeremie gang leader nga si Monel “Mikano” Felix.
english: According to the Prime Minister's office, they have mobilized all government forces to find those responsible for the crime including the Wharf Jeremie gang leader Monel “Mikano” Felix.

text: Ginalantaw nga magdamo pa ang casualties bangud sa reports nga may mga lawas pa nga ginpangsunog sa mga dalan lakip na ang mga mas bataon nga residente nga nagtuyo kuntani nga magluwas sa ila mga kaupdanan.
english: The casualties are expected to rise due to reports of bodies being burned in the streets including younger residents who tried to rescue their companions.

text: Base sa nagaguwa nga imbestigasyon, ginmandu sang gang leader ang massacre bangud nagmasakit ang iya anak kag ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: According to the investigation, the gang leader ordered the massacre because his son became ill and died.

text: Ginapatihan sini nga ang balatian sang bata ang resulta sang pagpanghiwit sang mga tigulang sa Cite Soleil area.
english: He believes that the child's illness is the result of witchcraft by the elders in the Cite Soleil area.

text: Padayon pa subong ang pagkumpirma sa data sang mga napatay kag posible nga survivors halin sa amo nga lugar.
english: The data of the dead and possible survivors from the area are still being confirmed.

text: Nagpagwa sang direktiba si Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas sa Iloilo City Health Office (ICHO) nga magsugod sang pagpanagtag sang doxycycline nga ginakabig nga prophylaxis ukon bulong nga naga protektar batok sa leptospirosis.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas has issued a directive to the Iloilo City Health Office (ICHO) to start distributing doxycycline which is considered a prophylaxis or drug that protects against leptospirosis.

text: Ini kasunod man sa nagaluntad nga pagbaha sa pila ka syudad sang Iloilo.
english: This follows the ongoing flooding in some cities of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga unahon nga hatagan ang lima ka mga barangay nga apektado sa pagbaha amo nga ginalakipan sang Camalig, Balantang, Tagbak, Lanit, kag Buntatala.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that priority will be given to the five barangays affected by the floods, namely Camalig, Balantang, Tagbak, Lanit, and Buntatala.

text: Ginklaro man niya nga bukas sa tanan nga mga kabarangayan sa syudad ang bulong batok sa leptospirosis, kag mahimo makipag-angot sa pinakamalapit nga health center kag mga Barangay Health Workers para sa pagbaton sang libre nga Doxycycline.
english: He also clarified that the drug against leptospirosis is open to all barangays in the city, and can contact the nearest health center and Barangay Health Workers to receive free Doxycycline.

text: Ginapanawagan man sini sa mga pumuluyo nga magbaton sang mga ginapanghatag nga mga bulong bilang dugang proteksyon sa balatian nga leptospirosis, nga masami makuha sa tubig baha nga may halo nga ihi sang ilaga.
english: It also calls on residents to receive the distributed medicines as additional protection against the disease leptospirosis, which is often contracted from flood water mixed with rat urine.

text: Nagapahanumdom man ang syudad sa publiko nga bantayan ang ila lawas kag magpakonsulta gilayon sa health centers kun may nabatyagan nga sintomas sang leptospirosis, pareho sang hilanat, sakit sang kalawasan, ukon palanakit sang mata.
english: The city also reminds the public to monitor their health and consult health centers immediately if they experience symptoms of leptospirosis, such as fever, body aches, or eye pain.

text: Padayon ang serbisyo kag pagbulig sang syudad sa mga apektado, kag ginapasalig sang lokal nga gobyerno nga wala sang ginapabay-an sa tunga sang krisis.
english: The city continues to provide services and assistance to the affected, and the local government assures that no one is being neglected in the midst of the crisis.

text: 𝗢𝗧𝗢𝗡, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Wala sang nakita ang kapulisan nga patimaan sang foul play sa kamatayon sang lalaki nga nasapwan sa kilid sang baybay sang Poblacion East, Oton, Iloilo.
english: October – Police found no signs of foul play in the death of a man found on the beach in Poblacion East, Oton, Iloilo.

english: The victim was identified as Marcelino Todorejos Sr., 59, married, resident of Barangay Poblacion South, Oton, Iloilo and works as a laborer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Fritz Desbaro, imbestigador sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa ila pagpangusisa, nakita sang isa ka manugpangisda ang biktima nga wala na sang kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Fritz Desbaro, investigator of the Oton Municipal Police Station, said that based on their investigation, a fisherman found the victim dead.

text: Suno kay Desbaro, gintuad mismo sang misis sang biktima nga masami ini nga naga-inom.
english: According to Desbaro, the victim's wife admitted that he often drinks.

text: Antes ini nasapwan nga patay, naglesensya pa ang biktima sa iya misis nga matsikyar sang iya trisikad, apang wala na ini makapauli.
english: Before he was found dead, the victim asked his wife for permission to check his tricycle, but he did not return home.

text: Possible suno sa natungdan nga bangud sa kahulugbon, wala na nakontrol sang biktima ang iya kaugalingon kag nahulog sa seawall.
english: It is possible that due to drunkenness, the victim lost control of himself and fell into the seawall.

text: Ginpahayag sang pulis nga may nakita sila nga pilas sa kamot sang biktima nga tuga sang mga lansang sa lugar.
english: Police said they found a wound on the victim's hand caused by nails at the scene.

text: ‘One Strong Momma’ ang aktres nga si Nadine Samonte nga sadto anay kilala bilang isa sa mga kapid sa bantog nga drama fantasy series nga ginaidolo sang mga kabataan.
english: ‘One Strong Momma’ is actress Nadine Samonte who was once known as one of the twins in the famous drama fantasy series that children idolize.

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, ginpakigbahin ni Nadine ang kabudlayan sa iya pagbusong sa ikatatlo niya nga baby.
english: In an Instagram post, Nadine shared the difficulty of being pregnant with her third baby.

text: Ginbuyagyag sang aktres nga ginapakigbatuan niya ang polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), isa ka kondisyon nga nagaapekto sa hormone levels sang mga babaye.
english: The actress revealed that she battles polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a condition that affects women’s hormone levels.

text: May ara man siya sang antiphospholipid syndrome (APAS), isa ka disorder sa immune system nga nagatuga sang kumplikasyon sa pagbusong sang mga mommies.
english: She also has antiphospholipid syndrome (APAS), an immune system disorder that causes pregnancy complications for mommies.

text: “Everyday is a struggle but its more of a blessing.
english: “Everyday is a struggle but its more of a blessing.

text: Feeling my tummy grow everyday is what im thankful for.
english: Feeling my tummy grow everyday is what he’s thankful for.

text: Thank you Lord for our 3rd baby.
english: Thank you Lord for our 3rd baby.

text: Yes, I still have PCOS and mostly APAS.
english: Yes, I still have PCOS and mostly APAS.

text: This journey is particularly different from my 2 kids,” kabahin sang Instagram post ni Nadine.
english: This journey is particularly different from my 2 kids,” part of Nadine’s Instagram post.

text: Suno kay Nadine, diutayan lang siya nga mahulugan sa first trimister bangud lain ang iya nga sitwasyon ipaanggid sang ginbusong niya ang iya una nga duha ka anak.
english: According to Nadine, she almost missed her first trimester because her situation was different compared to when she was pregnant with her first two children.

text: Madamo man ang hibi suno sa aktres apang wala siya nagareklamo kag gin-engganyo man sini ang iban nga mga iloy nga may kaangay nga kondisyon nga magbato gid para sa ila nga mga kabataan.
english: The actress said she cried a lot but she did not complain and encouraged other mothers with similar conditions to fight for their children.

text: “Ang dami kong iniyak sa journey na to hehe pero i wont give up EVER!
english: “I cried a lot on this journey hehe but I won't give up EVER!

text: Ill fight and stay strong for them!!!
english: Ill fight and stay strong for them!!!

text: Go APAS and PCOS mommas out there.
english: Go APAS and PCOS mommas out there.

text: Kaya natin to!,” dugang pa sang aktres.
english: We can do it!,” the actress added.

text: Positibo ang business sector nga maga-appoint si presumptive President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The business sector is positive that presumptive President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: sang economic manager nga amo ang magapanguna sa pag-oversee sa pagpabangon sa ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: of the economic manager who will lead the oversight of the country's economic recovery.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Terence Uygongco, spokesperson sang business organization nga Iloilo Economic Development Foundation Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Terence Uygongco, spokesperson of the business organization Iloilo Economic Development Foundation Inc.

text: (ILEDF), iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa economic team ni Marcos, ginabantayan subong sang business groups ang economic priorities sang bag-o nga administrasyon.
english: (ILEDF), he said that besides Marcos' economic team, business groups are now monitoring the economic priorities of the new administration.

text: Ginplastar ni Uygongco nga magluwas sa domestic consumption, ang foreign remittances ukon ang remittances sang overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) kag ang Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector amo ang duha sa mayor nga contributor sa gross domestic product (GDP) growth sang pungsod.
english: Uygongco pointed out that besides domestic consumption, foreign remittances or the remittances of overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and the Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector are two of the major contributors to the country's gross domestic product (GDP) growth.

text: Dapat siguraduhon sang Marcos administration suno kay Uygongco nga aktibo kag nagauswag pa gid ang kontribusyon sining duha agud nga mapabilin nga indi marumpag ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: Uygongco said the Marcos administration should ensure that the contribution of these two is active and growing in order to keep the country's economy afloat.

text: Ang BPO amo ang ginapahayag nagbulig sustinir sa ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sa tunga sang pandemya kag lakip diri ang bulig sang call centers, insurance, life sciences, healthcare, kag data analytics.
english: BPO is said to have helped sustain the Philippine economy amid the pandemic and includes the help of call centers, insurance, life sciences, healthcare, and data analytics.

text: Una na nagpasalig si Marcos nga nagapanguna sa priority list sa potential appointments amo ang economic managers bangud ini nga team amo ang magapabulig sa pungsod sa tunga sang pandemya kag economic crisis.
english: Earlier, Marcos assured that the economic managers are at the top of the priority list of potential appointments because this team will help the country in the midst of the pandemic and economic crisis.

text: Limitado subong ang hulag sang mga Pinoy sa Syria sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga tensyon matapos ang pag-agaw sang mga rebelde sang poder gikan kay Presidente Bashar al Assad.
english: The movement of Filipinos in Syria is now limited amid ongoing tensions after the rebels seized power from President Bashar al Assad.

text: Base sa deklarasyon sang Syrian rebels, gintapos na nila ang 24 ka tuig nga pagginahum kag diktadorya ni al- Assad.
english: Based on the declaration of the Syrian rebels, they have ended 24 years of rule and dictatorship of al- Assad.

text: Si al-Assad ang nagpalagyo kag nagpadulong sa Russia.
english: It was al-Assad who fled and headed for Russia.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Nenita Calambro direkta sa Damascus, Syria, nag-abiso ang Philippine Embassy sa mga Pinoy nga likawan anay ang maggwa sa samtang wala pa nagbalik sa normal ang sitwasyon.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Nenita Calambro directly in Damascus, Syria, the Philippine Embassy has warned Filipinos to avoid going out until the situation returns to normal.

text: Ginpahayag ni Calambro nga may mabatian pa sila nga mga lupok sang pusil kag bomba kag maswerte nga wala gid matandog ang ila ginaistaran.
english: Calambro said they still heard gunshots and bombs and fortunately their house was not affected.

text: Dugang niya, sa subong,nagaamat-amat na nga nagatahaw ang linukpanay kag kinagamo.
english: He added that, at present, the riots and riots are slowly escalating.

text: Samtang ginpahayag naman ni Calambro, may yara man sang isa ka Pinay domestic helper nga ginbayaansang iya employers kag gin-abisuhan sang embahada nga kun makapangita sang tiempo, magpadulong na lang sa Philippine embassy.
english: Meanwhile, Calambro said there was also a Filipina domestic helper who was abandoned by her employers and was advised by the embassy to go to the Philippine embassy if she could find time.

text: Si Calambro ang tumandok sang Alimodian kag nagatrabaho sa Syria bilang isa ka caregiver sa sulod na sang malapit 15 ka tuig.
english: Calambro is a native of Alimodian and has been working in Syria as a caregiver for nearly 15 years.

text: Nagsungka na sa National Bureau of Investigation ang duwa ka mga ginatudlo nga suspek sa pagpatay kay former Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office Board Secretary Wesley Barayuga.
english: Two alleged suspects in the murder of former Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office Board Secretary Wesley Barayuga have surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation.

text: Suno sa ahensya, una nagsungka sa NBI-Organized Transactional Crime Division si Nelson Mariano sang Septyembre 29 kag ginsundan naman ni PtlCol.
english: According to the agency, Nelson Mariano first surrendered to the NBI-Organized Transactional Crime Division on September 29 followed by PtlCol.

text: Santie Mendoza.
english: Santie Mendoza.

text: Boluntaryo nga nagsungka duwa matapos magpagwa sang warrant of arrest ang korte batok sa ila.
english: The two voluntarily surrendered after the court issued a warrant of arrest against them.

text: Matandaan nga patay sang gintiro si Atty. Barayuga sang mga riding-in-tandem suspects sang Hulyo 30, 2020 sa Mandaluyong City.
english: It can be recalled that Atty. Barayuga of riding-in-tandem suspects on July 30, 2020 in Mandaluyong City.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga joint investigation sang Department of Justice, NBI, kag Philippine National Police, naggwa nga ang anay opisyal sang PNP nga si Royina Garma ang sa likod sang krimen base sa panuaron sang mga testigo.
english: A joint investigation conducted by the Department of Justice, NBI, and Philippine National Police revealed that former PNP officer Royina Garma was behind the crime based on the testimony of witnesses.

text: Subong nga adlaw, ginpresentar sang NBI sa pagpanguna ni NBI Dir.
english: Today, the NBI led by NBI Dir.

text: Jaime Santiago, ang duwa ka mga suspek.
english: Jaime Santiago, the two suspects.

text: Gin-abisuhan sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) ang mga Pinoy sa Syria nga ipabilin nga bukas ang komunikasyon sa Philippine Embassy sa Damascus matapos nakumpirma nga nagdaog ang mga rebelde kag napahalin na sa pwesto si President Bashar al-Assad.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has advised Filipinos in Syria to keep communication open with the Philippine Embassy in Damascus after it was confirmed that the rebels won and President Bashar al-Assad was ousted.

text: Sa statement sang ahensya, ginpahayag ang kahangawa sa sitwasyon sang mga Pilipino sa pungsod.
english: In a statement, the agency expressed concern over the situation of Filipinos in the country.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa duha ka mga partido nga likawan ang mga kalakasan para nga wala sang casualties sa mga sibilyan.
english: He also called on both parties to refrain from violence so that there are no civilian casualties.

text: “We express concern regarding the situation of our Filipinos in Syria and advise them to take the necessary precautions and stay in contact with the Philippine Embassy in Damascus,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “We express concern regarding the situation of our Filipinos in Syria and advise them to take the necessary precautions and stay in contact with the Philippine Embassy in Damascus,” the statement said.

text: “The Department of Foreign Affairs continues to monitor, with concern, ongoing developments in Syria,” suno pa sa agency.
english: “The Department of Foreign Affairs continues to monitor, with concern, ongoing developments in Syria,” the agency said.

text:
“The Philippines calls on all concerned parties to exercise restraint and refrain from further violence, to avert further casualties and deaths of civilians.”

Ginsiling man sang ahensya nga padayon ang ila nga pag-monitor sa sitwasyon sa Syria matapos na gindeklarar sang rebelde ang kadalag-an, napatal-as ang presidente, kag nakuha ang control sa Damascus nga amo ang kapital sang pungsod.
english:
“The Philippines calls on all concerned parties to exercise restraint and refrain from further violence, to avert further casualties and deaths of civilians.”

The agency also said it continues to monitor the situation in Syria after the rebels declared victory, ousted the president, and took control of Damascus, the country's capital.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa record sang DFA, may 743 ka mga Pinoy nga yara sa Syria.
english: According to DFA records, there are 743 Filipinos in Syria.

text: Base sa deklarasyon sang Syrian rebels, gintapos na nila ang 24 ka tuig nga pagginahum ni Assad kag ginapatigayon na nila subong ang mga operasyon batok sa “terrorist groups” sa Hama kag Homs kag sa Deraa.
english: Based on the declaration of the Syrian rebels, they have ended 24 years of Assad's rule and are now conducting operations against "terrorist groups" in Hama and Homs and in Deraa.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginkumpirma naman sang Russian media nga nakaabot na sa Moscow si Assad kag ang iya pamilya matapos nga ginhatagan sang asylum kasunod sang ila pagtal-as sa Syria.
english: Meanwhile, Russian media confirmed that Assad and his family have arrived in Moscow after being granted asylum following their uprising in Syria.

text: Ginpahayag nga gin-base sa humanitarian grounds ang asylum nga ginhatag sa Syrian president.#
english: The asylum granted to the Syrian president was reportedly based on humanitarian grounds.

text: 𝗢𝗧𝗢𝗡, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Masami nga nagalagaw sa tion sang kagab-ihon kag kaagahon na kun magpauli ang lalaki nga nasapwan patay sa kilid sang baybay sang Barangay Poblacion East, Oton, Iloilo.
english: 𝗢𝗧𝗢𝗡, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The man who was found dead on the beach in Barangay Poblacion East, Oton, Iloilo was often walking around at night and early in the morning when he returned home.

text: Ang biktima amo si Marcelino Todorejos Sr., 59, kasado, residente sang Barangay Poblacion South, Oton, Iloilo kag nagatrabaho bilang laborer.
english: The victim was identified as Marcelino Todorejos Sr., 59, married, resident of Barangay Poblacion South, Oton, Iloilo and works as a laborer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mary Jane Todorejos, anak sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga naka-updanay pa sila kahapon sang iya amay nga nagpang-scrap sa C1 Road kag matapos sini, nagkaon pa sila sang Batchoy kag Halo-Halo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mary Jane Todorejos, the victim's daughter, said she and her father were scrapping on C1 Road yesterday and after that, they ate Batchoy and Halo-Halo.

text: Suno kay Mary Jane, nag-una ini pauli sa ila balay kag nagpadulong sa balay sang iya hinablos.
english: According to Mary Jane, he went home first and went to his nephew's house.

text: Samtang, wala naman ini sang ideya kun sa diin nagpadulong ang iya amay.
english: Meanwhile, he has no idea where his father went.

text: Kampante man ini nga mapauli man ang iya amay bangud masami nga kaagahon na niya ini pirme nga maabtan sa ila balay.
english: He is also confident that his father will come home because he often finds him at home early in the morning.

text: Subong nga adlaw, plano pa nila kuntani sang iya amay nga magpang-scrap sa liwat.
english: Today, he and his father were planning to scrap again.

text: Apang, amo na lang ang iya kasubo matapos ginpahibalo sang iya iloy nga nasapwan na nga patay ang ila amay.
english: However, his grief ended after his mother informed him that their father had been found dead.

text: Nagpanugyan si Socioeconomic Planning Secretary kag National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Karl Kendrick Chua sa kampo ni presumptive president Bongbong Marcos nga i-outline na ang iya nga mga plano kun paano i-dumala ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: Socioeconomic Planning Secretary and National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Karl Kendrick Chua has advised the camp of presumptive president Bongbong Marcos to outline his plans on how to manage the Philippine economy.

text: Ini agud nga masabat na ang pila ka pagpangalag-ag sang mga investors.
english: This is to address some of the hesitations of investors.

text: Ginpaathag ni Chua nga natural lang nga kun may paglain sa administrasyon, may kahangawa kag may mga concern ang mga investors.
english: Chua explained that it is natural that when there is a change in administration, investors have concerns.

text: Ginapahayag nga may yara sang “wait-and-see attitude” ang mga investors samtang nagahulat sa detalye sang mga polisa kag reforms sang incoming president sa nauna nga 100 ka adlaw sa iya pagpungko sa Malacañang.
english: Investors are said to have a “wait-and-see attitude” while waiting for the details of the incoming president's policies and reforms in the first 100 days of his tenure in Malacañang.

text: Ginahulat man kun sin-o ang mangin pinal nga myembro sang bag-o nga economic team.
english: It is also awaited who will be the final member of the new economic team.

text: Kun ma-lay out na ang economic agenda suno kay Chua, mas makahangop ang mga tawo.
english: Once the economic agenda is laid out, Chua said, people will understand better.

text: Matandaan nga wala pa sang gindetalye si Marcos kun paano sini i-manage ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas ilabi na bangud trillions ang utang sang Pilipinas nga kinahanglan sabton sang bag-o nga administrasyon.
english: It can be recalled that Marcos has not yet detailed how he will manage the Philippine economy especially since the Philippines has trillions of debt that the new administration must answer.

text: Ang pila sa naplastar ni Marcos amo ang pagpadayon sang Build, Build, Build program kag mag-focus sa digital infrastructure kag pagpanubo sa presyo sang bugas sa P20 kada kilo.
english: Among the things Marcos put forward are the continuation of the Build, Build, Build program and focus on digital infrastructure and reducing the price of rice to P20 per kilo.

text: Attention, pageant fans!
english: Attention, pageant fans!

text: Kahigayunan mo na ini nga suportahan ang imo nahamut-an nga kandidata sa Binibining Pilipinas 2021 agud nga makaabanse siya sa semifinals.
english: This is your chance to support your favorite candidate in Binibining Pilipinas 2021 so that she can advance to the semifinals.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang Binibining Pilipinas ang pag-lunsar sang mobile application kun sa diin makaboto online ang mga fans sa ila nga favorite candidate.
english: Binibining Pilipinas announced the launch of a mobile application where fans can vote online for their favorite candidate.

text: Ang kandidata nga may pinakamataas nga boto ang automatic nga makaangkon sang wildcard spot sa semifinals sang coronation night sa Domingo, Hulyo 11.
english: The candidate with the most votes will automatically earn a wildcard spot in the semifinals of coronation night on Sunday, July 11.

text: Ang registered app users ang mahimo lamang makaboto sang isa ka bes kada adlaw.
english: Registered app users can only vote once per day.

text: Magatakop ang online voting sa Sabado sang gab-i, Hulyo 10.
english: Online voting will close on Saturday evening, July 10.

text: Apat ka titulo ang gina-agawan sa Binibining Pilipinas 2021 grand coronation night: Binibining Pilipinas International, Binibining Pilipinas Grand International, Binibining Pilipinas Intercontinental, kag Binibining Pilipinas Globe.
english: Four titles are up for grabs at the Miss Philippines 2021 grand coronation night: Miss Philippines International, Miss Philippines Grand International, Miss Philippines Intercontinental, and Miss Philippines Globe.

text: Gindayaw sang lead vocalist sang banda nga Parokya ni Edgar nga si Chito Miranda ang pagtanyag sa ila sang abyan nga si Angel Locsin nga magtinir sa iya nga balay kasunod sang paglupok sang bulkan Taal.
english: Lead vocalist of the band Parokya ni Edgar, Chito Miranda, praised the offer of his friend Angel Locsin to stay at his house following the eruption of Taal volcano.

text: Sa instagram, ginpakigbahin ni Chito ang mensahe sa iya ni Angel sa diin ginpahayag sang aktres nga mahimo makatinir ang singer kag pamilya sini sa iya nga balay bangud may yara sang nakahanda nga kwarto para sa ila.
english: On Instagram, Chito shared Angel's message to her where the actress said that the singer and his family can stay at her house because there is a room ready for them.

text: Tuman naman ang pagpasalamat sang lead vocalist sa maayo nga kabubut-on ni Angel.
english: The lead vocalist is very grateful for Angel's kindness.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi na bag-o sa publiko ang pagbulig ni Angel sa tion sang kalamidad bangud makapila na ini nga nag-viral sa mga donasyon nga ginahimo sini sa mga biktima sang nakaligad nga mga bagyo, mangin sa gyera sa Marawi kag subong nga krisis sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: It is known that Angel is not new to the public in helping in times of disaster because he has repeatedly gone viral for his donations to the victims of past typhoons, including the war in Marawi and the current crisis in the midst of the pandemic.

text: 17 ka adlaw na lang, Paskuwa na!
english: 17 days to go, Easter!

text: Nakumpleto na bala ang imo Christmas decorations?
english: Are your Christmas decorations complete?

text: Kilala ang mga Pinoy kun pagahambalan ang pa-bongga-bongga kag palawig-lawig sang selebrasyon sang Paskuwa.
english: Filipinos are known for their exuberance and prolonged Easter celebrations.

text: Apang may yara pa gid sang isa ka pamilya sa Germany nga world record holder gid bangud sa kadamuon sang ila Christmas trees nga lab-ot pati sa ila bathroom.
english: But there is another family in Germany that is a world record holder for the number of Christmas trees that reach their bathroom.

text: Ini amo ang pamilya nanday Thomas kag Susanne Jeromin sa Rinteln sa Lower Saxony sa amo nga pungsod sa Europa.
english: This was the family of Thomas and Susanne Jeromin in Rinteln in Lower Saxony in that European country.

text: Hamakon mo nga 605 gid ka mga decorated plastic Christmas trees ang yara sa ila balay!
english: You can imagine that there are 605 decorated plastic Christmas trees in their house!

text: Gingamitan ini sang 120,000 Christmas baubles, 50,000 lights kag linibo ka Christmas figures.
english: It was equipped with 120,000 Christmas baubles, 50,000 lights and thousands of Christmas figures.

text: Ginsuguran sang Hunyo ang ila pagdekorar kag lain-lain pa ang theme sa kada kahoy — may ara nga “Star Wars” kag may ara naman nga “The Simpsons” kag iban pa.
english: They started decorating in June and each tree has a different theme — some are “Star Wars” and some are “The Simpsons” and so on.

text: Suno sa mag-asawa, passion gid sang bana ang paghimo sini gani nga nadalahig pati ang bathroom… apang ang isahanon nga off-limits amo ang kuwarto sang ila bata nga babaye.
english: According to the couple, the husband is so passionate about doing this that the bathroom is involved... but the only thing off-limits is their daughter's room.

text: Ini na ang ika-anum nga tuig nga ginhatag sa ila ang world record sang most decorated Christmas trees sa isa lamang ka lugar.
english: This is the sixth year that they have been awarded the world record of most decorated Christmas trees in one place.

text: Ginhatag man ini sang Record Institute for Germany sa ila pamilya sang 2017 tubtub sang 2021 kag sang 2023.
english: The Record Institute for Germany also gave it to their family in 2017 to 2021 and in 2023.

english: A mother gave birth on the side of the road in Cebu City amid the panic of the 6.9 magnitude earthquake.

english: Based on what Dr. Queen Grasya, the OB-GYN team quickly assisted and the mother and baby were safe.

english: This happened while patients and medical personnel were being evacuated from the Cebu City Medical Center to the Cebu City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) due to the earthquake.

english: This, I may say, is one of my unforgettable experiences of 2025,” captioned the doctor’s post.

text: Pangunahan nanday Kai Sotto kag naturalized player nga si Ange Kouame ang Gilas Pilipinas para sa fifth window sang FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
