text: Magahampang ang national squad batok sa Jordan sa Nobyembre 11 kag batok sa Saudi Arabia sa Nobyembre 14.
english: The national squad will play against Jordan on November 11 and against Saudi Arabia on November 14.

text: Maga-join si Sotto sa team sa Middle East bangud ginahikot pa subong ang final details para sa iya nga accommodation.
english: Sotto will join the team in the Middle East as the final details for his accommodation are still being worked out.

text: Magaupod man ang mainstays sang team nga naghampang anay sa Japan B. League magluwas lang kay Kiefer Ravena bangud nagpaidalom ini sa operasyon bangud sang iya nga wisdom tooth.
english: The mainstays of the team that played in the Japan B. League will also be present except for Kiefer Ravena who underwent surgery for his wisdom tooth.

text: Yara sa hampang sanday Dwight Ramos, Bobby Ray Parks, Jr.
english: In the game were Dwight Ramos, Bobby Ray Parks, Jr.

text: Ang PBA stars naman nga makaupod sa hampang amo ang reigning MVP nga si Scottie Thompson kag ang iya Barangay Ginebra teammates nga sanday Japeth Aguilar kag Jamie Malonzo, CJ Perez sang San Miguel Beer, Roger Pogoy, Calvin Oftana kag Poy Erram sang TNT, kag Arvin Tolentino sang NorthPort.
english: The PBA stars who will be in the game are reigning MVP Scottie Thompson and his Barangay Ginebra teammates Japeth Aguilar and Jamie Malonzo, CJ Perez of San Miguel Beer, Roger Pogoy, Calvin Oftana and Poy Erram of TNT, and Arvin Tolentino of NorthPort.

text: Magluwas kay Kouame, yara man si Kevin Quiambao sang La Salle nga amo ang isa pa ka collegiate star nga makaupod sa squad.
english: In addition to Kouame, La Salle’s Kevin Quiambao will be the other collegiate star to join the squad.

text:
Patay ang 14-anyos nga solterito sa Austria matapos nga brutal nga ginbuno sang 23-anyos nga Syrian asylum seeker nga ginkilala sang mga otoridad nga si Ahmad G.

Suno sa report, natabo ang insidente mga alas 4 sang hapon, Pebrero 15, oras sang Austria, sa Villach, sa diin gingamit sang suspek ang daku nga kutsilyo sa pagpangbuno nga nagresulta sa kamatayon sang bata kag pagkapilas sang lima ka iban pa.
english:
A 14-year-old boy in Austria was killed after being brutally stabbed by a 23-year-old Syrian asylum seeker identified by authorities as Ahmad G.

According to the report, the incident occurred around 4 pm, February 15, Austrian time, in Villach, where the suspect used a large knife to stab the child and injure five others.

text: Nauntat ang kinagamo samtang ginaalegar nga ginbunggoan sang food delivery driver ang suspek nga sang ulihi ginkilala sang mga otoridad nga si Alaaeddin Alhalabi, 42 anyos kag isa ka Syrian.
english: The chaos ended when the food delivery driver allegedly hit the suspect, later identified by authorities as Alaaeddin Alhalabi, 42, a Syrian.

text: Samtang, padayon naman ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad agud mahibaluan kun may kaupod si Ahmad G. kag kun may kaangtanan sa anuman nga Islamist activity ang nasambit nga pag-atake.
english: Meanwhile, the authorities are still investigating whether Ahmad G. was accompanied and whether the attack was related to any Islamist activity.

text: Base sa mga nakasaksi sa insidente, ginpahayag sang mga ini nga ila nabatian nga nagasinggit sang “Allahu Akbar” ang suspek samtang nagakadlaw kag nagabuno.
english: According to witnesses, they heard the suspect shouting “Allahu Akbar” while laughing and stabbing.

text: Nagtuga ini sang kabalaka sa mga awtoridad nahanungod sa posibilidad sang terorismo.
english: This raised concerns among authorities about the possibility of terrorism.

text: Apang, wala pa makumpirmar sang mga otoridad kon bala ang pag-atake isa ka terorista nga buhat ukon kon bala si Ahmad G. may problema lamang sa panghunahuna.
english: However, authorities have yet to confirm whether the attack was a terrorist act or whether Ahmad G. was simply mentally ill.

text: Gin-review man sang mga otoridad ang iya application para sa asylum kag kun pila ka oras ang iya gintinir sa asylum center, apang indi pa maathag kun kilala sang mga otoridad ang suspek antes ang insidente.
english: Authorities also reviewed his asylum application and how long he stayed at the asylum center, but it is unclear if authorities knew the suspect before the incident.

text:
Gintu-ad sang British pop singer nga si Ed Sheeran nga sa Pilipinas lang niya nabatyagan nga isa siya ka “star.”

Makaduha ka beses nga nagbisita sa Pilipinas ang singer — una sang 2014 kag ang ika-duha sang 2017.
english:
British pop singer Ed Sheeran admitted that he only felt like a star in the Philippines.

The singer has visited the Philippines twice — first in 2014 and the second in 2017.

text: Suno sa iya, sa Pilipinas lang niya nabatyagan ang tuman nga pagpalangga kag pag-abi abi.
english: She said she had never felt so much love and welcome in the Philippines.

text: Gintawag pa ni Ed Sheeran nga “the best” ang iya mga fans kag ang first show niya sa Manila ang ginakabig niya nga “craziest show” bangud napakigbahin sini ang iya musika sa pungsod nga may dako man nga interes sa music.
english: Ed Sheeran even called his fans “the best” and his first show in Manila was considered the “craziest show” because it shared his music with a country that also has a great interest in music.

text: Naka-record ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) sang masobra 100 ka aftershocks matapos ang magnitude 6.9 nga linog sa Bogo, Cebu.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) recorded more than 100 aftershocks after the magnitude 6.9 earthquake in Bogo, Cebu.

text: Base ini sa bulletin nga ginpaguwa alas 4 kaina sang kaagahon.
english: This is based on the bulletin issued at 4 am yesterday.

text: Ang una nga mga mabaskog nga aftershocks narehistro sang 10:24 p.m. (magnitude 5.0) kag 10:33 p.m. (magnitude 5.1), nga pareho nga malapit sa Bogo City.
english: The first strong aftershocks were registered at 10:24 p.m. (magnitude 5.0) and 10:33 p.m. (magnitude 5.1), both near Bogo City.

text:
Isa pa ka linog nga may kusog nga magnitude 3.8 ang natabo sa Tabogon sang 10:39 p.m.

Dugang diri, sang tungang gab-i na, may magnitude 4.4 nga natabo sang 11:59 p.m. kag isa pa nga mas mabaskog nga magnitude 4.9 sang 12:34 a.m. sang sini na nga Oktubre 1.
english:
Another earthquake measuring 3.8 on the Richter scale struck Tabogon at 10:39 p.m.

In addition, at midnight, a magnitude 4.4 occurred at 11:59 p.m. and another stronger magnitude 4.9 at 12:34 a.m. on October 1.

text: May mga gamay man nga aftershocks nga narehistro sunod-sunod, nga may kusog halin sa magnitude 1.5 tubtob 3.8, kag kadalumon sang linog nagasugod sa duha ka kilometro tubtob 80 ka kilometro.
english: Small aftershocks were also registered one after another, with strengths ranging from magnitude 1.5 to 3.8, and depths ranging from two kilometers to 80 kilometers.

text:
Base sa latest report sang Cebu Provincial Information Office, masobra na sa 20 ka mga tawo ang napatay bangud sa amo nga trahedya.#

english:
According to the latest report of the Cebu Provincial Information Office, more than 20 people have been killed in the tragedy.

Photo: Rowena Capistrano

text: Natukiban sang British journalists nga may yara sang computer hacking gang nga naka-base sa India nga nag-target sang mga kritiko sang kontrobersyal nga Qatar World Cup.
english: British journalists have discovered that an India-based computer hacking gang has been targeting critics of the controversial Qatar World Cup.

text: Sandig sa database nga na-leak sa Bureau of Investigative Journalism sang Britanya, ginhungod sang isa ka kliyente nga i-commission ang pag-hack sa mga abogado, journalists, kag manggaranon nga mga tawo halin sang 2019.
english: According to a database leaked to Britain’s Bureau of Investigative Journalism, a client deliberately commissioned the hack of lawyers, journalists, and wealthy people since 2019.

text: Lakip sa gin-target amo ang former head sang European football nga si Michel Platini.
english: Among those targeted was former head of European football Michel Platini.

text: Gin-target man ang London-based consultant nga nagapanag-iya sang kumpaniya nga amo ang nag-produce sang report kaangot sa corruption may kaangtanan sa World Cup.
english: The London-based consultant who owns the company that produced the report on corruption in connection with the World Cup was also targeted.

text: Gin-target man sang hacking si Nathalie Goulet, ang French senator kag vocal critic sang Qatar bangud sa ginaalegar pagpondo sini sa “Islamic terrorism”.
english: The hacking also targeted Nathalie Goulet, the French senator and vocal critic of Qatar for its alleged funding of “Islamic terrorism”.

text: Isa pa sa biktimahon kuntani sang hacking amo si Mark Somos, ang Germany-based lawyer nga nag-file sang complaint batok sa Qatari royal family sa United Nations Human Rights Council.
english: Another would-be hacking victim is Mark Somos, the Germany-based lawyer who filed a complaint against the Qatari royal family with the United Nations Human Rights Council.

text: Ang ginatudlo nga kliyente nga nagpasimuno sang hacking amo ang host nation sang football tournament nga amo ang Qatar.
english: The alleged client that initiated the hacking was the host nation of the football tournament which is Qatar.

text: Sunod naman nga nagwangal ang Qatar kag nagsiling nga sala ang amo nga alegasyon kag wala sang merito.
english: Qatar subsequently responded by saying that the allegation was false and without merit.

text: Nakalusot si South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol sa impeachment matapos gin-boycott sang ruling party ang pagbinotohay apisar sang mga protesta sa guwa sang parliament.
english: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol escaped impeachment after the ruling party boycotted the vote despite protests outside parliament.

text: Ini nga binotohay sa impeachment ang natabo bangud sa gulpyada nga pagdeklarar ni Yoon sang martial law, ginsuspinde ang civilian rule, kag nagpadala sang tropa sa parliament.
english: The impeachment vote came after Yoon suddenly declared martial law, suspended civilian rule, and sent troops to parliament.

text: Apang sunod man nga ginbawi ang amo nga deklarasyon kag nag-U-turn ang mga hitabo bangud sa lapnagon nga mga protesta kag pagpamatok sang lawmakers.
english: However, the declaration was subsequently withdrawn and events took a U-turn due to widespread protests and opposition from lawmakers.

text: Ang partido sang oposisyon amo ang nagduso sang impeachment nga nagakinahanglan sang two thirds majority para makapasar.
english: It was the opposition party that pushed for impeachment which requires a two thirds majority to pass.

text: Apang napalpak ini bangud halos tanan sa People Power Party (PPP) ni Yoon ang nag-walk out kag wala nagboto.
english: But it failed because almost everyone in Yoon's People Power Party (PPP) walked out and did not vote.

text: Base sa partido sang presidente, balabagan nila ang impeachment para nga malikawan ang paglala sang gamo.
english: Based on the president's party, they will block the impeachment to avoid escalating the violence.

text: Ginpasalig nila nga resolbahon ang krisis sa South Korea sa mas responsible kag mas malinong nga paagi.
english: They pledged to resolve the crisis in South Korea in a more responsible and more peaceful manner.

text: Nahibaluan nga samtang gina-istoryahan ang impeachment, may mga nagaprotesta sa guwa sang parliament nga nagadangat sa 150,000 suno sa data sang pulis kag 1-million naman kun basehan ang data sang organizers.
english: It is known that while the impeachment is being discussed, there are 150,000 protesters outside the parliament according to police data and 1-million based on the data of the organizers.

text: Nagtaliwan ang player sang Alas Pilipinas Men nga si Ike Andrew Barilea duha ka adlaw matapos ang iya ika-21 nga kaadlawan.
english: Alas Pilipinas Men player Ike Andrew Barilea passed away two days after his 21st birthday.

text: Ginpakigbahin sang national team ang masubo nga balita, apang wala gindetalye sa publiko kun ano ang rason sang kamatayon.
english: The national team shared the sad news, but did not detail the cause of death to the public.

text: “The court feels emptier, and our hearts heavier.
english: “The court feels emptier, and our hearts heavier.

text: Rest easy, Alas Ike Barilea,” kabahin sang tribute sang Alas.
english: Rest easy, Alas Ike Barilea,” as part of Alas’s tribute.

text: Dugang sini, “Thank you for the laughter, the memories, and the heart you gave to the team.
english: It added, “Thank you for the laughter, the memories, and the heart you gave to the team.

text: Heaven gained an angel, but we lost a piece of ours.
english: Heaven gained an angel, but we lost a piece of ours.

text:
Fly high, our dear Alas.”

Ini nga Negrense middle blocker ang ginpili mismo ni Alas head coach Angiolino Frigoni nga mangin kabahin sang 21-player pool sang national team sang 2025 FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship.
english:
Fly high, our dear Alas.”

This Negrense middle blocker was personally selected by Alas head coach Angiolino Frigoni to be part of the 21-player pool of the national team of the 2025 FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship.

text: Nakahampang siya upod sa Alas Pilipinas-Cignal nga nag-compete sa 2025 AVC Men’s Volleyball Champions League sa Japan sang nagligad nga Mayo.
english: He played with Alas Pilipinas-Cignal who competed in the 2025 AVC Men’s Volleyball Champions League in Japan last May.

text: Nag-update ang Queen of all Media nga si Kris Aquino nga magapaidalom siya sa duha ka surgical procedures.
english: Queen of all Media Kris Aquino updated that she will undergo two surgical procedures.

text: Gin-post sini sa Instagram ang black and white photo sang ginapatihan nga prominent punctures sa iya panit sa chest area.
english: He posted on Instagram a black and white photo of what he believed to be prominent punctures on his skin in the chest area.

text: Naghingyo man ini sang pangamuyo indi lamang para sa iya kundi para sa iya nga surgeons, cardio-interventionists, nurses, kag bilog nga OR team nga amo ang magahimo sang operasyon subong na mismo nga aga, Septyembre 10.
english: He also asked for prayers not only for him but for his surgeons, cardio-interventionists, nurses, and the entire OR team who will perform the operation this morning, September 10.

text: “I needed to use a filter because my closest friends, my doctors and family—all had the same reaction—why do the strangest, mysterious medical mishaps not caused by man or by the machine implanted very near my heart,” pahayag sini “Pwede bang makiusap ulit?
english: “I needed to use a filter because my closest friends, my doctors and family—all had the same reaction—why do the strangest, mysterious medical mishaps not caused by man or by the machine implanted very near my heart,” he said “Can I talk again?

text:
alam ko ang kulit ko na but at 9 AM tomorrow I will be brought down for the first of 2 surgical procedures.”

Dugang sini, “Please pray for my surgeons and cardio-interventionists, all the residents and fellows, all the nurses and all the staff in the OR, and the Cardio OR.
english:
I know I'm naughty but at 9 AM tomorrow I will be brought down for the first of 2 surgical procedures.”

It added, “Please pray for my surgeons and cardio-interventionists, all the residents and fellows, all the nurses and all the staff in the OR, and the Cardio OR.

text:
I thank the Holy Spirit and the birthday Girl Mama Mary for keeping my Survival Instinct Sharp.”

Sang nagligad nga bulan, ginpahayag ni Kris nga magapabilin siya sa isolation sa compound sang iya nga pamilya sa Tarlac para sa bag-o nga treatment sa iya nga autoimmune conditions.
english:
I thank the Holy Spirit and the birthday Girl Mama Mary for keeping my Survival Instinct Sharp.”

Last month, Kris said she would remain in isolation at her family's compound in Tarlac for new treatment for her autoimmune conditions.

text: GINMANDO sang aton gobyerno nga sarhan ang tanan nga mga buluthuan sa pungsod sugod sadtong Marso 2020 tubtub Oktubre 2020, pagkatapos nga gin-deklarar na sang World Health Organization ang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Our government has ordered the closure of all schools in the country from March 2020 to October 2020, after the World Health Organization declared the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, sang amat-amat na maglaka ang panglaton sang COVID-19, gintugutan na ang distance learning, ukon ang online learning sa mga estudyante nga may magamit nga computer kag paagi sa mga delivery modules sa mga estudyante nga wala sini, nga ang resulta ginabalik sang mga ginikanan sa mga manunudlo.
english: After that, as the spread of COVID-19 gradually subsided, distance learning, or online learning, was allowed for students who had access to computers and through delivery modules for students who did not, with the results being returned to teachers by parents.

text: Sang ulihi gintugutan na ang blended option, kon diin ang estudyante makasulod na sa eskwelahan sa pila ka adlaw sang five-day school days kag pagtuon sa iban nga inadlaw paagi sa online learning ukon sa paggamit sang learning modules.
english: Eventually the blended option was allowed, where the student could now attend school on some days of the five-day school days and learn on other days through online learning or the use of learning modules.

text: Gintugutan naman sang gobyerno sugod sang Setyembre 20, 2021 ang in-person schooling sa bug-os nga five-day school days sa mga low-risk nga mga lugar.
english: The government has allowed in-person schooling for the entire five-day school days in low-risk areas since September 20, 2021.

text: Samtang, ang iban nga schools nagapatuman pa sang blended learning nga gamit ang modules kag distance learning tubtub Oktubre 31, 2022.
english: Meanwhile, some schools are still implementing blended learning using modules and distance learning until October 31, 2022.

text: Finally, sugod sadtong Nobyembre 2, 2022, ang tanan nga public kag private schools gintugutan na mag-transition sa 5 ka adlaw nga in-person nga mga klase.
english: Finally, as of November 2, 2022, all public and private schools have been allowed to transition to 5 days of in-person classes.

text:
***

Napatuman naman ang full implementation sang K-12 curriculum – Kindergarten tubtub Grade 10 plus Junior HS (Grade 11) kag Senior HS (Grade 12).
english:
***

The full implementation of the K-12 curriculum – Kindergarten to Grade 10 plus Junior HS (Grade 11) and Senior HS (Grade 12) has been implemented.

text: Ginpatuman ini sugod sadtong School Year (SY) 2016-2017 nga lakip ang nagapasakop sa Alternative Learning System, pagkatapos ginsugdan anay ang implementation sang Grade 11 sa 33 ka pilot public schools sadtong SY 2012-2013.
english: It was implemented starting in School Year (SY) 2016-2017 which included those participating in the Alternative Learning System, after the implementation of Grade 11 in 33 pilot public schools began in SY 2012-2013.

text: Galaum ang Dept.
english: The Dept.

text: of Education (DepEd) nga ang K-12 graduate sa Senior High School (Grade 12) indi lang ready agud pagpadayon sa kolehiyo kundi agud maka-ubra dayon, kon luyag nila, sa fields of Agriculture, Electronics kag Trade ukon Entrepreneurship, sunu sa technical/vocational career track nga ginpili nila sudlan.
english: of Education (DepEd) that K-12 graduates in Senior High School (Grade 12) are not only ready to continue in college but also to work immediately, if they wish, in the fields of Agriculture, Electronics and Trade or Entrepreneurship, according to the technical/vocational career track they chose to enter.

text:
***

Gipirmahan ni Secretary of Education kag VP Sarah Duterte-Carpio ang DepEd Order No.
english:
***

Secretary of Education and VP Sarah Duterte-Carpio signed DepEd Order No.

text: 034, series of 2022, nga nagapatuman sang bag-o nga school calendar para sa SY 2022-2023 nga nagatalana sang pagsugod sang klase sa Agosto 22 tubtub sa pagtakop sini sa Hulyo 7, 2023.
english: 034, series of 2022, implementing the new school calendar for SY 2022-2023 that sets the start of classes on August 22 until the end of classes on July 7, 2023.

text: Nangin kontrobersyal ugaling ini tungod sa sina nga schedule may klase pa sa summer months sang Marso, Abril kag Mayo.
english: However, this became controversial because the schedule still has classes in the summer months of March, April and May.

text: Nagsugod na gani ang mga reklamo sang mga estudyante (lakip gani sang mga manunudlo), labi na gid sa bahin sang public schools sa elementarya kag hayskul, tungod sa sobra kainit kag kagin-ut sa palibut nga bisan ang mga bentilador ang ginahuyop mainit nga hangin.
english: Students (including teachers) have already started complaining, especially in public schools in elementary and high schools, because of the excessive heat and humidity in the environment that even the fans are blowing hot air.

text: May gin-report na gani nga nose-bleeding, sakit sang ulo, kabudlay sang pagtuon, kag iban pa nga ginabatyag.
english: Nose-bleeding, headaches, difficulty learning, and other symptoms have even been reported.

text: Okey lang sa mga private schools nga aircon ang mga kwarto.
english: It's okay in private schools with air-conditioned rooms.

text: Apang sa mga public schools, ahay daw mga pinunubol!
english: But in public schools, it's like they're being bullied!

text: Lately, ang heat index nagdangat na, sa siyudad sang Iloilo, sa 42 degrees Celsius.
english: Lately, the heat index has reached, in Iloilo City, to 42 degrees Celsius.

text: Sobra kataas nga hilanat ini kon nagamasakit ka!
english: It’s too high a fever when you’re sick!

text: Napilitan na gani ang iban nga mga manunudlo nga dalhon ang mga estudyante sa gwa sang lagwerta sang eskwelahan kon diin may landong sang mga edificio ukon mapasilungan nga kakahuyan.
english: Some teachers have even been forced to take students outside the school grounds where there is shade from buildings or sheltered trees.

text: Tungod sini, naggwa ang mga panawagan nga ibalik ang daan nga bakasyon sang mga estudyante sa summer months sang Marso, Abril kag Mayo.
english: As a result, there have been calls to restore the old vacations for students in the summer months of March, April and May.

text: Personally, sugot gid kita nga ibalik ang bakasyon sang mga estudyante sa summer months.
english: Personally, we agree that students should return their vacation to the summer months.

text: Una, tungod naandan na naton ini – estudyante, manunudlo, mga empleyado sa upisina, kag bisan sang mga trabador sa construction kag mga kargador sa piyer nga nagapati-al sa init apang kahibalo magpaumpaw sang init sa ila pagpahuway, padayon nga pag-inom sang malamig nga tubig kag pagsuob sang putos sa ulo kag long sleeve nga bayo bilang depensa sa init.
english: First, because we are used to it – students, teachers, office workers, and even construction workers and pier loaders who are sweating in the heat but know how to cool down by resting, continuously drinking cold water and wearing head wraps and long sleeve clothes as protection from the heat.

text: Sa kadam-an, okey bisan mag-exercise pa gani sa gwa bag-o 10 a.m. tubtub 3 p.m. kon san-o masingkal na ang init.
english: For the most part, it's okay to even exercise outside before 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. when the heat is blazing.

text: In fact, kahibalo ang tanan kon paano ma-enjoy sang mga estudyante ang ila bakasyon sa summer time sa mga parke kag mga baybayon agud magsinadya kag kon diin nga mga lugar nga makalagaw-lagaw sila agud magpalamig kag mag-take sang masulod sa ila tiyan nga makapalamig sa ila, katulad sang malamig nga softdrinks, ice cream ukon halo-halo.
english: In fact, everyone knows how students can enjoy their summer vacation in parks and beaches to have fun and where they can go for a walk to cool off and take something to cool them down, such as cold softdrinks, ice cream or halo-halo.

text: Samtang, segurado ko gid nga indi maka-enjoy ang mga estudyante sang ila bakasyon sa binulan nga mabagyuhon sa Hulyo tubtub Agosto.
english: Meanwhile, I am sure that students will not be able to enjoy their vacation during the stormy months of July to August.

text: Paano ka abe matuod maka-enjoy kon may bagyo, pagbinaha-baha, landslide, kag may storm surge ukon pag-awas sang suba lapit sa inyo puluy-an?
english: How can you really enjoy when there is a typhoon, flood, landslide, and storm surge or river overflow near your home?

text: Binulay-og ina ya nga kaisipan, kon si Pedro pa, ang magsiling nga maka-enjoy ka sa binagyuhon nga panahon./PN
english: That's a shaky thought, if Pedro were to say that you can enjoy the stormy weather./PN

text: Iloilo City – Nagapadayon ang Iloilo City Health Office sang health screening sa mga empleyado sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: Iloilo City – The Iloilo City Health Office continues to conduct health screening for employees of the Iloilo City Hall.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jay Fortuna, Medical Officer IV sang Iloilo City Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang ini nga hilikuton ang nagatuyo nga mahatagan sang pag-ulikid ang mga empleyado nga nagaserbisyo sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jay Fortuna, Medical Officer IV of the Iloilo City Health Office, said that this activity aims to give care to the employees who serve the city.

text: Suno kay Fortuna, ang ini pamaagi ang isa sa mga palaagyan agud mahibaluan ang family history sang empleyado kun may yara ini sang balatian nga wala pa na-diagnose kaangay sang hypertension kag diabetes.
english: According to Fortuna, this is one of the ways to find out the family history of the employee if he has undiagnosed diseases such as hypertension and diabetes.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan, ang ini nga aktibidad ang nag-umpisa sang nagligad pa nga tuig sang 2022 kun sa diin natapos na libot ang mga empleyado sa 5th, 6th kag 7th floor sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: He said the activity started last year in 2022 when the employees finished touring the 5th, 6th and 7th floors of Iloilo City Hall.

text: Sa subong, ini ang masami nga ginpadayon sa 4th floor kag padalom, magabalik ini liwat sa 7th floor ilabi na sa mga empleyado nga wala nagapaidalom sa health screening.
english: Currently, it is usually continued on the 4th floor and below, it will return to the 7th floor especially for employees who do not undergo health screening.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagahatag man ang amo nga opisina sang bulong kag maintenance sang mga empleyado.
english: The office also provides medicines and maintenance to the employees.

text: Nag-umpisa na ang pagdagsa sang mga tawo sa isa ka barangay sa Mandaluyong City kasunod sang mga “wanted” nga nagkaladakpan kag gin-turn over sa mga otoridad.
english: People have started flocking to a barangay in Mandaluyong City following the arrest of wanted persons who were turned over to the authorities.

text: Ini nga mga wanted “dead or alive” amo ang mga lamok kag pitik-pitik nga ginapangdakop sang mga residente kag ginahatag sa barangay kabaylo sang piso.
english: These wanted “dead or alive” are mosquitoes and flies that are caught by residents and given to the barangay in exchange for peso.

text: Pebrero 21 pa kuntani maga-umpisa ang programa nga ‘May Piso sa Mosquito’ apang indi na makahulat ang mga taga-Barangay Addition Hills kag nag-arangkada na sila sa pagpangita sa mga insekto umpisa Pebrero 19.
english: The program 'May Piso sa Mosquito' was supposed to start on February 21 but the residents of Barangay Addition Hills could not wait and they started looking for insects starting February 19.

text: Nagabayad ang barangay sang P1 sa kada lima ka lamok ukon kiti-kiti nga ginadala sa ila, buhi man ukon patay.
english: The barangay pays P1 for every five mosquitoes or ticks brought to them, whether alive or dead.

text: Ginatipon ini sang barangay sa glass cage sa ila nga barangay hall.
english: The barangay collects it in a glass cage in their barangay hall.

text: Ginklaro man sang mga opisyal nga indi pwede makaintra ang mga menor de edad sa dakpanay sang lamok.
english: Officials also clarified that minors are not allowed to participate in the mosquito net.

text: Kabahin ini sang tikang sang barangay para nga matapna ang dengue cases nga subong naglab-ot na sa 44.
english: This is part of the barangay's efforts to prevent dengue cases which has now reached 44.

text: Extra man ini nga encouragement bangud mas nagpisan ang iban sa pagpanglimpyo sa ila mga tarog kag sa ila mga ginasuptan sang tubig.
english: This is also extra encouragement because others are more diligent in cleaning their tarogs and their water tanks.

text: Subong, sobra na sa 700 ka mga lamok ang natugyan sa barangay.
english: So far, more than 700 mosquitoes have been handed over to the barangay.

text: Magapadayon ini nga programa tubtub nga magnubo ang kaso sang dengue sa ila nga lugar.
english: This program will continue until the number of dengue cases in their area decreases.

text: Pirmado na sang Pilipinas kag United Arab Emirates (UAE) ang labing-una nga free trade agreement sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: The Philippines and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) have signed the first ever free trade agreement between the two countries.

text: Tuyo sang Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) nga mabuhinan ang taripa, mapasangkad ang market access para sa mga produkto kag serbisyo, madugangan ang pagsulod sang investments, kag makahatag sang dugang nga oportunidad para sa mga Pilipino sa UAE.
english: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) aims to reduce tariffs, expand market access for goods and services, increase investment inflows, and provide more opportunities for Filipinos in the UAE.

text: Ginsaksihan nanday President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Witnessed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan ang pagpirma sang amo nga kasugtanan kadungan sang Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week.
english: and UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan signed the agreement in conjunction with Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week.

text: Ang CEPA amo ang una nga free trade agreement sang Pilipinas sa isa ka pungsod nga yara sa Middle East.
english: The CEPA is the Philippines’ first free trade agreement with a country located in the Middle East.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga mga pagtuon, paagi sa CEPA, mapataas ang exports sang Pilipinas sa UAE sang 9.13%.
english: According to initial studies, through CEPA, Philippine exports to the UAE will increase by 9.13%.

text: Lakip sa export products nga ginalantaw nga magabenepisyo diri amo ang pinya, saging, canned tuna, electronics, machinery, kag iban pa nga high-demand products.
english: Among the export products expected to benefit from this are pineapple, banana, canned tuna, electronics, machinery, and other high-demand products.

text: Magabenepisyo man suno sa Malacañang ang IT-BPM, tourism, healthcare, education, construction, kag ang professional services sectors.#
english: Malacañang said the IT-BPM, tourism, healthcare, education, construction, and professional services sectors will also benefit.

text: Ginpaidalum liwat sa reorganisasyon ni Mayor Raisa S. Treñas ang Task Force Boltahe pinaagi sa Executive Order No.
english: Mayor Raisa S. Treñas reorganized Task Force Voltahe through Executive Order No.

text: 015 agud masiguro nga ang mga pasilidad sang syudad hilway sa ilegal nga koneksyon sang kuryente.
english: 015 to ensure that city facilities are free from illegal electricity connections.

text: Suno kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Mayor Raisa S. Treñas sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahanumdom niya nga ang kabangdanan sang pag-reconstitute sang task force amo ang sunod-sunod nga sunog nga ginapatihan nga ginhalinan sang mga ilegal nga koneksyon sa mga linya sang kuryente sa mga pasilidad sang syudad.
english: According to Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa S. Treñas in an interview with Bombo Radyo, she reminded that the reason for the reconstitution of the task force was a series of fires believed to have been caused by illegal connections to power lines in the city's facilities.

text: Ginpahanugutan sang EO ang Task Force nga mag-imbestiga, mag-disconnect sang illegal nga koneksyon, kag magpasaka sang kaso batok sa mga responsable, upod ang pagkoordinasyon sa City Legal Office kag MORE Power.
english: The EO authorized the Task Force to investigate, disconnect illegal connections, and file charges against those responsible, in coordination with the City Legal Office and MORE Power.

text: Ginaplano man sang EO nga ang tanan nga gasto sang Task Force Boltahe kuhaon sa Discretionary Fund sang Alkalde, kag magalakip ini sang communication equipment, overtime pay, kag mga gastos sa dokumentasyon sang operasyon.
english: The EO also plans for all Task Force Voltahe expenses to be taken from the Mayor’s Discretionary Fund, and this will include communication equipment, overtime pay, and operational documentation costs.

text: Ginapasiguro man sang alkalde nga ang pagpahamtang liwat sang Task Force Boltahe isa ka determinado nga tikang agud protektahan ang seguridad sang publiko kag matapna ang paglapta sang ilegal nga koneksyon sang kuryente sa Iloilo City.
english: The mayor also assured that the re-establishment of Task Force Voltahe is a determined step to protect public safety and prevent the spread of illegal electricity connections in Iloilo City.

text: Kasal na ang aktres nga si Ara Mina kay Philippine International Trading Corporation (PITC) Undersecretary Dave Almarinez.
english: Actress Ara Mina is married to Philippine International Trading Corporation (PITC) Undersecretary Dave Almarinez.

text: Ginhiwat ang kasal sang duha sa Alphaland Baguio Mountain Lodges Chapel, Baguio City.
english: The wedding ceremony was held at the Alphaland Baguio Mountain Lodges Chapel, Baguio City.

text: Nagbubo ang luha sa umpisa pa lang sang kasal samtang nagalakat pakadto sa altar ang anak ni Ara nga si Amanda Gabrielle Meneses nga nagserbe bilang little bride kag ginkup-an ang iya stepfather nga si Dave.
english: Tears were shed early in the wedding as Ara's daughter, Amanda Gabrielle Meneses, who served as little bride, hugged her stepfather, Dave, as she walked to the altar.

text: Nalakip naman ang pila ka mga senador sa maninoy kag maninay nanday Dave kag Ara.
english: Several senators were among Dave and Ara's brothers-in-law.

text: Ginpaandaman sang FIFA ang Tunisia nga posible ini nga makakas gikan sa World Cup 2022 kun mapamatud-an nga nagapahilabot ang Tunisian goverment sa ila nga football organization.
english: FIFA has warned Tunisia that it could be disqualified from the 2022 World Cup if it is proven that the Tunisian government is interfering in its football organization.

text: Ginpadala sang FIFA ang sulat sa Tunisian Football Federation subong nga semana kag ginsaad ang concern kun sa diin partikular nga gin-mensyonar ang pahayag sang Youth and Sports Minister sang Tunisia nga si Kamel Deguiche.
english: FIFA sent a letter to the Tunisian Football Federation this week expressing concern, specifically mentioning the statement of Tunisia's Youth and Sports Minister Kamel Deguiche.

text: Kasunod ini sang komento ni Deguiche kaangot sa pagdula sang federal bureaux nga nagalakip man sang football federation.
english: This follows Deguiche's comments regarding the abolition of federal bureaux that also includes the football federation.

text: Nagapati ang FIFA nga nagatuyo si Deguiche nga magpahilabot kun paano ginapadalagan ang football federation sang Tunisia.
english: FIFA believes that Deguiche intends to interfere in the running of the Tunisian football federation.

text: Sa idalom sang pagsulundan sang FIFA, ang federations sang tanan nga member nations ang dapat nga mangin hilway sa third-party ukon sa anuman nga government involvement.
english: Under FIFA rules, federations of all member nations must be free from third-party or any government involvement.

text: Kun indi mabaton sang FIFA ang kinahanglanon sini nga paathag gikan sa mga ginbuy-an nga komento ni Deguiche, daku ang tyansa nga ma-ban ang Tunisia sa 2022 World Cup nga maga-umpisa na sa Nobyembre 20.
english: If FIFA does not accept the need for an explanation from Deguiche's released comments, Tunisia is likely to be banned from the 2022 World Cup, which starts on November 20.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-ban na ang Kenya kag ang Zimbabwe bangud sa paglapas sang nasambit nga pagsulundan sang FIFA.
english: Kenya and Zimbabwe have already been banned for violating the said FIFA rule.

text: Nasuspinder man anay sang Agusto ang India bangud sa amo man nga rason.
english: India was also suspended in August for the same reason.

text: Ini na ang ika-anum nga tion nga qualified ang Tunisia sa World Cup.
english: This is the sixth time Tunisia has qualified for the World Cup.

text: Kaupod sini sa Group D ang reigning world champion nga France, ang Australia, kag ang Denmark.
english: It is joined in Group D by reigning world champion France, Australia, and Denmark.

text: Sa maragtas sang World Cup, wala nakalampuwas ang Tunisia sa group stages.
english: In the history of the World Cup, Tunisia has not survived the group stages.

text: Pananglitan makakas ang Tunisia sa World Cup sa Qatar, lakip sa ginabati-bati nga magabulos amo ang Italya nga amo ang highest-ranked nation nga indi kuwalipikado sa Qatar.
english: If Tunisia is eliminated from the World Cup in Qatar, among the rumored replacements is Italy, the highest-ranked nation that did not qualify for Qatar.

text: Apang kun Italya ang ibutang sa Group D, buot silingon sini, tatlo na ang myembro sang Union of European Football Associations sa group stage kag indi ini pwede.
english: But if Italy is placed in Group D, it means that there are already three members of the Union of European Football Associations in the group stage and this is not possible.

text: May mga pahayag man nga pagabuslan ini sang isa pa ka African member association (CAF).
english: There are also statements that it will be replaced by another African member association (CAF).

text: Ang Nigeria amo ang highest-ranked Confederation Africaine de Football member nga wala naka-qualify sa World Cup subong nga tuig.
english: Nigeria is the highest-ranked Confederation Africaine de Football member that failed to qualify for the World Cup this year.

text: Posible man nga ang Mali ang magabulos sa Tunisia bangud sila ang nalutos sang Tunisia, 1-0, sa ila nga World Cup qualifier subong nga tuig.
english: It is also possible that Mali will replace Tunisia as they were defeated by Tunisia, 1-0, in their World Cup qualifier this year.

text: Nagtaas ang tyansa nga mangin isa ka bagyo ang isa ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga nagsulod sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) kagab-i, Septyembre 30.
english: A Low Pressure Area (LPA) that entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) last night, September 30, has increased its chances of becoming a typhoon.

text: Kun mahimo nga tropical depression, pagatawgon ini sa local name nga Paolo.
english: If it becomes a tropical depression, it will be called by the local name Paolo.

text: Ini man ang mangin una nga bagyo sa Pilipinas subong nga Oktubre kag pang-16 naman sa tuig 2025.
english: It will also be the first typhoon in the Philippines this October and the 16th in 2025.

text: Ulihi nga nakit-an ang LPA sa kalayuon nga 1,105 nasidlangan sang Southeastern Luzon.
english: The LPA was last spotted at a distance of 1,105 east of Southeastern Luzon.

text: Base sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), mahimo ini mangin bagyo sa masunod nga 24 ka oras.
english: According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), it could become a typhoon in the next 24 hours.

text: Posible nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan ang direksyon sini sa Philippine Sea sa masunod nga inadlaw antes ini mag-landfall sa Luzon.
english: It is likely to head west northwest in the Philippine Sea in the coming days before making landfall in Luzon.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag nga duha tubtub apat ka mga bagyo ang magasulod sa Pilipinas sa sini nga Oktubre.
english: Earlier, two to four typhoons were expected to enter the Philippines this October.

text: Balik na sa Pilipinas umpisa subong nga adlaw ang big men sang Gilas Pilipinas nga naghampang para sa Japan B. League.
english: The big men of Gilas Pilipinas who played for the Japan B. League are back in the Philippines starting today.

text: Ini amo sanday Kiefer kag Thirdy Ravena, Dwight Ramos, kag Ray Parks.
english: These were Kiefer and Thirdy Ravena, Dwight Ramos, and Ray Parks.

text: Maga-reinforce sila sa national team para sa fifth window sang FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers sa bulan sang Nobyembre.
english: They will reinforce the national team for the fifth window of the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers in November.

text: Ang nasambit nga B. League stalwarts ang mahatagan sang masobra isa ka semana nga makaupod ang iban nga myembro sang Gilas Pilipinas antes mag-arangka ang hampang sang pungsod batok sa Jordan sa November 10 kag batok sa Saudi Arabia sa November 13.
english: The B. League stalwarts will be given more than a week to join other members of Gilas Pilipinas before the country's matches against Jordan on November 10 and against Saudi Arabia on November 13.

text: Suno anay sa head coach nga si Chot Reyes, makabig nga kumpleto na ang national team kun makaabot na ini sa Jordan bangud ginahulat pa si Kai Sotto.
english: According to former head coach Chot Reyes, the national team will be considered complete when it arrives in Jordan because Kai Sotto is still waiting.

text: Sa Australia pa subong si Sotto bangud nagahampang ini sa team sang Adelaide 36ers sa National Basketball League.
english: Sotto is currently in Australia as he plays for the Adelaide 36ers team in the National Basketball League.

text: Apisar gamay lang ang tion sang preparasyon sang big men sang Gilas, wala sang mangin problema sa adjusting para sa B. League standouts suno kay Reyes bangud nakahibalo na sila sa pasikot sikot sa team.
english: Although the big men of the Gilas have little time to prepare, there will be no problem in adjusting for the B. League standouts, according to Reyes because they already know the ins and outs of the team.

text: Nagpadala ang World Health Organization (WHO) sang mga eksperto sa Democratic Republic of Congo agud imbestigaran ang isa ka “mystery disease” nga amo ang ginatudlo nga rason sang kamatayon sang madamo nga tawo sa isa ka nabaw-ing nga lugar sa pungsod.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) has sent experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to investigate a “mystery disease” that is believed to be the cause of death for many people in a recovered area of ​​the country.

text: Maga-diretso ang health experts sa Panzi nga isa ka lokalidad sa southwestern Kwango province kun sa diin dal-on ang kinahanglanon nga mga bulong kag diagnostic kits agud ma-analisar kun ano ang ginhalinan sang balatian.
english: The health experts will go straight to Panzi, a locality in southwestern Kwango province, where they will bring the necessary medicines and diagnostic kits to analyze the cause of the disease.

text: Indi pa subong matumod kun viral disease ini ukon bacterial disease apang kabahin ini sa usisaon sang medical research team lakip na ang epidemiologists.
english: It is not yet known whether it is a viral disease or a bacterial disease but it is part of the investigation by the medical research team including epidemiologists.

text: Base sa data sang Ministry of Public Health nga ginpasa sa WHO, may 394 ka mga kaso na kag 30 ka mga napatay sa lokalidad sang Panzi nga 700 kilometros ang kalayuon halin sa kapital nga Kinshasa.
english: Based on data from the Ministry of Public Health submitted to the WHO, there are 394 cases and 30 deaths in the locality of Panzi, 700 kilometers from the capital Kinshasa.

text: Sa temprano nga bahin subong nga semana, gin-report naman sang local nga otoridad nga may indi matumod nga balatian nga nagpatay sang 143 na ka mga tawo sa ila rehiyon sini lamang nga Nobyembre.
english: Earlier this week, local authorities reported that an unspecified disease has killed 143 people in their region this November alone.

text: Lakip sa ginpangpatpat nga komon nga sintomas amo ang pagpalanakit sa ulo, pag-ubo, hilanat, sip-on, kabudlay sa pagginhawa, anaemia, kag pagpalanakit sang lawas.
english: Among the common symptoms described were headache, cough, fever, cough, difficulty breathing, anemia, and body aches.

text: May yara man sang na-obserbahan nga abnormal nga pagnubo sa lebel sang hemoglobin sa dugo suno sa provincial health office.
english: There was also an observed abnormal decrease in the level of hemoglobin in the blood according to the provincial health office.

text: Base sa initial reports, 40% sang mga kaso amo ang kabataan nga edad singko-anyos panubo nga mga maluya na nga daan bangud sa malnutrition.
english: Based on initial reports, 40% of the cases are children under the age of five who are already weak due to malnutrition.

text: Nag-alburuto naman ang Bulkan Taal kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Volcano Taal erupted this morning.

text: Base sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), nag-umpisa ini 2:02 kag natapos 2:15.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), it began at 2:02 and ended at 2:15.

text: “A minor phreatomagmatic eruption from Taal Volcano Island’s Main Crater at 02:02 AM today, 01 October 2025 was captured by the thermal camera at Taal Volcano Observatory (TVO) and IP Camera at the Main Crater Observation station (VTMC).
english: “A minor phreatomagmatic eruption from Taal Volcano Island’s Main Crater at 02:02 AM today, 01 October 2025 was captured by the thermal camera at Taal Volcano Observatory (TVO) and IP Camera at the Main Crater Observation station (VTMC).

text: The event produced a 2500-meter-high eruption plume that drifted northwest,” suno sa ahensya.
english: The event produced a 2500-meter-high eruption plume that drifted northwest,” the agency said.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa Alert Level 1 ang status sang bulkan.
english: The volcano remains at Alert Level 1.

text: Ginpahayag sang ahensya nga ang Alert Level 1 nagakahulugan nga ang bulkan yara sa indi normal nga kahimtangan, may low-level unrest, kag posible pa nga magpakita sang dugang nga mga senyales sang aktibidad.
english: The agency said Alert Level 1 means the volcano is in an abnormal state, has low-level unrest, and is still likely to show further signs of activity.

text: Nahamtang ang Taal Volcano sa Batangas kag isa sa mga pinakaaktibo nga bulkan sa pungsod.
english: Taal Volcano is located in Batangas and is one of the most active volcanoes in the country.

text: Gin-anunsyo na sang Binibining Pilipinas ang mga kandidata nga nakasulod sa Top 10 Best in National Costume 2021.
english: Binibining Pilipinas has announced the contestants who entered the Top 10 Best in National Costume 2021.

text:
Ini amo sanday:

Kinahanglan pa nga magboto ang mga pageant fans agud mapili na kun sin-o sa nasambit nga qualifiers ang magadaug sang Best in National Costume sa grand coronation night sang pageant.
english:
These are:

The pageant fans will have to vote to choose which of the said qualifiers will win the Best in National Costume on the grand coronation night of the pageant.

text: Sa Hulyo 11 natalana ang Binibining Pilipinas 2021 Grand Coronation Night.
english: The Miss Philippines 2021 Grand Coronation Night is scheduled for July 11.

text: Nagahulat ang korona para sa apat ka mga titulo nga amo ang Binibining Pilipinas International, Binibining Pilipinas Grand International, Binibining Pilipinas Intercontinental, kag Binibining Pilipinas Globe.#
english: The crown awaits for four titles namely Miss Philippines International, Miss Philippines Grand International, Miss Philippines Intercontinental, and Miss Philippines Globe.

text: Natampukan sang duta ang duha ka mga balay sa natabo nga landslide sa Abiera, Sebaste, Antique.
english: Two houses were covered with earth in a landslide in Abiera, Sebaste, Antique.

text: Kasunod ini sang mamunog nga ulan nga epekto sang Bagyo Crising.
english: This follows the heavy rains caused by Typhoon Crising.

text: Wala natakos sa edad ang paglab-ot sang handum sa kabuhi.
english: Achieving a dream in life is not measured by age.

text: Ini ang ginpamatud-an sang aktres nga si Jodi Sta.
english: This was confirmed by actress Jodi Sta.

text: Maria matapos naggraduate sa kolehiyo.
english: Maria after graduating from college.

text: Si Jodi ang nagradwar sa kurso nga Bachelor’s degree in Psychology sa Southville International School and Colleges.
english: Jodi graduated with a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology from Southville International School and Colleges.

text: Suno kay Jodi, madugay man ang iya nga paghulat, natigayon naman niya subong nga natapos ang iya pag-eskwela bangud man sa suporta nga ginhatag sang iya mga manunudlo, pamilya, management team kag mga abyan.
english: According to Jodi, although she waited a long time, she was able to finish her studies thanks to the support given by her teachers, family, management team and friends.

text: Nahibaluan nga consistent nga dean’s lister si Jodi sa ila eskwelahan.
english: Jodi is a consistent dean's lister in her school.

text: Arestado ang mag-live-in partner sa Barangay New Visayas, Panabo City sa Davao del Norte sa ginpatigayon nga anti-illegal drug operation sang kapulisan sang Sabado sang aga, Pebrero 15, 2025.
english: A live-in partner was arrested in Barangay New Visayas, Panabo City in Davao del Norte in an anti-illegal drug operation conducted by the police on Saturday morning, February 15, 2025.

text: Ang mga suspek ang nagikan sa Caraga Region nga nagadul-ong sang suplay sang iligal nga droga sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar sa Mindanao.
english: The suspects are from the Caraga Region who deliver supplies of illegal drugs to various parts of Mindanao.

text: Nakuha sa ila ang masobra anum ka kilo sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang P44.4 million.
english: More than six kilos of suspected shabu worth P44.4 million were recovered from them.

text: Nakuha man sa mga suspetsado ang buy-bust money.
english: The suspects were also recovered with buy-bust money.

text: Ang duha nga nadakpan amo ang top 1 kag top 3 nga high-value targets sa regional level sang PNP.
english: The two arrested are top 1 and top 3 high-value targets at the regional level of the PNP.

text: Preso na karon sa Panabo Police Station ang mga suspetsado kag magapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspects are now detained at the Panabo Police Station and will face charges of violation of the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nagpagguwa sang tsunami warning alert ang Philippine Institute of of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) matapos ang magnitude 6.7 nga linog nga nag-igo sa Cebu.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) issued a tsunami warning alert after a magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck Cebu.

text: Suno sa PHIVOLCS nga nakabatyag sila sang minor sea-level disturbance.
english: PHIVOLCS said they felt a minor sea-level disturbance.

text: Ginalauman ang mabaskog nga sea currents kag badasig nga pagbag-o sang level sang tubig sa baybayon.
english: Strong sea currents and rapid changes in water levels are expected along the coast.

text: Bangud diri, ginmanduan sang ahensya ang publiko nga magpalayo sa mga baybayon, amo man ang mga manugpangisda.
english: The agency has ordered the public to stay away from the beaches, as well as fishermen.

text: Masobra 1,300 ka mga Briton ang gin-ban sa pagtambong sa World Cup sa Qatar sa 2022 agud malikawan nga masulit ang insidente sang mga kinagamo nga himo sang abusado nga football supporters.
english: More than 1,300 Britons have been banned from attending the World Cup in Qatar in 2022 to prevent a repeat of the incident of riots caused by abusive football supporters.

text: Ginpili ang mga gin-ban base sa may history sang football-related violence ukon disorder.
english: Those banned were selected based on a history of football-related violence or disorder.

text: Ginadumilian sila nga maghalin sa England ukon magbyahe sa pungsod kun sa diin pwede sila nga makacommute agud makalantaw sang prestihiyoso nga hinampang.
english: They are banned from leaving England or traveling to the country where they can commute to watch the prestigious game.

text: Ginapahayag nga kun sin-o man ang nakabutang sa banned list nga nagapamilit nga magbyahe sa Qatar, presuhon sa sulod ang anum ka bulan kag may ipapanaog man nga multa.
english: Anyone on the banned list who insists on traveling to Qatar will be imprisoned for six months and fined.

text: Magaumpisa ang restrictions 10 ka adlaw antes ang pagsugod sang World Cup sa Nobyember 20 kag magalawig tubtub sa katapusan sang tournament.
english: The restrictions will begin 10 days before the start of the World Cup on November 20 and will last until the end of the tournament.

text: Ini nga development ang kasunod sang pagtimbuok sang insidente sang kagamo kag “pitch invasions” nga nagresulta sa football-related arrests sang nagligad nga season ipaanggid sa nagligad pa nga mga tinuig.
english: This development follows an increase in incidents of riots and pitch invasions that resulted in football-related arrests last season compared to previous years.

text: Nagaplano ka bala nga islan na ang imo nga regular toothpaste?
english: Are you planning to replace your regular toothpaste?

text: Basi kun gusto mo ini nga tilawan!
english: Maybe if you want to give it a try!

text: Ginatun-an subong sang Department of Science and Technology – Industrial Technology Development Institute (DOST-ITDI) ang paggamit sang okra bilang toothpaste.
english: The Department of Science and Technology – Industrial Technology Development Institute (DOST-ITDI) is currently studying the use of okra as a toothpaste.

text: Isa ini sa mga paagi sang DOST agud mahimo ang lain-lain nga produkto gamit ang okra bangud tuman ka damo ang suplay sini sa Pilipinas.
english: This is one of the ways DOST can make different products using okra because there is a huge supply of it in the Philippines.

text: Isa sa ginatutukan amo ang Okra toothpaste infused with calamansi oil, isa ka ingredient nga ginapahayag may yara sang whitening properties.
english: One of the focuses is Okra toothpaste infused with calamansi oil, an ingredient purported to have whitening properties.

text: Iban pa nga okra developments nga ginatun-an sang science agency amo ang banaba milk tea, kag paggamit sang okra bilang stabilizer nga amo naman ang nagabulig agud nga ma-preserve ang food structure.
english: Other okra developments being studied by the science agency are banaba milk tea, and the use of okra as a stabilizer that helps preserve food structure.

text: Apisar pa nga daw bag-o ini sa pamatin-an, madamo na nga mga pungsod ang naga-eksperimento sa paghimo sang okra products.
english: Although it may sound new, many countries are already experimenting with making okra products.

text: Isa diri mo ang “okra water”, isa ka wellness trend kun sa diin ginahuluman ang lawas sang okra sa tubig sa sulod sang 24 ka oras, antes i-ingest.
english: One of them is “okra water”, a wellness trend where okra is soaked in water for 24 hours, before ingestion.

text: Ini ang ginapahayag maayo sa weight loss kag nagapa-improve sang blood sugar management.
english: It is said to be good for weight loss and improves blood sugar management.

text: May isa ka lalaki sa Argentina nga makakaluluoy gid ang naabtan bangud lamang sa iya pagdala sang pulbos.
english: There was a man in Argentina who was very unfortunate just because he was carrying powder.

text: Ini amo si Maximiliano Acosta nga nagasakay sa isa ka bus sang nagsulod ang mga pulis para sa isa ka routine check.
english: This is Maximiliano Acosta who was riding in a bus when the police came in for a routine check.

text: Ginpanglantaw pati ang baggage sang mga pasahero kag nadugayan gid ang mga pulis sa bag ni Maximiliano bangud sa 18 ka containers sang pulbos.
english: The passengers' luggage was also searched and the police took a long time to find Maximiliano's bag because of the 18 containers of powder.

text: Pila ka beses nga nagpaathag ang lalaki nga powder lang ang sulod sini kag personal niya ini nga gamiton kag nagaplano man siya nga i-resell ini sa Buenos Aires para nga makadugang sa income.
english: The man explained several times that it contained only powder and that he would use it personally and that he also planned to resell it in Buenos Aires to increase his income.

text: Indi kumbinsido ang mga pulis kag nagduda nga iligal ini nga droga.
english: The police were not convinced and suspected it was illegal drugs.

text: Gindala sa detention si Maxi kag ang makakilibot pa gid, ginsulod siya sa presuhan matapos gin-alegar nga napamatud-an sa test nga puno sang cocaine ang 18 ka containers.
english: Maxi was taken into custody and, more surprisingly, he was jailed after the test allegedly proved that 18 containers were full of cocaine.

text: Wala man ginpahibalo ang pamilya ni Maxi kun ano ang natabo sa iya.
english: Maxi's family was not informed of what happened to him.

text: Bangud gin-anunsyo sang otoridad nga duha ka kilo kag 444 grams sang cocaine ang dala ni Maxi kag nakumpiskar nila sa bus operation, madamo ang nagdayaw sa mga pulis kag pati ang Minister of Security sang Argentina ang nag-share man sini nga balita sa social media.
english: After the authorities announced that Maxi was carrying two kilos and 444 grams of cocaine and they confiscated it in the bus operation, many praised the police and even the Minister of Security of Argentina shared this news on social media.

text: Bangud sa padayon nga protesta ni Maxi, ginpaidalom sa lain pa gid nga laboratory testing ang white powder apang bangud madugay ang resulta, ginpabilin siya sa sulod sang presuhan kaupod ang mga criminal.
english: Due to Maxi's continued protest, the white powder was subjected to another laboratory testing but because the results were delayed, he was kept inside the jail with the criminals.

text: 21 ka adlaw pa ang ginlawig antes napamatud-an sa ikaduha nga resulta nga plain gid lamang nga pulbos ang unod sang container rason nga gin-release si Maxi sa presuhan.
english: It took 21 days before the second result proved that the container contained plain powder and Maxi was released from jail.

text: Sa baylo nga sorry ang iya mabaton, ginpamato-mato pa siya papauli kag nag-ayo lang siya sa mga motorista kun pwede siya pasakyon.
english: Instead of receiving an apology, he was driven home and asked the motorists if they could give him a ride.

text: Nagrason naman ang Minister of Security nga masami gid man masal-an ang talcum powder nga cocaine gani nga nagpanigurado lamang ang security forces.
english: The Minister of Security argued that talcum powder is often mistaken for cocaine so the security forces are just making sure.

text: Ginpasaka sang Philippine Institute of of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) sa magnitude 6.9 nga linog halin sa anay 6.7 nga linog nga nagtay-og sa Cebu sang Setyembre 30.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) upgraded it to a magnitude 6.9 earthquake from the former 6.7 earthquake that shook Cebu on September 30.

text: Base sa datos sang ahensya nga may yara sang kadalumon nga 5 kilometers nga ang epicenter ang makita sa Bogo City.
english: Based on the agency's data, the epicenter was located in Bogo City at a depth of 5 kilometers.

text: Nabatyagan ang intensity 5 sa Sipalay City, Cebu, Negros Occidental, Lapu-Lapu City kag Tacloban City.
english: Intensity 5 was felt in Sipalay City, Cebu, Negros Occidental, Lapu-Lapu City and Tacloban City.

text: Intensity 4 naman ang mabatyagan sa San Fernando, Cebu; Bulan, Bulusan at Casiguran, Sorsogon; Roxas City,Capiz; Himamaylan City, Negros Occidental; Ubay, Bohol; Lawaan, Eastern SAmar; Laoang, Northern Samar; Catbalogan, Samar; Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte.
english: Intensity 4 will be felt in San Fernando, Cebu; Bulan, Bulusan and Casiguran, Sorsogon; Roxas City,Capiz; Himamaylan City, Negros Occidental; Ubay, Bohol; Lawaan, Eastern SAmar; Laoang, Northern Samar; Catbalogan, Samar; Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte.

text: Intensity 3 naman sa Legazpi City, Albay; Iriga City, Camarines Sur; Donsol, Sorsogon; Tibiao, Antique.
english: Intensity 3 in Legazpi City, Albay; Iriga City, Camarines Sur; Donsol, Sorsogon; Tibiao, Antique.

text: Mala-‘Paubaya’ nga kanta ni Moira dela Torre ang istorya sa kasal ni Barangay Ginebra star Scottie Thompson.
english: Moira dela Torre's 'Paubaya' song is the story of Barangay Ginebra star Scottie Thompson's wedding.

text: Sang New Year’s Eve, nagpropose kag na-engage si Scottie sa iya nga longtime girlfriend nga si Pau Fajardo.
english: On New Year’s Eve, Scottie proposed and got engaged to his longtime girlfriend Pau Fajardo.

text: Subong nga Hunyo, nakibot ang tanan sang nagpakal si Scottie.
english: This June, everyone was shocked when Scottie got pregnant.

text: Ang bride?
english: The bride?

text: Indi si Pau Fajardo.
english: Not Pau Fajardo.

text: Ginkasal siya sa isa ka flight attendant nga si Jinky Serrano sa isa ka private wedding ceremony sa Las Piñas.
english: He was married to a flight attendant Jinky Serrano in a private wedding ceremony in Las Piñas.

text: Sang Hunyo 20 lang, ginkumpirma ni Scottie nga break na sila ni Pau sa sulod na sang duha ka bulan.
english: On June 20, Scottie confirmed that he and Pau have been on a break for two months.

text: Suno sa iya, siya ang may sala kag batunon niya kun anuman ang mga ihaboy ni Pau batok sa iya.
english: He said he was guilty and would accept whatever Pau threw against him.

text: Ginpangdelete man ang ila nga mga pictures sa ila social media accounts.
english: Their pictures were also deleted from their social media accounts.

text: Walo ka tuig man nga magkarelasyon sanday Pau kag Scottie gani nangin matunog nga pamangkot kun ngaa lain nga babaye ang iya ginpakaslan.
english: Pau and Scottie were also in a relationship for eight years, so it became a loud question why he married another woman.

text: Isa sa mga ginatudlo nga rason amo ang pagbusong sang flight attendant rason nga kinahanglan ini nga pakasalan ni Scottie.
english: One of the reasons given is the pregnancy of the flight attendant which is why Scottie had to marry her.

text: Nagpagwa man sang statement si Kayesha Chua, fiancée sang PBA player nga si Aljon Mariano kag close friend sang ex-couple.
english: Kayesha Chua, fiancée of PBA player Aljon Mariano and close friend of the ex-couple, also issued a statement.

text: Suno kay Kayesha, wala gid nagpangayo si Scottie sang bulig sa ila bisan nakahibalo sila kun ano ang problema sa tunga nila ni Pau.
english: According to Kayesha, Scottie never asked for help from them even though they knew what the problem was between them and Pau.

text: Wala suno sa iya sang may naka-imagine nga matabo ini sa tunga nanday Pau kag Scottie.
english: He said no one could have imagined this would happen between Pau and Scottie.

text: Sa subong, ginapangayo sa publiko nga respetuhon ang privacy sang duha kag ang ila desisyon nga mag-separar na sang ila banas.
english: In the meantime, the public is asked to respect the privacy of the two and their decision to go their separate ways.

text: Nagkinarankaran ang linibo ka mga pumuluyo sa bug-os nga isla sang Cebu matapos nga gin-igo sang mabaskog nga 6.9 magnitude nga linog kagab-i, alas 9:59 sang Martes, Setyembre 30.
english: Thousands of residents across the island of Cebu were scattered after being hit by a strong 6.9 magnitude earthquake last night, at 9:59 pm Tuesday, September 30.

text: Isa sa mga halitan amo ang Archdiocesan Shrine of Santa Rosa de Lima sa Daanbantayan, Cebu, nga naguba ang pila ka parte sang istraktura sang simbahan bangud sa mabaskog sang linog.
english: One of the damaged was the Archdiocesan Shrine of Santa Rosa de Lima in Daanpatanan, Cebu, which destroyed some parts of the church structure due to the strong earthquake.

text: Sa Bogo City, nga amo ang epicenter sang linog, isa ka kilala nga fast food chain ang naguba ang estruktura kag gin-deklarar nga delikado sudlan.
english: In Bogo City, which was the epicenter of the quake, a well-known fast food chain was destroyed and declared dangerous to enter.

text: Sa Cebu City, temporaryo nga naggwa sa guwa sang ospital ang mga pasyente kag medical staff sang Cebu City Medical Center bangud sa kakulba sang linog.
english: In Cebu City, patients and medical staff of the Cebu City Medical Center temporarily left the hospital due to the earthquake.

text: Tatlo ang kumpirmado nga nasamaran sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: Three people were confirmed injured in the incident.

text: Ginpahayag ni Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival ang iya panawagan sa publiko nga magpabilin nga kalmado, samtang ginahulat ang posible nga mga aftershocks.
english: Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival expressed his appeal to the public to remain calm, while waiting for possible aftershocks.

text: Suno kay Joel Erestain, Regional Director sang Office of the Civil Defense – Region 7, ginpahayag sini nga ang Nothernnga bahin sang Cebu ang pinaka-naapektuhan sang linog.
english: Joel Erestain, Regional Director of the Office of the Civil Defense – Region 7, said the northern part of Cebu was the most affected by the quake.

text: Ginkumpirmar man niya nga ginpasaka ang magnitude sang linog halin sa 6.5 pakadtu sa 6.9 base sa pinakaulihi nga datos.
english: He also confirmed that the magnitude of the quake was raised from 6.5 to 6.9 based on the latest data.

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga report sang Cebu Capitol PIO kaina nga alas 2:00 sang kaagahon, Oktubre 1, nakumpirmar nga 13 ka tawo ang napatay, siyam ka tigulang kag apat ka kabataan sa Bogo City, samtang apat man ang napatay sa San Remegio.
english: In the latest report of the Cebu Capitol PIO yesterday at 2:00 am, October 1, it was confirmed that 13 people were killed, nine elderly and four children in Bogo City, while four were also killed in San Remegio.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang search and rescue operations sang mga otoridad sa mga lugar nga naapektuhan.
english: Search and rescue operations are still ongoing in the affected areas.

text: Bangud sini, pila sa mga eskwelahan sa Cebu City, Mandaue, kag iban pa nga lugar ang nagdeklara sang wala klase subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 1.
english: As a result, some schools in Cebu City, Mandaue, and other areas have declared no classes today, October 1.

text:
Yari ang diutay nga pagnubo sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo epektibo subong nga Martes, Mayo 3:

GASOLINA – maganubo sang P0.65 kada litro

DIESEL – maganubo sang P1.15 kada litro

KEROSENE – maganubo sang P1.15 kada litro

Ini ang ikaapat nga price rollback subong nga tuig.
english:
Here is the slight reduction in petroleum product prices effective this Tuesday, May 3:

GASOLINE – to drop by P0.65 per liter

DIESEL – to drop by P1.15 per liter

KEROSENE – to drop by P1.15 per liter

This is the fourth price rollback this year.

text: Ginsundan sini ang major oil price hike nga ginpatuman sang nagligad nga semana.
english: This follows the major oil price hike implemented last week.

text:
Sa rekord sang Department of Energy, kun basehan naman ang ginsaka sa presyo sang fuel products halin sang una nga semana sang Enero tubtub sa katapusan nga price hike (sang nagligad lang nga semana):

Ang gasolina nagsaka sang P18.45 per liter; P31.45 per liter sa diesel; kag P25.05 sa kerosene.
english:
According to the Department of Energy, the price of fuel products increased from the first week of January to the last price hike (last week):

Gasoline rose by P18.45 per liter; P31.45 per liter of diesel; and P25.05 for kerosene.

text: Ginakonsiderar ni Asia’s Next Top Model Maureen Wroblewitz ang pagpasakop sa beauty pageants apang wala niya ginkumpirma kun may plano siya nga sudlon ang Miss Universe Philippines subong nga tuig.
english: Asia's Next Top Model Maureen Wroblewitz is considering participating in beauty pageants but has not confirmed whether she plans to enter Miss Universe Philippines this year.

text: May mga nagalagaw na nga report nga isa si Maureen sa mga nag-audition agud mangin flag-bearer sang isa ka sikat nga pageant camp sa Miss Universe Philippines 2021.
english: There are already reports circulating that Maureen is one of those who auditioned to be the flag-bearer of a popular pageant camp at Miss Universe Philippines 2021.

text: “I’ve always considered joining pageants… As in my other interviews, I’ve always said that I’ve considered it, that I am not closing any doors,” pahayag ni Maureen.
english: “I’ve always considered joining pageants… As in my other interviews, I’ve always said that I’ve considered it, that I am not closing any doors,” stated Maureen.

text: Kasunod sini gin-athag sang 22 anyos nga model nga magapasakop lamang siya sa pageant kun 100 percent ready na siya para diri.
english: The 22-year-old model then explained that she will only participate in the pageant if she is 100 percent ready for it.

text: Subong na ayhan ina nga tuig?
english: Is that year now?

text: “I am not so sure yet because this is the year, I’ve heard, that you have the least preparation time.
english: “I am not so sure yet because this is the year, I’ve heard, that you have the least preparation time.

text:
I really want to be ready if I do join.”

Suno kay Maureen, sa subong nagatutok anay siya sa iya acting career.
english:
I really want to be ready if I do join.”

According to Maureen, she is currently focusing on her acting career.

text: Nagalaum man siya nga makatrabaho ang iya boyfriend nga si Juan Karlos Labajo sa masunod nga mga proyekto.
english: She also hopes to work with her boyfriend Juan Karlos Labajo on future projects.

text: Gintay-og sang 7.0-magnitude nga linog ang Northern California 10:44 a.m. local time sang Huwebes (Biyernes sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas).
english: A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Northern California at 10:44 a.m. local time on Thursday (Friday morning Philippine time).

text: Base sa United States Geological Survey, una nga na-record ang magnitude 6.6 apang gin-revise ini pila ka minutos lang ang nakaligad.
english: According to the United States Geological Survey, a magnitude of 6.6 was first recorded but was revised a few minutes later.

text: Suno pa sa ahensya, na-rekord ang epicenter sa 10 miles southwest sang Scotia sa Humboldt County.
english: The agency said the epicenter was recorded 10 miles southwest of Scotia in Humboldt County.

text: Natabo ini nga linog kasunod sang una naman nabatyagan nga pagtay-og sa amo man nga area sang Mierkules nga naka-rehistro sang magnitudes nga 4.2 kag 4.4 apang wala sang una napaguwa nga trigger alerts.
english: The quake followed earlier tremors felt in the same area on Wednesday that registered magnitudes of 4.2 and 4.4 but no trigger alerts were issued.

text: Santo sa reports, nabatyagan ang pagtay-og sini nga Huwebes pati sa San Francisco Bay Area kag gilayon nga may ginpaguwa nga tsunami warnings sa coast.
english: According to reports, the quake was felt this Thursday also in the San Francisco Bay Area and tsunami warnings were immediately issued on the coast.

text: Ginpadala ang mergency notifications paagi sa smartphones kun sa diin gin-abisuhan ang mga apektado nga residente nga magsaylo sa mas mataas nga lugar bangud sa posible delikado nga mga sitwasyon malapit sa baybayon: “A series of powerful waves and strong currents may impact coasts near you.
english: Emergency notifications were sent via smartphones advising affected residents to move to higher ground due to potentially dangerous situations near the coast: “A series of powerful waves and strong currents have impacted coasts near you.

text: You are in danger.
english: You are in danger.

text:
Get away from coastal waters.”

Sakop sang tsunami warning ang coastal areas sang California kag Oregon halin Davenport, 10 miles northwest sang Santa Cruz, pakadto sa Douglas/Lane Line, Oregon 10 miles southwest sang Oregon.
english:
Get away from coastal waters.”

The tsunami warning covers coastal areas of California and Oregon from Davenport, 10 miles northwest of Santa Cruz, to the Douglas/Lane Line, Oregon 10 miles southwest of Oregon.

text: Wala sang na-report nga damage as of press time.#
english: No damage was reported as of press time.#

text: Nagkalamatay man ang pila ka mga baka kag karabaw bangud sa pagbaha sa Madalag, Aklan.
english: Several cattle and buffaloes also died due to flooding in Madalag, Aklan.

text: Magluwas sa Madalag, may narekord man nga mga nagkalamatay nga kasapatan sa Banga sa amo nga probinsya.
english: Besides Madalag, there were also recorded dead animals in Banga in the province.

text: Ini nga mga pagbaha ang dulot sang ulan nga dala sang Bagyo Crising.
english: These floods were caused by the rains brought by Typhoon Crising.

text: Plano nga dal-on sa rehabilitation center sa banwa sang Pototan ang isa sa lima ka mga child in conflict with the law (CICL) nga nakagwa sang nagligad nga adlaw sa Balay Dalayunan sa Bo.
english: One of the five children in conflict with the law (CICL) who was released yesterday from Balay Dalayunan in Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz kag ginatudlo nga suspek nga nagpang-hold up sa Quirino Lopez Bridge sa Iloilo City Proper.
english: Obrero, Lapuz and alleged suspect who held up the Quirino Lopez Bridge in Iloilo City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Teresa Gelogo, Head sang City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), iya ginpahayag nga bangud ini sila ang CICL, ang Korte ang maga-desisyon kun ano ang madangtan kag kon sa diin sila ibutang nga nakasanto sa ila ginapangatubang nga kaso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Teresa Gelogo, Head of the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), said that since they are the CICL, the Court will decide what will happen and where they will be placed in accordance with the case they are facing.

text: Isa diri sa ila ang involved sa illegal nga droga kag ginahulat nalang subong ang decision halin sa Korte agud matigayon nga maipaidalom sa rehabilitation.
english: Isa diri sa ila ang involved sa illegal nga droga kag ginahulat nalang subong ang decision halin sa Korte agud matigayon nga maipaidalom sa rehabilitation.

text: Suno kay Gelogo, ang sa iban nga mga kabataan, kapareho man ang proseso, kapareho sang ginahimo sa Department of Social Welfare and Development Rehabilitation Center for youth sang Nueva Valencia Guimaras.
english: According to Gelogo, the process for other children is the same, as is done at the Department of Social Welfare and Development Rehabilitation Center for youth of Nueva Valencia Guimaras.

text: Indi man manegar suno sa natungdan nga may bes nga makagwa gid ang mga kabataan bangud kay ginarason nga nahidlaw sila sa ila ginikanan.
english: Indi man manegar suno sa natungdan nga may bes nga makagwa gid ang mga kabataan bangud kay ginarason nga nahidlaw sila sa ila ginikanan.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginguba sang mga menor-de-edad ang grills sa bintana nga may sliding window rason nga nakapalagyo.
english: It was learned that the minors broke the grills of the window with the sliding window and escaped.

text: Natigayon naman ini nga makay-o kag maislan sang city engineers office sang mas dako nga grills agud indi na maguba pa.
english: The city engineers office was able to repair and replace the grills with larger grills to prevent further damage.

text: The long wait is over para sa mga fans ni Janella Salvador!
english: The long wait is over for fans of Janella Salvador!

text: Balik trabaho na ang aktres matapos ang 15 ka bulan nga pregnancy break.
english: The actress is back at work after a 15-month pregnancy break.

text: Sa Instagram post ni Janella, ginsiling sini nga “able to work” na siya kag #happyday.
english: In an Instagram post, Janella said she was “able to work” and #happyday.

text: Wala sang detalye halin sa aktres kun sa diin kag paano siya liwat nga malantaw sang iya mga fans.
english: There are no details from the actress about where and how her fans will be able to see her again.

text: Pebrero 2020 sang ulihi nga nagwa sa telebisyon si Janella.
english: Janella last appeared on television in February 2020.

text: Hunyo tubtob Agusto 2020 nangin balita sa social media nga siya ang nagbusong.
english: From June to August 2020, it became news on social media that she was pregnant.

text: September 12, 2020 ginsapubliko nila ang ila relasyon ni Markus Paterson.
english: September 12, 2020 they made their relationship with Markus Paterson public.

text: October 2020 sang ginbun-ag ni Janella ila anak ni Markus nga si Jude Trevor kag ginpakilala ini sa publiko sang Enero 2021.
english: October 2020 when Janella gave birth to their son Markus, Jude Trevor and introduced him to the public in January 2021.

text: Nagsampay na lang malapit sa kilid sang suba sa Daja Norte, Banga, Aklan, ang mga patay nga baka nga nalumos sa baha.
english: The dead cows that drowned in the floods were found near the riverbank in Daja Norte, Banga, Aklan.

text: Ini kasunod sang mamunog nga pag-ulan bangud sa Bagyo Crising.
english: This follows heavy rains due to Typhoon Crising.

text: Nagapadayon sa gihapon ang pagprotesta sang pila ka komunista nga pwersa sa South Korea apisar sang pagbawi ni South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol sang emergency martial law.
english: Protests by some communist forces in South Korea continue despite South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol's lifting of emergency martial law.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rhandy Tolentino, Bombo International Correspondent in South Korea, iya ginpahayag nga “hilaw” ang pagdeklarar sang Martial Law sang presidente sang South Korea.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rhandy Tolentino, Bombo International Correspondent in South Korea, said the declaration of Martial Law by the South Korean president is “raw”.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, sang nagdeklarar si President Yoon Suk Yeol, wala gilayon nakahibalo ang Philippine embassy kag ang pila ka mga Pinoy sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to Tolentino, when President Yoon Suk Yeol declared, the Philippine embassy and some Filipinos in the country did not immediately know.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tubtob subong may candle light rally nga ginapatigayon, kon sa diin, kalabanan sa mga nagpartisipar amo ang pamatan-on.
english: He also said that so far there is a candle light rally being held, where, most of the participants are young people.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ang pagbawi sang martial law ang kasunod sang pagpasar sang mosyon sang South Korean parliament sa ginpatigayon nga National Assembly kon sa diin, nakakuha sang boto nga 300 to 190.
