english: He also explained that the lifting of martial law follows the passage of a motion by the South Korean parliament in the National Assembly which received a vote of 300 to 190.

text: Nahibaluan nga kasunod sang resulta sang binotohay, wala na diri sang mahimo ang presidente kundi bawion ang pagdeklarar sang Martial Law.
english: It is known that following the results of the vote, the president has no choice but to withdraw the declaration of Martial Law.

text: Una ginpahayag sang administrasyon sang South Korea nga ginpatuman ang tikang agud proteksyunan ang kahilwayan kag constitutional order bangud sa mga opposition.
english: The South Korean administration initially said the move was implemented to protect freedom and constitutional order because of the opposition.

text: Patay ang chief executive officer (CEO) sang UnitedHealthcare matapos ginluthang sa guwa sang isa ka hotel sa Manhattan, New York, USA.
english: The chief executive officer (CEO) of UnitedHealthcare was shot dead outside a hotel in Manhattan, New York, USA.

text: Ang biktima amo si Bryan Thompson, 50, tumandok sang state sang Minnesota.
english: The victim was identified as Bryan Thompson, 50, a native of the state of Minnesota.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon sang mga pulis, pakadto kuntani si Thompson sa investor conference sang UnitedHealth Group sang ginpalapitan siya sang gunman kag gintiro sang makapila ka beses.
english: According to the police investigation, Thompson was on his way to a UnitedHealth Group investor conference when the gunman approached him and fired several shots.

text: Suno sa otoridad, madugay na nga nagatindog ang suspek sa lugar kag nagaguwa nga ginhulat gid sini si Thompson nga makaguwa kag amo gid ini ang iya target.
english: According to authorities, the suspect had been standing at the scene for some time and it appeared that he had been waiting for Thompson to get out and that he was his target.

text: Sunod nga ginkumpirma nga patay na ang biktima sang gindala sa Mount Sinai West.
english: The victim was later confirmed dead when he was taken to Mount Sinai West.

text: Suno sa iya asawa nga si Paulette Thompson, antes ang insidente, pila ka beses na ini nga nakabaton sang death threats.
english: His wife, Paulette Thompson, said prior to the incident, he had received several death threats.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2021 sang nagpungko si Thompson bilang CEO sang UnitedHealthcare nga kabahin sang UnitedHealth Group nga amo ang largest insurance company sa Amerika.
english: Thompson took over as CEO of UnitedHealthcare in 2021, which is part of the UnitedHealth Group, the largest insurance company in America.

text: Ginlaragway sang otoridad nga “premeditated, preplanned, kag targeted attack” ang natabo sa CEO.
english: Authorities described what happened to the CEO as a “premeditated, preplanned, and targeted attack.”

text: Ginhatagan importansiya ni Senator Mark Villar ang husto kag matalunsay nga pagpasar sang mga polisa sa imprastruktura agud makadul-ong sang epektibo nga programa para sa publiko.
english: Senator Mark Villar stressed the importance of proper and smooth passage of infrastructure policies to deliver effective programs for the public.

text: Kadungan ini sang iya pagbukas sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Public Works subong nga Martes.
english: This coincides with his opening at the hearing of the Senate Committee on Public Works this Tuesday.

text: Sa iya opening statement ginsiling niya,”We will practice utmost diligence in delivering public service.”
english: In his opening statement he said, “We will practice utmost diligence in delivering public service.”

text:
“Lilibet Diana Mountbatten-Windsor.”

Ini ang matahum nga pangalan sang healthy baby girl nga ginbun-ag ni Meghan Markle, Duchess of Sussex.
english:
“Lilibet Diana Mountbatten-Windsor.”

This is the beautiful name of the healthy baby girl born to Meghan Markle, Duchess of Sussex.

text: Si Lilibet ‘Lili’ Diana ang ikaduha nila nga anak sang iya bana nga si Prince Harry.
english: Lilibet ‘Lili’ Diana is the second child of her husband Prince Harry.

text: Suno sa spokesperson nanday Prince Harry kag Meghan, ginsunod ang pangalan ni Lili sa iya great-grandmother nga si Queen Elizabeth nga ginatawag Lilibet sa ila nga pamilya.
english: According to a spokesperson for Prince Harry and Meghan, Lili was named after her great-grandmother Queen Elizabeth, who was called Lilibet in their family.

text: Ang Diana nga iya middle name ang ginsunod naman sa iya late grandmother, ang iloy ni Prince Harry nga si Princess Diana, ang Princess of Wales.
english: Diana, her middle name, is named after her late grandmother, Prince Harry's mother, Princess Diana, the Princess of Wales.

text: Nagbun-ag si Meghan sa Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital sa California.
english: Meghan gave birth at Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital in California.

text: Sa subong suno sa spokesperson, healthy kag nagapahuway-huway sa ila balay ang mag-iloy.
english: The spokesperson said the mother and daughter are currently healthy and resting at home.

text: Pebrero sang gin-anunsyar sang duha nga nagabusong si Meghan sa ila nga baby girl.
english: In February, the couple announced that Meghan was pregnant with their baby girl.

text: Tuman ang natuga nga kahadlok sang isa ka lalaki sa mga tawo sa sulod sang bangko nga iya ginhold-up kag may ginauyatan ini nga pusil apang naputos sa itom nga plastic.
english: A man caused a lot of fear among the people inside the bank he robbed and he was holding a gun but wrapped in black plastic.

text: Natabo ini sa Gijang Busan, South Korea.
english: It took place in Gijang Busan, South Korea.

text: Sa kuha sang cctv, nagsulod sa bangko ang suspek nga may tabon ang nawong kag may dala nga attache case.
english: According to cctv footage, the suspect entered the bank with a mask and an attache case.

text: Sunod ini nga nagdeklarar sang holdap kag gintayaan sang pusil ang mga tawo.
english: He then declared a robbery and threatened the people with guns.

text: Apang may isa ka lalaki nga nagpangisog nga atakehon ang suspek gani iya ini gindumog kag nagbulig man ang iban nga tawo.
english: However, a man dared to attack the suspect so he stabbed him and other people also helped.

text: Sang nag-abot ang otoridad, didto na ginlantaw ang pusil kag ginkakibot sang tanan nga isa lamang ini ka water gun nga may disenyo nga dinosaur.
english: When the authorities arrived, they looked at the gun and to everyone's surprise it was just a water gun with a dinosaur design.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang pulis ang 30-anyos nga suspek.
english: The 30-year-old suspect is now in police custody.

text: Hatagan naman sang pagkilala ang customer nga nangisog agud dumugon ang holdaper.
english: The customer who dared to beat the holdaper will be recognized.

text: Nagbalik na sa normal ang sitwasyon sa South Korea matapos ginbawi na ni South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol ang pagpatuman sang Martial law.
english: The situation in South Korea has returned to normal after South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol lifted the implementation of martial law.

text: Mangin ang mga Pinoy sa South Korea ang nagapabilin nga kalmado.
english: Even the Filipinos in South Korea remain calm.

text: Suno kay Bombo Mary Lyn Ferrer, international correspondent sa South Korea, wala nauyunan sang mga residente sa nasambit nga pungsod ang desisyon ni President Yoon.
english: According to Bombo Mary Lyn Ferrer, international correspondent in South Korea, residents in the country did not agree with President Yoon's decision.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa natungdan, ginhimo lang ini ni President Yoon agud matabunan ang mga kapalpakan sini sa iya pagpamuno.
english: In fact, he said, President Yoon did this to cover up his failures in his leadership.

text: Indi man suno sa natungdan madula ang posibilidad nga ma-impeach si President Yoon bangud sa iya ginhimo nga pagdeklara sang Martial law.
english: He said the possibility of impeaching President Yoon for his declaration of martial law is not ruled out.

text: Apang bangud sa kahadlok sini sa mangin epekto sang iya desisyon, ginbawi man sini ang deklarasyon.
english: But fearing the consequences of his decision, he also withdrew the declaration.

text: Ang nasambit nga pagbawi ang kasunod sang pagpasar sang mosyon sang South Korean parliament sa ginpatigayon nga National Assembly nga nagapanawagan sang pagdula sang Martial Law.
english: The withdrawal follows the passage of a motion by the South Korean parliament in the National Assembly calling for the lifting of Martial Law.

text: Suno kay Yoon, magasunod ini sa nasambit nga desisyon sang mga mamalidha gani ginmanduan na niya ang mga military nga magbalik na sa ila kampo.
english: Yoon said he will follow the decision of the lawmakers and has ordered the military to return to their camps.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa National Assembly nga untatan na ang wala pulos nga tikang kaangay sang panawagan nga impeachment, legislative manipulations kag budget manipulation mga magaguba sa estado.
english: He also called on the National Assembly to stop useless steps such as calls for impeachment, legislative manipulations and budget manipulation that will destroy the state.

text: Nanindugan si Senate President Tito Sotto III nga ang mga amyenda ukon insertions, indibidwal man ukon institusyonal, nga ginahimo sa panahon sang deliberasyon ang kabahin sang regular nga proseso sang national budget.
english: Senate President Tito Sotto III insisted that amendments or insertions, whether individual or institutional, made during the deliberation period are part of the regular process of the national budget.

text: Suno kay Sotto, mandato sang mga senador nga magpasulod sang mga pagbag-o sa budget agud masiguro nga husto ang paggamit sang pondo sang pumuluyo.
english: Sotto said it is the mandate of the senators to introduce changes in the budget to ensure the proper use of public funds.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ini ang nagaserbe nga mekanismo sang check-and-balance sa paggasto sang gobyerno.
english: He said it serves as a check-and-balance mechanism in government spending.

text: Ginbawi na ni South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol ang pagpatuman sini sang Martial law.
english: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has lifted the implementation of martial law.

text: Ang nasambit nga pagbawi ang kasunod sang pagpasar sang mosyon sang South Korean parliament sa ginpatigayon nga National Assembly nga nagapanawagan sang pagdula sang Martial Law.
english: The withdrawal follows the passage of a motion by the South Korean parliament in the National Assembly calling for the lifting of Martial Law.

text: Suno kay Yoon, magasunod ini sa nasambit nga desisyon sang mga mamalidha gani ginmanduan na niya ang mga military nga magbalik na sa ila kampo.
english: Yoon said he will follow the decision of the lawmakers and has ordered the military to return to their camps.

text: Nahibaluan nga makakas lang ang Martial Law pinaagi sa pagsinapol sang State Council ukon gabinete.
english: It is known that Martial Law can only be lifted through a meeting of the State Council or cabinet.

text: Subong nga aga pa lang patigayunon ang pag-convene sang State Council kag kinahanglan sang quorum agud maaprubahan ang nasambit nga resolution.
english: The State Council will convene early this morning and a quorum is needed to approve the resolution.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa National Assembly nga untatan na ang wala pulos nga tikang kaangay sang panawagan nga impeachment, legislative manipulations kag budget manipulation mga magaguba sa estado.
english: He also called on the National Assembly to stop useless steps such as calls for impeachment, legislative manipulations and budget manipulation that will destroy the state.

text: Ginklaro sang Highway Patrol Group (HPG) Iloilo nga may ginasunod nga mga proseso ang tanan nga kaso nga may kaangtanan sa dalanun antes ini ideretso sa ila talatapan.
english: The Highway Patrol Group (HPG) Iloilo clarified that all cases related to the road are followed by processes before they are directed to their office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMaj.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMaj.

text: Ryan Palaran, Team Leader sang Provincial Highway Patrol Team Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga suno sa PNP Memorandum Circular 2025-049 ukon ang “Reporting and Disposition of Stolen and Recovered or Impounded Motor Vehicles,” nagakadapat anay nga magpalapit sa lokal nga kapulisan ang tagreklamo agud magpasaka sang blotter report antes ini i-refer sa HPG.
english: Ryan Palaran, Team Leader of the Provincial Highway Patrol Team Iloilo, said that according to PNP Memorandum Circular 2025-049 or the “Reporting and Disposition of Stolen and Recovered or Impounded Motor Vehicles,” the complainant should first approach the local police before filing a report with the HPG blotter.

text: Dugang pa ni Palaran nga pagkatapos sang pagpablotter, maga-coordinate ang mga ini sa territorial police agud hibaluon ang sitwasyon kag makabulig sa imbestigasyon sang kaso.
english: Palaran added that after the blotter, they will coordinate with the territorial police to find out the situation and assist in the investigation of the case.

text: Ini nga klaripikasyon sang HPG Iloilo ang sabat sa pila ka mga palamangkutanon sang mga biktima sang sunod-sunod nga kaso sang motornapping sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: This clarification of HPG Iloilo is the answer to some of the questions of the victims of a series of cases of motornapping in Iloilo City.

text: Naghakot sang pasidungog si Lady Gaga sa 2025 MTV Video Music Awards.
english: Lady Gaga picked up the honor at the 2025 MTV Video Music Awards.

text: Lakip sa iya nga nakuha amo ang Artist of the Year, Best Collaboration, Best Direction kag Best Art Direction.
english: Among his wins were Artist of the Year, Best Collaboration, Best Direction and Best Art Direction.

text: Nakuha naman ni Ariana Grande ang Video of the Year award sa iya “Brighter Days Ahead” kag Best Pop.
english: Ariana Grande won the Video of the Year award for “Brighter Days Ahead” and Best Pop.

text: Nagdaog naman si BlackPink member Rose kag Bruno Mars bilang Song of The Year Award sa kanilang kanta nga “APT”.
english: BlackPink member Rose and Bruno Mars won the Song of the Year Award for their song “APT”.

text: Ginpasidunggan naman bilang Best New Artist si Alex Warren samtang ang K-pop group nga Blackpink bilang Best Group.
english: Alex Warren was awarded Best New Artist while K-pop group Blackpink was awarded Best Group.

text: Ginapangunahan sang mga barangay kapitan sa Iloilo City ang ila nga mga tikang agud malikawan ang pagbalik sang ilegal nga druga sa mga kabarangayan.
english: Barangay captains in Iloilo City are leading their efforts to prevent the return of illegal drugs to the barangays.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni ABC President kag Punong Barangay Rodel Mamon sang Jaro District nga padayon ang ila monitoring system sa kada barangay, kag ginatukiban pa ang presensya sang mga minor de edad nga nadalahaig sang illegal nga aktibidad sa druga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, ABC President and Punong Barangay Rodel Mamon of Jaro District said they are continuing their monitoring system in each barangay, and are still detecting the presence of minors involved in illegal drug activities.

text: Ginapadayon man nila ang edukasyon kontra droga ilabi na sa kabataan bilang kabahin sang preventive efforts.
english: They also continue anti-drug education especially among children as part of preventive efforts.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahibalo man ni Punong Barangay Welbor Orada sang Brgy.
english: Meanwhile, Punong Barangay Welbor Orada of Brgy.

text: Tanza Esperanza nga may separate community rehab program sila para sa mga users kag pushers, nga nagalawig tubtob anum (6) ka bulan.
english: Tanza Esperanza said they have a separate community rehab program for users and pushers, which lasts up to six (6) months.

text: Naistoryahan sa Senado ang posibilidad sang pagdagdag sang penalidad sa mga ginikanan sang mga kabataan nga nagapang-bully sa eskwelahan.
english: The Senate discussed the possibility of increasing penalties for parents of children who bully at school.

text: Nagtuhaw ang amo nga proposal kadungan sang joint hearing sang Senate Committee on Basic Education kag sang Committee on Finance.
english: The proposal came during a joint hearing of the Senate Committee on Basic Education and the Committee on Finance.

text: Ginpamangkot ni Senator Bam Aquino, chair sang education committee, kun ano ang mga lihok nga ginahimo sang Department of Education (DepEd) agud matapna ang mga insidente sang bullying.
english: Senator Bam Aquino, chair of the education committee, asked what measures the Department of Education (DepEd) is taking to prevent incidents of bullying.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga kinahanglan ang mas mabakod nga preventive measures kag mas madasig nga tikang sa pagdisiplina agud nga indi maandan ang kultura sa pagtami-tami sa kapareho nga kabataan.
english: He said stronger preventive measures and swifter disciplinary measures are needed to prevent the culture of peer bullying from becoming a habit.

text: “How do we go from being the bullying capital to having a zero-bullying policy?
english: “How do we go from being the bullying capital to having a zero-bullying policy?

text: Unang-una, yung preventive—mahalaga ‘yan.
english: First of all, the preventive—that's important.

text: Dapat alam ng mga tao na hindi dapat ito ginagawa,” suno kay Aquino.
english: People should know that this should not be done,” Aquino said.

text: Diri na kag gindala sini ang gina-propose sang iban nga dapat nga mas involved man ang ginikanan kun ang ila kabataan ang nagapang-bully.
english: This is where he brought up the proposal of others that parents should be more involved when their children are bullying.

text: “And then yung parents, the parents need to be involved here.
english: “And then your parents, the parents need to be involved here.

text: May nag-suggest online na baka daw yung magulang kailangan rin ipenalize kapag yung mga anak bully,” suno sa iya.
english: Someone suggested online that maybe parents should also be penalized when their children bully,” he said.

text: Suportado naman ni Senator Raffy Tulfo ang ideya nga may sanctions dapat ang ginikanan sang bully kaangay sang community service.
english: Senator Raffy Tulfo supported the idea that there should be sanctions for the parents of the bully such as community service.

text: “Tama ka, Mr. Chair, dapat may parusa sa mga magulang.
english: “You’re right, Mr. Chair, there should be punishment for parents.

text: When I say parusa, siguro community service.
english: When I say punishment, probably community service.

text: Tapos ikaw maging janitor sa school,” suno kay Tulfo.
english: Then you become a janitor at the school,” Tulfo said.

text: Ginduso man ni Tulfo nga indi dapat “reactionary” ang eskwelahan sa kaangay sini nga mga kaso kundi dapat nga mangin proactive agud nga malikawan nga magluntad ini.
english: Tulfo also suggested that the school should not be “reactionary” in such cases but should be proactive to prevent them from happening.

text: “That’s our problem—we are reactionary.
english: “That’s our problem—we are reactionary.

text: What do you do when you find out that a child has been bullied in a certain school?
english: What do you do when you find out that a child has been bullied in a certain school?

text: Do you call the parents?” pamangkot sini.
english: Do you call the parents?” it asked.

text: Ginkwestyon man sini kun ngaa nga nakadepende pa ang imbestigasyon sa formal complaints, ilabi na nga may mga biktima nga nahadlok mag-report.
english: He also questioned why the investigation is still dependent on formal complaints, especially since there are victims who are afraid to report.

text: Nagpaathag naman ang DepEd nga ginapabaskog man nila ang ila nga mga programa nga ma-engganyo ang mga estudyante nga mag-intervene kag mag-report kun may nahibaluan sila nga bullying incidents.
english: The DepEd explained that they are also strengthening their programs to encourage students to intervene and report if they know of bullying incidents.

text: Gina-develop man sang ahensya ang parental involvement sa bullying prevention kasunod sang mga rekomendasyon halin sa Second Congressional Commission on Education.
english: The agency is also developing parental involvement in bullying prevention following recommendations from the Second Congressional Commission on Education.

text: Sandig sa EDCOM II, 63% sang Grade 5 students ang nag-report nga gina-bully sila sang at least isa ka bes sa kada isa ka semana.
english: According to EDCOM II, 63% of Grade 5 students reported being bullied at least once a week.

text: Sa hearing, ginplastar man ni EDCOM II technical specialist for basic education Riz Comia nga ang bullying makabig nga “direct driver” sang krisis sa edukasyon sa Pilipinas.
english: During the hearing, EDCOM II technical specialist for basic education Riz Comia also argued that bullying is considered a “direct driver” of the education crisis in the Philippines.

text: “Frequent exposure to bullying is associated with a significant decline in test scores,” suno kay Comia.
english: “Frequent exposure to bullying is associated with a significant decline in test scores,” according to Comia.

text: Lakip sa rekomendasyon sang EDCOM II amo ang pagpain sang dugang nga pondo kag personnel para sa anti-bullying programs kag pagbutang sang “discipline officer” position sa mga eskwelahan agud nga makaayo ang student behavior concerns.#
english: Among the recommendations of EDCOM II are the allocation of additional funds and personnel for anti-bullying programs and the establishment of a “discipline officer” position in schools to improve student behavior concerns.

text: Ka-bombo kun ikaw ang pamangkuton, gusto mo ayhan magselebrar sang imo kaadlawan sa sulod sang presuhan?
english: Ka-bombo if you were asked, would you like to celebrate your birthday inside the prison?

text: Kalabanan siguro “indi gid eh” ang sabat.
english: Most of the answers are probably “not at all”.

text: Apang didto bala sa New York, USA, may isa ka tigulang nga ginpili nga iselebrar ang iya ika-104 nga birthday paagi sa pagtuman sang iya madugay na nga plano, ang pagselebrar sa sulod sang presohan.
english: But was it in New York, USA, that an old man chose to celebrate his 104th birthday by fulfilling his long-standing plan, celebrating inside the prison.

text: Ini amo si Loretta nga nagaistar sa isa ka nursing home.
english: This is Loretta who lives in a nursing home.

text: Antes ang iya kaadlawan, nag-request ini sa Livingston County Sheriff’s Office nga luyag niya magbisita sa Livingston County Jail.
english: Before his birthday, he made a request to the Livingston County Sheriff’s Office that he wanted to visit the Livingston County Jail.

text: Nagpasugot man ang Sheriff’s Office sa request gani nga gin-tour siya sa lock-up facility.
english: The Sheriff's Office also agreed to the request and gave him a tour of the lock-up facility.

text: Ginkalipay gid sang mga personnel sang jail facility kag mangin sang mga preso ang pagbisita sa ila sang tigulang.
english: The personnel of the jail facility and the inmates were very happy with the visit of the elderly man.

text: Ginpakigbahin naman sini ang sekrekto sa malawig nga kabuhi amo ang ‘mind your own business!’
english: He shared that the secret to longevity is 'mind your own business!'

text: Iloilo – Nagdugang ang banwa sang Zarraga, Iloilo sa mga banwa nga ginpaidalom sa red infected zone bangud sa African Swine Fever.
english: Iloilo – The town of Zarraga, Iloilo has joined the towns that have been placed under the red infected zone due to African Swine Fever.

text: Matandaan nga yara man sa Red Zones ang mga banwa sang Oton, San Miguel, Leganes, New Lucena, Alimodian, Santa Barbara, Mina, Barotac Nuevo, Dumangas, Banate, Janiuay, Barotac Viejo, Dingle, Batad, kag San Dionisio.
english: The towns of Oton, San Miguel, Leganes, New Lucena, Alimodian, Santa Barbara, Mina, Barotac Nuevo, Dumangas, Banate, Janiuay, Barotac Viejo, Dingle, Batad, and San Dionisio are also in the Red Zones.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ventilacion, Iloilo Provincial Administrator, iya ginpahayag nga kaangay sa mga infected nga kabanwahan, may yara man sang igapahamtang nga mga checkpoint sa banwa sang Zarraga kun sa diin hugot nga ginadumilian ang magpasulod kag magpagwa sang baboy sa lugar agud malikawan ang paglapta sang African swine fever.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ventilacion, Iloilo Provincial Administrator, said that like the infected towns, there will also be checkpoints in Zarraga town where it is strictly prohibited to enter and leave the area to prevent the spread of African swine fever.

text: Nahibaluan nga nalakip sa ginadumilian amo ang buhi nga mga baboy kag pork products kaangay sang fresh/frozen pork products kag uncooked processed pork products.
english: It is known that among the prohibited are live pigs and pork products such as fresh/frozen pork products and uncooked processed pork products.

text: Nagpanawagan ang natungdan sa publiko nga nagakadapat nga magsunod ang tanan sa health protocols agud malikaw ang paglapta sang african swine fever sa bug-os nga probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: He appealed to the public to follow the health protocols to prevent the spread of African swine fever throughout the province of Iloilo.

text: Ipakigbato sa gihapon ni Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog ang iya odinansa nga nagaduso sa pagpatuman sang 80% nga Real Property Tax reduction nga halin sa 40%.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog will still fight for her ordinance proposing the implementation of an 80% Real Property Tax reduction from 40%.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga magatambong siya sang committee hearing sang Commitee on Ways and Means agud mapabutyag niya ang iya sentimyento.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Mabilog said he will attend the committee hearing of the Committee on Ways and Means to express his sentiments.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, apisar nga ginbasura ini sa konseho sa first reading, indi ini magauntat sa pagduso kag paghimo sang mga ordinansa nga makapamaayo sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: Mabilog said that although it was rejected by the council in the first reading, he will not stop pushing and making ordinances that will benefit Iloilo City.

text: Nagapati man si Mabilog nga fair ukon patas ang Sangguniang Panlungsod rason nga wala ini nag-ekpektar nga wala sang may maga-’second the motion’ ukon masuporta sa iya.
english: Mabilog also believes that the Sangguniang Panlungsod is fair and that is why it did not work without anyone seconding the motion or supporting him.

text: Bumanat si dating Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque kay Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co kaugnay ng isyu ng korapsyon, at iginiit na sirang-sira na umano ang relasyon nito sa sariling mga anak.
english: Former Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque approached Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co regarding the issue of corruption, and insisted that the relationship with his own children is broken.

text: Sa isang video na ibinahagi ni Roque sa kanyang Facebook account, sinabi nito na dapat ibalik ni Co ang umano’y perang ninakaw mula sa kaban ng bayan upang maayos ang relasyon sa pamilya, partikular sa anak na si Ellis Co na hayagang nagsabing nahihiya siya sa mga nangyayari.
english: In a video shared on his Facebook account, Roque said that Co should return the money allegedly stolen from the public treasury to improve the relationship with the family, particularly with his son Ellis Co who openly said he was ashamed of what was happening.

text: Ayon kay Roque, maaari pang mapabuti ni Co ang kanyang ugnayan sa mga anak kung isasauli niya ang pondong kinukuwestiyon.
english: According to Roque, Co can improve his relationship with his children if he returns the funds in question.

text: Dagdag pa niya, galit na umano ang mga ito sa kanilang ama dahil sa mga alegasyon ng korapsyon.
english: He added that the children are allegedly angry with their father over allegations of corruption.

text: Kasabay nito, hinamon ni Roque si Co na makipagkita sa kanya sa The Hague, Netherlands, matapos umanong mapabalitang nasa Europa ang kongresista.
english: Meanwhile, Roque challenged Co to meet him in The Hague, Netherlands, after the congressman was reportedly in Europe.

text: Ipinaliwanag ni Roque na maaari siyang tumulong kay Co na makagawa ng sworn statement upang mailahad ang buong katotohanan hinggil sa umano’y pagnanakaw ng pondo.
english: Roque explained that he can help Co make a sworn statement to reveal the whole truth about the alleged theft of funds.

text: Ani Roque, posibleng maging daan ito upang makapasok si Co sa Witness Protection Program sa ilalim ng susunod na administrasyon.
english: According to Roque, this may be a way for Co to join the Witness Protection Program under the next administration.

text: Samantala, kamakailan ay naglabas ng pahayag si Ellis Co hinggil sa isyu.
english: Meanwhile, Ellis Co recently issued a statement on the issue.

text: Ayon dito, nakikiisa siya sa mga mamamayan na lumalaban sa korapsyon at iginiit niyang matagal na niyang sinikap ihiwalay ang kanyang sarili sa pangalan ng kanilang pamilya.
english: According to him, he is united with the people who are fighting corruption and he insisted that he has long tried to separate himself from the name of their family.

text: Binanggit din ni Ellis na kinikilala niya ang galit at pagkasuklam ng taumbayan, at nanawagan sa kanyang ama na umuwi, humarap sa korte, at magbigay ng kasagutan sa taumbayan.
english: Ellis also mentioned that he recognizes the anger and disgust of the people, and called on his father to go home, appear in court, and give an answer to the people.

text: /JDS
english: /JDS

text: Na-rescue sang mga katapo sang Task Force on Morals and Values Formation ang isa ka menor de edad nga dalagita nga nagcheck-in sa isa ka beach resort sa Arevalo, Iloilo City kadungan sang Valentine’s day kahapon.
english: Members of the Task Force on Morals and Values ​​Formation rescued a minor girl who checked-in at a beach resort in Arevalo, Iloilo City during Valentine's Day yesterday.

text: Suno kay task force head Nestor Canong, yara sa sulod sang kwarto sang resort ang dalagita sang ginkadtuan sang tag-iya kag ginpamangkot kag nag-ako man ini angot sa iya edad.
english: According to task force head Nestor Canong, the girl was inside the resort room when the owner approached her and asked her about her age.

text: Gin-turnover ini sa mga social workers antes ginbalik sa iya ginikanan.
english: He was turned over to social workers before being returned to his parents.

text: Gin-ako naman sang personnel sang resort nga wala nila na-monitor ang mga nagasulod nga customers rason nga nakasulod ang dalagita.
english: The resort personnel admitted that they did not monitor the incoming customers which is why the girl entered.

text: Natalana naman nga pasabton ang tagdumalahan bangud sa paglapas sa ordinansa angot sa pagdumili sa mga minors nga magsulod sa kaangay nga mga accommodation establishments.
english: The management is scheduled to be held accountable for violating the ordinance prohibiting minors from entering such accommodation establishments.

text: Napasar na sang Iloilo City Council ang ordinansa nga nagapahanugot sa pagpasirado sang area kun sa diin magasugod ang pagplastar sang contractor sa relocation site para sa mga vendors nga apektado sa rehabilitation sang La Paz Public Market.
english: The Iloilo City Council has passed an ordinance allowing the closure of the area where the contractor will begin the placement of the relocation site for the vendors affected by the rehabilitation of the La Paz Public Market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Ely Estante, chairman sang Committee on Engineering, Construction, and Public Works, partikular niya nga ginplastar ang paghatag sang kiosko para sa mga eateries.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Ely Estante, chairman of the Committee on Engineering, Construction, and Public Works, specifically laid out the provision of kiosks for eateries.

text: Suno kay Estante, 28 ka stalls ang i-provide para diri kag may kadakuon lang nga 2.4 meters by 2.5 meters agud mapaigo ang tanan.
english: According to Estante, 28 stalls will be provided for this and will have a size of only 2.4 meters by 2.5 meters to accommodate everyone.

text: Pahayag ni Estante, ang Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) ang in-charge sa pag-identify kun sin-o ang i-assign sa sini nga mga kiosko.
english: Estante said the Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) is in-charge of identifying who will be assigned to these kiosks.

text: Dugang ni Estante, ang pag-provide sang kuryente sa mga kiosko ang mangin katungdanan na sang contractor nga F. Gurrea Construction, Inc.
english: Estante added that the provision of electricity to the kiosks will be the responsibility of the contractor F. Gurrea Construction, Inc.

text: apang ang Task Force Asis ang maga-assist sa pagpatakod.
english: but Task Force Asis will assist in the installation.

text: Sa bahin sang tubig, patakdan man sang linya para sa ila samtang ang drainage para sa ginagamit nga tubig sang mga eateries ang ginaplanuhan man kun diin iplastar.
english: In terms of water, a line will also be installed for them while drainage for the water used by the eateries is also planned where to be placed.

text: Dumilian naman ang pagluto sa eatery kun wala sang fire extinguisher gani ginarekomendar nga luto na nga daan nga dal-on ang mga baligya agud mas convenient.
english: Cooking is prohibited in the eatery without a fire extinguisher so it is recommended to bring pre-cooked goods for more convenience.

text: Gin-anunsiyo ni South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol nga iga-lift niya ang martial law declaration nga iya ginpatuman.
english: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has announced that he will lift the martial law declaration he imposed.

text: Ang bag-o nga anunisyo ni Yoon ang kasunod sang pagboto sang mga mamalidha nga ibasura ang martial law decree sang president kun sa diin 190 sa 300 ka mga members ang present sa parliament kag unanimous ang ila desisyon.
english: Yoon's new announcement follows the vote of lawmakers to reject the president's martial law decree where 190 of the 300 members were present in parliament and their decision was unanimous.

text: Suno sa head sang isa ka minor opposition party nga si Cho Kuk sa iya pag-atubang sa mga protesters kasunod sang deklarasyon sang martial law, isa ka delikado nga tawo si Yoon kag isa ka pagpamahog sa demokrasya kag konstitusyon.
english: According to the head of a minor opposition party Cho Kuk in his confrontation with protesters following the declaration of martial law, Yoon is a dangerous person and a threat to democracy and the constitution.

text: Nagbuya man ang amo nga opposition leader nga iga- impeach nila si Yoon paagi sa pagtipon sang tanan nga boto gikan sa iban nga mga partido.
english: The opposition leader also threatened to impeach Yoon by collecting all the votes from other parties.

text: Nagsabat na si Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo sa mga huring-huring nga break na sila sang iya long-time boyfriend nga si Neil Salvacion.
english: Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo has responded to rumors that she and her long-time boyfriend Neil Salvacion are breaking up.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, ‘it’s a complicated situation’ kag kinahanglan pa nila nga mag-istoryahanay kun makabalik siya sa Pilipinas.
english: Rabiya said it's a complicated situation and they still need to discuss whether she can return to the Philippines.

text: Space anay ang kinahanglan subong suno sa iya, apang gin-athag man niya nga indi ini ang una nga bes nga may natabo nga kaangay sini sa ila bangud pito man sila ka tuig nga magkarelasyon.
english: Space was needed now, he said, but he also explained that this is not the first time something like this happened to them because they have been in a relationship for seven years.

text: “It’s a complicated situation, and we need to talk about things when I go back to the Philippines.
english: “It’s a complicated situation, and we need to talk about things when I go back to the Philippines.

text: We are friends.
english: We are friends.

text: I still tried to contact him, but we need to have this space together… as of the moment.
english: I still tried to contact him, but we need to have this space together… as of the moment.

text: But I am not closing any doors.
english: But I am not closing any doors.

text: We’ve been in this kind of situation before.
english: We’ve been in this kind of situation before.

text: We’ve been together for seven years.
english: We’ve been together for seven years.

text: Who knows po?
english: Who even knows?

text:
Who knows.”

Nag-umpisa ang breakup rumors sang nakit-an sang publiko nga gin-delete ni Neil ang mga pictures ni Rabiya sa iya nga Instagram account.
english:
Who knows.”

The breakup rumors started when the public saw that Neil deleted Rabiya's pictures from his Instagram account.

text: Mas labi pa gid nga nagtunog ang huring-huring sang nakit-an nga magkaupod sa pictures sanday Rabiya kag ang model nga si Andre Brouillette samtang yara pa ini sa Estados Unidos pagkatapos ang Miss Universe pageant.
english: The rumors sounded even louder when Rabiya and model Andre Brouillette were spotted in pictures together while she was still in the United States after the Miss Universe pageant.

text: Madasig naman ang defense sang Ilongga beauty queen kun sa diin may gin-repost siya nga picture kag nagsiling friends lang sila ni Andre.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen was quick to defend herself where she reposted a picture and said they were just friends with Andre.

text: Gingamit sang 24 anyos nga biracial beauty ang hashtag #NotAvailable.
english: The 24-year-old biracial beauty used the hashtag #NotAvailable.

text: Sa mga nagapangita sang trabaho, amo na ini ang inyo kahigayunan!
english: For those who are looking for a job, this is your chance!

text: Nag-anunsyo ang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) nga may yara sang 12,000 ka job vacancies nga pwede gid maaply-an sang mga tawo sa Labor Day job fair nga iga-organisar sang ahensya.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) announced that there are 12,000 job vacancies that people can apply for at the Labor Day job fair to be organized by the agency.

text: Suno kay Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello, sa 12,000 ka mga trabaho nga itanyag sa Mayo 1, ang 2,000 ang iga-hire on the spot.
english: According to Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello, of the 12,000 jobs to be offered on May 1, 2,000 will be hired on the spot.

text: Magluwas diri, mismo sa Mayo 1, mangin operational naman ang Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) Hospital.
english: In addition, on May 1, the Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) Hospital will be operational.

text: Diri pwede mabulong sang libre ang mga OFWs kun may yara sang sakit amo man ang medical certificates and laboratory exams.
english: Here, OFWs can receive free treatment for illnesses as well as medical certificates and laboratory exams.

text: Mangin libre man pati na ang legal dependents sang OFWs apang may yara pa sang ginahitso nga guidelines.
english: Legal dependents of OFWs will also be free but there are still guidelines to be adjusted.

text: Nagpasalig man ang ahensya nga magapadayon ang paghatag sang bulig sa mga Pinoy agud nga maka-trabaho.##
english: The agency also assured that it will continue to provide assistance to Filipinos to find jobs.##

text: Patay ang mangunguma kag manogbaligya sang utan sa Barangay Tabug, Alimodian, Iloilo matapos natiruhan sang wala pa makilalal-an nga mga kalalakihan.
english: A farmer and vegetable vendor in Barangay Tabug, Alimodian, Iloilo was stabbed to death by unidentified men.

text: Ang biktima amo sanday Rio Agudo, 46-anyos, isa ka mangunguma kag residente sang nasambit nga barangay; Roquita Cantomayor Dolar, 50-anyos, manugbaligya sang utan, kag residente sang Sitio Tabionan, Brgy.
english: The victims were identified as Rio Agudo, 46, a farmer and resident of the said barangay; Roquita Cantomayor Dolar, 50, vegetable vendor, and resident of Sitio Tabionan, Brgy.

text: Bucari, Leon, Iloilo.
english: Bucari, Leon, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Marion Asparo, Hepe sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga magalawig kontani sang karbaw si Agudo kag hinali nga gintiro sang duha ka kalalakihan nga nakasuksok sang bonnet.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Marion Asparo, chief of Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said Agudo was about to ride a cow when he was suddenly shot by two men wearing bonnets.

text: Samtang, nadalahig naman sa pagpangluthang si Dolar nga mamyesta lang man kontani sa amo nga barangay.
english: Meanwhile, Dolar was involved in the shooting when he was about to celebrate a party in the barangay.

text: Suno kay Asparo, ginsundan sang mga suspek si Agudo antes nakakuha sang tyempo agud himuon ang krimen.
english: According to Asparo, the suspects followed Agudo before getting time to commit the crime.

text: Nag-agum sang patal nga pilas sa ulo si Agudo kon sa diin, nadagdag pa ini sa pil-as kasunod sang pagpangluthang.
english: Agudo sustained fatal head injuries and was thrown into the ravine following the shooting.

text: Pilas naman sa lawas ang naagum ni Dolar nga nagtuga man sang iya kamatayon.
english: Dolar sustained injuries to his body which also led to his death.

text: Gindala pa ang duha sa Aleosan District Hospital apang gindeklarar nga dead-on-arrival.
english: The two were rushed to the Aleosan District Hospital but were declared dead on arrival.

text: Na-recover sang otoridad sa crime scene ang caliber 45 pistol kag duha ka empty shells sang amo nga unit sang armas.
english: Police recovered a caliber 45 pistol and two empty shells of the same unit of firearm from the crime scene.

text: Ginalantaw naman ang anggulo nga personal grudge kag pagpangawat ang motibo sang mga suspek sa paghimo sang krimen.
english: Personal grudge and robbery are believed to be the motives of the suspects in committing the crime.

text: Nagdeklarar sang emergency martial law si South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has declared emergency martial law.

text: Suno kay Yoon, ini nga tikang ang importante agud protektahan ang pungsod gikan sa komunista nga pwersa sa tunga sang parliamentary nga tension tuhoy sa budget bill.
english: Yoon said the move was important to protect the country from communist forces amid parliamentary tension over the budget bill.

text: Ginpahayag ni Yoon nga agud mapangapinan ang liberal nga South Korea gikan sa pagpamahog sang communist forces sang North Korea kag mapapas ang anti-state elements, gindeklarar niya ang emergency martial law.
english: Yoon said that in order to defend liberal South Korea from the threat of North Korea's communist forces and eliminate anti-state elements, he declared emergency martial law.

text: Suno pa sa presidente, ginhimo niya ang desisyon agud proteksyunan ang kahilwayan kag constitutional order bangud sa mga katapo sang opposition nga luyag i- paralyse ang administration paagi sa impeachment moves.
english: The president said he made the decision to protect freedom and constitutional order because of members of the opposition who want to paralyze the administration through impeachment moves.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang mga tikang nga himuon ukon kun paano maapektuhan ang pagpamuno kag demokrasya sa pungsod.
english: It is not yet clear what steps will be taken or how leadership and democracy in the country will be affected.

text: Humalin sang nagpungko sang 2022, nangin mabudlay para kay Yoon nga iduso ang iya agenda batok sa opposition-controlled parliament.
english: Since taking office in 2022, it has been difficult for Yoon to push his agenda against the opposition-controlled parliament.

text: Dugang niya, wala sila sang choice kundi maghimo sang amo nga tikang bangud gina-hostage sang opposition parties ang parliamentary process agud ibutang sa krisis ang pungsod.
english: He added that they have no choice but to take such a step because the opposition parties are holding the parliamentary process hostage to put the country in crisis.

text: Ginrason ni Ako Bicol Rep.
english: Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co sa iya nga pag-resign sa pwesto ang mga ginaalegar pamahog sa iya kabuhi kag sa iya pamilya kag ang pagdingot sa iya sang iya kinamatarong sa due process sang layi.
english: Zaldy Co in his resignation from office the alleged threats to his life and his family and the denial of his right to due process of law.

text: Ini sa tunga sang pagtudlo sa iya nga isa sa mga involved sa budget insertions kag kickback scheme sa flood control projects.
english: This is amid allegations that he was involved in budget insertions and kickback scheme in flood control projects.

text: “On the account of the real, direct, grave and imminent threat to the lives of my family and me, and the evident denial of my right to due process of law, I am constrained to tender with immediate effect my irrevocable resignation as a member of the House of Representatives,” pahayag sang anay kongresista.
english: “On account of the real, direct, grave and imminent threat to the lives of my family and me, and the evident denial of my right to due process of law, I am constrained to tender with immediate effect my irrevocable resignation as a member of the House of Representatives,” the former congressman said.

text: Sa iya sulat kay House Speaker Faustino Dy III, ginpahayag sini nga epektibo gilayon ang iya nga irrevocable resignation bilang myembro sang Kamara kag ipahibalo lang ugaling sang Ako Bicol kun sin-o nga nominee ang magabulos.
english: In a letter to House Speaker Faustino Dy III, he said his irrevocable resignation as a member of the House of Representatives is effective immediately and Ako Bicol will announce which nominee will replace him.

text: Ginpahat-pahat man sini ang iya sabat sa mga alegasyon ni Navotas Lone District Rep.
english: He also shared his response to the allegations of Navotas Lone District Rep.

text: Toby Tiangco nga amo ang nagpasaka sang ethics complaint batok sa iya.
english: Toby Tiangco who filed the ethics complaint against him.

text: Hugot nga ginpanginwala ni Co ang mga last-minute insertions sa 2025 budget.
english: Co vehemently denied the last-minute insertions in the 2025 budget.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga wala siya sang ginpasa nga medical certificates sang nag-file sang leave of absence bangud nga wala man ini gina-require.
english: He also said that he did not submit any medical certificates when he filed for leave of absence because it is not required.

text: Apang dugang niya, halin pa sang tunga-tunga sang 2024, nagabalik-balik na siya sa mga doctor abroad agud nga magpakonsulta.
english: But he added that since mid-2024, he has been going back and forth to doctors abroad for consultations.

text:
May separado naman nga sulat si Co sa Ako Bicol Partylist nga nagasiling: “It is with great sadness that I inform you that I will be taking a leave of absence from the Ako Bicol Partylist starting today until such time as it is safe for me to return to the Philippines to resume my duties as a member and representative of our organization and to address the many false claims being made against me.”

Ginkumpirma naman ni Speaker Dy nga nabaton na sini ang resignation letter.
english:
Co wrote a separate letter to the Ako Bicol Partylist saying: “It is with great sadness that I inform you that I will be taking a leave of absence from the Ako Bicol Partylist starting today until such time as it is safe for me to return to the Philippines to resume my duties as a member and representative of our organization Me.”

Speaker Dy confirmed that he has received the resignation letter.

text: Depende na suno sa iya sa Department of Justice kun ano nga kaso ang atubangon ni Co bangud wala na sang hurisdiksyon sa iya ang House Committee on Ethics kasunod sang pagpanaog sini sa pwesto.#
english: He said it is up to the Department of Justice what case Co will face because the House Committee on Ethics no longer has jurisdiction over him following his resignation.

text: Isang Filipino ang kabilang sa mga crew ng isang Dutch-flagged cargo ship na sinalakay ng isang explosive device sa Gulf of Aden, ayon sa European Union maritime mission na Aspides.
english: A Filipino was among the crew of a Dutch-flagged cargo ship that was attacked by an explosive device in the Gulf of Aden, according to the European Union maritime mission Aspides.

text: Inilikas ng mga rescuer ang 19 crew ng barkong Minervagracht, na binubuo ng mga Russian, Ukrainian, Filipino, at Sri Lankan matapos ang pag-atake na nagdulot ng malawakang pinsala at sunog sa barko.
english: Rescuers evacuated the 19 crew of the ship Minervagracht, made up of Russians, Ukrainians, Filipinos, and Sri Lankans after the attack caused extensive damage and fire to the ship.

text: Ayon sa Aspides, isa sa mga crew ang nagtamo ng sugat at nasa ligtas nang kondisyon habang isa pa ang malubhang nasaktan at dinala patungong Djibouti para sa medikal na atensyon.
english: According to Aspides, one of the crew sustained injuries and is in safe condition while another was seriously injured and taken to Djibouti for medical attention.

text: Kinumpirma ng operator ng barko, ang Amsterdam-based Spliethoff, na ang Minervagracht ay nasa international waters ng Gulf of Aden nang tamaan ito ng isang hindi pa natutukoy na explosive device na nagpasimula ng sunog at nagdulot ng malaking pinsala.
english: The ship's operator, Amsterdam-based Spliethoff, confirmed that the Minervagracht was in the international waters of the Gulf of Aden when it was hit by an unidentified explosive device that started a fire and caused extensive damage.

text: Dagdag pa ng Aspides, ang cargo ship ay nasa humigit-kumulang 128 nautical miles timog-silangan ng port ng Aden sa Yemen nang mangyari ang pagsabog, at hindi ito humiling ng proteksiyon mula sa kanilang misyon bago ang insidente.
english: Aspides added that the cargo ship was about 128 nautical miles southeast of the port of Aden in Yemen when the explosion occurred, and it did not seek protection from their mission before the incident.

text: Hindi pa malinaw kung ang mga Houthi rebel na kaalyado ng Iran sa Yemen ang responsable sa atake.
english: It is not clear whether the Houthi rebels, Iran's allies in Yemen, were responsible for the attack.

text: Simula 2023, ilang beses na silang umatake sa mga barkong naglalayag sa Red Sea na itinuturing nilang konektado sa Israel, bilang pakikiisa umano sa Palestine sa gitna ng digmaan sa Gaza.
english: Since 2023, they have repeatedly attacked ships sailing in the Red Sea that they consider connected to Israel, in solidarity with Palestine in the midst of the Gaza conflict.

text: Kung mapapatunayan, ito ang unang pag-atake ng Houthi laban sa isang commercial ship mula noong Setyembre 1, nang targetin nila ang Israeli-owned tanker na Scarlet Ray malapit sa port city ng Yanbu sa Red Sea ng Saudi Arabia.
english: If confirmed, this would be the first Houthi attack against a commercial ship since September 1, when they targeted the Israeli-owned tanker Scarlet Ray near the port city of Yanbu in Saudi Arabia's Red Sea.

text: Noong Hulyo, umatake rin ang mga Houthi at pinalubog ang bulk carrier na Magic Seas at ang cargo ship na Eternity C sa Red Sea.
english: In July, the Houthis also attacked and sank the bulk carrier Magic Seas and the cargo ship Eternity C in the Red Sea.

text: Ang huling malaking atake naman ng mga rebelde sa Gulf of Aden ay laban sa Singapore-flagged container ship na Lobivia noong Hulyo 2024.
english: The last major rebel attack in the Gulf of Aden was against the Singapore-flagged container ship Lobivia in July 2024.

text: Batay pa sa British security firm na Ambrey, dati na ring tinarget ang Minervagracht noong Setyembre 23 habang ito ay patungo sa Djibouti.
english: According to British security firm Ambrey, Minervagracht was previously targeted on September 23 while it was en route to Djibouti.

text: /Via Reuters
english: /Via Reuters

text: Excited na sa bag-o nga chapter sang iya nga career si Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo.
english: Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo is excited for the new chapter of her career.

text: Matapos makasulod sa Top 21 sang Miss Universe pageant, handa na si Rabiya para sa oportunidad nga maabot sa iya kabuhi.
english: After making it to the Top 21 of the Miss Universe pageant, Rabiya is ready for the opportunity to come in her life.

text: Isa sa posibilidad para kay Rabiya amo ang pagsulod sa showbiz.
english: One of the possibilities for Rabiya is to enter showbiz.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, posible nga may yara siya sang teleserye nga pagahimuon antes magtakop ang tuig.
english: Rabiya said she might have a teleserye lined up before the end of the year.

text: Sa subong, yara pa sa Estados Unidos ang Ilongga beauty queen.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen is currently in the United States.

text: Wala nagpaulihi ang pila sa mga Filipino sa pagdala sang ‘Pinoy vibes’ nga pagselebrar sang Christmas sa Qatar.
english: Some Filipinos did not hesitate to bring the 'Pinoy vibes' celebration of Christmas in Qatar.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joseph Rivera, Bombo International Correspondent in Qatar, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka normal working day ang adlaw mismo sang paskwa sa Qatar, apang ang pinasahi sa paghiwat sang Christmas sa ila, amo ang pag-display sang mga ‘slim’ nga Santa Claus figure.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joseph Rivera, Bombo International Correspondent in Qatar, said that Christmas Day is a normal working day in Qatar, but the special thing about celebrating Christmas in Qatar is the display of slim Santa Claus figures.

text: Ginlaragway man sini nga ang pagselebrar sang paskwa sa amo nga pungsod ang daw kaangay lamang sa Pilipinas nga masami madamo sang dekorasyon.
english: He also described the celebration of Christmas in the country as similar to the Philippines which often has many decorations.

text: Ang kinalain lamang suno sa natungdan, amo ang wala sang mga belen kag wala man sang makit-an nga tinaga nga “Christmas” luwas sa sulod sang Catholic Church.
english: The only difference, he said, is that there are no nativity scenes and there is no word “Christmas” except inside the Catholic Church.

text: Indi naman pwede makahiwat sang Christmas Party ang pumuluyo sa sagwa sang balay ukon outdoor bangud man sa matugnaw nga panahon.
english: Residents are not allowed to hold Christmas parties outside their homes or outdoors due to the cold weather.

text: Nagdepensa si anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga naga-himo-himo lang sang istorya si Vice President Sara Duterte kag gina-akusaran siya sang mga iligal nga buluhaton nga wala man sang ebidensya.
english: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez defended that Vice President Sara Duterte is making up stories and accusing her of illegal activities without evidence.

text: Indi matuod suno sa anay House leader nga nagabaton siya sang suhol halin sa ilegal nga sugal.
english: The former House leader said it is not true that he receives bribes from illegal gambling.

text: “Naririnig ko ang mga akusasyon.
english: “I hear the accusations.

text: Diretsahan kong sasabihin hindi totoo na ako’y tumatatanggap mula sa ilegal na sugal,” pahayag niya.
english: I will say frankly that it is not true that I am receiving money from illegal gambling,” he said.

text:
“Lahat guni-guni.”

Pahayag pa sini, si Duterte nga gin-impeach sang Kamara bangud sang misuse sang public funds amo pa ang nagapalapta sini nga binutig.
english:
“All bags.”

He said Duterte, who was impeached by the House of Representatives for misuse of public funds, is still spreading this lie.

text: Indi dapat pagpatihan ini nga mga istorya suno kay Romualdez bangud wala sang kredibilidad ang nagahambal.
english: Romualdez said these stories should not be believed because there is no credibility in the speaker.

text: “Madaling magturo, madaling mag-imbento — pero ang katotohanan, hindi kayang patunayan.
english: “It's easy to teach, it's easy to invent — but the truth is impossible to prove.

text: Until today, wala pa ring ipinakitang ebidensya — puro sabi-sabi lang na inuulit-ulit,” pahayag sini sa iya gin-release nga statement.
english: Until today, no evidence has been shown — just rumors that are repeated,” he said in a statement.

text: “Sa isyung Okada/Delaware, malinaw: hindi ako kasali, hindi ako iniimbestigahan, at hindi ako akusado.
english: “On the Okada/Delaware issue, it is clear: I am not involved, I am not being investigated, and I am not accused.

text: Wala akong kinalaman sa kasong iyon, na away ng dalawang negosyo.
english: I have nothing to do with that case, which is a fight between two businesses.

text: Binabalik lang ngayon para siraan ako,” dugang sini.
english: They are just coming back now to shut me up,” he added.

text: “Nakakalungkot na ang mismong Bise Presidente, na inakusahan at na-impeach ng House dahil sa maling paggamit ng pondo, ay siya pang nagkakalat ng ganitong kasinungalingan.
english: “It is sad that the Vice President himself, who was accused and impeached by the House for misuse of funds, is still spreading such lies.

text:
When the source itself has lost credibility, why should anyone believe these baseless claims?”

Ini nga sabat ang kasunod sang ginbuyagyag ni VP Sara nga indi lang sa flood control projects nagabaton sang kickback si Romualdez kundi mangin sa illegal gambling.
english:
When the source itself has lost credibility, why should anyone believe these baseless claims?”

This answer follows VP Sara's revelation that Romualdez is not only receiving kickbacks for flood control projects but also for illegal gambling.

text: Pahayag sang bise, nakuha sini ang impormasyon halin sa staff ni Romualdez nga amo man ang nag-tip sa iya kaangot sa ginpahayag sini nga “pag-atake” sang Kamara sa confidential funds sang Office of the Vice President.#
english: The vice said he got the information from Romualdez's staff who also tipped him off about the House's alleged “attack” on the confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President.

text:
Text by: Bombo Ray Gerald Badiang

Wala gihapon sang face-to-face nga klase sa Pis-anan National High School kag Pis-anan Central School sa banwa sang Sibalom, Antique.
english:
Text by: Bombo Ray Gerald Badiang

There are still no face-to-face classes at Pis-anan National High School and Pis-anan Central School in Sibalom, Antique.

text: Ini apisar subong na kuntani nga adlaw, Hulyo 16, natalana nga makabalik ang mga estudyante sa eskwelahan matapos nga gin-suspend ang klase kasunod sang natabo nga chemical poisoning nga nagresulta sa pagkalipong sang 200 tubtob 300 ka mga kabataan.
english: This is despite the fact that today, July 16, students are scheduled to return to school after classes were suspended following the chemical poisoning that resulted in the dizziness of 200 to 300 children.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpatigayon ang decontamination sa mga classroom sang Hulyo 14 kag 15, gamit ang pressurized water kag dishwashing soap agud malimpyuhan ang palibot kag malikawan ang epekto sang baho nga una na ginreklamo sang mga ginikanan.
english: Decontamination was conducted in the classrooms on July 14 and 15, using pressurized water and dishwashing soap to clean the environment and avoid the effects of the smell that parents had already complained about.

text: Apang base sa inisyal nga ebalwasyon, may yara pa sang mahaklo nga baho sang chemical sa pila ka parte sang eskwelahan, rason nga ginpili sang lokal nga pamunuan nga indi anay pagpabalikon ang mga kabataan.
english: However, based on initial evaluation, there is still a strong smell of chemicals in some parts of the school, which is why the local government chose not to send the children back.

text: Ginpaguwa ni Sibalom Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña ang executive order nga nagamando nga padayon sa Alternative Delivery Mode ang klase tubtob nga masiguro nga limpyo na kag wala sang baho ang classrooms.
english: Sibalom Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña issued an executive order ordering that classes continue in Alternative Delivery Mode until it is ensured that the classrooms are clean and free of odor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson sang DepEd Region 6, ginpahayag sini nga apisar nga face-to-face classes gid ang ideal nga setup para sa pagtudlo sang mga kabataan, ginrespeto nila sa gihapon ang desisyon sang lokal nga gobyerno kag ang mga guidelines sang DILG bangud prayoridad ang safety sang mga estudyante.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson of DepEd Region 6, said that although face-to-face classes are the ideal setup for teaching children, they still respected the decision of the local government and the guidelines of the DILG because the safety of the students is a priority.

text: Padayon subong ang ginapatigayon nga decontamination sa eskwelahan, kag ginapaabot sang mga otoridad nga sa mas madali nga panahon, makabalik na sa face-to-face classes ang mga estudyante.
english: Decontamination is ongoing at the school, and authorities expect students to return to face-to-face classes as soon as possible.

text: Gindayaw ni Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Huang Xilian ang iya ginpahayag mas maayo nga relasyon sang Pilipinas kag China sa nagligad nga anum ka tuig.
english: Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Huang Xilian praised what he said was a better relationship between the Philippines and China in the past six years.

text: Nagpahayag man ini nga kuntani mapadayon ang amo nga relasyon sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod apisar nga magatakop na ang administrasyon ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: He also expressed hope that the relationship between the two countries will continue despite the end of President Rodrigo Duterte's administration.

text: Sa isa ka photo exhibit nga gin-organisar sang Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry Inc., ginpakita ang nangin proyekto sang China sa Pilipinas sang nagliligad nga mga tuig.
english: In a photo exhibit organized by the Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry Inc., China's projects in the Philippines in recent years were shown.

text: Suno sa Chinese ambassador, nagdoble pa ang trade sang duha ka pungsod kag apat ka pilo gid ang nangin investments sang China sa Pilipinas sa sulod man sang amo nga tion, ipaanggid sa nagligad nga anum ka tuig sa idalom sang lain nga administrasyon.
english: According to the Chinese ambassador, trade between the two countries has doubled and China's investments in the Philippines have quadrupled during the same period, compared to the past six years under a different administration.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2016, nagpahayag si Duterte nga nagpromisa si Chinese President Xi Jinping sang investments kag loan pledge sa Pilipinas sa kabug-usan nga balor nga $24 billion ukon P1.26 trillion.
english: In 2016, Duterte said Chinese President Xi Jinping promised investments and loan pledges to the Philippines worth $24 billion or P1.26 trillion.

text: Apang sandig sa nangin report sang Bloomberg sang 2021, wala pa nahatag sang China ini nga billions apisar nga malapit si Duterte sa amo nga nasyon.
english: But according to a Bloomberg report in 2021, China has not yet given these billions despite Duterte's close ties to the country.

text: Suno pa sa report, kalabanan sang big-ticket projects sa Pilipinas nga ginpondohan sang China ang nagakinahanglan pa lang sang approval.
english: According to the report, most of the big-ticket projects in the Philippines funded by China still need approval.

text: Target sang Ilongga beauty queen nga makakuha sang isa sa mga korona sa Miss World Philippines 2021.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen targets to win one of the crowns at Miss World Philippines 2021.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ruffa Nava, iya ginpahayag nga antes magtakop ang iya journey sa pageantry, luyag niya nga makuha ang Supranational ukon Reina Hispanoamericana title.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ruffa Nava said that before her journey in pageantry ends, she wants to win the Supranational or Reina Hispanoamericana title.

text: Apat ka mga national pageants kag isa ka international pageant na ang na-intrahan ni Ruffa.
english: Ruffa has participated in four national pageants and one international pageant.

text: Suno sa beauty queen, sa kada pag-intra niya sa beauty pageant kada tuig, naga-evolve man siya bilang beauty queen kag mas nagamaayo pa.
english: According to the beauty queen, every time she participates in the beauty pageant every year, she evolves as a beauty queen and gets better.

text: Si Ruffa ang yara sa beauty camp nga Kagandahang Flores.
english: Ruffa is in the beauty camp Kagandahang Flores.

text: Ang adbokasiya niya ang nagasentro sa paghatag sang libre nga edukasyon sa mga kabataan ilabi na ang mga yara sa pigado nga lugar.
english: His advocacy focuses on providing free education to children especially those in poor areas.

text: Gin-ako man ni Ruffa nga nagakabatyag siya sang pressure bangud sa bag-o lang natapos nga Miss Universe pageant sa diin ang nangin tiglawas sang Pilipinas ang isa ka Ilongga nga si Rabiya Mateo.
english: Ruffa also admitted that she feels pressure because of the recently concluded Miss Universe pageant where an Ilongga, Rabiya Mateo, represented the Philippines.

text: Indi man manigar nga may mga kritisismo siya nga mabaton apang pahayag niya, naanad na siya sa mga ginahaboy nga tinaga sa iya apang wala na niya ini ginasapak pa.
english: He doesn't deny that he receives criticism but he said he is used to the words thrown at him but he doesn't care anymore.

text: Halos isa ka bulan antes ang official turnover of power sa Enero 20, nagdesisyon si US President Joe Biden nga hatagan sang pardon ang iya anak nga si Hunter Biden.
english: Almost a month before the official turnover of power on January 20, US President Joe Biden decided to grant a pardon to his son Hunter Biden.

text: Si Hunter ang nagapangatubang sang tatlo ka felony gun charges, tatlo ka felony tax offenses, kag anom ka misdemeanor tax offenses.
english: Hunter faces three felony gun charges, three felony tax offenses, and six misdemeanor tax offenses.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga pahayag sang White House, nanindugan si President Biden nga ang mga akusasyon batok kay Hunter ang indi patas kag lunsay mga pato-pato lang halin sa political opponents nga luyag balabagan ang iya administrasyon.
english: In a statement issued by the White House, President Biden insisted that the accusations against Hunter are unfair and all fabrications from political opponents who want to disrupt his administration.

text: Gindepensa ni Pres.
english: Defended by Pres.

text: Biden nga si Hunter ang wala naga-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sa sulod sang masobra lima ka tuig kag indi dapat pag-atakihon.
english: Biden said Hunter has been sober for more than five years and should not be attacked.

text: “There has been an effort to break Hunter – who has been five and a half years sober, even in the face of unrelenting attacks and selective prosecution.
english: “There has been an effort to break Hunter – who has been five and a half years sober, even in the face of unrelenting attacks and selective prosecution.

text: In trying to break Hunter, they’ve tried to break me – and there’s no reason to believe it will stop here.
english: In trying to break Hunter, they’ve tried to break me – and there’s no reason to believe it will stop here.

text: Enough is enough,” pahayag ni Pres.
english: Enough is enough,” said Pres.

text: Biden.
english: Biden.

text: Suno pa sa US President, ang mga kaso batok sa iya anak ang nag-umpisa sa isa ka plea deal nga napaslawan sa US Court bangud sa pagtum-ok sang mga kasumpong sa politika.
english: According to the US President, the cases against his son began with a plea deal that failed in the US Court due to the pressure of political opponents.

text: Gin-athag man ni Biden nga wala siya nagapahilabot sa desisyon sang Department of Justice, apang bilang isa ka amay, luyag niya nga depensahan ang iya anak.
english: Biden also made it clear that he was not interfering with the Department of Justice’s decision, but as a father, he wanted to defend his son.

text: Nagdangat sa malapit P1.4 billion ang balor sang damage sa agrikultura bangud sang bagyo Agaton.
english: The damage to agriculture due to Typhoon Agaton reached nearly P1.4 billion.

text: Sa ginpaggwa nga bulletin sang Department of Agriculture (DA), ang nasambit nga bagyo ang nag-apekto sa 23,188 nga mga mangunguma kag manugpangisda samtang nagdangat sa 35,258 metric tons ang volume sang production loss kag 17,384 ka ektarya sang agricultural areas sa Western Visayas, Eastern Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Soccsksargen kag Caraga ang naapektuhan.
english: According to the bulletin released by the Department of Agriculture (DA), the typhoon affected 23,188 farmers and fisherfolk while the volume of production loss reached 35,258 metric tons and 17,384 hectares of agricultural areas in Western Visayas, Eastern Visayas, Peninsula, Zamboula Soccsksargen and Caraga were affected.

text: Ang fisheries amo ang labing naapektuhan nga may total nga P763.3 million nga value loss kag 2,234 nga manugpangisda ang apektado.
english: The fisheries were the most affected with a total value loss of P763.3 million and 2,234 fishermen were affected.

text: Nagdangat naman sa 33,501 MT ang volume loss sa palay kag 16,752 ka ektarya sang lupa nga nagabalor sang P595.6 million ang apektado.
english: The volume loss in rice reached 33,501 MT and 16,752 hectares of land worth P595.6 million were affected.

text: Sa high value crops, P30 million nga may volume loss nga 866 MT kag 215 nga ektarya sang lupa ang naguba.
english: In high value crops, P30 million with a volume loss of 866 MT and 215 hectares of land were destroyed.

text: Sa mais, nagdangat sa P21.4 million ang kapyerdehan kun sa diin, ang volume loss ang naglab-ot sa 891 MT kag 417 ka ektarya sang lupa ang na-wipe out.
english: In corn, the loss amounted to P21.4 million with a volume loss of 891 MT and 417 hectares of land wiped out.

text: Ang damage naman sa livestock kag poultry ang nagdangat sa P7.2 million kun sa diin, 12,771 ka ulo sang manok, baboy, carabao, pato kag kanding ang nagkalamatay.
english: The damage to livestock and poultry amounted to P7.2 million where 12,771 heads of chickens, pigs, carabaos, ducks and goats died.

text: Suno sa DA, nagapatigayon na sila sang assessment sang guba kag kapyerdehan nga tuga sang bagyo sa agri-fisheries sector pinaagi sa mga regional field offices.
english: According to the DA, they are already conducting an assessment of the damage and losses caused by the typhoon in the agri-fisheries sector through regional field offices.

text: Nagapadayon man ang pagpakig-angot sa concerned national government agencies, local government units kag iban pa nga disaster reduction kag management-related offices sa epekto sang tropical depression kag subong man sa available nga resources nga gamiton para sa intervention kag assistance.
english: Liaison is also ongoing with concerned national government agencies, local government units and other disaster reduction and management-related offices on the impact of tropical depression as well as on available resources to be used for intervention and assistance.

text: Suno sa ahensya, yari ang mga assistance nga ihatag sa mga apektado nga mangunguma kag manugpangisda:
english: According to the agency, here are the assistance to be given to the affected farmers and fisherfolk:

text: Gin-raid sang mga pulis ang mga bar kag nightclubs sa Moscow, Russia sa idalom sang layi nga naga-hatag sang penalidad sa LGBT propaganda.
english: Police raided bars and nightclubs in Moscow, Russia under a law that criminalizes LGBT propaganda.

text: Sa amo nga mga operasyon, may ginpangkumpiskar man nga smartphones, laptops kag video cameras samtang ginpang-check naman ang club-goers kag ang ila nga mga dokumento.
english: In the operations, smartphones, laptops and video cameras were also confiscated while club-goers and their documents were checked.

text: Samtang ginahimo ini, ginpahapa sa salog ang partygoers sa nightclub samtang may yara naman nga popular nga gay club kun sa diin gin-escort paguwa ang mga tawo.
english: While doing so, partygoers were knocked to the floor in the nightclub while there was a popular gay club where people were escorted out.

text: Suno sa Interior Ministry, ginsulod man sang mga pulis ang isa ka nightclub nga nagapalapta sang propaganda sa ideolohiya sang ginadumilian nga LGBT movement.
english: According to the Interior Ministry, police also raided a nightclub that was spreading propaganda on the ideology of the banned LGBT movement.

text: Ini nga raid ang ginpatigayon kadungan sang una nga anibersaryo sang pag-ban sang Russian Supreme Court sang “international LGBT movement”.
english: The raid was conducted on the first anniversary of the Russian Supreme Court's ban on the international LGBT movement.

text: Ginakabig ini sang otoridad nga “extremist organization” nga amo ang rason sang pagdakop kag pag-prosecute sang mga miyembro sang LGBTQ community sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Authorities consider it an “extremist organization” that is responsible for the arrest and prosecution of members of the LGBTQ community in the country.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang gin-lunsar sang Russia ang military attack sini sa Ukraine halos tatlo ka tuig na ang nagligad, ginpasangkad pa sini ang ila conservative rhetoric kag ila nga “traditional values” bilang pagpakita man sang ila pagkontra sa Western countries kag sa ila mga kinaandan nga pagginawi.
english: Since Russia launched its military attack on Ukraine nearly three years ago, it has expanded its conservative rhetoric and traditional values ​​as a sign of its opposition to Western countries and their traditional practices.

text: Ginpanugyanan ni Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach ang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Rabiya Mateo nga ihibi lang ang iya ginabatyag matapos ang nangin Miss Universe journey sini.
english: Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach advised Ilongga beauty queen Rabiya Mateo to just cry after her Miss Universe journey.

text: Suno kay Pia, ginkamusta niya si Rabiya kag ginpabatyag nga wala ini naga-isahanon.
english: Pia says she greeted Rabiya and made her feel that she is not alone.

text: Gin-abisohan man niya ang Miss Universe semi-finalist nga madamo sang oportunidad ang nagahulat sa iya nga pagpauli sa Pilipinas.
english: He also advised the Miss Universe semi-finalist that many opportunities await her when she returns to the Philippines.

text: Sa pihak sang kapaslawan nga makuha ang ika-lima nga Miss Universe crown para sa pungsod, ginpahayag naman ni Rabiya nga ginhimo niya ang tanan nga masarangan kag excited na ini para sa panibag-o nga chapter sang iya nga kabuhi.
english: Despite failing to win the fifth Miss Universe crown for the country, Rabiya said she did everything she could and is excited for the new chapter of her life.

text: Antes magpauli sa Pilipinas, yara subong naga-enjoy ang Ilongga beauty queen sa paglibot sa Estados Unidos.
english: Before returning to the Philippines, the Ilongga beauty queen is currently enjoying a tour of the United States.

text: Nagsabat si Leyte 1st District Representative kag anay House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez nga indi ‘expose’ ang ginhimo ni Senator Francis Escudero sa iya nga privilege speech.
english: Leyte 1st District Representative and former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez responded that Senator Francis Escudero's privilege speech was not an expose.

text: Sa baylo suno kay Romualdez, isa ini ka DDS ukon Diehard Duterte Supporter script.
english: Instead, Romualdez said, it is a DDS or Diehard Duterte Supporter script.

text: Pahayag sang anay house leader, wala na sang bag-o kag wala sang kamatuoran sa kaundan sang speech bangud recycled na ini nga mga akusasyon sang DDS ilabi na suno sa iya sa troll pages kag sa social media networks.
english: The former house leader said there is nothing new and no truth in the content of the speech because these are recycled accusations of DDS especially on troll pages and social media networks.

text: “I listened to the privilege speech of Sen.
english: “I listened to the privilege speech of Sen.

text: Chiz Escudero.
english: Chiz Escudero.

text: With respect, what we heard was not an exposé but a DDS script — the same recycled accusations we have long seen on troll pages and social media posts.
english: With respect, what we heard was not an exposé but a DDS script — the same recycled accusations we have long seen on troll pages and social media posts.

text: Walang bago, at wala ring katotohanan,” suno sa kongresista.
english: Nothing new, and no truth,” the congressman said.

text: “Instead of answering the serious questions he himself must face, Sen.
english: “Instead of answering the serious questions he himself must face, Sen.

text: Escudero chose to deflect.
english: Escudero chose to deflect.

text: He did not deny the allegations against him.
english: He did not deny the allegations against him.

text: He did not explain his own role in flood-control kickbacks.
english: He did not explain his own role in flood-control kickbacks.

text: Imbes na magpaliwanag, nanisi siya,” dugang sini.
english: Instead of explaining, he got angry,” it added.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Romualdez nga wala man nagalagas si Chiz sa accountability kundi gusto lang sini ipakita ang iya katampad kag iya serbisyo kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Romualdez said Chiz is not chasing accountability but just wants to show his loyalty and service to Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Si Sara ang yara mismo sa Senate plenary session sang naghatag sang privilege speech si Escudero.
english: Sara was in the Senate plenary session when Escudero delivered the privilege speech.

text: Dugang niya, luyag ni Chiz i-posisyon ang iya kaugalingon bilang kaalyado ni Sara para sa 2028 electons.
english: He added that Chiz wants to position himself as Sara's ally for the 2028 elections.

text: “The truth is clear: Senator Escudero’s speech is not about accountability, but to push for his personal ambition,” pahayag pa ni Romualdez.
english: “The truth is clear: Senator Escudero’s speech is not about accountability, but to push for his personal ambition,” Romualdez said.

text: “It was a performance designed to profess loyalty and service to Vice President Sara Duterte, and to position himself as her ally for 2028.
