english: “It was a performance designed to profess loyalty and service to Vice President Sara Duterte, and to position himself as her ally for 2028.

text: His true line of service is not for the truth, but for a personal interest and political plans,” dugang sini.
english: His true line of service is not for the truth, but for a personal interest and political plans,” it added.

text: Matandaan nga pareho sanday Chiz kag Romualdez nga nagpanguna sa Kamara kag Senado sang 19th Congress, kag sa pamuno sang 20th Congress antes nabulgar ang flood control issues kag ginkakas si Chiz samtang nag-resign naman si Romualdez.
english: It can be recalled that both Chiz and Romualdez led the House and Senate in the 19th Congress, and in the leadership of the 20th Congress before flood control issues were exposed and Chiz was removed while Romualdez resigned.

text:
Sa speech ni Chiz, gin-akusaran sini si Romualdez nga amo ang mastermind sa flood control issue nga gintawag sini nga “sarswela.”

“Iisang tao lamang ang nasa likod ng script at sarswelang ito.
english:
In his speech, Chiz accused Romualdez of being the mastermind of the flood control issue which he called “sarswela.”

“There is only one person behind this script and sarswelang.

text: Siya ang dahilan ng kaguluhan, pag-aaway, pagkakawatak-watak na ngayo’y yumayanig sa ating bayan maprotektahan lamang ang sarili niya.
english: He is the cause of chaos, fighting, division that is spreading in our country just to protect himself.

text: Ang pangalan niya ay matagal nang bulung-bulungan sa bawat sulok ng bansa pero ngayon unti-unting nang sinisigaw ng taumbayan,” pahayag sang anay Senate leader nga nagatumod sa kongresista.#
english: His name has long been whispered in every corner of the country but now it is slowly being shouted by the people,” said the former Senate leader referring to the congressman.

text: Naabtan nga duguon sa sulod sang isa ka banyo sa isa ka eskwelahan sa Cebu City ang isa ka 14-anyos nga dalagita nga gin-gulgulan sang iya anay nobyo nga 18-anyos.
english: A 14-year-old girl was found bleeding inside a bathroom at a school in Cebu City after being raped by her 18-year-old ex-boyfriend.

text: Ang pakaisa sang biktima ang nakakita sa iya makaluluoy nga sitwasyon.
english: The victim's cousin saw his plight.

text: May mga lagob man ini sa likod kag padayon nga naga-recover subong sa ospital.
english: He also sustained injuries to his back and is recovering at the hospital.

text: Nadakpan naman ang suspek nga Grade 10 student nga schoolmate sang biktima.
english: The suspect, a Grade 10 student who is a schoolmate of the victim, was arrested.

text: Ang pagpakig-break sang biktima sa suspek ang ginalantaw nga motibo sa krimen.
english: The victim's breakup with the suspect is believed to be the motive of the crime.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang mga pulis ang naglapta sa social media nga espekulasyon nga nangakig ang suspek sa biktima bangud namalibad ini nga magpakighilawas.
english: Police denied speculation on social media that the suspect was angry with the victim because she refused to have sex.

text: Pasakaan naman sang frustrated homicide nga complaint ang suspek.
english: A complaint of frustrated homicide will be filed against the suspect.

text: Gintudlo ni anay Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero si anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga amo ang mastermind sa mga akusasyon batok sa iya kag sa iban pa nga mga senador nga involved sa flood control scandal.
english: Former Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero pointed to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez as the mastermind behind the accusations against him and other senators involved in the flood control scandal.

text: Sa iya privilege speech sa plenary session sang Senado kun sa diin naglantaw kag nagpamati si Vice President Sara Duterte, nagpahayag si Escudero nga si Romualdez ang sa likod sang sini nga script kag pati sang pag-ilinaway nga nagakatabo subong.
english: In his privilege speech at the plenary session of the Senate where Vice President Sara Duterte watched and listened, Escudero said that Romualdez is behind this script and also the fighting that is happening now.

text: “Iisang tao lamang ang nasa likod ng script at sarswelang ito.
english: “There is only one person behind this script and sarswelang.

text: Siya ang dahilan ng kaguluhan, pag-aaway, pagkakawatak-watak na ngayo’y yumayanig sa ating bayan maprotektahan lamang ang sarili niya.
english: He is the cause of chaos, fighting, division that is spreading in our country just to protect himself.

text: Ang pangalan niya ay matagal nang bulung-bulungan sa bawat sulok ng bansa pero ngayon unti-unting nang sinisigaw ng taumbayan,” pahayag sang anay Senate leader.
english: His name has long been whispered in every corner of the country but now it is slowly being shouted by the people,” said the former Senate leader.

text: Gin-play pa sini ang video kun sa diin nagasinggit ang mga manugprotesta nga kawatan si Romualdez.
english: He even played a video of protesters shouting that Romualdez is a thief.

text: Kasunod ini sang pag-tag sang pila ka mga indibidwal kay Romualdez bilang isa man sa konektado sa flood control anomalies.
english: This follows the tagging of some individuals to Romualdez as one of those connected to flood control anomalies.

text: Lakip sa nag-implicate sa iya amo ang mag-asawa nga Discaya kag ang “surprise witness” ni Senator Rodante Marcoleta nga si Orly Regala Guteza.
english: Among those who implicated him were the Discaya couple and Senator Rodante Marcoleta’s “surprise witness” Orly Regala Guteza.

text: Sa “script” naman ni Romualdez suno kay Escudero, ginaliso sini ang atensyon sang publiko, agud sa baylo nga magtutok sa mga congressman, ang mga senador ang basulon kaangay sa iya, former Senate president pro tempore Jinggoy Estrada kag former Senate majority leader Joel Villanueva.
english: In Romualdez's script, Escudero said, he diverts public attention, so that instead of focusing on congressmen, senators are to blame like him, former Senate president pro tempore Jinggoy Estrada and former Senate majority leader Joel Villanueva.

text: Nagwangal man si Chiz kun ngaa kulang ang hulag sang gobyerno partikular sang Department of Justice, National Bureau of Investigation, ukon sang Anti-Money Laundering Council kag kun ngaa wala gid gina-mensyonar ang pangalan sang anay House speaker.
english: Chiz also complained about the lack of government action particularly the Department of Justice, National Bureau of Investigation, or the Anti-Money Laundering Council and why the name of the former House speaker is never mentioned.

text:
Dugang sini: “Ganito ba katindi ang kapangyarihang hawak ni Martin Romualdez, na bagaman hindi siya speaker, tila ‘the name that cannot be mentioned’ pa din siya, at nagagawa pa rin niya ang nais niya kaugnay sa isang mapamiling hustisya o selective justice.”

“Tila pilit na ginagawang panakip butas, ika nga, at fall guy at dibersyon ang mga senador palayo sa Kamara at sa mga tunay na may sala,” dugang niya.
english:
He added: “Is Martin Romualdez so powerful, that even though he is not a speaker, he is still 'the name that cannot be mentioned', and he is still doing what he wants in relation to selective justice.”

“It seems that the senators are being forced to cover up, you, at fall guy and diversion away from the House and the real guilty,” he added.

text: Gin-akusaran man ni Escudero si Romualdez nga naggamit sang flood control funds nga may label nga “for later release” agud mapilit ang mga myembro sang Kamara nga magpirma sang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Escudero also accused Romualdez of using flood control funds labeled “for later release” to force members of the House of Representatives to sign an impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Escudero, ginhimo ini ni Romualdez bisan nga nakahibalo siya nga wala na sang bastante nga tion ang Senado nga aktuhan ang impeachment complaint antes magtakop ang 19th Congress.
english: Escudero said Romualdez did this even though he knew that the Senate did not have enough time to act on the impeachment complaint before the end of the 19th Congress.

text: Antes ini nga privilege speech, gin-implicate man ni former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) undersecretary Roberto Bernardo si Escudero sa flood control scandal.
english: Before this privilege speech, former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) undersecretary Roberto Bernardo also implicated Escudero in the flood control scandal.

text: Ginbuyagyag sini nga nagbaton si Escudero sang P30 million nga election campaign donation halin sa contractor.#
english: He revealed that Escudero received a P30 million election campaign donation from the contractor.

text: Wala preno ang ginpangbuy-an nga pahayag ni Miss Bulgaria Radinela Chusheva may kaangtanan sa nangin resulta sang 69th Miss Universe pageant.
english: Miss Bulgaria Radinela Chusheva has released a statement regarding the results of the 69th Miss Universe pageant.

text: Madamo ang naham-ot sa iya serye sang Instagram stories kun sa diin wala man sini gintago ang disappointment kun ngaa si Andrea Meza sang Mexico ang nagdaug.
english: Many were impressed by her series of Instagram stories where she did not hide her disappointment that Andrea Meza of Mexico won.

text: Indi deserving si Mexico suno kay Andrea bangud ang icon gid niya amo si Nova Stevens sang Canada.
english: Andrea said Mexico is not deserving because her icon is Nova Stevens of Canada.

text: Dala man sa iya napilian nga deserving amo si Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo kag mga kandidata halin sa Thailand, Malaysia, Cambodia, kag Costa Rica.
english: Also among the deserving were Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo and contestants from Thailand, Malaysia, Cambodia, and Costa Rica.

text: Sang may nagpahayag nga basi madulaan siya sang fans sa Mexico bangud sang iya ginapanghambal, nagsabat si Miss Bulgaria nga sorry not sorry apang masobra 10 ka adlaw niya nga kaupod ang 73 ka mga kandidata apang wala gani niya nakilal-an kun sin-o si Andrea Meza.
english: When someone said she might lose fans in Mexico because of what she said, Miss Bulgaria replied sorry not sorry but she spent more than 10 days with 73 candidates but she didn't even know who Andrea Meza was.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala man sang placement sa amo nga pageant si Bulgaria apang isa siya sa mga wala nagtago sang disgusto sa nangin resulta sang pageant.
english: It is known that Bulgaria did not have a placement in the pageant but she was one of those who did not hide her disgust with the result of the pageant.

text: May tyansa ang Pilipinas nga makatapos sa pang-lima nga pwesto sa 2022 Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC) Cup for Women.
english: The Philippines has a chance to finish fifth in the 2022 Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC) Cup for Women.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos sang Philippine women’s volleyball team ang Australia sa five-set thriller sa PhilSports Arena sa Pasig City, 21-25, 25-19, 19-25, 25-18, 15-12.
english: The Philippine women's volleyball team defeated Australia in a five-set thriller at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City, 21-25, 25-19, 19-25, 25-18, 15-12.

text: May 26 puntos nga nakuha si Tots Carlos samtang may 18 points naman si Jema Galanza.
english: Tots Carlos had 26 points while Jema Galanza had 18 points.

text: Ang kadalag-an batok sa Australia ang kasunod man sang kalutusan sang Pilipinas batok sa Thailand sa quarterfinals.
english: The victory over Australia also follows the Philippines' defeat against Thailand in the quarterfinals.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang pungsod para sa pang-lima nga pwesto ang Chinese Taipei ‘la una karon sa hapon.
english: The country will next face Chinese Taipei for fifth place this afternoon.

text: Kun magdaog ang Pilipinas sa sini nga hampang, ini ang makabig nga best finish sang pungsod sa nasambit nga tournament — kasunod sang pang-siyam nga pwesto sang pag-umpisa sini sa 2018 edition sa Thailand.
english: If the Philippines wins this match, it will be considered the country's best finish in the tournament — following its ninth-place finish at the start of the 2018 edition in Thailand.

text:
Samtang, China naman kag Japan ang maga-atubangay para sa gold medal match sa ‘las syete karon sa gab-i.

Defending champion ang China kag target nga makuha ang ikaanum nga titulo sa tournament.
english:
Meanwhile, China and Japan will face each other for the gold medal match at 7 pm tonight.

China is the defending champion and targets to win its sixth title in the tournament.

text: Target naman sang Japan nga makakuha sang labing-una nga gold sa AVC Cup.
english: Japan is targeting its first gold medal in the AVC Cup.

text: Na-umpisahan na sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang testing sang bag-o nga mga bakuna batok sa African swine fever (ASF).
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has started testing new vaccines against African swine fever (ASF).

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary William Dar, ini na ang ikaduha nga sahi sang bakuna nga gindevelop agud nga matapna ang nasambit nga balatian sa baboy.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary William Dar, this is the second type of vaccine developed to prevent the disease in pigs.

text: “Very encouraging” ang inisyal nga resulta suno kay Dar.
english: The initial results are “very encouraging,” Dar said.

text: Kun mangin madinalag-on man ang ikaduha nga trial suno kay Dar, iga-rekomendar ini sang DA para sa massive vaccination sa mga baboy sa masunod nga administrasyon.
english: If the second trial is successful, Dar said, the DA will recommend it for massive vaccination of pigs in the next administration.

text: Sa latest data sang ahensya, ginpahayag nga apat ka probinsya sa pungsod ang may yara gihapon sang aktibo nga kaso sang ASF: Camarines Norte, Leyte, Southern Leyte kag Northern Samar.
english: According to the agency's latest data, four provinces in the country still have active cases of ASF: Camarines Norte, Leyte, Southern Leyte and Northern Samar.

text: Arestado sa drug buybust operation ang ginakabig nga high-value drug personality nga si alyas “Nestor”, 67 anyos, kag residente sang Zone 6, Brgy.
english: Arrested in a drug buybust operation was alias “Nestor”, 67 years old, and resident of Zone 6, Brgy.

text: Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City, sang 11:55 sang udto, Hulyo 15.
english: Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City, at 11:55 pm, July 15.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, Deputy Station Commander sang Police Station 4, iya gin pahayag nga nabaklan si Nestor sang isa ka plastic sachet sang ginapatihan nga shabu sa ginpatigayon nga buybust operation sang mga otoridad.
english: Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, Deputy Station Commander of Police Station 4, said Nestor was bought a plastic sachet of suspected shabu in a buybust operation conducted by the authorities.

text: Nakumpiskar sa iya ang suspected shabu nga may kabug-aton nga 50 ka gramos kag ginabana-bana nga may market value nga ₱340,000.
english: Seized from him was suspected shabu weighing 50 grams and estimated to have a market value of ₱340,000.

text: Suno kay PLt.
english: According to PLt.

text: Pagulayan nga duha ka semana ginmonitor si alyas Nestor antes ginkasa ang operasyon.Sa ila imbestigasyon, nabutyagan nga kaliwaan ukon si Nestor mismo ang naga-dahu sang illegal drugs nga ginabaligya niya sa mga interesado nga magbakal.
english: Nestor was monitored for two weeks before the operation was launched. In their investigation, it was revealed that Nestor himself was selling illegal drugs to interested buyers.

text: May gintumod man ini nga isa ka ngalan nga posible ginakuhaan niya sang supply sang shabu kag ini ginpaidalum gilayon sa imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan.
english: He also identified a name as a possible source of shabu supply and this was immediately subjected to police investigation.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang Drug Enforcement Team sang Molo Police Station 4 si Nestor kag atubangon niya ang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Nestor is now in the custody of the Drug Enforcement Team of Molo Police Station 4 and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nagapati ang kapulisan nga organisado nga grupo ang yara sa likod sang nagakatabo nga modus sang rent-tangay sa Iloilo City.
english: Police believe that an organized group is behind the modus operandi of rent-tangay in Iloilo City.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagka-aresto sa mag-live in partner nga sanday alyas AJ kag alyas Cristine sa entrapment operation sa Molo.
english: This follows the arrest of live-in partners alias AJ and alias Cristine in an entrapment operation in Molo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Officer in Charge sang Molo Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga antes ang operasyon, may nagreklamo sa ila estasyon nga tag-iya sang salakyan lakip na ang nagbakal sang unit gani gilahon nga naghulag ang otoridad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Officer in Charge of Molo Police Station, said that before the operation, the owner of the vehicle, including the buyer of the unit, complained to the station.

text: Base sa reklamo sang tag-iya sang rent a car, nakibot nalang ini nga ginabaligya na online ang iya fortuner nga salakyan nga ginrentahan sang suspek.
english: According to the complaint of the owner of the rent a car, he was surprised that his Fortuner car rented by the suspect was being sold online.

text: Nagreklamo man ang nagbakal sang salakyan bangud peke ang mga dokumento nga ginhatag sa iya sang suspek.
english: The buyer of the vehicle also complained that the documents given to him by the suspect were fake.

text: Diri na ginplano ang entrapment nga nagresulta sa pagkaaresto sa duha.
english: It was here that the entrapment was planned which resulted in the arrest of the two.

text: Suno kay Inot, modus na sang mga suspek ang pagrenta sang salakyan kag ginabaligya.
english: According to Inot, the suspects' modus operandi is to rent vehicles and sell them.

text: Sa subong, preso ang mga ini sa Molo Police Station.
english: They are currently detained at the Molo Police Station.

text: Ginpabutyag sang isa ka legal expert nga ang pag-appoint ukon pag-designate sang mga elected officials sa posisyon sa gobyerno, posible nga may conflict of interest kag paglapas sa konstitusyon, nga nagahatag sang kabalaka sa legalidad sang mga ginahimo sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa tunga sang ginapatigayun nga imbestigasyon sa maanomaliya nga flood control scandal.
english: A legal expert has expressed that the appointment or designation of elected officials to government positions, is likely to have a conflict of interest and violation of the constitution, raising concerns about the legality of the actions of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) amid the ongoing investigation into the flood control scandal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Noel Palomado, ginpahayag niya nga base sa ila pagtan-aw, may probisyon sa konstitusyon nga klaro nga nagadumili sa mga elected officials nga ma-appoint ukon ma-designate sa bisan ano nga kapasidad sa gobyerno.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Noel Palomado, he said that based on their view, there is a provision in the constitution that clearly prohibits elected officials from being appointed or designated in any capacity in government.

text: Suno sa iya, ini nga sitwasyon ang nagahatag sang legal nga kabalaka kag ginakabig nga conflict of interest, ilabi na sa kaso ni Mayor sang Baguio City nga si Benjamin Magalong nga gindesignar bilang special adviser sang ICI.
english: He said this situation raises legal concerns and is considered a conflict of interest, especially in the case of Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong who was designated as special adviser of the ICI.

text: Dugang pa ni Atty. Palomado nga samtang ginapanawagan sang pumuluyo ang masanag kag matuod-tuod nga imbestigasyon sa flood control scandal, nga ginakabig nga may kaangtanan sa mga ginatawag nga insertions sa proyekto nga ginadudahan nga may koneksyon sa pila ka mga senador, sanday Joel Villanueva, Jinggoy Estrada kag Chiz Escudero.
english: He added that Atty. Palomado said that while the people are calling for a transparent and genuine investigation into the flood control scandal, which is considered to be related to the so-called insertions in the project suspected of having connections with some senators, Joel Villanueva, Jinggoy Estrada and Chiz Escudero.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Atty. Palomado nga ginahulat pa sang publiko ang resulta sang imbestigasyon sang ICI, kag wala pa sang klaro nga direksyon kon sa diin padulong ang mga findings.
english: He also said that Atty. Palomado said the public is still waiting for the results of the ICI's investigation, and there is no clear direction for the findings.

text: Ginapaabot man ang mga audit procedures, audit program kag fraud audit halin sa Commission on Audit (COA), apang wala pa sang may mabatian nga update ukon resulta halin sa nasambit nga ahensya.
english: Audit procedures, audit programs and fraud audits are also expected from the Commission on Audit (COA), but no updates or results have been heard from the agency.

text: Padayon ang panawagan sang pumuluyo para sa hustisya kag kasanag sa likod sang ginadudahan nga korapsiyon sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), kag ginahingyo nga ang mga ahensya sang gobyerno magpatigayon sang matuod-tuod nga tikang agud maprotektahan ang pondo sang pungsod kag ang interes sang publiko.
english: The people continue to call for justice and enlightenment behind the suspected corruption in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), and demand that government agencies take genuine steps to protect the nation's funds and the public interest.

text: ILOILO CITY – Sulod na sa quarterfinals ang Pilipinas sa nagapadayon nga preliminary round sang AVC Cup for Women sa Philsports Arena.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Philippines is now in the quarterfinals of the ongoing preliminary round of the AVC Cup for Women at the Philsports Arena.

text: Ini matapos nga nalutos sang Pilipinas ang South Korea pinaagi sa score nga 25-18, 25-13, 25-17.
english: This is after the Philippines defeated South Korea with a score of 25-18, 25-13, 25-17.

text: Si Tots Carlos ang may 12 points kag 2 blocks samtang si Jema Galanza ang may yara sang 11 points.
english: Tots Carlos had 12 points and 2 blocks while Jema Galanza had 11 points.

text: Gintapos sang Pilipinas ang Pool A campaign nga may 2-2 record kag tinguha-an nga makuha ang ikatatlo nga pwesto sa masunod nga hampang kun sa diin, makasumpong nila ang Thailand.
english: The Philippines finished the Pool A campaign with a 2-2 record and will try to take third place in the next match where they will face Thailand.

text: Malipayon naman sa resulta si Coach Sherwin Meneses nga kabahin sang coaching staff sang national men’s volleyball team nga nakakuha sang historic silver medal sa 30th Southeast Asian Games sang 2019.
english: Coach Sherwin Meneses, who is part of the coaching staff of the national men's volleyball team that won the historic silver medal at the 30th Southeast Asian Games in 2019, is happy with the result.

text: Wala sang kalain sang buot kag paghinulsolsi Rabiya Mateo nga napaslawan siya sa iya handom nga madala pauli ang ika-lima nga Miss Universe crown para sa Pilipinas.
english: Rabiya Mateo has no regrets that she failed in her dream of bringing home the fifth Miss Universe crown for the Philippines.

text: Suno sa 24 anyos nga Ilongga beauty queen, maayo ini nga umpisa para sa ila nga Miss Universe 2020 sisters bangud nakatukod sila sang friendship sa ila nga pag-updanay sa Florida.
english: According to the 24-year-old Ilongga beauty queen, this is a good start for their Miss Universe 2020 sisters because they built a friendship during their time together in Florida.

text: Pahayag niya, dako ang impact sang ila partisipasyon sa Miss Universe 2020 bangud indi man adlaw-adlaw nga marepresenta nila ang ila tagsa ka mga pungod.
english: She said their participation in Miss Universe 2020 has a big impact because it is not every day that they can represent their respective countries.

text: Gani dako ang pagpasalamat niya nga nahatagan sila sang kahigayunan.
english: So he was very grateful that they were given the opportunity.

text: Dugang pa ni Rabiya, tanan sila ang makabig nga reyna may korona man ukon wala.
english: Rabiya added that they are all considered queens with or without a crown.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Andrea Meza sang Mexico ang ginkoronahan bilang Miss Universe 2020.
english: Andrea Meza of Mexico was crowned Miss Universe 2020.

text: Ginhiwat ang grand finale sa Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino sa Hollywood, Florida, USA.
english: The grand finale was held at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Hollywood, Florida, USA.

text:
Text and reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

Pilason ang isa ka 31-anyos nga dispatcher matapos ginbuno sang konduktor sang jeep sa atubang sang Cultural Hall sa banwa sang Miagao, pasado alas 9:45 sang aga sang Hulyo 14.
english:
Text and reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

A 31-year-old dispatcher was injured after being stabbed by a jeep conductor in front of the Cultural Hall in Miagao town, around 9:45 am on July 14.

text: Ginkilala ang biktima kay alyas “Neth”, pamilyado kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as alias “Neth”, family and resident of Brgy.

text: Calampitao, Guimbal.
english: Calampitao, Guimbal.

text: Ang suspek naman ginkilala kay alyas “Biboy”, 26 anyos, pamilyado, residente sang Tiolas, San Joaquin kag isa man ka konduktor.
english: The suspect was identified as alias “Biboy”, 26 years old, married, resident of Tiolas, San Joaquin and also a conductor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Richard Lao, hepe sang Miagao Municipal Police Station, ginpahayag sini nga may nauna na nga away ang duha sang Sabado, Hulyo 12, sa Mohon Terminal bangud sa agaway sa pasahero.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Richard Lao, chief of Miagao Municipal Police Station, said the two had a previous fight on Saturday, July 12, at the Mohon Terminal over a fight over a passenger.

text: Sang Lunes sang aga, nagkitaay ang duha sa jeepney terminal sa plaza sang Miagao.
english: On Monday morning, the two met at the jeepney terminal in Miagao plaza.

text: Nagluntad ang tensyon sa tunga nila, nga nagsugod sa pagtulukay, pagpabati-bati kag pagsuyaay.
english: Tension arose between them, which began with staring, whispering and arguing.

text: Una nga gin sumbag sang suspek ang biktima, kag sang nagdumugay sila, ginkuha sang suspek ang kutsilyo halin sa front seat sang jeep kag ginbuno si “Neth”, nga naigo sa wala nga braso.
english: The suspect first stabbed the victim, and when they talked, the suspect took a knife from the front seat of the jeep and stabbed “Neth”, who was hit in the left arm.

text: Gilayon ini gindala sa ospital kag subong stable na ang kondisyon.
english: He was rushed to the hospital and is now in stable condition.

text: Narekober man ang kutsilyo nga may 10 ka pulgada ang kalabaon.
english: A 10-inch knife was also recovered.

text: Na-detain ang suspek sa Miagao Police Station apang ginrelease sang alas 3 sang kaagahon matapos mag-expire ang reglementary period.
english: The suspect was detained at the Miagao Police Station but was released at 3 am after the reglementary period expired.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginpahayag sang pamilya sang biktima nga ila ginahanda na ang pagpasa sang kaso batok sa suspek.
english: Meanwhile, the victim's family said they are preparing to file a case against the suspect.

text: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza
english: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Dako na nga bugal para sa Pilipinas nga nakasulod sa Top 21 ang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Rabiya Mateo.
english: It is a great pride for the Philippines that Ilongga beauty queen Rabiya Mateo has entered the Top 21.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga tuman ang kalipay sang bug-os nga probinsya sang Iloilo sa nangin journey ni Rabiya sa Miss Universe pageant.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said the entire province of Iloilo is very happy with Rabiya's journey in the Miss Universe pageant.

text: Gin-congratulate man niya si Rabiya bangud sa tuman nga maisog kag maalam nga representasyon sang Pilipinas sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: He also congratulated Rabiya for her brave and intelligent representation of the Philippines in the world.

text: Sa subong, ‘looking forward’ na ang gobernador sa homecoming sang Ilongga beauty queen.
english: The governor is now looking forward to the homecoming of the Ilongga beauty queen.

text: Ginhangkat ni anay Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque si Ako Bicol Partylist Rep.
english: Former Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque challenged Ako Bicol Partylist Rep.

text: Elizaldy Co nga ginapahayag nga yara sa Europa nga makigkita sa iya kag ibuyagyag ang mga nahibaluan tuhoy sa maanomalya nga flood control projects.
english: Elizaldy Co. who is reportedly in Europe to meet with him and reveal knowledge about anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Roque, mahapos pa lang para kay Co nga tultulon ini sa Hague.
english: According to Roque, it is easy for Co to trace it to The Hague.

text: Ginsiling man ni Roque nga mangin proud ang amay ni Co kun ibuyagyag na sini ang mga nahibaluan sa nasambit nga maanomalya nga proyekto.
english: Roque also said that Co's father will be proud when he reveals what he knows about the anomalous project.

text: Gin-engganyo man ni Roque si Co nga maghimo sang isa ka sworn statement nga mahimo niya gamiton kun pamatian siya sang masunod nga administrasyon.
english: Roque also encouraged Co to make a sworn statement that he can use if the next administration listens to him.

text:
Yari ang pahayag ni Roque:

“At what I can assure you, is kung nasaan man ang iyong ama, he will be proud of you.
english:
Here is Roque's statement:

“And what I can assure you, is wherever your father is, he will be proud of you.

text:
Kung ikaw ngayon ay aamin ng iyong pagkakamali, at ilalantad ang katunayan kung sino talaga ang pinakamalaking benepisyo na natanggap dito sa ginawa ninyong pagnanakaw ng pondo, ng kaban ng bayan.”

“Magkita tayo, gagawan kita ng sworn statements at titingnan natin na sa susunod na administrasyon kung tatanggapin ang sworn statements mo para ikaw ay makapasok din sa Witness Protection Program at mabigyan ng immunity.”

Subong nga adlaw ang ulihi nga plaso kay Co nga magpauli sa pungsod matapos gin-revoke ni House Speaker Faustino Dy ang iya nga travel clearance.
english:
If you now admit your mistake, and expose the fact who really is the biggest benefit received here from your theft of funds, of the public treasury.”

"Let's meet, we'll make sworn statements and we'll see if the next administration accepts your sworn statements so that you can also enter the Witness Protection Program and be given immunity.

Today is the deadline for Co to return to the country after House Speaker Faustino Dy revoked his travel clearance.

text: Masobra 3 million ka mga Filipinos ang jobless ukon wala sang trabaho subong nga tuig.
english: More than 3 million Filipinos are jobless this year.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ang unemployment rate sang Pebrero ang nagapabilin sa 6.4 percent.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the unemployment rate in February remained at 6.4 percent.

text: Ang nasambit nga unemployment rate ang kapareho man sang Enero nga may 6.4 percent.
english: The unemployment rate is the same as in January with 6.4 percent.

text: Apang ang unemployment rate sang Pebrero subong nga tuig ang mas manubo kun ipaanggid sang Pebrero sang nagligad nga tuig nga nagadangat sa 8.8 percent.
english: However, the unemployment rate in February this year was lower than in February last year which was 8.8 percent.

text: Luyag sang aktres nga si Angel Aquino nga may mapasar nga layi sa Pilipinas batok sa mga naga-obra kag nagapalapta sang mga malaswa nga mga post nga gina-gamitan sang artificial intelligence ukon AI.
english: Actress Angel Aquino wants a law passed in the Philippines against those who make and spread obscene posts using artificial intelligence or AI.

text: Gindiskusyunan ini sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Women, Children, Family Relations and Gender Equality nga ginapangunahan ni Senador Risa Hontiveros.
english: This was discussed at the hearing of the Senate Committee on Women, Children, Family Relations and Gender Equality chaired by Senator Risa Hontiveros.

text: Naangot ini sa isyu sang deepfake porn kun sa diin ginabutang ang nawong sang isa ka tawo sa malain nga video ukon litrato.
english: This is related to the issue of deepfake porn where a person's face is placed in a bad video or photo.

text: Upod sa mga bisita sa hearing ang beterana nga aktre nga nagsiling nga nangin biktima siya sang A.I. porn matapos ginbutang ang iya nawong sa isa ka porn video.
english: Among the guests at the hearing was the veteran actress who said she had been a victim of A.I. porn after putting her face in a porn video.

text: “It was dehumanizing.
english: “It was dehumanizing.

text: It was digital assault, one that leaves no bruises on the skin, but strips away one’s dignity in the most obscene manner imaginable,” pahayag ni Angel.
english: It was digital assault, one that leaves no bruises on the skin, but strips away one’s dignity in the most obscene manner imaginable,” stated Angel.

text: Nagalaum si Angel nga makasunod ang Pilipinas sa paghimo sang layi agud mapunggan ang mga ilegal nga aktibidad gamit ang moderno nga teknolohiya.
english: Angel hopes that the Philippines will follow suit in drafting laws to curb illegal activities using modern technology.

text: Gusto man sini nga pasabton ang mga naga-share kag naga-repost sang malaswa nga mga post nga gin-gamitan sang AI.
english: It also wants to hold accountable those who share and repost obscene AI-powered posts.

text: Dugang sini: “These deepfake photos and videos hurt and violate real people.
english: It added: “These deepfake photos and videos hurt and violate real people.

text: I urge you all to take action.
english: I urge you all to take action.

text:
Punish the perpetrators, those who share and repost, the websites that host it, the platforms that turn a blind eye while it spreads.”

Sa pihak nga bahin, nagalaum naman ang Anti-Cyber Crime Group sang Philippine National Police nga mapa-inan sila sang pondo agud makabakal sang gamit nga makabulig sa ila nga mapangita ang malain nga mga content online kaangay sang deepfake.#
english:
Punish the perpetrators, those who share and repost, the websites that host it, the platforms that turn a blind eye while it spreads.”

Meanwhile, the Anti-Cyber ​​Crime Group of the Philippine National Police hopes to be allocated funds to purchase equipment that will help them find malicious content online such as deepfake.

text: Kun bata pa kita, naga-amat-amat pa lang kita sa pagtuon kun paano magkinot, gani natural nga wala ginatugyan sa aton ang dalagku nga kantidad.
english: When we are young, we are still learning how to save, so naturally we are not entrusted with large sums of money.

text: Ang aton nanay kag tatay amo ang nagatago sini tubtub sa tiyempo nga kabalo na kita kun paano mag-manage sang aton galastuhon.
english: Our mother and father are the ones who hide it until we know how to manage our expenses.

text: Apang may isa ka bata nga nainit gid sang ginkuha sang iya tatay ang iya kuwarta nga nabaton niya kadungan sang holidays.
english: But one child was very angry when his father took his money that he received during the holidays.

text: Isa abi ka tradisyon sa China kag ginahimo naman diri sa Pilipinas kag sa iban pa nga Asian countries nga sa tion sang Chinese New Year, may ginahatag nga red envelop nga ginatawag man nga money card ukon ampao sa mga kabataan.
english: It is a tradition in China and in the Philippines and other Asian countries that during the Chinese New Year, a red envelope called a money card or ampao is given to children.

text: May sulod ini nga kuwarta, gani nga sa Chinese family, masami nga ang ginikanan anay ang nagatago sang monetary gifts para sa ila nga bata.
english: It contains money, so in Chinese families, parents often keep monetary gifts for their children.

text: Apang may isa ka bata nga lalaki sa amo nga pungsod nga indi kuntento sa arrangement nga ang iya tatay ang matago sang kuwarta, gani ang iya gin-obra, nagtawag ini sang pulis.
english: But there was a boy in that country who was not satisfied with the arrangement that his father would keep the money, so he called the police.

text: Nabaton sang police station sa Lanzhou, Gansu province ang tawag halin sa bata nga nagapanugid nga may bad guy kuno sa ila nga balay, kag ginkawat sini ang iya kuwarta.
english: The police station in Lanzhou, Gansu province received a call from a child who said that there was a bad guy in their house, and he stole his money.

text: Nabatian pa sang pulis nga may nagsinggit sa bata nga nagasaway sa iya kun ngaa nagtawag ini sa police station, gani nag-responde sila para ma-verify ang reklamo.
english: The police heard someone shouting at the child scolding him for calling the police station, so they responded to verify the complaint.

text: Tuman ang kalipay sang bata sang nakit-an sini ang iya mga uncle police nga nag-abot — baliskad sa iya tatay nga tuman ang kahuya sa sitwasyon.
english: The child was overjoyed when he saw his uncle police arrive — unlike his father who was very embarrassed by the situation.

text: Nag-insister ang bata nga bad person ang iya tatay, apang nagpaathag naman ang amay nga wala lang nakahangop ang iya bata gani nga nagtawag ini sang pulis bangud indi ini magpasugot nga ang amay lang anay ang matago sang kuwarta.
english: The child insisted that his father was a bad person, but the father explained that his son did not understand so he called the police because he would not allow the father to hide the money.

text: Mismo ang cellphone pa gali sang tatay ang gingamit sang bata sang nagtawag ini sa mga pulis.
english: The child used his father's cellphone to call the police.

text: Nagbulig naman ang mga pulis sa pag-settle sa problema paagi sa pagpaathag sa bata nga ang tatay gid man ang dapat nga magtago sang kuwarta, kag kun may kinahanglan ini baklon, mahimo lang siya makapangayo.
english: The police helped settle the problem by explaining to the child that the father should keep the money, and if he needed to buy something, he could just ask.

text: Ginpanugyan man sa amay nga tudluan ang iya bata sa mga patakaran sa kuwarta, kag klaruhon gid sa iya ang arrangement antes ini kuhaon kag taguon.
english: The father was also advised to teach his son money rules, and to make the arrangement very clear to him before taking it and keeping it.

text: Magabyahe sa Iloilo City subong nga adlaw, Marso 23, ang bus units sang Vallacar Transit Inc.
english: The bus units of Vallacar Transit Inc. will operate in Iloilo City today, March 23.

text: kadungan sang pagpatigayon sang mga transport cooperatives sang transport holiday.
english: in conjunction with the transport cooperatives' transport holiday.

text: Ini matapos gin-aprubahan sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang special permit.
english: This is after the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) approved the special permit.

text: “In view of the scheduled Transport Holiday, a Special Permit has been granted to Vallacar Transit Inc.
english: “In view of the scheduled Transport Holiday, a Special Permit has been granted to Vallacar Transit Inc.

text: to ensure continuous transportation service for the commuting public,” suno sa post sang LTFRB.
english: to ensure continuous transportation service for the commuting public,” according to the LTFRB post.

text:
Yari ang apat ka mga ruta kun sa diin magabyahe ang Ceres Liner buses subong nga adlaw:

Gin-athag man sang regulatory board nga indi libre ang ila nga pagbyahe kag magasunod sila sa standard fare matrix.
english:
Here are the four routes where Ceres Liner buses will operate today:

The regulatory board also clarified that their trip is not free and they will follow the standard fare matrix.

text: Sa post sang LTFRB, ang standard fare sa nauna nga singko kilometros amo ang P13 para sa regular commuters, kag P10.50 naman para sa PWDs, estudyante, kag senior citizens.#
english: According to the LTFRB, the standard fare for the first five kilometers is P13 for regular commuters, and P10.50 for PWDs, students, and senior citizens.

text: SA AKON trabaho sadto bilang newspaper reporter tubtub nangin editor-in-chief sang tatlo ka daily local newspaper sa Iningles, duha ka weekly magasin sa Iningles kag isa ka tri-weekly sa Hiligaynon, kag newspaper columnist na lang sa akon retirement age, indi malikawan nga may magpalapit gid agud manugid sa imo sang nahibal-an nila nga korapsyon sa gobyerno ukon ano man nga isyu nga may kahilabtanan sa interes sang mga pumuluyo sa aton Demokrasya.
english: IN MY job as a newspaper reporter until I became editor-in-chief of three daily local newspapers in English, two weekly magazines in English and one tri-weekly in Hiligaynon, and newspaper columnist at my retirement age, it is inevitable that someone will approach you to tell you about corruption or corruption in the government. also issues related to the interests of the people in our Democracy.

text: Pila sini ang mangisug gid sa pagtindug bilang testigo sa imo report.
english: How many of them will be brave enough to stand as witnesses to your report.

text: Pwede na matalakay ini nga impormasyon.
english: This information can be discussed.

text: Pwede na ini ipahayag sa media nga dapat na sabton ang isyu sang natungdan, public servant man siya ukon sa pribado man nga sektor nga may kahilabtanan sa public interest.
english: It can be announced to the media that the issue of the person concerned should be answered, whether he is a public servant or in the private sector that is related to the public interest.

text: Ang pila ugaling indi mo na madala sa balita ukon sa panugdaon tungod ang source indi luyag makilal-an kag wala man sing masaligan nga dokumento nga mapakita.
english: Some, however, cannot be brought to the news or to the suggestion because the source does not want to be identified and there is no reliable document to show.

text: Ginadala na lang namon ini bilang blind item kag kon may lamod sang akusasyon ginapaagi lang ini sa pamangkot, katulad sang: “Matuod bala ini sir, ma’am?” agud malikawan nga maakusaran sing libel sa bahin namon nga mga peryodista.
english: We just carry it as a blind item and if there is a hint of accusation it is just a question, such as: “Is this true sir, ma’am?” to avoid being accused of libel on the part of us journalists.

text: Although, kon kis-a mapaylan ka man sing libel agud mapauntat ka lang sa padayon nga pagdala sang isyu sang imo naigu.
english: Although, sometimes you can file a libel just to stop you from continuing to bring up the issue of your injury.

text: Ina tungod ma-isyuhan ka sang korte sang sub judice samtang akusado agud punggan ka anay sa padayon nga pagdala sang isyu.
english: That's because the court will issue you a sub judice while the accused is there to prevent you from continuing to bring the issue.

text: Well, napaylan ako sing malapit 30 ka libel cases nga ang tanan na-dismiss naman.
english: Well, I filed close to 30 libel cases that were all dismissed.

text:
***

May ara man nga ang ginasugid sa imo nga sadto pa niya ginahimo apang madugay na niya gin-untat, katulad sang kaso sang nangin abyan ko sang ulihi (Kaluy-an ang iya kalag!).
english:
***

There are also those who tell you that he used to do it but he stopped long ago, like the case of my later friend (Pity his soul!).

text: Sunu sa iya, madugay na ini siya naga-negosyo sang mga expired medicine tubtub nangin-iskandalo na ini sa pila ka public hospital nga ginakuhaan niya, kag, tungod sini, nag-untat na gid lang ini siya sa sining negosyo sa expired medicine.
english: According to him, he has been doing business with expired medicines for a long time until it became a scandal in some public hospitals where he works, and, because of this, he stopped doing business with expired medicines.

text: Maayo lang kay nakalusot siya sa iskandalo.
english: Fortunately, he escaped the scandal.

text: Ginabaligya man niya kuno ini sa pila ka botika sa iya ka-deal sa ospital.
english: He also allegedly sold it in several pharmacies to his dealmates at the hospital.

text: Wala man siya kuno ma-konsyensya kay pwede pa magamit ang mga ini tungod sang ila extended shelf life, ukon grace period sa kabuhi sini halin sa expiration date.
english: He said he did not feel guilty because they can still be used because of their extended shelf life, or grace period in its life from the expiration date.

text: Daw nag-manggaranon gid kuno siya diri.
english: He seems to have become very rich here.

text: Wala ugaling niya masugid sa aton kon otorisado sang ospital ang pagnegosyo niya sa iya ka-deal sa ospital.
english: However, he did not tell us whether the hospital authorized his business dealings with his hospital partner.

text: Pero, may extended shelf life gid man bala ang pila ka bulong lapaw sa ila expiration date?
english: But, do some medicines really have an extended shelf life beyond their expiration date?

text: May ara kay napamapatud-an naton ini sa akon 2nd booster shot batok sa Covid-19.
english: There is because we can prove it with my 2nd booster shot against Covid-19.

text: Ginpahibalo ako sang nars bag-o ako tudlukan sang vaccine kon sugot ako tuslukan bisan sa extended life na sang vaccine.
english: The nurse informed me before I was given the vaccine if I was willing to be vaccinated even with the extended life of the vaccine.

text: Nagsugot ako kay luas sa pagsalig ko sa nars nakabasa man ako parti sa ining extended shelf life sang mga bulong.
english: I agreed because besides trusting the nurse I had also read about this extended shelf life of medicines.

text: Nagalab-ut sang pila bulan sa iban, pila ka tuig sa iban pa gid, kag mas madugay pa gid nga panahon sa kaso sang pila ka bulong nga mapamatud-an nga indi paglus-aw sang kahimtangan sini sa kadugayon.
english: It takes a few months for some, a few years for others, and a much longer period in the case of some drugs that prove to be unstable in the long run.

text: In other words, wala man sing peligro ang ginabaligya sang aton abyan nga expired medicine tungod sa mapamatud-an nga extended shelf life sini.
english: In other words, there is no danger in the expired medicine sold by our friend because of its proven extended shelf life.

text: Ugaling lang kay basi ang nasudlan niya amo ang ilegal nga transaksyon upod sa iya ka-deal kon ngaa na-iskandalo gid, nga ginhaum-haum ko gid lang agud indi maupang ang iya pagsugid.
english: However, maybe he was involved in an illegal transaction with his deal partner, which is why he was scandalized, which I just made up so as not to interrupt his story.

text:
***

In fact, nakamutik na ang aton mga otoridad sining pagbaligya sang expired medicine, subong man sang fake nga mga bulong kag sang ilegal nga pagbaligya sang mga bulong sa mga sari-sari store nga madale mabiktima sang mga haslo nga mga ambulant seller.
english:
***

In fact, our authorities have already detected this sale of expired medicine, as well as fake medicines and the illegal sale of medicines in sari-sari stores that are easily victimized by hasty ambulant sellers.

text: Si DILG Sec.
english: DILG Sec.

text: Eduardo Año nagmando na gani sa mga LGUs agud magpasar sang mga ordinansa nga naga-ban sang pagbaligya kag pagbakal sang mga bulong sa mga sari-sari store halin kay sin-o lang.
english: Eduardo Año has even ordered LGUs to pass ordinances banning the sale and purchase of medicines in sari-sari stores from anyone.

text: In fact, naka-report na gani sang kasubong nga anomaliya ang Food and Drug Administeration (FDA).
english: In fact, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has even reported a similar anomaly.

text: Natukiban nila nga may 78 ka sari-sari store ang nakabaligya sining illegally sold nga mga bulong sa na-inspeksyon nila nga mga 185 ka outlet.
english: They found that 78 sari-sari stores sold these illegally sold drugs in the 185 outlets they inspected.

text: Nadiskubrihan man nila nga 13 sini ang nagabaligya sang fake nga bulong.
english: They also discovered that 13 of them were selling fake medicines.

text: Sa idalom sang Section 30 sang Philippine Pharmacy Act, ang FDA-licensed lang nga mga drug outlets ukon pharmacies ang tugot magbaligya sang bulong sa publiko.
english: Under Section 30 of the Philippine Pharmacy Act, only FDA-licensed drug outlets or pharmacies are allowed to sell medicines to the public.

text: Sa karon naka-isyu na ang DILG sang memorandum circular sa mga LGU agud magbulig sa pagpangdakop sining nagabaligya sang unauthorized medicine./PN
english: The DILG has now issued a memorandum circular to LGUs to assist in the arrest of these unauthorized medicine sellers./PN

text: Gindayaw ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un ang mga soldado sang ila pungsod nga nangin maisog suno sa iya sa pagpakig-away para sa Russia.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un praised his country's soldiers who he said were brave in fighting for Russia.

text: Kadungan ini sang pagbisita ni Kim sa memorial site kun sa diin ginpanglubong ang mga soldado nga napatay sa giyera.
english: This coincides with Kim's visit to the memorial site where soldiers killed in the war are buried.

text: Suno sa North Korean leader, wala sang tupong ang kaisog kag pagkabaganihan sang Korean People’s Army nga involved sa overseas military operations.
english: According to the North Korean leader, the courage and heroism of the Korean People's Army involved in overseas military operations is unparalleled.

text: Apisar nga wala namensyonar ang Russia sa report sang state media nga Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), nauna na nga nagpasalig si Kim nga padayunon sini ang suporta sa tanan nga polisa kag desisyon ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Although Russia was not mentioned in the report by state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), Kim has previously pledged to continue to support all policies and decisions of Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Matandaan nga mas ginpadalom pa sang North Korea ang relasyon sini sa Russia halin sang gin-invade sang Moscow ang Ukraine sang Pebrero 2022.
english: It can be recalled that North Korea has further deepened its ties with Russia since Moscow invaded Ukraine in February 2022.

text: Linibo ka mga soldado ang ila ginpadala agud magbulig sa Russia sa gyera suno sa South Korean kag Western intelligence agencies.
english: They have sent thousands of troops to help Russia in the war, according to South Korean and Western intelligence agencies.

text: Sandig pa sa reports sang Seoul, 600 ka mga North Korean soldier ang napatay kag linibo ang napilasan bangud sa ila pag-intra sa gyera.
english: According to Seoul reports, 600 North Korean soldiers have been killed and thousands wounded in the war.

text: Magluwas sa pagpadala sang tropa, nagapadala man ang Pyongyang sang artillery shells, missiles kag long-range rocket systems nga ginabayluhan naman sang Russia sang financial aid, military technology kag food and energy supplies.
english: In addition to sending troops, Pyongyang also sends artillery shells, missiles and long-range rocket systems, which Russia exchanges for financial aid, military technology and food and energy supplies.

text: Ginpanas sang Portland Trail Blazers ang 22-point deficit kag ginpatilaw sa defending NBA champions nga Oklahoma City Thunder ang ila una nga kalutusan subong nga season.
english: The Portland Trail Blazers erased a 22-point deficit and handed the defending NBA champions the Oklahoma City Thunder their first loss of the season.

text: Nanguna sa 121-119 nga kadalag-an sang Blazers si Deni Avdija nga may 26 points, 10 rebounds kag nine assists.
english: Deni Avdija led the way in the Blazers’ 121-119 win with 26 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists.

text: Magluwas sa 22 nga lalagson sa imbukada nga quarter, wala gid naka-abanse ang Portland sa Thunder tubtub nga masulusobra na lang sa singko minutos ang nabilin sa final quarter.
english: Aside from 22 runs in the opening quarter, Portland never got ahead of the Thunder until just over five minutes remained in the final quarter.

text: May 22 points naman si Jrue Holiday kag 20 points si Jerami Grant nga nagdugang sang puntos sang Portland.
english: Jrue Holiday had 22 points and Jerami Grant added 20 points for Portland.

text: 35 puntos naman kag siyam ka rebounds ang nahimo sang reigning MVP nga si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander para sa Oklahoma City.
english: Reigning MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 35 points and nine rebounds for Oklahoma City.

text: Antes sini nga game, nadag-an sang Thunder ang walo ka una nga hampang kag isahahon nga team nga wala sang pierde subong nga season.
english: Before this game, the Thunder had won their first eight games and were the only team without a loss this season.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ini naman ang pang-81 nga sunod-sunod nga hampang nga masobra sa 20 ang puntos ni Gilgeous-Alexander nga amo ang third-longest streak sa maragtas sang NBA.
english: On the other hand, this is the 81st consecutive game that Gilgeous-Alexander has scored more than 20 points, which is the third-longest streak in NBA history.

text: Iloilo – Ginakabig nga problema sa probinsya sang Iloilo ang nagapayon nga pagbuhin sang suplay sang baboy.
english: Iloilo – The continuing decline in the supply of pigs is considered a problem in Iloilo province.

text: Ini matapos nakit-an nga nabuhinan sang 36% ang suplay sini humalin sang Oktubre 2022.
english: This is after it was found to have reduced its supply by 36% since October 2022.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga ginatinguhaan sang iya opisina nga mapadasig ang pag-recover sang mga baboy gikan sa African Swine Fever.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr. said his office is trying to speed up the recovery of pigs from African Swine Fever.

text: Suno kay Defensor, nangin lihuk na sang opisina amo ang pagbulig sa 15 ka mga kabanwahanan sa probinsya sang Iloilo bilang mga lugar kun sa diin pagatukuron ang mga sentinel para sa dugang nga monitoring sang mga baboy kag amo man pagpadamo ukon repopulation sang mga ini.
english: According to Defensor, the office's initiative is to assist 15 towns in Iloilo province as places where sentinels will be established for further monitoring of pigs as well as their reproduction.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa data sang 2021 Philippine Statistics Authority, yara sa Top 4 ang probinsya sang Iloilo sa top hog-producing provinces.
english: According to the 2021 Philippine Statistics Authority data, Iloilo province is in the Top 4 of the top hog-producing provinces.

text: Sa subong, nagapadayon ang kampanya sang kabanwahanan paagi sa prevention containment kag repopulation program sang mga baboy.
english: Currently, the campaign of the municipalities through prevention containment and repopulation program of pigs continues.

text: I-check man suno kay Defensor kun may mga barangay sa red zone areas nga mahimu na makasagod liwat sang baboy para mabawi ang nadula nga population sang baboy.
english: Defensor said they will also check if there are barangays in red zone areas that can raise pigs again to recover the lost population of pigs.

text: Hindi ikinatuwa ng Department of Justice ang ginawang “heart sign” at pahayag ng kontrobersyal na contractor na si Cezarah “Sarah” Discaya sa kanyang pagharap sa ahensya, na anila’y maaaring makaapekto sa pagsusuri sa kanyang aplikasyon bilang state witness.
english: The Department of Justice is not pleased with the heart sign and statement of controversial contractor Cezarah “Sarah” Discaya in her appearance before the agency, which could affect the review of her application as a state witness.

text: Ayon kay DOJ spokesperson Jose Dominic Clavano IV, isinama sa assessment ang kilos at pahayag ni Discaya, na itinuturing ng ahensya bilang palatandaan ng kawalan ng sinseridad at pagiging kampante.
english: According to DOJ spokesperson Jose Dominic Clavano IV, the assessment included Discaya's actions and statements, which the agency considers as a sign of lack of sincerity and confidence.

text: Nanawagan din siya sa lahat ng persons of interest na kumilos nang naaayon.
english: He also called on all persons of interest to act accordingly.

text: Kabilang ang mag-asawang Discaya sa 15 contractor na pinangalanan ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Discaya couple are among the 15 contractors named by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: na nakakuha ng 404 flood control projects na nagkakahalaga ng P30 bilyon sa loob lamang ng tatlong taon.
english: that got 404 flood control projects worth P30 billion in just three years.

text: Dumalo sila sa DOJ case buildup laban sa mga personalidad na umano’y sangkot sa anomalya.
english: They attended the DOJ case buildup against personalities allegedly involved in the anomaly.

text: Habang papasok sa DOJ, hindi agad sinagot ni Sarah ang tanong ng media ngunit kalaunan ay humarap sa kamera at nagpakita ng “finger heart” gesture na pamoso sa Korean pop culture.
english: While entering the DOJ, Sarah did not immediately answer the media's question but instead faced the camera and showed a "finger heart" gesture that is popular in Korean pop culture.

text: Samantala, dumating naman si Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya II na naka-bulletproof vest at may kasamang seguridad.
english: Meanwhile, Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya II arrived wearing a bulletproof vest and accompanied by security.

text: Sa mga pagdinig sa Kongreso, nag-alok ang mag-asawa na maging state witnesses at nagbanggit ng ilang mambabatas at opisyal ng Department of Public Works and Highways na umano’y humihingi ng hanggang 25% kickback sa mga proyekto.
english: In congressional hearings, the couple offered to be state witnesses and mentioned some lawmakers and officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways who allegedly asked for up to 25% kickback on projects.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, ang mga Discaya ay nasa ilalim ng provisional Witness Protection Program ng DOJ habang hinihintay ang desisyon kung sila ay kikilalaning state witness na magpapawalang-sala sa kanila sa kasong kriminal at sibil.
english: Currently, the Discayas are under the DOJ's provisional Witness Protection Program while awaiting a decision on whether they will be recognized as state witnesses who will exonerate them from criminal and civil charges.

text: Kasama rin sa mga binigyan ng proteksiyon sina dating DPWH engineers Henry Alcantara, Brice Hernandez, Jaypee Mendoza at Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo.
english: Also among those given protection were former DPWH engineers Henry Alcantara, Brice Hernandez, Jaypee Mendoza and Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo.

text: Ayon kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla may ilan sa kanila na nagpapakita ng good faith at naglalabas ng dokumento bilang patunay sa kanilang testimonya.
english: According to Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, some of them are showing good faith and producing documents as proof of their testimony.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nalapawan sang Bureau of Customs (BOC) ang monthly target sini sa ikatlo nga sunod-sunod nga bulan matapos nakakolekta sang record high nga P70.73 billion sang Marso.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Bureau of Customs (BOC) surpassed its monthly target for the third consecutive month after collecting a record high of P70.73 billion in March.

text: Suno kay Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, ini bangud man sa nagataas nga global oil prices sa tunga sang Russia-Ukraine war.
english: According to Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, this is also due to rising global oil prices amid the Russia-Ukraine war.

text: Pahayag ni Guerrero, ini bunga man sang padayon nga commitment kag dedikasyon sa serbisyo sang ila mga empleyado sa pihak sang pandemya.
english: Guerrero said this is also the result of the continued commitment and dedication to the service of their employees despite the pandemic.

text: Base sa data nga gin- release sang ahensya, ginapakita nga ang revenue sang nagligad nga bulan ang 22.6 percent ukon P13.04 billion nga mas mataas sa P57.69 billion nga gin-target para sa Marso.
english: Based on data released by the agency, last month's revenue was 22.6 percent or P13.04 billion, higher than the P57.69 billion targeted for March.

text: Suno sa BOC,ang positive revenue collection performance ang resulta sang naga- improve nga volume sang importasyon sa pungsod kag mas ginpabaskog nga collective efforts sang tanan nga collection districts.
english: According to the BOC, the positive revenue collection performance is the result of the improving volume of imports in the country and the strengthened collective efforts of all collection districts.

text: Naalarma ang South Korea matapos nagsulod sa air defense zone sini ang lima ka Chinese military planes kag anum nga halin naman sa Russia.
english: South Korea was alarmed after five Chinese military planes and six from Russia entered its air defense zone.

text: Suno sa Joint Chiefs of Staff sang Seoul, 9:35 sang aga sang nagsulod kag nagguwa man dayon ini nga mga military aircraft sa Korea Air Defense Identification Zone sa East Sea kag South Sea.
english: According to the Joint Chiefs of Staff of Seoul, the military aircraft entered and left the Korean Air Defense Identification Zone in the East and South Seas at 9:35 am.

text: Ang air defense identification zone amo ang mas malapad nga area ipaanggid sa airspace sang pungsod kun sa diin kontrolado ang aircraft para sa security reasons, apang ini nga concept ang wala na-define sa international treaty.
english: An air defense identification zone is a larger area compared to a country's airspace where aircraft are controlled for security reasons, but this concept is not defined in an international treaty.

text: Gintawag naman sang Chinese defense ministry nga ika-siyam nga strategic patrol ang ila nga pagpalupad sang aircraft sa ibabaw sang Sea of Japan ukon kilala man nga East Sea sa South Korea.
english: The Chinese defense ministry called the aircraft's ninth strategic patrol over the Sea of ​​Japan or also known as the East Sea in South Korea.

text: Suno sa Beijing, ginhimo nila ini sandig sa annual cooperation plan sa tunga sang Chinese kag Russian militaries.
english: According to Beijing, they did so in accordance with the annual cooperation plan between the Chinese and Russian militaries.

text: Gin-report naman sang South Korean military officials nga ang Chinese military aircraft ang naglupad pakadto sa Dokdo islands sa eastern coast matapos naglabay sa Korean peninsula kag Japan malapit sa contested submerged rock nga Ieodo.
english: South Korean military officials reported that the Chinese military aircraft flew to the Dokdo islands on the east coast after passing through the Korean peninsula and Japan near the contested submerged rock Ieodo.

text: Naglupad naman ang Russian planes pa-nabagatnan sa Dokdo islets nga kilala nga Takeshima sa Japanese.
english: The Russian planes flew south to the Dokdo islets, known as Takeshima in Japanese.

text: Suno sa officials, nakita pa nga nag-updanay ang Chinese kag Russian aircraft sa dagat sa nabagatnan sang Dokdo antes sila nagseparar kag nagpauli na.
english: According to officials, the Chinese and Russian aircraft were seen together in the sea south of Dokdo before they separated and headed home.

text: Halin sang 2019, nagapalupad na ang Beijing kag Moscow sang military aircraft sa South Korea air defense zone nga wala sang prior notice kag nagarason lang nga nagahimo sila sang joint exercises.
english: Since 2019, Beijing and Moscow have been flying military aircraft into the South Korean air defense zone without prior notice and only on the grounds that they are conducting joint exercises.

text: Natabo man ini sang Hunyo kag Disyembre 2023 kag sang Mayo kag Nobyembre 2022 nga gintawag sang duha ka mga magkaalyado nga pungsod nga “joint strategic air patrols.”
english: It also took place in June and December 2023 and in May and November 2022 which the two allied countries called “joint strategic air patrols.”

text: Hot, sexy kag stunning.
english: Hot, sexy and stunning.

text: Ini ang nangin reaksyon sang mga netizens matapos ginpakigbahin sang Ilongga nga si Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo ang iya nga pictorial samtang naka-bikini nga duag pula.
english: This was the reaction of netizens after Ilongga Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo shared her pictorial while wearing a red bikini.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, naga-umpisa pa lamang siya kag madamo pa sang lauman sa iya nga journey isa ka bulan antes ang 69th Miss Universe pageant nga pagahiwaton sa Hollywood sa Florida, USA sa Mayo 17, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Rabiya said she is just getting started and has a lot to look forward to in her journey a month before the 69th Miss Universe pageant to be held in Hollywood, Florida, USA on May 17, Philippine time.

text: Matandaan nga makapila naman ka beses nga ginpa-WOW ni Rabiya ang publiko sa iya masami nga mga pictures nga ginapaguwa sa social media.
english: Rabiya has repeatedly wowed the public with her frequent pictures posted on social media.

text: Umakyat na sa 27 ang iniulat na nasawi bunsod ng epekto ng Southwest Monsoon o Habagat at ng mga bagyong Mirasol, Nando, at Opong, ayon sa National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council nitong Lunes.
english: The number of people reported affected by the Southwest Monsoon and typhoons Mirasol, Nando and Opong has risen to 27, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council on Monday.

text: Sa ulat ng NDRRMC, apat na ang nakumpirmang patay habang 23 pa ang sumasailalim sa beripikasyon.
english: According to the NDRRMC, four have been confirmed dead while 23 are still undergoing verification.

text: Nanatili naman sa 33 ang mga sugatan, at umakyat sa 16 ang mga nawawala na pawang for validation pa rin.
english: Nanatili naman sa 33 ang mga sugatan, at umakyat sa 16 ang mga nawawala na pawang for validation pa rin.

text: Aabot sa 906,794 pamilya o 3.4 milyong katao ang naapektuhan ng mga pag-ulan at pagbaha.
english: A total of 906,794 families or 3.4 million people were affected by the rains and floods.

text: Mahigit 30,000 pamilya ang pansamantalang nanunuluyan sa higit 1,600 evacuation centers, habang 22,000 pamilya naman ang tinutulungan sa labas ng mga ito.
english: More than 30,000 families are temporarily sheltered in more than 1,600 evacuation centers, while 22,000 families are being assisted outside these.

text: Nagdulot ng pagbaha sa 370 lugar ang sama ng panahon, kung saan 282 na ang humupa.
english: The same weather caused flooding in 370 places, of which 282 have already subsided.

text: Nasa 287 kalsada at 55 tulay ang naapektuhan, at hanggang Lunes, 47 kalsada at 13 tulay ang nananatiling hindi madaanan.
english: A total of 287 roads and 55 bridges were affected, and as of Monday, 47 roads and 13 bridges remained impassable.

text: Naitala rin ang power outage sa 225 lungsod at bayan, kung saan 159 na ang naibalik ang suplay.
english: Power outages were also recorded in 225 cities and towns, of which 159 have been restored.

text: Sa 16 lugar na nawalan ng tubig, 12 ang naibalik, habang 37 lugar ang naapektuhan sa komunikasyon at 33 dito ang wala pa ring linya.
english: Of the 16 areas that lost water, 12 have been restored, while 37 areas have been affected by communication and 33 of them are still without lines.

text: Samantala, 178 seaports ang naapektuhan, at 35 pa ang hindi operational.
english: Meanwhile, 178 seaports were affected, and 35 are still not operational.

text: Dahil dito, mahigit 2,600 pasahero, 928 rolling cargoes at 21 vessels ang naistranded.
english: As a result, more than 2,600 passengers, 928 rolling cargoes and 21 vessels were stranded.

text: Umakyat naman sa 16,911 ang kabuuang bilang ng mga napinsalang bahay sa iba’t ibang rehiyon, kabilang ang 2,600 na tuluyang nasira.
english: The total number of damaged houses in various regions rose to 16,911, including 2,600 that were completely destroyed.

text: Sa agrikultura, tinatayang higit P1 bilyon ang production loss na katumbas ng 86,207 metric tons, na nakaapekto sa mahigit 37,000 magsasaka at mangingisda.
english: In agriculture, the production loss is estimated at more than P1 billion equivalent to 86,207 metric tons, affecting more than 37,000 farmers and fisherfolk.

text: Samantala, nasa P979.6 milyon ang pinsala sa imprastraktura, pinakamatindi sa Region 1 na umabot sa P773 milyon.
english: Meanwhile, infrastructure damage amounted to P979.6 million, the worst in Region 1 at P773 million.

text: Naitala rin ng Department of Education ang pagkasira ng 1,370 silid-aralan, kabilang ang 254 na ganap na nasira.
english: The Department of Education also recorded the destruction of 1,370 classrooms, including 254 that were completely destroyed.

text: Mahigit 50 lungsod at bayan ang nagdeklara ng state of calamity.
english: More than 50 cities and towns have declared a state of calamity.

text: Ayon pa sa NDRRMC, tinatayang 384,221 pamilya ang nangangailangan ng ayuda na katumbas ng P156.7 milyon, at halos kalahati na ang natugunan ng pamahalaan.
english: According to the NDRRMC, an estimated 384,221 families are in need of assistance equivalent to P156.7 million, and almost half of them have been targeted by the government.

text: Nagapati ang chairman sang Committee on Domestic and International Relations sang Iloilo City Council nga madamo sang kaayuhan nga dala ang sisterhood agreements sa tunga sang China kag Pilipinas partikular ang Iloilo City.
english: The chairman of the Committee on Domestic and International Relations of the Iloilo City Council believes that the sisterhood agreements between China and the Philippines have many benefits particularly Iloilo City.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa pag-file sang mga mamalidha nga myembro sang Akbayan party list, Mamamayang Liberal (ML), kag Liberal Party (LP) sang resolusyon nga imbestigaran ang mga sister city agreements sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag China kag ginaduso nga bawion ini bangud sa pagpati nga gamiton lang ini sang Chinese government para sa ila interes.
english: This is in connection with the filing of a resolution by lawmakers members of the Akbayan party list, Mamamayang Liberal (ML), and Liberal Party (LP) to investigate the sister city agreements between the Philippines and China and propose to withdraw them because they believe that the Chinese government will use them for their interests.

text: Base sa data, may 16 nga sister city partnerships sa DILG samtang 29 naman ang sa idalom sang League of Cities of the Philippines sa tunga sang mga local government units sa Pilipinas kag mga syudad sa China.
english: Based on the data, there are 16 sister city partnerships in the DILG while 29 are under the League of Cities of the Philippines between local government units in the Philippines and cities in China.

text: Sa bahin sang Iloilo City, naka-establish ini sang sister city ties sa Qingdao sang 2000, Guangzhou City sa Fujian province sang 2020, kag Wuhan sa Hubei province sang 2021.
english: For Iloilo City, it established sister city ties with Qingdao in 2000, Guangzhou City in Fujian province in 2020, and Wuhan in Hubei province in 2021.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Rudolph Ganzon, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga mga sisterhood agreements ang makabulig sa pag-boost sang ekonomiya, promosyon sang turismo, kag pag-engganyo sang dugang nga mga investors.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Rudolph Ganzon said these sisterhood agreements will help boost the economy, promote tourism, and attract more investors.

text: Apang, gin-athag naman sang opisyal nga pabor man ini nga i-review ang mga agreements ilabi na kun wala man gid sang regular nga mga aktibidad sa tunga mga siyudad.
english: However, the official explained that he is also in favor of reviewing the agreements especially if there are no regular activities between the cities.

text: Suno sa iya, kumporme man ini sa pag-review agud masiguro nga ang kaundan sang agreements ang wala sang peligro nga dala sa safety sang syudad kag sang pungsod.
english: He said he also agreed to review to ensure that the contents of the agreements do not pose a threat to the safety of the city and the country.

text: Dugang niya, mas maayo man nga indi lang ang sisterhood agreements sa China ang i-review kundi pati man sa iban nga syudad sa Pilipinas kag sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: He added that it is better to review not only the sisterhood agreements in China but also in other cities in the Philippines and abroad.

text: Matapos ginkamasaan ang Syria paagi sa 64-puntos nga abanse sa 2022 Fiba Under-18 Asian Championship, nag-arangka liwat ang Gilas Pilipinas Youth kag ginlampaso ang Qatar, 77-61.
english: After stunning Syria with a 64-point lead in the 2022 Fiba Under-18 Asian Championship, Gilas Pilipinas Youth rallied again and topped Qatar, 77-61.

text: Wala sa gihapon sang pyerde ang Gilas sa hinampang nga ginapatigayon sa Azadi Basketball Hall sa Tehran, Iran.
english: The Gilas are still undefeated in the match held at the Azadi Basketball Hall in Tehran, Iran.

text: Nanguna si Mason Amos sa Gilas paagi sa iya 19 points kag seven rebounds.
english: Mason Amos led the Gilas with 19 points and seven rebounds.

text: Nakaamot naman si Jared Bahay sang 15 points, three boards, kag three assists.
english: Jared Bahay contributed 15 points, three boards, and three assists.

text:
Kasunod sini nga ikaduha nga kadalag-an, patas na ang Gilas sa Chinese Taipei sa top spot sa Group C.

Mentor sang Gilas si Josh Reyes nga amo man ang nag-coach sa U16 team nga nagpang-pito sa pagbalik sang Asian youth tilt sang nagligad nga bulan sa Doha, Qatar.
english:
Following this second victory, the Gilas are tied with Chinese Taipei for the top spot in Group C.

Gilas mentor Josh Reyes, who also coached the U16 team that finished seventh in the return of the Asian youth tilt last month in Doha, Qatar.

text: Tatlo ka bulan nga magatinir anay sa Thailand ang tiglawas sang Myanmar sa Miss Grand International bangud sa kahangawa nga arestuhon siya sang militar kun siya ang magabalik sa iya pungsod.
english: Myanmar's Miss Grand International representative will stay in Thailand for three months for fear of being arrested by the military if she returns to her country.

text: Matandaan nga nangin viral sa social media ang nangin speech ni Miss Grand Myanmar Han Lay kun sa diin nagpanindugan siya batok sa kalakasan nga ginahimo sang mga katapo sang militar sa Myanmar halin sang ginpatuman ang kudeta sang Pebrero 1.
english: Miss Grand Myanmar Han Lay's speech became viral on social media in which she stood up against the violence committed by members of the military in Myanmar since the February 1 coup.

text: Sa Miss Grand International Pageant, nagahibi nga nagpangayo sang bulig si Han Lay halin sa lain-lain nga pungsod ilabi na bangud ginatos na ka mga protesters ang napatay sa Myanmar.
english: At the Miss Grand International Pageant, Han Lay tearfully asked for help from different countries especially since hundreds of protesters have been killed in Myanmar.

text: “Today in my country Myanmar … there are so many people dying.
english: “Today in my country Myanmar … there are so many people dying.

text: Please help Myanmar.
english: Please help Myanmar.

text: We need your urgent international help right now,” kabahin sang iya pa-apelar sang bulig.
english: We need your urgent international help right now,” part of his appeal for help.

text: Bangud sang iya duha ka minutos nga speech, nagakahangawa ang 22 anyos nga beauty queen nga mabutang siya sa radar sang militar.
english: Because of her two-minute speech, the 22-year-old beauty queen is worried that she will be put on the radar of the military.

text: Gin-ako niya nga antes siya maghalin sa iya pungsod para sa Miss Grand International pageant, nakahibalo siya nga ginabutang niya sa risgo ang iya kaugalingon.
english: She admitted that before she left her country for the Miss Grand International pageant, she was aware that she was putting herself at risk.

text: Labi pa nga nagdaku ang iya nga kahangawa bangud sang nagligad nga semana, nag-isyu ang security forces sang arrest warrant sa 18 ka mga artista kag social media “influencers” kag duha ka journalists bangud sa ginapahayag pagsapubliko sang materyal “intended to cause a member of the armed forces to mutiny or disregard their duty”.
english: He is further concerned that last week, security forces issued arrest warrants against 18 artists and social media influencers and two journalists for allegedly publishing material “intended to cause a member of the armed forces to mutiny or disregard their duty”.

text: Suno kay Han Lay, wala pa man siya ginkontak sang militar halin sang ginpatigayon ang pageant apang may mga nabaton siya nga mga pagpamahog sa iya nga social media accounts.
english: According to Han Lay, the military has not contacted her since the pageant but she has received threats on her social media accounts.

text: May mga nagapadala man sang mensahe sa iya nga nagahulat ang presuhan sa iya liwat nga pagbalik sa Myanmar.
english: Some also sent him messages that the prison was waiting for him to return to Myanmar.

text: Safe man suno sa iya ang iya nga pamilya apang mabudlay ang pag-communicate sa ila bangud masami nga ginautod ang internet connection sa ila nga pungsod.
english: He said his family is safe but it is difficult to communicate with them because the internet connection in their country is often cut off.

text: ahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, isa man si Han Lay sa mga nag-gwa sa dalanon sa Yangon agud magprotesta batok sa militar.
english: Last month, Han Lay was also one of those who took to the streets in Yangon to protest against the military.

text: Ang kaupod niya sa amo nga protesta ang gin-aresto sang mga pulis.
english: His companion in the protest was arrested by the police.

text: Santo sa record sang activist group nga Assistance Association for Political Prisoners (AAPP), kapin 2,500 ka tawo na ang naaresto sa Myanmar bangud sang military crackdown.
