english: According to the records of the activist group Assistance Association for Political Prisoners (AAPP), more than 2,500 people have been arrested in Myanmar due to the military crackdown.

text: Sa subong, masobra naman sa 550 ang patay kag masobra 40 diri amo ang mga kabataan.
english: So far, more than 550 people have died, more than 40 of them children.

text: Nagpasalig ang bag-o nga OIC Regional Director sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Region 6 nga magapadayon ang ginapatuman nga mga programa nga nagatuyo magpauswag sang kabuhi sang mga pumuluyo sa Western Visayas.
english: The new OIC Regional Director of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Region 6 assured that the implementation of programs aimed at improving the lives of the people in Western Visayas will continue.

text: Isa sa mga nagapadayon nga inisyatibo amo ang “Walang Gutom” innovation program nga ginaduso sa national level sa liderato ni DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian.
english: One of the ongoing initiatives is the “Walang Gutom” innovation program being pushed at the national level under the leadership of DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian.

text: Nakalinyada man ang Extension Accreditation Pilot Program, nga nagsugod na sa Iloilo, kag ginapaabot nga magalapnag pa sa iban nga mga probinsya sa rehiyon.
english: The Extension Accreditation Pilot Program, which has already started in Iloilo, is also in line, and is expected to expand to other provinces in the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay OIC Regional Director Joselito Estember, ginpahayag sini nga nagapadayon ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), kag subong nga tuig may target ang DSWD nga mapagraduate ang masobra 50% sang mga benepisyaryo, ukon kabug-osan nga 175,000 ka pumuluyo nga ginaalalayan sang programa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, OIC Regional Director Joselito Estember said the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) is ongoing, and this year the DSWD has a target to graduate more than 50% of the beneficiaries, or a total of 175,000 people served by the program.

text: Ginapadayon man ang koordinasyon sa mga local government units (LGU) agud masiguro ang padayon nga pagbangon sang kabuhi sang mga pamilya bisan matapos na ang ila benepisyo sa 4Ps.
english: Coordination with local government units (LGUs) is also being continued to ensure the continued recovery of families even after their 4Ps benefits end.

text: Gindugang pa ni Estember nga may yara man sang X-Program para sa mga medical nga kinahanglangon, samtang kabahin man ang DSWD-6 sa Buong Pilipinas Handa nga kampanya para sa disaster preparedness and response, kun sa diin nagahanda na sila sang mga food packs kag relief goods sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: Estember added that there is also an X-Program for medical needs, while the DSWD-6 is also part of the Philippine Ready campaign for disaster preparedness and response, where they are already preparing food packs and relief goods in times of disaster.

text: Para naman sa mga unemployed nga benepisyaryo sang 4Ps, may Serbisyo Caravan ukon Trabaho Tulong Program nga ginahiwat ang ahensya sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar sa rehiyon, agud matagaan sang oportunidad sa palangabuhian ang mga wala pa sang permanente nga trabaho.
english: For the unemployed 4Ps beneficiaries, the agency is conducting a Serbisyo Caravan or Trabaho Tulong Program in various parts of the region, to provide livelihood opportunities to those who do not yet have permanent jobs.

text: Sa karon, may 43,000 ka benepisyaryo ang yara sa Western Visayas kag ginakabig nga 1.5 bilyon pesos ang gina-invest sang national government kada tuig para sa mga programa nga ini.
english: Currently, there are 43,000 beneficiaries in Western Visayas and it is estimated that the national government invests 1.5 billion pesos annually for these programs.

text: Ginpasalig ni Estember nga padayon ang commitment sang DSWD-6 sa pagbulig sa mga pumuluyo, kag ginapaninguhaan nga mas madamo pa ang mabenepisyuhan sa palaabuton.
english: Estember assured that the DSWD-6 continues to be committed to helping the people, and is working to benefit more people in the future.

text: Kumpirmado paagi sa isa ka video nga ginpost sa Youtube nga kasal na ang aktres nga si Jessy Mendiola kag aktor nga si Luis Manzano.
english: It was confirmed through a video posted on Youtube that actress Jessy Mendiola and actor Luis Manzano are married.

text: Ginpatigayon ang intimate wedding ceremony sa The Farm sa Lipa City, Batangas kun sa diin imbitado ang ila pamilya kag pila lang ka abyan.
english: The intimate wedding ceremony was held at The Farm in Lipa City, Batangas where their family and a few friends were invited.

text: Yara ang ginikanan ni Luis nga sanday Batangas 6th District Representative Vilma Santos kag aktor nga si Edu Manzano.
english: Luis' parents, Batangas 6th District Representative Vilma Santos and actor Edu Manzano, were present.

text: Wala nakatambong ang iloy ni Jessy apang nag-upod man sa selebrasyon sang kasal sang iya anak paagi sa video call.
english: Jessy's mother did not attend but also joined her daughter's wedding celebration via video call.

text: Suksok ni Jessy ang simple apang matahum nga gown nga himo ni Patricia Santos samtang suksok naman ni Luis ang pink suit nga himo ni Paulo Lazaro.
english: Jessy wore a simple but beautiful gown by Patricia Santos while Luis wore a pink suit by Paulo Lazaro.

text: Matandaan nga 2016 sang ginkumpirma sang duha nga naga-date sila kag Disyembre 2020 sang gin-anunsyo ang ila nga engagement.
english: It can be recalled that in 2016, the two confirmed that they were dating and in December 2020, they announced their engagement.

text: Ginpukaw sang Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL) ang atensyon sang mga mall sa pungsod kun sa diin posible ginapeke ang mga produkto nga nagakopya sang iban nga mga brand.
english: The Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL) has drawn the attention of malls in the country where products that copy other brands may be counterfeit.

text: Kasunod ini sang raid nga ginpatigayon sang National Bureau of Investigation sa Greenhills Shopping Center kun sa diin nakumpiskar ang P69 million nga balor sang counterfeit bags, belts, wallets, kag iban pa nga items, nga iligal nga nagagamit sang luxury brand logos.
english: This follows a raid conducted by the National Bureau of Investigation at the Greenhills Shopping Center where P69 million worth of counterfeit bags, belts, wallets, and other items, illegally using luxury brand logos, were confiscated.

text: Ginserbe sang NBI Intellectual Property Rights Division (IPRD) ang search warrant matapos nga nag-file sang intellectual property rights complaint ang tiglawas halin sa luxury brand nga Louis Vuitton.
english: The NBI Intellectual Property Rights Division (IPRD) served the search warrant after a representative from luxury brand Louis Vuitton filed an intellectual property rights complaint.

text: Nag-guwa naman sa rekord sang IPOPHL nga ang amo nga mall ang nagtupa sa listahan sang US Trade Representatives’ 2021 Review of Notorious Markets for Counterfeiting and Piracy.
english: IPOPHL records showed that the mall was included in the US Trade Representatives' 2021 Review of Notorious Markets for Counterfeiting and Piracy.

text: Ini nga lista ang ginpaguwa sang nagligad nga Pebrero.
english: This list was released last February.

text: Indi maasi-asi ang performance sang Gilas Pilipinas Youth sa pag-umpisa sang 2022 Fiba Under-18 Asian Championship sa sa Tehran, Iran.
english: The performance of the Gilas Pilipinas Youth at the start of the 2022 Fiba Under-18 Asian Championship in Tehran, Iran was not to be missed.

text: Ini matapos ginkamasaan sini ang Syria, 112-48, sa hampang sa Azadi Basketball Hall.
english: This was after it defeated Syria, 112-48, in the match at Azadi Basketball Hall.

text: Si Mason Amos ang nanguna sa Gilas boys nga may 26 points, samtang si Earl Jared Abadam naman ang may yara sang 19 markers, six rebounds, four assists kag seven steals.
english: Mason Amos led the Gilas boys with 26 points, while Earl Jared Abadam had 19 markers, six rebounds, four assists and seven steals.

text: Nagdugang man si Seven Gagate sang 19 points kag nine rebounds.
english: Seven Gagate also added 19 points and nine rebounds.

text: Sunod nga makasumpong sang Gilas Youth ang Qatar subong nga Lunes sa Group C action agud makatipon sang daog kag makasulod sa top eight.
english: Qatar will next face Gilas Youth this Monday in Group C action to collect wins and move into the top eight.

text: Patay sa plane crash sa New York, USA ang isa ka volunteer pilot nga kilala sa pag-transport sa mga na-rescue nga mga sapat.
english: A volunteer pilot known for transporting rescued animals was killed in a plane crash in New York, USA.

text: Ini amo si Seuk Kim, 49, nga may sakay nga tatlo ka ido sang nagbyahe ini halin sa Maryland pakadto sa Albany, New York, apang nagtibusok ang eroplano sa Windham sa Catskill Mountains.
english: This is Seuk Kim, 49, who had three dogs on board when he traveled from Maryland to Albany, New York, but the plane crashed in Windham in the Catskill Mountains.

text: Isa ka ido ang napatay man sa insidente, apang nakaluwas ang duha kag subong naga-recover na.
english: A dog was also killed in the incident, but two survived and are now recovering.

text: Nag-ulan gid ang simpatiya kag kasubo kasunod sang plane crash ilabi na sang nahibaluan nga idul-ong kuntani ni Kim ang mga ido sa Animal Shelter of Schoharie Valley (ASSV) nga isa ka no-kill shelter sa Howes Cave, New York.
english: Sympathy and sadness poured in following the plane crash especially when it was learned that Kim was supposed to take the dogs to the Animal Shelter of Schoharie Valley (ASSV) a no-kill shelter in Howes Cave, New York.

text: Kabahin siya sang “freedom flight” volunteer pilots nga nagapasakay sang mga sapat nga ma-rescue halin sa euthanasia lists sa high-kill shelters.
english: She is part of the “freedom flight” volunteer pilots who fly animals to be rescued from euthanasia lists to high-kill shelters.

text: Nagakatabo ang pagpatay sang mga ido bangud nagasulubra na sila sa animal shelters apang isa si Kim sa mga nagboluntaryo nga magbulig kag magsaylo sa ila para sa nagakaigu nga veterinary care.
english: Dogs are being killed because they are overcrowded in animal shelters but Kim is one of those who volunteered to help and transfer them for proper veterinary care.

text: Gina-imbestigaran naman subong sang National Transportation Safety Board ang rason sa plane crash.
english: The National Transportation Safety Board is investigating the cause of the plane crash.

text: Nagpatigayon na sang decontamination ang mga otoridad sa Pis-anan National High School sa Sibalom, Antique.
english: Authorities have already conducted decontamination at Pis-anan National High School in Sibalom, Antique.

text: Kasunod ini sang natabo nga ginapatiha nga chemical poisoning nga nagresulta sa pagkalipong kag pagka-ospital sang 200 tubtob 300 ka mga estudyante matapos makahaklo sang baho nga kaangay sang luto nga bayabas.
english: This follows the incident of suspected chemical poisoning that resulted in dizziness and hospitalization of 200 to 300 students after inhaling the smell of cooked guava.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Rodel Esler, Head sang Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office kag Information Office sang Task Force Pis-anan, iya ginpahayag nag-umpisa ang decontamination kahapon, Hulyo 14 kag magalawig tubtob subong, Huylo 15.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Rodel Esler, Head of the Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office and Information Office of Task Force Pis-anan, said the decontamination began yesterday, July 14 and will continue until today, July 15.

text: Suno kay Esler, mismo ang alcalde sang banwa nga si Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña ang nag-isyu sang Executive Order para makapatigayon sang pagtinlo sa eskwelahan partikular na ang mga area kun sa diin nagtinir ang nagkalalipo nga mga estudyante.
english: According to Esler, the town's mayor, Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña, issued an Executive Order to clean up the school particularly the areas where the students stayed.

text: Pahayag ni Esler, kun makita nga safe na ang lugar, posible nga tugutan ang mga estudyante nga makabalik sa eskwelahan, buas Hulyo 16.
english: Esler said that if the area is found to be safe, it is possible that students will be allowed to return to school tomorrow, July 16.

text: Isa ka bulan matapos ginsapubliko sang aktres nga si Ellen Adarna kag aktor nga si Derek Ramsay ang ila relasyon, gin-anunsyo na engaged na sila.
english: A month after actress Ellen Adarna and actor Derek Ramsay made their relationship public, they announced they were engaged.

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, ginpakita ni Ellen ang iya nga singsing sa iya kamot.
english: In an Instagram post, Ellen showed off her ring on her hand.

text: May yara man sang mga laragway halin sa proposal sang aktor.
english: There are also pictures from the actor’s proposal.

text: May laragway man nga ginpakita nga nagahibi kag shocked si Ellen bangud sa proposal.
english: A picture was also shown of Ellen crying and shocked by the proposal.

text: Ang Instagram post ni Ellen ang may caption nga ‘Game Over’.
english: Ellen’s Instagram post was captioned ‘Game Over’.

text: Iselebrar sang duha ang ila second monthsary sa Abril 4.
english: The two will celebrate their second monthsary on April 4.

text: Matandaan nga Enero subong nga tuig sang ginhuring-huring nga may nagapatunga sa duha matapos nakit-an ang ila sweet moments sa isa ka dinner party kaupod ang ila celebrity friends.
english: It can be recalled that in January this year, there were rumors that someone was breaking up with the two after they were seen having sweet moments at a dinner party with their celebrity friends.

text: Inihayag ng Philippine National Police (PNP) nitong Linggo na ang mga menor de edad na naaresto sa naganap na marahas na protesta laban sa korapsyon noong Setyembre 21 ay dapat sumailalim sa rehabilitation at counseling.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) announced on Sunday that the minors arrested during the violent anti-corruption protests on September 21 should undergo rehabilitation and counseling.

text: Ayon kay PNP acting chief Lt.
english: According to PNP acting chief Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr., 55 na mga menor de edad at 25 na mga adults na naaresto ay pinalaya na alinsunod sa batas, partikular sa Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act.
english: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr., 55 minors and 25 adults who were arrested were released in accordance with the law, particularly the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act.

text: Sinabi naman ni Manila Mayor Isko Moreno na ang mga menor de edad ay kailangan dalhin sa Manila Department of Social Welfare upang magsagawa ng community service gaya ng cleanup drives bilang bahagi ng kanilang rehabilitation, reintegration, at diversion.
english: Manila Mayor Isko Moreno said the minors should be brought to the Manila Department of Social Welfare to conduct community service such as cleanup drives as part of their rehabilitation, reintegration, and diversion.

text: Binigyang-diin ni Nartatez na mahalaga ang pananagutan, ngunit dapat din bigyang-pansin ang wastong paggabay at rehabilitasyon para sa mga kabataan.
english: Nartatez stressed that accountability is important, but proper guidance and rehabilitation for the children should also be given due attention.

text: Hinimok din ng PNP ang mga magulang, tagapag-alaga, at lokal na opisyal na maging aktibo sa paggabay sa mga kabataan upang maiwasan ang mga katulad na insidente sa hinaharap.
english: The PNP also urged parents, guardians, and local officials to be active in guiding the youth to avoid similar incidents in the future.

text: Para naman sa 25 na mga adults na naaresto, iniutos ni Nartatez na makipag-ugnayan nang maigi ang mga imbestigador sa mga prosekusyon upang matiyak ang wastong pag-file ng kaso.
english: For the 25 adults arrested, Nartatez ordered investigators to contact the prosecution to ensure the proper filing of cases.

text: Ginlutos sang Vietnam ang Pilipinas sa imbukada sang 2022 Asian Volleyball Confederation Cup for Women sa PhilSports Arena sa Pasig.
english: Vietnam defeated the Philippines in the opening round of the 2022 Asian Volleyball Confederation Cup for Women at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig.

text: Gin-dominar sang Southeast Asian powerhouse nga Vietnam ang straight sets, 19-25, 17-25, 29-31.
english: Southeast Asian powerhouse Vietnam dominated in straight sets, 19-25, 17-25, 29-31.

text: Nagpanguna sa kadalag-an sang Vietnam ang veteran team captain nga si Tran Thi Thanh Thuy.
english: Veteran team captain Tran Thi Thanh Thuy led Vietnam to victory.

text: Makaupod sang Vietnam sa top sang Pool A ang defending champion nga China.
english: Vietnam will be joined at the top of Pool A by defending champion China.

text: Nagtinguha pa ang Pilipinas nga makabawi sa third set apang wala gid nakahingagaw.
english: The Philippines tried to recover in the third set but could not breathe.

text: Wala sa hampang ang top star nga si Alyssa Valdez, team captain nga si Jia De Guzman, kag head coach nga si Sherwin Meneses.
english: Absent from the game were top star Alyssa Valdez, team captain Jia De Guzman, and head coach Sherwin Meneses.

text: Si Jema Galanza ang nanguna sa Pilipinas nga may 13 points off 11 attacks kag two aces, samtang si Michele Gumabao naman ang may yara sang 11 points.
english: Jema Galanza led the Philippines with 13 points off 11 attacks and two aces, while Michele Gumabao had 11 points.

text: Sunod nga makasumpong sang Pilipinas ang five-time champion nga China sa buwas, Martes, ‘las syete sa gab-i, sa PhilSports Arena.
english: The Philippines will next face five-time champion China tomorrow, Tuesday, at 7 pm, at the PhilSports Arena.

text: Nagmandu na si Bureau of Customs (BoC) Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero nga imbestigaran ang mga personnel sang ahensya nga ginatudlo may kahilabtanan sa pag-smuggle sang agricultural products.
english: Bureau of Customs (BoC) Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero has ordered an investigation into the agency's personnel allegedly involved in the smuggling of agricultural products.

text: Magluwas sa administrative investigation, gina-pabaskog man suno kay Guerrero ang border protection efforts paagi sa enhanced intelligence kag enforcement operations kag pagpakig-angot sa Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: Besides the administrative investigation, Guerrero said border protection efforts are also being strengthened through enhanced intelligence and enforcement operations and liaison with the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Gina-review man ang tanan nga nagasulod nga agricultural products batok sa posible paglapas sa Customs laws, rules, kag regulations.
english: All incoming agricultural products are also reviewed against possible violations of Customs laws, rules, and regulations.

text: Sa rekord sang customs, halin sang 2019, may yara sang 542 ka seizure cases nga napatigayon kun sa diin masobra sa P1.99 billion ang balor sang agricultural products.
english: According to customs records, since 2019, there have been 542 seizure cases conducted where more than P1.99 billion worth of agricultural products.

text: Samtang, ginpanginwala naman ni BoC spokesman kag Assistant Commissioner Vincent Maronilla ang akusasyon nga nagpahilabot si ACT-CIS partylist Rep.
english: Meanwhile, BoC spokesman and Assistant Commissioner Vincent Maronilla denied the accusation that ACT-CIS partylist Rep.

text: Eric Go Yap, ang chairman sang House Committee on Appropriations, sa Customs officials may kaangtanan sa release sang anuman nga shipment.
english: Eric Go Yap, the chairman of the House Committee on Appropriations, to Customs officials regarding the release of any shipment.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang Customs nga naga-engage ang amo nga mamalidha sa smuggling activities.
english: Customs also denied that the lawmaker was engaged in smuggling activities.

text: Gintawag sang Department of Justice (DOJ) nga “insincerity kag complacency” ang hulag kag pahayag sang kontrobersyal nga kontraktor nga si Sarah Discaya.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) called the actions and statements of controversial contractor Sarah Discaya “insincerity and complacency”.

text: Ini matapos nga magpakita sang finger heart sign kag maglahog sa media samtang ginaimbistigaran angot sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: This is after he showed a finger heart sign and appeared in the media while being investigated for anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Justice Assistant Secretary Mico Clavano, ang tanan nga hulag kag ang pag-finger heart ni Sarah Discaya ang ilakip sa assesment kag evaluation sang Department of Justice, kun bala kwalipikado ini nga malakip sa witness protection program.
english: According to Justice Assistant Secretary Mico Clavano, all the movements and the finger heart of Sarah Discaya will be included in the assessment and evaluation of the Department of Justice, whether she is eligible to be included in the witness protection program.

text: Matandaan nga nag-trending ang finger heart sign ni Discaya samtang nagapaguwa ini sa Department of Justice, kadungan sa pagpangusisa sang ahensya sa aplikasyon sang mag-asawa nga Discaya sa WPP.
english: It can be recalled that Discaya's finger heart sign was trending while he was leaving the Department of Justice, while the agency was investigating the Discaya couple's application to WPP.

text: Liwat nga ginpabakod sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization members ang suporta para sa Ukraine sa isa ka pagsinapol kaupod ang mga opisyal sang pungsod bilang sabat sa paglunsar sang Russia sang experimental intermediate-range ballistic missile sang damlag lang.
english: North Atlantic Treaty Organization members reaffirmed support for Ukraine in a meeting with national officials in response to Russia’s recent launch of an experimental intermediate-range ballistic missile.

text: Ini matapos nagpatawag ang Kyiv sang meeting sa NATO-Ukraine Council.
english: This comes after Kyiv called a meeting of the NATO-Ukraine Council.

text: Sa amo nga pagsinapol, ginplastar sang chief of the defense intelligence sang Ukraine kag acting commander sang air force sa mga kaalyado nga pungsod ang detalye sang pagpang-atake kag ang possible nga konsekwensya.
english: During the meeting, the chief of the defense intelligence of Ukraine and acting commander of the air force in the allied countries laid out the details of the attack and the possible consequences.

text: Suno sa NATO, ang pagpang-atake nga nag-target sa Dnipro, ang isa ka pagtuyo sang Russia nga i- terrorize ang mga sibilyan sa Ukraine kag pahugon ang mga tawo nga nagasuporta sa Ukraine sa pagdepensa sini sa iya kaugalingon batok sa giyera nga ginlunsar sang Russia.
english: According to NATO, the attack, which targeted Dnipro, was a Russian attempt to terrorize civilians in Ukraine and intimidate people who support Ukraine in defending itself against the war launched by Russia.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Russian President Vladimir Putin nga gin-igo sang Moscow ang isa ka Ukrainian military facility paagi sa bag-o nga intermediate-range, hypersonic ballistic missile bilang sabat sa pagpahanugot sang U.S. kag UK sa Kyiv nga atakehon ang Russian territory gamit ang advanced Western weapons.
english: It can be recalled that Russian President Vladimir Putin said Moscow struck a Ukrainian military facility with a new intermediate-range, hypersonic ballistic missile in response to the U.S. and UK allowing Kyiv to attack Russian territory with advanced Western weapons.

text: May ginasundan na nga duha ka persons of interest ang Pavia Municipal Police Station kaangot sa nagluntad nga pagpang-holdup sa fuel tanker sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) sa Hibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: The Pavia Municipal Police Station is pursuing two persons of interest in connection with the robbery of a fuel tanker of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) in Hibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Harold Rendora, Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga pasado las-9 sang gab-i kahapon nga adlaw sang ginabaybay sang fuel tanker ang dalan halin sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Harold Rendora, chief of police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said that around 9 pm yesterday, the fuel tanker was crossing the road from Brgy.

text: Balabag, Pavia, kag sang nakalab-ot na ini sa Gorriceta Avenue, may nagbalabag na sa iya nga isa ka Mitsubishi mirage.
english: Barrier, Pavia, and when it reached Gorriceta Avenue, a Mitsubishi mirage blocked it.

text: Suno kay Rendora, naka-cover pa sang conduction sticker ang plater number sang salakyan sang suspek.
english: According to Rendora, the plater number of the suspect's vehicle was covered with a conduction sticker.

text: Gintuad man sini nga gintayaan sang pusil ang driver sang tanker truck kag ginkuha ang bag nga naga-unod sang kwarta nga indi magnubo sa P300,000.
english: He also confessed to throwing a gun at the driver of the tanker truck and took the bag containing at least P300,000.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpalagyo ang Mitsubishi mirage lakip na ang isa ka motorsiklo nga ginalantaw man nga kaupod sang nang-holdup.
english: The Mitsubishi mirage immediately fled the scene along with a motorcycle believed to be with the holdup.

text: Nahibaluan nga magarahe na kontani ang tanker sa C1 Road sa Brgy.
english: It was learned that the tanker was about to park on C1 Road in Brgy.

text: Pandac, Pavia kon sa diin, 150 meters na lang ang kalayuon sini antes makalab-ot sa amo nga garahe.
english: Pandac, Pavia where, it is only 150 meters away before reaching the garage.

text: Natumod man nga bag-ohanon ang driver kon sa diin, duha pa lang ka semana nga naga-remit sang kwarta sang fuel tanker.
english: The driver was also identified as a newcomer who had been remitting the fuel tanker for only two weeks.

text: Nagapatuman naman subong back tracking ang Pavia PNP agud nga matumod ang direksyon sang mga hold upper.
english: Pavia PNP is now conducting back tracking to identify the direction of the hold uppers.

text: Naghatag si United States President Donald Trump sang 50 ka adlaw agud nga maresolba sang Russia ang kumplikto sini sa Ukraine.
english: United States President Donald Trump has given Russia 50 days to resolve its conflict with Ukraine.

text: Kun indi ini mahimo suno sa presidente, mangatubang gid ang Moscow sang mabug-at kag bag-o nga economic sanctions.
english: If this is not done, the president said, Moscow will face heavy and new economic sanctions.

text: Matapos na-istorya si NATO chief Mark Rutte sa White House, ginpahayag ni Trump nga wala na gid siya nalipay sa mga ginapanghimo sang Russia.
english: After talking to NATO chief Mark Rutte at the White House, Trump said he was no longer happy with Russia's actions.

text: Lakip sa ginpaandam sini amo ang pagdagdag sang malala nga taripa nga lab-ot sa 100% kun wala pa gid sang kasugtanan nga malab-ot.
english: Among the warnings is the increase in severe tariffs of up to 100% if no agreement is reached.

text: “We’re going to be doing very severe tariffs if we don’t have a deal in 50 days,” suno kay Trump.
english: “We’re going to be doing very severe tariffs if we don’t have a deal in 50 days,” according to Trump.

text: “Tariffs at about 100%, you’d call them secondary tariffs.
english: “Tariffs at about 100%, you’d call them secondary tariffs.

text: You know what that means… I use trade for a lot of things.
english: You know what that means… I use trade for a lot of things.

text:
But it’s great for settling wars.”

Target man sini ang nabilin nga trade partners sang Russia agud nga mabudlayan ang Moscow nga makabangon ilabi na sa tunga sang ginasuprer sini subong nga Western sanctions.
english:
But it’s great for settling wars.”

It also targets Russia's remaining trade partners to make it difficult for Moscow to recover especially amid the current Western sanctions.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Trump kag ni Rutte ang ila nakasugtan kun sa diin magabakal ang NATO military alliance sang mga armas halin sa United States.
english: Trump and Rutte also revealed their agreement on where the NATO military alliance will buy weapons from the United States.

text: Namensyonar nga lakip sa baklon amo ang Patriot anti-missile batteries nga amo ang ihatag sa Ukraine agud mabuligan ini nga magbato sa atake sang Russia nga nag-umpisa pa sang Pebrero 2022.
english: It was mentioned that among the purchases will be Patriot anti-missile batteries that will be given to Ukraine to help it resist the Russian attack that began in February 2022.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Trump nga wala sini naluyagan ang mga ginpanghimo ni Russian leader Vladimir Putin nga sa baylo nga untaton ang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera, nagpalupad pa ini sang missiles kag drones agud nga mas palalaon ang away sa kaiping sini nga pungsod.
english: Earlier, Trump said he did not like the actions of Russian leader Vladimir Putin who, instead of ending the three-year war, launched missiles and drones to escalate the conflict with his neighbor.

text: Kasunod sang pag-kampyeon sa Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Invitational Conference, ginbaton sang Creamline Cool Smashers ang imbitasyon sa pagtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa nagahilapit nga 2022 Asian Women’s Volleyball Cup (2022 AVC Cup for Women).
english: Following the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Invitational Conference championship, the Creamline Cool Smashers accepted the invitation to represent the Philippines in the upcoming 2022 Asian Women’s Volleyball Cup (2022 AVC Cup for Women).

text: Ang Pilipinas man ang maga-host sang nasambit nga hinampang sa PhilSports Arena sa Pasig umpisa sa Agusto 21.
english: The Philippines will also host the game at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig starting August 21.

text: Kahapon lang, Agusto 14, sang ginlutos sang Creamline ang KingWhale Taipei sa PVL Invitational Conference final, 25-21, 25-19, 25-8, sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: It was only yesterday, August 14, that Creamline defeated KingWhale Taipei in the PVL Invitational Conference final, 25-21, 25-19, 25-8, at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Diskusyunan pa ang roster sang Creamline para sa kumpetisyon.
english: Creamline’s roster for the competition is still under discussion.

text: May 14 players ang Creamline nga naka-line up para sa PVL, apang 12 lang ang ginapahanugutan sang AVC Cup.
english: Creamline has 14 players lined up for the PVL, but the AVC Cup only allows 12.

text: Yara sa Pool A ang Pilipinas kun sa diin atubangon sini ang China, Iran, South Korea, kag ang Vietnam.
english: The Philippines are in Pool A where they will face China, Iran, South Korea, and Vietnam.

text: Sa Pool B naman amo ang Australia, Chinese Taipei, Japan, Kazakhstan, kag Thailand.##
english: In Pool B are Australia, Chinese Taipei, Japan, Kazakhstan, and Thailand.##

text: Dismayado si Department of the Interior and Local Government Undersecretary Epimaco Densing III sang natukiban nga nakapabakuna sang COVID-19 vaccine ang aktor nga si Mark Anthony Fernandez sa Parañaque City apisar wala siya sa priority list.
english: Department of the Interior and Local Government Undersecretary Epimaco Densing III was disappointed when it was discovered that actor Mark Anthony Fernandez in Parañaque City was vaccinated against COVID-19 despite not being on the priority list.

text: Suno kay Densing, napikon siya bangud may yara sang artista nga nabakunahan nga sa pagkamatuod, ang mga tawo nga yara sa priority list amo ang dapat una nga mabakunahan.
english: Densing said he was annoyed because there was an actor who got vaccinated when in fact, people on the priority list should be vaccinated first.

text: Pahayag sang opisyal, ang alkalde sang Parañaque City amo ang manabat sa natabo nga pagbakuna sa aktor.
english: The official said the mayor of Parañaque City is responsible for the vaccination of the actor.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpaguwa sang show cause order ang nasambit nga ahensya batuk sa lima ka mga alkalde nga nagpatublok na sang COVID-19 vaccine apisar wala pa sila sa listahan sang mga prayoridad.
english: The agency issued a show cause order against five mayors who have already received the COVID-19 vaccine despite not being on the priority list.

text: Gintuad sang mga barangay officials sang Barangay Tacas, Jaro kon paano nila na-rescue sang apat sa lima ka mga menor-de-edad nga nagpalagyo sa Balay Dalayunan sa Barangay Bo.
english: Barangay officials of Barangay Tacas, Jaro confessed how they rescued four of the five minors who escaped from the Balay Dalayunan in Barangay Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Joseph Poral sang Tacas, Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga insigida nga nagpadala sila sang mga otoridad lakip na sa nagbulig ang barangay tanod agud maglibot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Joseph Poral of Tacas, Jaro said they immediately sent authorities including the barangay tanod to help them patrol.

text: Ini kasunod man sa report nga ang mga menor-de-edad ang nagpanghold-up sang isa ka babaye sa area sang Muelle Loney Street.
english: This follows a report that minors robbed a woman in the area of ​​Muelle Loney Street.

text: Suno kay Poral, ang isa sa lima ka mga menor-de-edad ang nadakpan samtang nagalakat-lakat.
english: According to Poral, one of the five minors was caught while walking around.

text: Samtang, matapos nga na intercept ang isa, gintudlo sang pumuluyo nga yara ang nabilin nga apat sa isa ka balay apang natukiban nga wala na sila didto pag-abot sang otoridad.
english: Meanwhile, after one was intercepted, the resident pointed out that the remaining four were in a house but it was discovered that they were no longer there when the authorities arrived.

text: Liwat naman nga ginlibot nila ang sakop sang San Isidro, Jaro kon sa diin, nasugat-an sini ang duha kag gilayon nga nadakpan kag ginsakay sa pick up agud i-turnover sa barangay hall.
english: They again patrolled the area of ​​San Isidro, Jaro where they met the two and immediately arrested them and put them in a pick up to turn over to the barangay hall.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang nabilin nga isa ang nadakpan sa Brgy.
english: He also said that the remaining one was arrested in Brgy.

text: Quintin Salas, Jaro.
english: Quintin Salas, Jaro.

text: Gin-athag naman sang Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) nga may ginguba sa pasilidad ang mga menor-de-edad rason nga nakaguwa.
english: The Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) explained that the minors broke something in the facility and escaped.

text: Suno kay Teresa Gelogo, head sang Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office, may security guard, jail guard, kag may house parents nga nagabantay sa mga kabataan.
english: According to Teresa Gelogo, head of the Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office, there are security guards, jail guards, and house parents who watch over the children.

text: Apang, daw kaangay nga wala nagakatulog ang mga menor-de-edad rason nga nakahimo sang paagi agud makaguwa suno sa natungdan.
english: However, it seems that the minors were not sleeping so they managed to get out, he said.

text: Ginahulat naman sang talatapan ang pahayag sang in-charge sa Balay Dalayunan sa amo nga tion agud mapaathag kon ngaa nakapalagyo ang mga kabataan.
english: The office is waiting for the statement of the in-charge of the Balay Dalayunan at the time to explain why the children escaped.

text: Dismayado si Vice Pres.
english: Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte tuhoy sa pag-asikaso sa ikaayong lawas sang iya amay kag anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Sara Duterte on the health care of her father and former President Rodrigo Duterte in the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Suno sa iya, apisar ang basic care indi pa mahatag sa anay presidente kag indi pa mahatagan sang maga-upod sa iya hiligdaan sa sulod sang 24 hours.
english: He said that although basic care has not been provided to the former president and has not been provided with a bedmate for 24 hours.

text: “The continued detention of Former President Duterte under such troubling conditions is not only unjust but inhumane.
english: “The continued detention of Former President Duterte under such troubling conditions is not only unjust but inhuman.

text: It amounts to punishment without having been convicted of any crime,” pahag sang bise presidente.
english: It amounts to punishment without having been convicted of any crime,” the vice president said.

text: Nagapanawagan siya sa ICC nga hatagan sang lihok agud masiguro nga mahatagan sang proper care ang anay presidente kag sang nagakadapat nga humanitarian consideration.
english: He called on the ICC to take action to ensure that the former president is given proper care and due humanitarian consideration.

text: Wala ginkalimtan sang aktres nga si Claudine Barretto nga dumdumon ang ika- 46 nga kaadlawan sang nagtaliwan sini nga nobyo nga si Rico Yan.
english: Actress Claudine Barretto did not forget to commemorate the 46th birthday of her late boyfriend Rico Yan.

text: Nagpost sang video sa Instagram si Claudine sa diin iya ginpahayag nga bangud birthday ni Rico Yan, luyag niya ini nga iselebrar kag dumdumon pinaagi sa paghanda niya mismo sang pagkaon sa ila nga balay.
english: Claudine posted a video on Instagram where she said that since it was Rico Yan's birthday, she wanted to celebrate and remember him by preparing her own food at home.

text: Gin-greet mismo ni Claudine sang “Happy Birthday” si Rico Yan kag nagpabutyag ini nga indi gid niya mahimo kalimtan ang anay aktor.
english: Claudine herself greeted Rico Yan with a “Happy Birthday” and expressed that she will never forget the former actor.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtaliwan si Rico Yan sang 2002 sa cardiac arrest bangud sa acute hemorrhagic pancreatitis sa edad nga 27.
english: Rico Yan died in 2002 of cardiac arrest due to acute hemorrhagic pancreatitis at the age of 27.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Napun-an sang pagpasalamat ang isa ka Ilonggo nga si Father Romeo Duetao Convocar matapos gin-appoint ni Pope Francis bilang bag-o nga obispo sang Diocese of Chalan Kanoa sa Northern Mariana Islands.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – An Ilonggo, Father Romeo Duetao Convocar, was filled with gratitude after Pope Francis appointed him as the new bishop of the Diocese of Chalan Kanoa in the Northern Mariana Islands.

text: Ang pagpili sa iya bilang bishop sang Chalan Kanoa ang gin-anunsyo sang Vatican sa Roma.
english: His appointment as bishop of Chalan Kanoa was announced by the Vatican in Rome.

text: Sa Saipan naman, si His Eminence, Luis Antonio Gokim Cardinal Tagle, ang Pro-Prefect ng Dicastery for Evangelization ang nagpahibalo sang balita kadungan sang 40th anniversary sang Diocese of Chalan Kanoa.
english: In Saipan, His Eminence, Luis Antonio Gokim Cardinal Tagle, the Pro-Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, announced the news in conjunction with the 40th anniversary of the Diocese of Chalan Kanoa.

text: Ini bangud si Tagle ang highest ranking Filipino sa Catholic Church nga subong pro-prefect sang Dicastery for Evangelization sa Vatican.
english: This is because Tagle is the highest ranking Filipino in the Catholic Church who is currently pro-prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization in the Vatican.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Convocar, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka dako nga kadungganan ang pagsalig nga ginhatag sa iya sang Santo Papa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Convocar said it is a great honor to have the trust given to him by the Pope.

text: Suno kay Convocar, kaupod sang bag-o sini nga posisyon ang dako man nga responsibilidad.
english: According to Convocar, with his new position comes great responsibility.

text: Ang amay ni Bishop-elect Convocar ang tumadok sang Janiuay, Iloilo samtang ang iloy naman sini ang taga Zarraga, Iloilo.
english: Bishop-elect Convocar's father is a native of Janiuay, Iloilo while his mother is from Zarraga, Iloilo.

text: Nag-eskwela siya sa high school kag nagtuon sang philosophy sa Saint Joseph Seminary sa Dumaguete City kag gintapos ang iya theological studies sa Saint Joseph Regional Seminary sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: He attended high school and studied philosophy at Saint Joseph Seminary in Dumaguete City and completed his theological studies at Saint Joseph Regional Seminary in Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Na-ordenahan siya bilang pari sang Septyembre 17, 1996.
english: He was ordained a priest on September 17, 1996.

text: Nakaserbe siya sa Military Ordinariate of the Philippines nga amo ang nagahatag sang serbisyo sa men and women in uniform.
english: He served in the Military Ordinariate of the Philippines which provides services to men and women in uniform.

text: Nangin military chaplain siya sang Philippine Navy nga may rank nga captain.
english: He became a military chaplain of the Philippine Navy with the rank of captain.

text: Nakaserbe man siya sa AFP Central Command nga amo ang Cavite Naval Base nga military base sa Fort Bonifacio.
english: He also served in the AFP Central Command, the Cavite Naval Base, a military base in Fort Bonifacio.

text: Sang ulihi, ginsaylo siya sa Archdiocese of Agaña sa Guam kun sa diin lain-lain ang iya nangin posisyon tubtub sang 2012.
english: Later, he was transferred to the Archdiocese of Agaña in Guam where he held various positions until 2012.

text: Inirekomenda ng National Bureau of Investigation ang pagsasampa ng kaso laban sa 21 katao na umano’y sangkot sa flood control scandal at maanomalyang government infrastructure projects, ayon sa Department of Justice nitong Biyernes.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation recommended the filing of cases against 21 people allegedly involved in the flood control scandal and anomalous government infrastructure projects, the Department of Justice said on Friday.

text: Kabilang sa mga pangalan sina Senators Francis Escudero, Joel Villanueva at Jinggoy Estrada; Ako Bicol Rep.
english: The names include Senators Francis Escudero, Joel Villanueva and Jinggoy Estrada; I'm Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co; dating Sen.
english: Zaldy Co; former Sen.

text: Bong Revilla; at dating Caloocan Rep.
english: Bong Revilla; and former Caloocan Rep.

text: Mitch Cajayon-Uy.
english: Mitch Cajayon-Uy.

text: Kasama rin ang ilang matataas na opisyal at kawani ng Department of Public Works and Highways Bulacan District Engineering Office, pati na rin mga contractor na umano’y nakinabang sa substandard at ghost projects na nagkakahalaga ng bilyon-bilyong piso.
english: Also present were some senior officials and employees of the Department of Public Works and Highways Bulacan District Engineering Office, as well as contractors who allegedly benefited from substandard and ghost projects worth billions of pesos.

text: Batay sa ulat, ang mga reklamong isasampa ay paglabag sa Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, indirect bribery, at malversation of public funds.
english: According to the report, the complaints will be filed for violation of the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, indirect bribery, and malversation of public funds.

text: Lahat ng kasong ito ay may piyansa, maliban kung lagpas sa P8.8 milyon ang malversation na kinasasangkutan.
english: All of these cases are bailable, unless the malversation involved exceeds P8.8 million.

text: Binanggit ng DOJ na ang rekomendasyon ng NBI ay nakabatay sa mga testimonya sa ilalim ng panunumpa ng ilang dating opisyal ng DPWH.
english: The DOJ mentioned that the NBI's recommendation was based on the testimonies under oath of some former DPWH officials.

text: Nilinaw rin ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla na nasa case buildup pa lamang ang proseso bago dumaan sa preliminary investigation at posibleng maisampa sa korte.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla also clarified that the process is still in the case buildup before going through a preliminary investigation and possibly being filed in court.

text: Samantala, anim sa mga nasa listahan ay dati nang may kaso sa Office of the Ombudsman, habang ang iba ay nasangkot din sa mga alegasyon ng money laundering at paggamit ng pondo sa casino.
english: Meanwhile, six of those on the list have previous cases with the Office of the Ombudsman, while others are also involved in allegations of money laundering and use of casino funds.

text: Giit ng DOJ, wala umanong “above the law,” at kapag kinakailangan, maglalabas sila ng freeze order, lookout bulletin, o karagdagang kaso laban sa mga sangkot sa flood control scandal.
english: The DOJ insists that nothing is “above the law,” and if necessary, they will issue freeze orders, lookout bulletins, or additional cases against those involved in the flood control scandal.

text: Labi pa nga nagataas ang kahangawa kaangot sa preparasyon ni four-time Grand Slam champion Naomi Osaka para sa nagahilapit nga US Open matapos nga napilitan ini nga mag-withdraw sa opening match sang Canadian Open bangud sa gin-suprer nga lower back pain.
english: Concerns are rising over four-time Grand Slam champion Naomi Osaka's preparations for the upcoming US Open after she was forced to withdraw from the opening match of the Canadian Open due to lower back pain.

text: Naghilibion ang nasambit nga Japanese star samtang nagapanugiron nga nabatyagan niya ang sakit sa iya likod sa umpisa pa lang sang hampang.
english: The Japanese star cried as he said he felt pain in his back at the beginning of the game.

text: Ang Estonian tennis player nga si Kaia Kanepi ang magapadayon sa tennis match bangud sa pag-withdraw ni Osaka.
english: Estonian tennis player Kaia Kanepi will continue in the tennis match due to Osaka’s withdrawal.

text: Antes sini, nakaatras man si Osaka sa semifinals sang Melbourne Summer Set 1 tournament sang Enero bangud sa abdominal injury.
english: Earlier, Osaka also withdrew from the semifinals of the Melbourne Summer Set 1 tournament in January due to an abdominal injury.

text: Sa Italian Open kag Wimbledon, wala man siya nakahampang bangud sa Achilles injury.
english: At the Italian Open and Wimbledon, he also missed an Achilles injury.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana sa Mubadala Silicon Valley Classic, ginlutos siya ni world No.
english: Last week at the Mubadala Silicon Valley Classic, he was defeated by world No.

text: 11 Coco Gauff sa quarterfinals.
english: 11 Coco Gauff in the quarterfinals.

text: Ginsuyaan sang mga netizens ang nangin greeting sang aktor nga si Gerald Anderson sa birthday sang iya nobya nga si Julia Barretto.
english: Netizens have criticized actor Gerald Anderson's greeting on his girlfriend Julia Barretto's birthday.

text: “Happy Birthday” nga may heart emoji kag “#youareablessing” ang nangin caption sang picture ni Julia nga ginpost ni Gerald sa Instagram.
english: “Happy Birthday” with a heart emoji and “#youareablessing” was the caption of a picture of Julia that Gerald posted on Instagram.

text: Gilayon nga nakaangkon sang linibo nga mga comments ang post ni Gerald apang mas madamo pa ang pagpanghikay kun ipaanggid sa mga pagdayaw.
english: Gerald's post immediately received thousands of comments but there were more arrangements than praises.

text: Wala napunggan sang pila ka mga netizens kag ginpaanggid ang nangin mensahe ni Julia para kay Gerald sang kaadlawan sini sang Marso 7 kag subong nga base sa mga netizens, nangin makinot si Gerald sa mga tinaga nga iya ginbuy-an para sa nobya.
english: Some netizens couldn't help but compare Julia's message to Gerald on his birthday on March 7 and now based on netizens, Gerald became stingy with the words he released for his girlfriend.

text: Gani bangud sini, gintawag nga “stiff” kag “dry” sang mga netizens ang greeting ni Gerald para kay Julia.
english: Because of this, netizens called Gerald's greeting for Julia “stiff” and “dry”.

text: Balik sa pagka-Provincial Director si Police Colonel Bayani Razalan sa Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO).
english: Police Colonel Bayani Razalan has been reinstated as Provincial Director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO).

text: Suno sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, ang order epektibo subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 14, 2025.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, the order is effective today, July 14, 2025.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Razalan ang gin-relieve sa pwesto inadlaw antes ang eleksyon sang Mayo kag gin -assign sa Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 bilang Chief sang Regional Investigation and Detective Management Division.
english: Razalan was relieved of his post a day before the May elections and was assigned to the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 as Chief of the Regional Investigation and Detective Management Division.

text: Lain-lain ang reaksyon sang mga tawo kaangot sa diskusyon sa Artificial Intelligence ukon AI.
english: People have different reactions to the discussion of Artificial Intelligence or AI.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga indi lamang sa commercial ukon business industry ukon sa patag sang edukasyon ginagamit ang AI kundi mangin sa simbahan?
english: But did you know that AI is not only used in the commercial or business industry or in the field of education but also in the church?

text: Agaw-atensyon gid ang ginhimo sang gamay apang dumaan kag maragtason nga simbahan nga amo ang St.
english: The small but ancient and historic church of St.

text: Peter s Church sa Lucerne, Switzerland matapos nag-install ini sang AI-Powered Jesus Christ nga makahambal sang tubtub sa 100 ka lengguwahe.
english: Peter s Church in Lucerne, Switzerland after it installed an AI-Powered Jesus Christ that can speak up to 100 languages.

text: Gintawag ini nga “Deus in Machina” nga in-install sa confessional booth sa sulod sang simbahan sang nagligad pa nga Agusto 2024.
english: It is called “Deus in Machina” which was installed in the confessional booth inside the church last August 2024.

text:
Kun magkadto ang mga tawo sa confessional booth, makit-an sa sulod sini ang screen kun sa diin makit-an ang avatar ni Jesus Christ nga mala-“hologram.”

Naka-program ang theological texts kun sa diin magahalin ang iya mga sabat.
english:
When people go to the confessional booth, they see a screen inside where they can see the avatar of Jesus Christ as a hologram.

The theological texts where his answers will come from are programmed.

text: Sunod nga gin-imbitaran sang simbahan ang visitors nga mag-atubang sa hologram ni Jesus nga nagasabat man sang real-time.
english: The church next invited visitors to face a hologram of Jesus that also responded in real-time.

text: Paathag ni Marco Schmid, isa ka theologian sa St.
english: Marco Schmid, a theologian at St.

text: Peters Church, gin-abisuhan man nila ang visitors nga AI-generated ang ila istoryahan kag indi dapat sila mag-pangumpisal ukon mag-disclose sang mga personal nga impormasyon.
english: Peters Church, they also advised visitors that their conversations are AI-generated and they should not confess or disclose personal information.

text: Ginklaro man nga isa lang ini ka experiment bangud gusto mahibaluan sang simbahan kun ano ang reaksyon sang tawo nga naga-istorya sa AI ni Jesus Christ kag kun ano ang gusto nila ipamangkot.
english: It was also clarified that this is just an experiment because the church wants to know how the person who talks to the AI ​​of Jesus Christ reacts and what they want to ask.

text: Sa duha ka bulan nga naga-operate ang Jesus avatar, nagdangat na sa masobra 1,000 ang mga bisita sa simbahan kag nag-atubang sa AI-powered Jesus Christ.
english: In the two months that the Jesus avatar has been operating, more than 1,000 visitors have come to the church and faced the AI-powered Jesus Christ.

text: May mga Muslim pa gani nga nagkadto kag mga tawo halin diri sa Asya.
english: There were even Muslims who came and people from here in Asia.

text: May mga bisita nga nagpakigbahin nga isa ka spiritual experience ang pakipag-istorya sa AI-powered Jesus Christ samtang may iban naman nga wala nanamian kag may reporters naman nga nagmuno nga sulit-sulit ang sabat sang AI kag cliche.
english: Some guests shared that it was a spiritual experience to talk to the AI-powered Jesus Christ while others did not like it and some reporters said that the AI's answers were repetitive and cliche.

text: May iban naman nga negatibo gid ang reaksyon sa ginhimo sang local church sa avatar Jesus kag may Catholic colleagues nga nagaprotesta sa paggamit sang confessional para sa sini nga “experiment”.
english: Others have a very negative reaction to what the local church did to the avatar Jesus and some Catholic colleagues are protesting against the use of the confessional for this “experiment”.

text: Natalana nga igapresentar subong nga semana ang data sa installation sa sini nga avatar agud mahibaluan dugang ang ila nga mga reaksyon.
english: Installation data on this avatar is scheduled to be presented this week to learn more about their reactions.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad sa natabo nga pagluthang-patay sa manug-bantay sang pantatan sa Sitio Bulod 2 Barangay Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Authorities are still investigating the shooting death of a pier guard in Sitio Bulod 2, Barangay Pulao, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jomarie Torres, 32, residente sang Barangay Cabilauan, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Jomarie Torres, 32, resident of Barangay Cabilauan, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant Jhon Mark Tuazon, imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ka bulan na nga nagatinir ang biktima sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: Police Master Sergeant Jhon Mark Tuazon, investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said the victim had been staying in the area for three months.

text: Suno kay Tuazon, nag inom-inom pa ang biktima sa balay sang tag-iya sang pantatan nga ginabulubanta 300 metros ang kalayuon sa payag inoras antes nagluntad ang insidente.
english: According to Tuazon, the victim was drinking at the house of the owner of the pantatan, which is about 300 meters away from the hut, hours before the incident.

text: Suno sa mga residente, may nabatian sila nga lupok sang ‘las 11 sang gab-i sang Pebrero 9, apang hapon na sang Pebrero 10 nakit-an ang lawas sini sang nagbisita ang utod sang tag-iya sang pantatan.
english: According to residents, they heard gunshots at 11 pm on February 9, but his body was found in the afternoon of February 10 when the brother of the owner of the pier visited.

text: Ginabulubanta walo ka gunshot wounds ang naagum sang biktima nga possible igo sang 12 gauge shot gun.
english: The victim sustained eight gunshot wounds, possibly from a 12 gauge shot gun.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa nga ginapangita ang suspek sa krimen.
english: The suspect is still being sought.

text: Nangin record-high ang utang sang Philippine government sa katapusan nga bahin sang Pebrero bangud sa mga hulam nga kuwarta sa guwa sang pungsod kag diri mismo sa sulod sang Pilipinas.
english: The Philippine government's debt hit a record-high in late February due to borrowings abroad and within the Philippines.

text: Ginapahayag nga gingasto sa Covid-19 recovery measures ang utang kag gintumod man nga rason ang manubo nga value sang peso.
english: The debt was reportedly spent on Covid-19 recovery measures and the low value of the peso was also cited as a reason.

text: Sandig sa data sang Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), ginpahayag nga sa end-February, yara sa P12.09 trillion ang utang sang national government.
english: According to data from the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), it was reported that at end-February, the national government's debt was P12.09 trillion.

text: Ini ang 0.5% ukon P63.828 billion nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa P12.029 trillion nga utang nga na-rekord sang end-January.
english: This is 0.5% or P63.828 billion higher compared to the P12.029 trillion debt recorded at end-January.

text: Nasapwan ang 16 ka mga bangkay kasunod sang flash floods sa Indonesia partikular sa nabukid nga bahin sang Sumatra Island.
english: Sixteen bodies have been found following flash floods in Indonesia particularly in the mountainous part of Sumatra Island.

text: Suno sa Indonesian officials, may anum pa subong ka mga tawo nga nagapabilin nga missing.
english: According to Indonesian officials, there are still six people who remain missing.

text: Nag-awas ang tubig sa mga suba sang weekend bangud sang sige-sige nga pag-ulan kag nagkalatumba man ang mga kahoy sa mga distrito nga sakop sang North Sumatra province.
english: Rivers overflowed over the weekend due to heavy rains and trees fell in districts of North Sumatra province.

text: May nagkalaguba man nga mga balay kag daku ang nangin halit sa kaumhan.
english: Houses were also destroyed and the countryside was badly damaged.

text: Nag-augment naman ang mga pulis, mga soldado, kag rescue workers agud nga makapangkutkot sa mga lugar kun sa diin natiphag ang duta agud makit-an pananglitan may mga lawas pa sang mga tawo nga nagkalalubong.#
english: Police, soldiers, and rescue workers have been augmented to dig in the areas where the ground collapsed to find if there are still bodies of people buried.

text: Nakaguwa na si Bagyo Opong sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) base sa latest update sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA).
english: Typhoon Opong has now left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) based on the latest update of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA).

text: Sa 11:00 a.m. bulletin sang weather bureau, ginpahayag nga nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa 645 km nakatundan sang Sangley Pt, Cavite City, Cavite.
english: In the 11:00 a.m. bulletin of the weather bureau, the center of the typhoon was located 645 km west of Sangley Pt, Cavite City, Cavite.

text:
Dala sang bagyo ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 120 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 150 km/h. Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 35 km/h.

Wala na sang anuman nga lugar nga napaidalom sa Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal.
english:
The typhoon brought winds of 120 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 150 km/h. It is moving west northwest at 35 km/h.

No areas are under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal.

text: Sa pihak sini suno sa ahensya, ang Southwest Monsoon ukon Habagat nga ginapabaskog ni Opong ang magadala sang “strong to gale-force gusts” ilabi na sa coastal kag upland areas sa Luzon, Western Visayas, kag Negros Occidental.
english: Meanwhile, the agency said the Southwest Monsoon or Habagat, which is being strengthened by Opong, will bring “strong to gale-force gusts” especially in the coastal and upland areas in Luzon, Western Visayas, and Negros Occidental.

text: Base sa track and intensity forecast, magahulag ang bagyo pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan pakadto sa northern Vietnam.
english: Based on the track and intensity forecast, the typhoon will move west northwest towards northern Vietnam.

text: “Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property.
english: “Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property.

text: Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials,” kabahin sang pahanumdom sang PAGASA.
english: Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials,” PAGASA said in a reminder.

text: Antes nagbiya ang Opong, lakip sa ginlaslasan sini amo ang Western Visayas.
english: Before leaving, Opong included Western Visayas.

text: Ginbaha ang Iloilo City kag ang 31 ka mga munisipalidad sa probinsya sang Iloilo bangud sang mamunog nga ulan nga dala sini.#
english: Iloilo City and 31 municipalities in Iloilo province were flooded due to heavy rains.

text: Nagdeklara si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sang hugot nga pagpakig-away batok sa street crimes lakip na sa basag-kotse syndicates.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas has declared a strong fight against street crimes including carjacking syndicates.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga naghatag na siya sang mandu sa kapulisan sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) lakip na sa Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) agud nga pasangkaron ang pagpatrolya sa pila ka dalan sang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said he has already given orders to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) and the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) to increase patrols on some roads in the city.

text: Naghatag man ang instruction ang natungdan sa Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (CDRRMO) nga dugangan ang mga closed circuit television (CCTV) agud nga mas mabuhinan ang basag-kotse nga insidente.
english: He also instructed the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (CDRRMO) to increase the number of closed circuit televisions (CCTVs) to further reduce the number of car accidents.

text: Suno kay Treñas, nakigsapol man ang city government sa Bankers Association of the Philippines nahanungod sa pagtrabaho sang fiber optic lines agud nga makahimo sang system nga mas mahapos makakonekta ang tanan nga mga CCTV lakip na sa mga bangko kag atm machines.
english: Treñas said the city government also met with the Bankers Association of the Philippines regarding the working of fiber optic lines to create a system that will make it easier to connect all CCTVs including banks and ATM machines.

text: Plano man nga dugangan ang mga CCTV sa Esplanade bangud may mga porsyon nga medyo madulom kag wala sang mga tawo.
english: It is also planned to increase the number of CCTVs on the Esplanade as some portions are relatively dark and deserted.

text:
(ESPLANADE 333)

Nagtanyag man sang reward ang alkalde sa mga makadakop sang mga myembro sang basag-kotse.
english:
(ESPLANADE 333)

The mayor also offered a reward to those who can catch the members of the gang.

text: Naga-preparar sa gihapon sang emergency plan ang gobyerno sang Germany kun hinali nga maglain ang pinsar ni Russian President Vladimir Putin kag manukot ini liwat sang rubles bilang bayad sang ila gina-deliver nga gas supply.
english: The German government is still preparing an emergency plan in case Russian President Vladimir Putin suddenly changes his mind and demands rubles again as payment for their delivered gas supply.

text: Ini apisar ginkumpirma naman ni German Chancellor Olaf Scholz nga nagpasalig na si Putin nga batunon na sang Russia ang bayad nga euros ukon dollars.
english: This is despite German Chancellor Olaf Scholz confirming that Putin has already assured that Russia will accept payments in euros or dollars.

text: Kun balik-balikan, sang nagligad nga semana, nagpaandam si Putin nga rubles lang ang iya nga batunon nga bayad halin sa European Union nations, kag kun indi sila maka-comply, utdon sang Russia ang gas supply.
english: Last week, Putin warned that he would only accept rubles as payment from European Union nations, and that if they failed to comply, Russia would cut off gas supplies.

text: Ini nga demand ang gin-reject sang Germany kag sang G7 group sang nagapanguna nga developed economies.
english: This demand was rejected by Germany and the G7 group of leading developed economies.

text: Apang sa latest development suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Aimee Hilger direkta sa Germany, nagpasugot na liwat si Putin nga magbayad ang Germany sa Gazprom Bank, bangko nga wala ginpatawan sang sanctions, kag ini ang iga-transfer sa Russia sa rubles nga currency.
english: But in the latest development, according to Bombo International Correspondent Aimee Hilger directly in Germany, Putin has again agreed that Germany will pay Gazprom Bank, a bank that has not been sanctioned, and it will be transferred to Russia in rubles.

text: Sa subong, wala nagakumpyansa ang Germany kag naka-isyu naman sang early warning sa mga tawo batok sa posible kakulangan sa gas kun may pagbag-o nga matabo sa desisyon ni Putin.
english: For now, Germany is not confident and has issued an early warning to people against possible gas shortages if there is a change in Putin's decision.

text: Sa abiso sang gobyerno, bastante subong ang gas sa amo nga pungsod apang ginhingyo sa mga pumuluyo nga magkinot sa paggamit sang sini sa ila nga mga puluy-an.
english: According to the government, there is now enough gas in the country but urged residents to use it sparingly in their homes.

text: Sa alert levels sa Germany, ang early warning amo ang pinakauna; kag kun maglala ang sitwasyon, ginadeklarar ang alarm, kag sunod amo ang emergency.
english: Of the alert levels in Germany, early warning comes first; and if the situation worsens, an alarm is declared, followed by an emergency.

text: Muli na namang nanguna ang Pilipinas sa World Risk Index bilang bansang pinaka-exposed sa matitinding epekto ng extreme weather, partikular na pagbaha, ayon sa inilabas na ulat ngayong taon.
english: The Philippines once again topped the World Risk Index as the country most exposed to the severe impacts of extreme weather, particularly flooding, according to a report released this year.

text: Batay sa World Risk Report 2025 na inilathala nitong Biyernes, kabilang ang Pilipinas sa mga bansang may pinakamataas na antas ng panganib mula sa sakuna.
english: According to the World Risk Report 2025 released on Friday, the Philippines is among the countries with the highest level of risk from disasters.

text: Tinalakay ng ulat ang disaster risk sa 193 bansa sa buong mundo, na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng miyembro ng United Nations at mahigit 99 porsyento ng pandaigdigang populasyon.
english: The report addresses disaster risk in 193 countries around the world, covering all United Nations member states and more than 99 percent of the world's population.

text: Kasabay ng naturang ranggo, lumitaw din ang mga usapin hinggil sa mga iregularidad sa ilang proyekto ng imprastruktura na layong pigilan o kahit papaano ay mabawasan ang epekto ng pagbaha tuwing may malalakas na bagyo.
english: Along with the ranking, there were also talks about irregularities in some infrastructure projects that would prevent or somehow reduce the impact of flooding every time there is a strong typhoon.

text: Ayon sa ulat, nananatiling nakapokus ang tinatawag na risk hot spots sa Asya at Amerika, gayundin sa Africa na patuloy umanong nagpapakita ng pinakamataas na antas ng vulnerability sa buong mundo.
english: According to the report, the so-called risk hot spots remain focused on Asia and the Americas, as well as Africa which continues to show the highest level of vulnerability in the world.

text: Sa pahayag ng World Risk Report, inilahad na ang Pilipinas ay muling nasa tuktok ng World Risk Index ngayong taon bilang isang bansang may mataas na geographic fragmentation at lubos na pagkakalantad sa mga matitinding epekto ng panahon.
english: In a statement, the World Risk Report revealed that the Philippines is again at the top of the World Risk Index this year as a country with high geographical fragmentation and full exposure to extreme weather impacts.

text: Samtang may mga pila ka transport groups nga nagahingyo sang inadlaw nga sweldo, nagapadayon naman ang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) sa pagpatuman sang weekly nga sweldohanay bangud ini, suno sa ila, ang mas epektibo para sa mga driver kag konduktor.
english: While there are some transport groups demanding daily pay, the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) continues to implement weekly pay because it, according to them, is more effective for drivers and conductors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, presidente sang Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) kag chairperson sang WVTC, ginpahayag sini nga kada Sabado ginabaton sang mga empleyado ang ila sweldo, kag wala man sang reklamo gikan sa ila.
english: Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, president of the Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) and chairperson of the WVTC, said the employees receive their salaries every Saturday, and there are no complaints from them.

text: Suno sa iya, indi sila mag-adopt sang inadlaw nga sweldo bangud sa risgo nga may pila ka driver nga nagabisyo, kag posible nga indi na makaabot sa panimalay ang ila kita.
english: He said they will not adopt a daily wage because of the risk that some drivers are addicted, and it is possible that their income will not reach the household.

text: Gindugang ni Parcon nga ang ila polisiya, para gid sa pamilya, indi lang para sa driver mismo.
english: Parcon added that their policy is for the family, not just for the driver himself.

text: Suno pa sa iya, may yara sila sang incentives nga ginahatag, kag ang daily rate nagalab-ot sa ₱733 para sa driver kag ₱533 para sa konduktor, wala pa nadala ang ila overtime pay.
english: He said they have incentives given, and the daily rate is ₱733 for the driver and ₱533 for the conductor, not including their overtime pay.

text: Ginpaathag man ni Parcon nga padayon ang implementasyon sang Anti-Sardinas Policy, nga nagatuyo nga malikawan ang pagginutokanay sang pasahero sa sulod sang mga unit agud mapasiguro ang comfort kag kaluwasan sang tanan.
english: Parcon also explained that the implementation of the Anti-Sardinas Policy is ongoing, which aims to avoid overcrowding of passengers inside the units to ensure the comfort and safety of all.

english: That's because the Prosecution is under the power of the president, whose current president is PBBM who agrees with him.

english: Well, let’s take a look at the curve!

text:
***

Ang pagpasanyog sang kakahuyan (forest), sunu sa experyensya sang gamay nga pungsod nga Bhutan, daku nga yabe agud maaway sing husto ang sobra nga “emission” sang carbon sa forma sang carbon dioxide kon masunog ang fossil fuel (oil,natural gas, kag coal) nga padayon pa gihapon ginagamit sa subong sang mga industriya sa kalibutan.
english:
***

Forest development, according to the experience of the small country of Bhutan, is a major key to effectively combat the excessive emission of carbon in the form of carbon dioxide when fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, and coal) are still used today by the world's industries.

text: Indi gid man tani problema ini kon maayo lang ang pagtatap naton kag wala gina-abusaran ang aton kakahuyan tungod ginasalo sini ang carbon emission.
english: This would not be a problem if we took good care of our forests and did not abuse them because they absorb carbon emissions.

text: Ang sobra ugaling nga pagluntad sini sa kahanginan, nga tuga sang wala kontrol nga paggamit sang fossil fuel, nagatuga man sang dugang nga init (global warming) nga nagatuga sang makahalalit nga Climate Change (shift) upod sa iban pa nga greenhouse gas (GHG).
english: However, its excessive presence in the atmosphere, caused by the uncontrolled use of fossil fuels, also causes more heat (global warming) that causes devastating Climate Change (shift) along with other greenhouse gases (GHG).

text: Ang carbon dioxide, sunu sa world data, nagalakip sang three-fourths (3/4) sang total GHG emission sa kalibutan, nga ginatutokan gid sang Paris Agreement of 2015 agud mapanubo tubtub 40% sa pag-abot sang 2030.
english: Carbon dioxide, according to world data, accounts for three-fourths (3/4) of the world's total GHG emissions, which the Paris Agreement of 2015 is focusing on reducing to 40% by 2030.

text: Ang experyensya sang kalibutan nagapakita nga ang Climate Change nagatuga sang pagtaas sang dagat sa mga baybayon kag pagsakop na sang pila ka coastal areas.
english: The experience of the world shows that Climate Change is causing sea level rise on the coasts and already occupying some coastal areas.

text: Nagatuga man ini sang mas malala nga bagyo, pagbaha, pagkaguba sang bukid tungod sa sobra nga pag-ulan, mas madugay nga tagmala (drought), pag-ibwal sang mga bulkan, kag pagpabatyag sang mga linog.
english: It also causes more severe storms, flooding, mountain erosion due to excessive rainfall, longer droughts, volcanic eruptions, and earthquakes.

text: Lakip dira ang tsunami ukon storm surge nga na-experyensahan naton sa Filipinas sang magtupa ang Bagyo Yolanda nga nagpatay sing sobra 6,000 ka tawo sa probinsya sang Leyte.
english: This includes the tsunami or storm surge that we experienced in the Philippines when Typhoon Yolanda hit and killed more than 6,000 people in Leyte province.

text: Ang world data nagapakita nga ang may pinakataas nga per capita GHG emission nga mga pungsod amo gid ang mga naga-producir sang fossil fuel, katulad sang Guyana, Brunei, Botswana, United Arab Emirate kag Kuwait, nga ginapalapta naman nila sa mga pungsod nga naga-import sang fossil fuel.
english: World data shows that the countries with the highest per capita GHG emissions are actually those that produce fossil fuels, such as Guyana, Brunei, Botswana, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait, which they then spread to countries that import fossil fuels.

text:
***

Ang Kingdom of Bhutan isa ka gamay nga pungsod sa Himalayas, nga may populasyon nga wala pa sing isa ka milyon.
english:
***

The Kingdom of Bhutan is a small country in the Himalayas, with a population of less than a million.

text: Apang may daku ini nga leksyon nga matudlo sa iban nga mga pungsod parti sa ila man problema sa GHG sa ila sige pa paggamit sang fossil fuel.
english: But it has a big lesson to teach other countries about their own GHG problems with their continued use of fossil fuels.

text: Nangin carbon negative na ini pila lang ka tuig nga nagpasakop sa Paris Agreement of 2015 sa away sini batok sa Climate Change.
english: It has become carbon negative just a few years after joining the Paris Agreement of 2015 in its fight against Climate Change.

text: Ang isa ka pungsod mangin carbon negative kon ang gina-“absorb” nga carbon emission sobra sangsa gina-“emit” sini.
english: A country becomes carbon negative when it “absorbs” carbon emission more than it “emits”.

text: Sadtong 2020, ang Bhutan may 75% na ka forest cover nga naka-“absorb” na sang carbon emission sang sobra 9 ka milyon ka tonelada samtang naga-“emit” lang sang mga 2 ka tonelada sini.
english: By 2020, Bhutan had 75% forest cover that had absorbed carbon emissions of more than 9 million tonnes while emitting only about 2 tonnes.

text: In fact, ini ang pinakauna nga pungsod nga nangin carbon negative.
english: In fact, it is the first country to become carbon negative.

text: Gina-maintain ining status sang Bhutan paagi sa pag-ban sang log export, padayon nga pagtanom sang kakahuyan, pagpasanyog sang hydroelectric power halin sa iya mga suba, kag ang pag-import sang mga electric cars sa lugar nga maggamit sang fossil fuel bilang gatong sang fossil fuel-fed nga mga salakyan.
english: Bhutan maintains this status through a log export ban, continued afforestation, the promotion of hydroelectric power from its rivers, and the import of electric cars in the area to use fossil fuel as fuel for fossil fuel-fed vehicles.

text: May mga proyekto man ini sa renewable energy halin sa wind, solar kag biogas.
english: It also has renewable energy projects from wind, solar and biogas.

text: Polisa man sini ang paghatag sing importansya sa economic growth nga indi ma-sakripisyo ang duna (“pristine”) nga kahimtangan sang environment.
english: It is also a policy to emphasize economic growth without sacrificing the pristine condition of the environment.

text: Strategy sini ang pagpasanyog sang economic growth paagi sa sustainable socio-economic development kag environmental conservation.
english: Its strategy is to promote economic growth through sustainable socio-economic development and environmental conservation.

text: Sa karon gani, naga-export na ang Bhutan sang hydroelectric power sa mga kaiping nga mga pungsod./PN
english: Bhutan is now exporting hydroelectric power to neighboring countries.

text: Naghatag ang Iloilo City Government sang “Libre Sakay” kadungan sang transport holiday sang transport cooperatives sa syudad subong nga adlaw, Marso 23.
english: The Iloilo City Government has provided “Libre Sakay” in conjunction with the transport holiday of transport cooperatives in the city today, March 23.

text: Suno kay Mayor Raisa Treñas, gamiton ang government vehicles kag ang service vehicles halin sa tatlo ka major jump-off points agud nga mabuligan ang commuters sa syudad.
english: According to Mayor Raisa Treñas, government vehicles and service vehicles from the three major jump-off points will be used to assist commuters in the city.

text: Ini amo ang Arevalo Plaza, Mandurriao Plaza, kag Jaro Plaza, kag pakadto kag pabalik sa Plaza Libertad.
english: These are Arevalo Plaza, Mandurriao Plaza, and Jaro Plaza, and to and from Plaza Libertad.

text: Ang mga salakyan sang gobyerno magahulat sa designated areas alas-6:00 sang aga, kag magabiyahe ini kun mapuno na padulong sa ila tagsa ka ruta, kag mabalik dayon sa ila starting points agud mas madamo pa gid nga pasahero ang maserbisyuhan.
english: Government vehicles will wait in designated areas at 6:00 am, and will depart when full to their respective routes, and then return to their starting points to serve more passengers.

text: Suno sa alkalde, padayon ini nga operasyon tubtob alas-10:00 sang aga.
english: The mayor said the operation will continue until 10:00 am.

text:
Sa hapon, magaresume ang byahe halin naman sa Plaza Libertad, pakadto sa ila tagsa ka ruta, magasugod alas-4:00 sang hapon tubtob alas-8:00 sang gab-i.

Gina-engganyo man sang alkalde ang mga may pribado nga salakyan nga mag-carpooling agud makahatag sang bulig sa iban nga naga-commute.
english:
In the afternoon, the flight will resume from Plaza Libertad, to their respective routes, starting at 4:00 pm until 8:00 pm.

The mayor also encouraged those with private vehicles to carpool to help others who commute.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang alkalde sa tanan nga magkooperar kag magplano sang ila byahe samtang ginahimo sang City Government ang tanan nga tikang agud maserbisyuhan ang kadam-an.
english: The mayor also appealed to everyone to cooperate and plan their trips while the City Government is taking all steps to serve the public.
