text: Lorenz “Noy” Defensor sang 3rd District sang Iloilo ang iya suporta nga padayunon ang impeachment kay VP Sara Duterte bilang pagtuman sa mandato sang Konstitusyon.
english: Lorenz “Noy” Defensor of the 3rd District of Iloilo expressed his support to continue the impeachment of VP Sara Duterte in fulfillment of the mandate of the Constitution.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpunto ni Defensor nga dapat paduyonon kag matabo ini sa 20th Congress kag ginapaabot nga padayunon ang trial bangud amo ini ang sugo sang Konstitusyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Defensor pointed out that this should be continued and will happen in the 20th Congress and is expected to continue the trial because this is the mandate of the Constitution.

text: Suno sa iya dapat nga husgahan sang husto kag batunon sang mga Pilipino, kag sundon ang proseso sang impeachment bilang proteksyon sa pungsod.
english: He said it should be judged fairly and accepted by Filipinos, and follow the impeachment process as a protection for the country.

text: Dugang pa niya nga kun malain nga tawo ang isa ka leader, dapat may trial, aquit man ukon convict, basta masunod ang layi kag konstitusyon.
english: He added that if a leader is a bad person, there should be a trial, whether acquitted or convicted, as long as the law and constitution are followed.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Defensor nga indi siya kumbinsido sa desisyon sang Senado nga i-remand ukon ibalik sa Kongreso ang kaso.
english: Defensor also said he is not convinced of the Senate's decision to remand or return the case to Congress.

text: Suno sa iya, indi pwede nga i-dismiss ukon i-remand ang impeachment bangud dapat ini nga padayunon.
english: He said the impeachment cannot be dismissed or remanded because it must be continued.

text: Iloilo City – Magapatigayon sang international health strike sa United Kingdom ang mga healthcare workers bwas, Pebrero 6.
english: ILOILO CITY – Healthcare workers will hold an international health strike in the United Kingdom tomorrow, February 6.

text: Ini matapos ang panawagan sang mga unions kaangay sang mga nurses, ambulance workers, midwives, kag physiotherapists nga pataasan ang sweldo sang mga ini.
english: This follows the call of unions such as nurses, ambulance workers, midwives, and physiotherapists to increase their salaries.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ramil Isogon, International Correspondent sa United Kingdom, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang pinakadako nga health strike bangud lakip diri ang masobra 300,000 nga mga healthcare workers.
english: According to Bombo Ramil Isogon, International Correspondent in the United Kingdom, he said this is the largest health strike because it includes more than 300,000 healthcare workers.

text: Matandaan nga nagpanawagan ang Royal College of Nursing sa gobyerno nga pataasan ang sweldo sang mga healthcare workers sa 19%.
english: The Royal College of Nursing has called on the government to increase the salary of healthcare workers to 19%.

text: Gin-ako naman sang gobyerno sang United Kingdom, indi ini makasarang nga pataason ang sweldo bangud masami ini nga ginadesisyunan sang independent pay review bodies.
english: The United Kingdom government has admitted that it cannot afford to increase salaries because they are often decided by independent pay review bodies.

text: Ginalauman nga magalawig ang protesta tubtob sa Pebrero 24.
english: The protest is expected to last until February 24.

text: Kun kaisa, sa kadamo sang ulubrahon, gusto man naton makapahuway, maka-liwa-liwa, kag makalagaw kaupod sa aton nga mga abyan.
english: Sometimes, with so much to do, we want to rest, relax, and go out with our friends.

text: Wala man dira sang problema.
english: There's no problem there.

text: Ang problema amo kun naga-himu-himo na ikaw sang indi makatarunganon nga mga rason agud nga maka-eskapo sa trabaho.
english: The problem is when you're already making up unreasonable excuses to escape work.

text: Kaangay sa natabo sa Singapore kun sa diin isa ka lalaki ang ginmultahan kag napuno pa sang pagpakamalaot matapos napamatud-an nga ginhimu-himo lang sini ang death certificate sang iya nga Lolo agud nga maka-leave with pay sa opisina.
english: Like what happened in Singapore where a man was fined and filled with condemnation after it was proven that he forged the death certificate of his grandfather in order to leave with pay from the office.

text: Natabo ini sa 29-anyos nga si Barath Gopal nga isa ka security financing operation analyst.
english: This happened to 29-year-old Barath Gopal who is a security financing operation analyst.

text: Isa ka adlaw, nahibal-an sini nga nag-cheat ang iya girlfriend sa iya gani nga indi siya maka-focus sa iya obra.
english: One day, he found out that his girlfriend had cheated on him so he couldn't focus on his work.

text: Sa baylo nga mag-apply para sa iya annual leave, mas gin-gusto sini ang paid compassionate leave sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Instead of applying for her annual leave, she preferred paid compassionate leave for three days.

text: Ginrason sini nga napatay ang iya Lolo sa India apang nangin mas kumplikado ini sang ginpangayuan siya sang death certificate.
english: He argued that his grandfather died in India but it became more complicated when he was asked for a death certificate.

text: Bangud indi na sini ma-islan ang iya rason, gingamit sini ang death certificate sang himata sang iya abyan, gin-ilog, kag naghimo sang dokumento kun sa diin nakabutang ang pangalan sang iya Lolo.
english: Unable to change his excuse, he used the death certificate of his friend's relative, copied it, and made a document with his grandfather's name on it.

text: Indi man galling mahapos intuon ang supervisor bangud nagduda ini sa dokumento.
english: It was not easy to study the supervisor because he doubted the document.

text: Nag-send man si Barath sang bilog nga document, apang bangud nakahibalo siya nga madiskubrehan ang iya pagbinutig, nag-resign na lang siya sa trahabo.
english: Barath also sent the entire document, but knowing that his lie would be discovered, he resigned from the job.

text: Unfortunately para sa iya, ginlagas gid siya sang kumpaniya, ginkasuhan, tubtub nga nag-plead ini nga guilty sa pag-forge sang death certificate nga may intensyon nga maghimo sang fraud.
english: Unfortunately for him, he was chased by the company, prosecuted, until he pleaded guilty to forging a death certificate with the intention of committing fraud.

text: Kun amo sini ang imo sala sa Singapore, tubtub sa $10,000 ang multa ukon mahimo ka mapreso sang 10 ka tuig ukon pareho gid nga sentensya ang imo makuha.
english: If you are guilty of such an offense in Singapore, you will be fined up to $10,000 or sentenced to 10 years in prison or the same sentence.

text: Maswerte na si Barath nga masobra P230,700 lang ang iya multa apang nagserbe man nga daku nga leksyon nga indi na maghimu-himo sang kaangay nga istorya.
english: Barath was lucky that he was only fined more than P230,700 but it also served as a big lesson not to make up such stories.

text: Nagakabalaka sa karun ang hubon sang mga mangunguma sa posibilidad sang paglala sang krisis sa industriya sang kalamay bangud sa hagna nga Sugar Order No.

english: The Confederation of Sugar Producers Associations (CONFED) led by , also expressed similar sentiments, warning that sugar mills have been affected and the jobs of thousands of farmers have been put on hold.

english: Under Republic Act 9367, it mandates the use of locally sourced bioethanol to reduce the country’s dependence on imported gasoline and diesel.

english: Earlier, the Philippine Biodiesel Association said the law is still the country's most reliable defense against dependence on imported petroleum.

english: P-Pop Kings SB19 will celebrate their seventh debut anniversary with a collaboration with renowned Filipino fashion designer Francis Libiran, titled Fast Zone.

text:
Suno sa 1Z Entertainment nga amo ang company sang SB19, “FAST ZONE is a high-octane fashion & music experience that amplifies a premiere collection of pop culture, emerging as a new sonic of style in motion.”

Natalana ini sa Oktubre 26 sa Araneta Coliseum.
english:
According to 1Z Entertainment which is SB19’s company, “FAST ZONE is a high-octane fashion & music experience that amplifies a premiere collection of pop culture, emerging as a new sonic of style in motion.”

It is scheduled for Oct. 26 at Araneta Coliseum.

text: Ang SB19 masako subong sa ila Simula at Wakas World Tour kag nag-perform sa Singapore kag Indonesia sang damlag lang.
english: SB19 are currently busy with their Simula at Wakas World Tour and have performed in Singapore and Indonesia recently.

text: Sang Hulyo, gin-release nila ang ila collaboration song upod sa Popstar Royalty nga si Sarah Geronimo nga amo ang “Umaaligid.”
english: In July, they released their collaboration song with Popstar Royalty Sarah Geronimo which was “Umaaligid.”

text: Imbestigaran sang Antique Provincial Police Office (APPO) ang ginaalegar pagpangkastigo sang mga kapulisan sang Sibalom Municipal Police Station sa apat ka mga manogbulang.
english: The Antique Provincial Police Office (APPO) is investigating the alleged beating of four healers by the police of the Sibalom Municipal Police Station.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginpa-Bombo sang mga manogbulang ang mga pulis.
english: This follows the police being bombed by the doctors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Lea Rose Peña, Provincial Director sang Antique Provincial Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga gilayon sila nga nagpatuman sang imbestigasyon sang nabaton ang report nahanungod sa ginaalegar pagpangkastigo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Lea Rose Peña, Provincial Director of the Antique Provincial Police Office, said they immediately conducted an investigation when they received the report about the alleged beating.

text: Suno kay Peñas, tanan nga involve sa hitabo ang lakip sa pagaimbestigaran.
english: Peñas said all those involved in the incident will be investigated.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga kon ano man ang mangin resulta sang imbestigasyon ang magaatubang sang nagakaigo nga reklamo kon mapatud-an nga may kapaltahan.
english: He also assured that whatever the outcome of the investigation, he will face appropriate complaints if proven to be wrong.

text: Ginalantaw man sang talatapan ang tanan nga posible anggulo agud matumod ang mga nagluntad nga iregularidad.
english: The office is also looking at all possible angles to identify the irregularities.

text: Indi man pag-itolerar sang Antique PPO ang mga kapulisan nga naga-akto nga wala nagakaigo sa ila nga responsibilidad.
english: The Antique PPO will not tolerate police officers who act inappropriately in their responsibilities.

text: Nahibaluan nga ipatawag sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) ang pito ka mga pulis sang Sibalom Municipal Police Station lakip na hepe.
english: The National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) will summon seven policemen of the Sibalom Municipal Police Station including the chief.

text: Ginalauman nga sa Myerkules sang aga, Pebrero 12, 2025 magaatubang ang pito ka mga pulis sa nasambit nga talatapan.
english: The seven police officers are expected to appear before the office on Wednesday morning, February 12, 2025.

text: Ginpasundayag paagi sa Iloilo Festivals Homecoming Parade ang mga performances nga naghatag sang dungog sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo sang Hunyo.
english: The performances that brought honor to the city and province of Iloilo in June were showcased through the Iloilo Festivals Homecoming Parade.

text: Ginhimo ang parada, Hulyo 12, halin sa Provincial Capitol tubtub sa Freedom Grandstand agud nga magpakita man sang pagpasalamat sa suporta sang mga Ilonggo sa national kag international stages.
english: The parade, July 12, was held from the Provincial Capitol to the Freedom Grandstand to show gratitude for the support of Ilonggos on the national and international stages.

text: Lakip sa nag-perform amo ang Dinagyang Tribes competition champion nga Tribu Paghidaet nga amo man ang nagtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa Philippine National Day Parade sa World Expo 2025 Osaka, Japan.
english: Among the performers was Dinagyang Tribes competition champion Tribu Paghidaet who also represented the Philippines in the Philippine National Day Parade at World Expo 2025 Osaka, Japan.

text: Nagpabilib man sa mga tumalan-aw ang Tribu Pan-ay nga first runner-up sa Festivals Performance Competition sa Parada ng Kalayaan 2025, amo man ang Tultugan Festival sang Maasin nga amo ang kampyon sa amo nga kategorya.
english: Tribu Pan-ay, first runner-up in the Festivals Performance Competition at Parada ng Kalayaan 2025, also impressed the audience, as did Tultugan Festival of Maasin, which was the champion in the same category.

text: Nasaksihan man sa syudad ang katahum sang Cry of Sta.
english: The city also witnessed the beauty of the Cry of Sta.

text: Barbara Float sang Sta.
english: Barbara Float of Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo nga amo ang first runner-up sa Floats Competition sa amo man nga event sang tinalikdan nga bulan kadungan sang 127th Independence Day sang Pilipinas.
english: Barbara, Iloilo who was the first runner-up in the Floats Competition in the same event last month in conjunction with the 127th Independence Day of the Philippines.

text: Sa iya mensahe, nagpalab-ot sang pagpanginbulahan si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: In his message, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr. congratulated the government.

text: sa tanan nga nagtiglawas sang syudad kag probinsya.
english: to all those who represented the city and province.

text: Labaw diri suno sa iya, ginapasalamatan niya ang pagbuligay sang tanan nga nakilala pa ang Iloilo sa Pilipinas nga nagbilin man sang marka nga makabulig sa ekonomiya sang syudad kag probinsya.
english: Moreover, he said, he is grateful for the cooperation of all those who know Iloilo in the Philippines who have also left a mark that will help the economy of the city and province.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hulyo 10, bangud sa sini nga performances, nakabaton man ang Iloilo officials ang pagpasidungog sa Kalayaan Hall sa Malacañang.
english: It can be recalled that on July 10, due to these performances, Iloilo officials also received the honor at the Kalayaan Hall in Malacañang.

text: Lakip sa nagkadto sa seremonya nga ginpangunahan ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Among those who attended the ceremony led by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kag First Lady Liza Marcos amo sanday Gov.
english: and First Lady Liza Marcos are Gov.

text: Defensor, Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuqe, Maasin Mayor Francis Amboy, Santa Barbara Mayor Dennis Superficial kag Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas.
english: Defensor, Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuqe, Maasin Mayor Francis Amboy, Santa Barbara Mayor Dennis Superficial and Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas.

text: Labinsiyam ang naiulat na nasawi bunsod ng epekto ng tropical cyclones na sina Mirasol, Nando, Opong, at ng Southwest Monsoon o Habagat, ayon sa ulat ng National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council nitong Sabado.
english: Nineteen people were reported missing due to the effects of tropical cyclones Mirasol, Nando, Opong, and the Southwest Monsoon or Habagat, according to a report by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council on Saturday.

text: Sa naturang bilang, apat na kaso ang nakumpirma habang 15 pa ang sumasailalim sa beripikasyon, batay sa situational report ng NDRRMC.
english: Of the current number, four cases have been confirmed while 15 are still undergoing verification, based on the situational report of the NDRRMC.

text: Samantala, labingwalo ang nasugatan, kung saan labing-apat na ang nakumpirma.
english: Meanwhile, eighteen people were injured, of which fourteen have been confirmed.

text: Labing-apat din ang naiulat na nawawala at kasalukuyang bineberipika.
english: Fourteen were also reported missing and are currently being verified.

text: Umabot sa 2,026,246 na indibidwal o katumbas ng 520,165 pamilya ang naapektuhan sa 15 rehiyon, 57 probinsya, 504 lungsod at bayan, at 4,219 barangay.
english: A total of 2,026,246 individuals or the equivalent of 520,165 families were affected in 15 regions, 57 provinces, 504 cities and towns, and 4,219 barangays.

text: Nasa 351,840 katao naman ang napilitang lumikas, karamihan ay pansamantalang nanunuluyan sa 1,906 evacuation centers.
english: A total of 351,840 people were forced to evacuate, most of whom are temporarily sheltered in 1,906 evacuation centers.

text: Naitala rin ng NDRRMC ang preemptive evacuation ng 407,914 katao o 114,121 pamilya sa Regions 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, CARAGA, CAR, at Negros Island Region.
english: The NDRRMC also recorded the preemptive evacuation of 407,914 people or 114,121 families in Regions 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, CARAGA, CAR, and Negros Island Region.

text: Umabot sa 243 na kalsada at 46 na tulay ang naapektuhan ng kalamidad.
english: A total of 243 roads and 46 bridges were affected by the disaster.

text: Sa mga ito, 30 road sections sa Region 1 ang nananatiling hindi madaanan hanggang nitong Sabado.
english: Of these, 30 road sections in Region 1 remain impassable until Saturday.

text: Nakararanas din ng pagkawala ng kuryente ang 143 lungsod at bayan; 105 na rito ang naibalik ang suplay.
english: 143 cities and towns are also experiencing power outages; 105 rites have been restored.

text: Naitala ang pinsala sa 5,202 kabahayan, kabilang ang 708 na tuluyang nawasak.
english: Damage was recorded to 5,202 houses, including 708 that were completely destroyed.

text: Kabilang sa mga apektadong lugar ang Region 1, Region 2, CAR, Region 3, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 5, Region 6, Region 9, at BARMM.
english: The affected areas include Region 1, Region 2, CAR, Region 3, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 5, Region 6, Region 9, and BARMM.

text: Tinatayang nasa P914,875,615.50 ang lugi sa agrikultura, katumbas ng 78,267.08 metric tons ng produksyon.
english: The loss in agriculture is estimated at P914,875,615.50, equivalent to 78,267.08 metric tons of production.

text: Samantala, P822,163,458.08 naman ang halaga ng pinsala sa imprastruktura na naiulat sa Region 1, Region 2, CAR, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 6, at Region 7.
english: Meanwhile, P822,163,458.08 worth of infrastructure damage was reported in Region 1, Region 2, CAR, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 6, and Region 7.

text: Nagdeklara ng state of calamity ang 32 lungsod at bayan.
english: Thirty-two cities and towns have declared a state of calamity.

text: Sa kabila nito, umabot na sa 84,641 ang nabigyan ng tulong mula sa tinatayang 122,800 pamilya na nangangailangan.
english: Meanwhile, 84,641 people have been given assistance out of an estimated 122,800 families in need.

text: Nasa P57,928,043.74 ang kabuuang halaga ng naipadalang ayuda.
english: The total amount of aid sent was P57,928,043.74.

text: Nagpasalig ang gobyerno sang Poland nga wala sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga pumuluyo sa pamahog sang Russia nga pag-atake sa United States anti-missile base sa Redzikowo, Poland.
english: The Polish government has assured that citizens have nothing to worry about the threat of a Russian attack on the United States anti-missile base in Redzikowo, Poland.

text: Ang warning sang Russia ang kasunod sang paghatag otoridad ni U.S. President Joe Biden sa Ukraine nga gamiton ang long-range American missiles batok sa Russian targets.
english: Russia's warning follows U.S. President Joe Biden authorizing Ukraine to use long-range American missiles against Russian targets.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler direkta sa Poland, ginsiling ni Polish Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz nga masarangan sang Poland ang ano man nga potensiyal nga pag-atake sang Russia.
english: According to Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler directly in Poland, Polish Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said that Poland can handle any potential Russian attack.

text: Nagbukas ang amo nga military base sang Nobyembre 13, matapos orihinal nga gin- commission ni former U.S. President Barack Obama sang 2009.
english: The military base opened on November 13, after being originally commissioned by former U.S. President Barack Obama in 2009.

text: Kabahin sang American anti-missile shield, ini ang una nga permanent installation sang U.S. armed forces sa Poland.
english: Part of the American anti-missile shield, it is the first permanent installation of U.S. armed forces in Poland.

text: Indi dapat paghimuon nga big deal para sa isa ka Miss Universe Candidate ang iya social media activities.
english: One should not make a big deal for a Miss Universe Candidate with her social media activities.

text: Ini ang reaksyon sang blogger kag pageant expert nga si Norman Tinio may kaangtanan sa nagagwa nga mga pahayag nga kulang ang exposure para kay Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo apisar nagahilapit na ang Miss Universe pageant.
english: This is the reaction of blogger and pageant expert Norman Tinio regarding the emerging statements that there is a lack of exposure for Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo despite the approaching Miss Universe pageant.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Tinio, iya ginpahayag nga kun kaisa daw wala na sang lugaran ang mga beauty queens bangud sa lain-lain nga mga komento sang tawo sa social media.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Tinio said that sometimes it seems that beauty queens have no place because of the various comments of people on social media.

text: May yara sang beauty queens nga may mga pasabog sa photoshoot, kag may yara man nga lowkey lang suno kay Tinio.
english: There are beauty queens who have explosions in the photoshoot, and there are also those who are lowkey, according to Tinio.

text: Ang importante suno kay Tinio amo nga handa si Rabiya sa international pageant.
english: The important thing, according to Tinio, is that Rabiya is ready for the international pageant.

text: Suno kay Tinio, masarangan ni Rabiya ang mangibabaw indi lamang sa katahum kundi paagi man sa iya kaalam nga pwede mangin spokesperson sang organization.
english: According to Tinio, Rabiya can dominate not only in beauty but also through her intelligence that can be the spokesperson of the organization.

text: Bold and outspoken si Rabiya suno kay Tinio kag may yara sang ‘mind of her own’.
english: Tinio said Rabiya is bold and outspoken and has a mind of her own.

text: Ginakabig man nga mabaskog nga kasumpong ni Rabiya sanday Miss Universe South Africa Natasha Joubert kag Miss Universe Thailand Amanda Obdam.
english: Miss Universe South Africa Natasha Joubert and Miss Universe Thailand Amanda Obdam are also considered strong opponents for Rabiya.

text: Una na nagwa sa reports nga sa Mayo 16 patigayunon ang Miss Universe pageant sa Estados Unidos.
english: Earlier, reports said that the Miss Universe pageant will be held on May 16 in the United States.

text: Nagsaka na sa 19 ka mga tawo ang na-report nga napatay bangud sang epekto sang mga Bagyo Mirasol, Nando, kag Opong kag resulta man sang Habagat.
english: More than 19 people have been reported dead due to the impact of Typhoons Mirasol, Nando, and Opong as well as the result of Habagat.

text: Santo sa latest nga report nga National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 15 pa diri ang subject sa validation samtang apat ang kumpirmado.
english: According to the latest report of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 15 of these are still subject to validation while four are confirmed.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, 18 ang na-report nga nasamaran kun sa diin 14 ang kumpirmado.
english: Meanwhile, 18 were reported injured while 14 were confirmed.

text: Pahayag pa sang council, 14 ang nagapabilin nga missing.
english: According to the council, 14 remain missing.

text: Lab-ot naman sa masobra 2.02-million individuals ukon masobra 520,000 families ang apektado sa 15 regions, 57 provinces, 504 cities/municipalities, kag 4,219 barangays.
english: More than 2.02-million individuals or more than 520,000 families were affected in 15 regions, 57 provinces, 504 cities/municipalities, and 4,219 barangays.

text: Sa bahin sang agrikultura, nagdangat sa masobra sa P914.86-million ang naisip nga balor sang halit sa masobra 78,000 metriko tonelada nga pierde sa produksyon.
english: In the agricultural sector, the estimated value of damage amounted to more than P914.86-million with more than 78,000 metric tons of production losses.

text: Sa imprastraktura naman, nagadangat sa masobra P822-million ang damage partikular sa Region 1, Region 2, CAR, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 6, kag Region 7.#
english: In infrastructure, the damage amounted to more than P822-million particularly in Region 1, Region 2, CAR, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Region 6, and Region 7.#

text: Natalana nga hatagan sang gobyerno sang Spain sang residency kag work permits ang kapin 300,000 migrants nga iligal nga nagaistar sa amo nga pungsod kada tuig sa masunod nga tatlo ka tuig kag magaumpisa ini sa 2025.
english: The Spanish government is scheduled to issue residency and work permits to more than 300,000 migrants living illegally in the country each year for the next three years starting in 2025.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ma.
english: According to Bombo Ma.

text: Edzel Lamparero Lopez, ang polisa nagatuyo nga ma- expand ang nagaedad nga workforce sang Espanya.
english: Edzel Lamparero Lopez, the policy aims to expand Spain's aging workforce.

text: Ang Espanya ang nagapabilin nga bukas sa pagbaton sang migrants bisan pa nga ang iban nga European nations ang nagaistrikto sa ila borders batok sa illegal crossings kag asylum seekers.
english: Spain remains open to receiving migrants even as other European nations tighten their borders against illegal crossings and asylum seekers.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lopez nga ang ini nga tikang sang Spain ang indi lamang pagpakita sang pagrespeto sa human rights kundi ang paghatag sa ila sang oportunidad nga magsanyog.
english: Lopez said Spain's move is not only to show respect for human rights but also to give them the opportunity to flourish.

text: Una na ginsiling ni Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez nga ang migration policies sang gobyerno ang nagatuyo nga masolusyunan ang naganubo nga birthrate sang pungsod.
english: Earlier, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said the government's migration policies aim to address the country's declining birthrate.

text: Sang 2023, ang Spain nag- issue sang 1.3 million visas sa mga foreigners.
english: In 2023, Spain will issue 1.3 million visas to foreigners.

text: Patay ang Brazilian jiu-jitsu great kag eight-time world champion nga si Leandro Lo matapos ginluthang sa Sao Paulo, Brazil.
english: Brazilian jiu-jitsu great and eight-time world champion Leandro Lo is dead after being shot in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

text: Ginapahayag nga kaupod sang 33-anyos nga martial arts champion ang iya nga mga abyan sa isa ka sports kag social club sa Sao Paulo sang nag-abot ang isa ka ginapahayag pulis sa ila lamesa kag nagpamahog.
english: The 33-year-old martial arts champion was reportedly with his friends at a sports and social club in Sao Paulo when an alleged policeman came to their table and threatened.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagbalos pa si Lo apang ginapahayag nga nagbunot ang pulis sang iya nga pusil kag gintiro sa ulo si Lo.
english: Lo allegedly retaliated but the policeman allegedly pulled out his gun and shot Lo in the head.

text: Gindala pa ang jiu-jitsu champ sa ospital apang gin-deklarar nga brain-dead.
english: The jiu-jitsu champ was rushed to the hospital but was declared brain-dead.

text: Isa si Lo sa ginakabig most successful jiu-jitsu competitors of all time.
english: Lo is one of the most successful jiu-jitsu competitors of all time.

text: Nakadaog siya sang International Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Federation (IBJJF) world titles sa lima ka lain-lain nga weight classes halin 2012 tubtub 2022.
english: He won the International Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Federation (IBJJF) world titles in five different weight classes from 2012 to 2022.

text: Nakahampang man siya sa World Cup, Pan American championships kag Brazilian National Jiu-Jitsu Championships.
english: He has also played in the World Cup, Pan American championships and Brazilian National Jiu-Jitsu Championships.

text: Nabuhuan gid ang tiyan sang isa ka 70-anyos nga lolo matapos nga ginsungay sang karabaw sa Camotes Island, Cebu.
english: A 70-year-old grandfather sustained severe stomach ulcers after being stabbed by a buffalo in Camotes Island, Cebu.

text: Ang biktima amo si Samuel Contridas, may asawa kag residente sang Barangay Dapdap, Pilar sang amo nga banwa.
english: The victim was identified as Samuel Contridas, married and resident of Barangay Dapdap, Pilar of the same town.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagakuha sang panggatong nga kahoy ang biktima sa bukid sang gin-atake kag ginsungay sang karabaw nga nakabuya sa iya higot.
english: The victim was reportedly collecting firewood in the mountains when he was attacked and stabbed by a buffalo that broke his rope.

text: Nagdulot gid ang sungay sang karabaw sa tiyan sang tigulang.
english: The buffalo's horn pierced the old man's stomach.

text: Nasapwan nalang sang iya nga pamilya ang bangkay sang biktima pila ka oras matapos ang insidente.
english: The victim's body was found by his family a few hours after the incident.

text: Wala nagalain ang buot sang aktres nga si Rhian Ramos sa mga pagpang-atake sa iya bangud sa nangin porma sang iya lawas.
english: Actress Rhian Ramos is not offended by the attacks on her because of her body shape.

text: Ginapahayag nga may yara sang eaiting disorder ang aktres bangud sa iya nga pagniwang.
english: The actress reportedly has an eating disorder due to her weight loss.

text: Apang suno kay Rhian, indi ini matuod bangud ang iya pagniwang ang resulta sang iya tuman nga stress.
english: However, according to Rhian, this is not true as her weight loss is the result of her extreme stress.

text: Pahayag niya, kun indi interesado ukon wala man naluyagan sang iban nga tawo ang iya lawas, indi nila ini paghimuon sa ila kaugalingon.
english: She said that if other people are not interested or do not like her body, they will not do it to themselves.

text: Bangud para kay Rhian, taste kag health goals niya amo ang masunod kag indi ang opinyon sang iban nga tawo.
english: Because for Rhian, her taste and health goals come first and not other people’s opinions.

text: Gina-istriktuhan sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) ang ila mga driver kag konduktor nga indi pagpasobrahan sa 10 ka mga pasahero ang tugutan nga magtindog sa sulod sang modernized jeep.
english: The Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) is strict with its drivers and conductors that no more than 10 passengers will be allowed to stand inside the modernized jeep.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang pag-comply sa Anti-Sardinas policy sang gobyerno ukon polisa batok sa pagginutok sa mga public utility vehicles.
english: This is part of compliance with the government's Anti-Sardinas policy or policy against overcrowding in public utility vehicles.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Boyet Parcon, chairman sang amo nga kooperatiba, iya ginpahayag nga patakaran na sa ila nga mga Passenger Assistant Officer nga 10 lang gid ang tugutan nga magtindog, kag papanaugon na ang ulihi-saka nga pasahero nga sobra na sa kapasidad sang unit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Boyet Parcon, chairman of the cooperative, said it is the policy of their Passenger Assistant Officers that only 10 passengers will be allowed to stand, and the last passengers who are beyond the capacity of the unit will be dropped off.

text: Suno kay Parcon, dapat man hangpon sang mga pasahero ilabi na sa peak hours nga may salabton man ang mga konduktor pananglitan madakpan nga naga-cater sang mga commuter nga sobra na sa capacity.
english: According to Parcon, passengers should also understand especially during peak hours that conductors are also responsible if they are caught catering to commuters who are over capacity.

text: Pananglitan matabo ini suno kay Parcon, mahimo gid makuha ang bus number kag i-report sa management ukon sa kooperatiba agud nga maka-akto man sila ukon maka-isyu sang warning.
english: If this happens, Parcon said, the bus number can be obtained and reported to the management or the cooperative so that they can act or issue a warning.

text: “Ang aton diri nga ang comfort sang mga pasahero kay te nagsakay gani sila sa modernized jeep nga aircon kag makapungko sila sang maayo.
english: “What we have here is that the comfort of the passengers is that they even ride in a modernized jeep with aircon and they can sit comfortably.

text: Gina-disseminate gid naton sa mga drivers kag conductor nga indi gid magsobra sa 10 ang standing,” suno kay Parcon.
english: We are disseminating to drivers and conductors that there should be no more than 10 standing,” Parcon said.

text: Matandaan nga nagpahanumdom ang Department of Transportation (DOTr) sang implementasyon sang ‘Anti-Sardinas’ policy nga sunod man sa direktiba ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It can be recalled that the Department of Transportation (DOTr) reminded the implementation of the 'Anti-Sardinas' policy in line with the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: para masiguro ang safe kag convenient nga public transportation.#
english: to ensure safe and convenient public transportation.#

text: Plano sang Japan kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga maghimo sang joint military plan para sa posible emerhensya nga matabo sa Taiwan nga teritoryo nga ginaangkon sang China.
english: Japan and the United States of America plan to develop a joint military plan for a possible emergency in Taiwan territory claimed by China.

text: Suno sa Kyodo news agency nga nakabase sa Japan, nalakip diri nga plano ang pag-deploy sang missiles.
english: According to the Japan-based Kyodo news agency, the plan includes the deployment of missiles.

text: Sa masunod nga semana pa iga-compile ang plano.
english: The plan will be compiled next week.

text: Base diri, magapadala ang Estados Unidos sang missile units sa Nansei Islands sa southwestern Kagoshima kag Okinawa prefectures sa Japan amo man sa Pilipinas.
english: Based on this, the United States will send missile units to the Nansei Islands in southwestern Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures in Japan as well as the Philippines.

text: Wala pa ginhingadlan sa report kun sin-o ang US kag Japanese sources kaangot sa sini nga plano.
english: The report did not name the US and Japanese sources in connection with the plan.

text: Base sa Kyodo, ang Marine Littoral Regiment sang US Marine Corps nga may High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS) kag iban pa nga weapons amo ang iga-deploy sa Nansei Islands.
english: Based on Kyodo, the Marine Littoral Regiment of the US Marine Corps with High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS) and other weapons will be deployed to the Nansei Islands.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang iga-estasyon naman sa Pilipinas amo ang US unit nga para sa space, cyberspace kag electromagnetic waves.
english: On the other hand, the US unit for space, cyberspace and electromagnetic waves will be stationed in the Philippines.

text: Ginahulat pa kun ano ang mangin statement sang Japanese defense ministry kag mga embahada sang US kag Pilipinas sa Tokyo kaangot diri.
english: The statement of the Japanese defense ministry and the US and Philippine embassies in Tokyo is still awaited.

text: Nag-resign si Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong bilang special adviser sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).
english: Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong has resigned as special adviser of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).

text: Sa iya sulat nga naka-address kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., ginplastar sini nga ang latest nga mga pahayag sang Malacañang nahanungod sa iya nga designation ang wala nagasanto sa terms sang iya nga appointment kag suno sa iya naga-undermine sang papel kag mandato nga gintugyan sa iya.
english: In his letter addressed to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., he laid out that the latest statements of Malacañang regarding his designation are not in line with the terms of his appointment and according to him undermine the role and mandate entrusted to him.

text: Natabo ini nga resignation matapos ginsiling ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro nga magakuha sang legal team ang presidente agud tun-an kun husto ang pag-appoint kay Magalong.
english: The resignation came after Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro said the president will hire a legal team to study whether Magalong's appointment was correct.

text: “Nadinig po din natin ang kagalang-galang na Mayor Magalong na nauubusan na yata siya or busy siya or kinukulang na ang oras niya sa Baguio City dahil busy siya sa ICI.
english: “We also heard from the honorable Mayor Magalong that he is running out or he is busy or he is running out of time in Baguio City because he is busy with ICI.

text: Hindi po gugustuhin ng Pangulong Marcos Jr.
english: President Marcos Jr. will not like it.

text: na makaligtaan ni Mayor Magalong ang mga kababayan natin sa Baguio City,” suno anay kay Castro.
english: that Mayor Magalong will forget our fellow citizens in Baguio City,” Castro said.

text:
Pahayag pa sini, “At kailangan unahin po rin ang mga kababayan natin sa Baguio City dahil siya po ay special adviser hindi naman po niya kinakailangan na ubusin ang oras sa ICI dahil hindi po siya miyembro ng ICI.”

Sa resignation letter naman ni Magalong, may ginhinambit ini nga mga “sirkumstansya” nga nagahatag na sang duha-duha sa independence sang ICI.
english:
He added, “And our fellow citizens in Baguio City must be given priority because he is a special adviser and he does not need to spend time in ICI because he is not a member of ICI.”

In his resignation letter, Magalong mentioned “circumstances” that cast doubt on the independence of the ICI.

text: “Combined with circumstances that already cast doubt on the independence of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure, it has become clear that my continued service is no longer tenable,” suno sa alkalde.
english: “Combined with circumstances that already cast doubt on the independence of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure, it has become clear that my continued service is no longer tenable,” according to the mayor.

text: Ginklaro sini nga wala niya ginapabayaan ang iya nga responsibilidad sa mga pumuluyo sang Baguio bangud sila ang prayoridad sini sa iya nga serbisyo sa publiko.
english: He clarified that he is not neglecting his responsibility to the people of Baguio because they are his priority in his public service.

text: “Let it also be stated that I have not neglected, nor will I ever neglect, my primary responsibility to the people of Baguio, whose welfare and interests remain at the core of my public service.
english: “Let it also be stated that I have not neglected, nor will I ever neglect, my primary responsibility to the people of Baguio, whose welfare and interests remain at the core of my public service.

text: I hereby tender my resignation from the Independent Commission for Infrastructure effective immediately,” dugang sang Baguio City mayor.
english: I hereby tender my resignation from the Independent Commission for Infrastructure effective immediately,” the Baguio City mayor added.

text: Septyembre 13 sang gin-anunsyo sang Palasyo ang designation kay Magalong bilang special adviser.
english: On September 13, the Palace announced the designation of Magalong as special adviser.

text: Sanday former public works secretary Rogelio Singson kag certified public accountant Rossana Fajardo naman ang mga myembro sang independent fact-finding body agud imbestigaran ang mga anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: Former public works secretary Rogelio Singson and certified public accountant Rossana Fajardo are members of the independent fact-finding body to investigate anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Sang ulihi, ginhingadlan naman si former Supreme Court Associate Justice Andres Reyes Jr.
english: Later, former Supreme Court Associate Justice Andres Reyes Jr. was named.

english: as chairperson of the panel.

text: Matandaan nga sang gin-appoint ni Marcos si Magalong, nagsiling ini nga nagasalig siya sa integridad sang alkalde kag sa track record sini bilang imbestigador sa Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: When Marcos appointed Magalong, he said he trusted the mayor's integrity and his track record as an investigator in the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Si Magalong amo anay ang hepe sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) kag isa sa nangin top investigators sang Mamasapano incident sadtong 2015.#
english: Magalong was the former chief of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) and one of the top investigators of the Mamasapano incident in 2015.#

english: More than P2-million worth of suspected shabu was seized in a drug buy bust in Barangay Janipaan Olo, Cabatuan, Iloilo where four people were arrested including a minor.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Glenn Soliman, chief of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU), said the total weight of the recovered suspected shabu was 400 grams.

english: It has a standard drug price of P2,720,000.

english: Also seized were a caliber 38 pistol with three rounds of ammunition, a 12 gauge shotgun with ammunition, and other non-drug items.

english: Honor for beauty queen Samantha Bernardo, who will represent the Philippines in Miss Grand International 2020 after she was selected by Binibing Pilipinas Charities Inc.

text: ukon BPCI.
english: or BPCI.

text: Suno sa organisasyon, suportado nila si Samantha nga madala sini ang labing una nga Miss Grand International crown sa pungsod.
english: According to the organization, they support Samantha to win the country's first Miss Grand International crown.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, ginakasubo man sang Binibing Pilipinas Charities Inc.
english: However, Binibing Pilipinas Charities Inc. is also sad.

text: nga indi si Aya Abesamis ang magatiglawas sa pungsod sa nasambit nga pageant bangud overage na ini tuga sang pagkadelay sang contest bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: that Aya Abesamis will not represent the country in the said pageant because it is overage due to the delay of the contest due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ang age requirement sa Miss Grand International ang yara lamang sa 18 tubtob 28 anyos.
english: The age requirement for Miss Grand International is only 18 to 28 years old.

english: However, the BPCI made it clear that they will not take the title back from Aya.

text: Ginapahayag nga sa Oktubre 8 na subong nga tuig naka-schedule ang rematch sa tunga sang Pinoy boxer nga si Jerwin Ancajas kag sang IBF world super flyweight champion nga si Fernando Martinez.
english: The rematch between Pinoy boxer Jerwin Ancajas and IBF world super flyweight champion Fernando Martinez is scheduled for October 8 this year.

text: Sandig sa reports, patigayunon ini sa Los Angeles.
english: According to reports, it will be held in Los Angeles.

text: Si Ancajas ang former IBF world super flyweight champion kag nadula ang iya nga world title sang ginlutos siya sang nasambit nga Argentinian Olympian sang nagligad nga Pebrero paagi sa 12-round unanimous decision.
english: Ancajas is the former IBF world super flyweight champion and lost his world title when he was defeated by the Argentine Olympian last February by a 12-round unanimous decision.

text: May rekord nga 33-2-2 with 22 knockouts si Ancajas kag siyam ka beses nga na-depensahan ang iya nga titulo antes ginpierde ni Martinez nga may yara naman sang unbeaten record nga 14-0 with 8 knockouts.
english: Ancajas has a record of 33-2-2 with 22 knockouts and defended his title nine times before being defeated by Martinez who has an unbeaten record of 14-0 with 8 knockouts.

text: Nagtanyag ang gobyerno sang Colombia nga handa ini magsupply sa Pilipinas sang karne sang baboy kag baka.
english: The Colombian government has offered to supply the Philippines with pork and beef.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag ni Marcela Ordoñez Fernandez, resident ambassador sang Colombia sa Pilipinas may kaangtanan sa pagtaas sang presyo kag karne kag kakulang sang supply sini sa mga merkado sa Metro Manila tuga sang African Swine Fever kag iban pa nga mga kalamidad.
english: This was stated by Marcela Ordoñez Fernandez, resident ambassador of Colombia to the Philippines in connection with the increase in prices and meat and its shortage in the markets in Metro Manila due to African Swine Fever and other disasters.

text: Suno kay Fernandez, interesado ang Colombia nga magbaligya sang karne sang baboy kag baka sa Pilipinas kag luyag man sini nga makabulig sa pagpataas sang foreign investment indi lamang para sa ekonomiya sang ila pungsod kundi mangin sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Fernandez, Colombia is interested in selling pork and beef to the Philippines and also wants to help increase foreign investment not only for the economy of their country but also in the Philippines.

text: Sa bahin ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, handa man ang punsod nga pasangkaron pa ang kooperasyon sa Colombia kun “trade and investment” ang pagahambalan.
english: For his part, President Rodrigo Duterte said the country is also ready to expand cooperation with Colombia when it comes to trade and investment.

text: ILOILO CITY– Ginklaro sang Department of Agriculture nga wala sang high-ranking government officials kag DA officials nga involve sa illegal importation ukon smuggling activities sa agricultural products sa pungsod.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Department of Agriculture has clarified that there are no high-ranking government officials and DA officials involved in illegal importation or smuggling activities of agricultural products in the country.

text: Ini ang kasunod man sang ginpatigayon nga senate hearing sang Lunes angut sa nagapadayon nga smuggling sang agricultural products nagikan sa China nga nagaresulta sang minilyon nga kapyerdehan sa mga local farmers sa tagsa ka adlaw.
english: This follows the senate hearing held on Monday regarding the ongoing smuggling of agricultural products from China that results in millions of losses to local farmers every day.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes, iya ginpahayag nga basi man sa nangin pahayag ni Asst.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes said that based on the statement of Asst.

text: Secretary Federico E. Laciste Jr., ang Assistant Secretary for the DA-Wide Field Inspectorate, may mga negosyante nga nagatawag kay Laciste kag ginagamit ang pangalan sang mga pulitiko kag mangin sang mga opisyal sang ahensya.
english: Secretary Federico E. Laciste Jr., the Assistant Secretary for the DA-Wide Field Inspectorate, has businessmen calling Laciste and using the names of politicians and even agency officials.

text: Ginklaro man ni Reyes nga wala sang opisyal sang ila nga ahensya nga na-angot sa smuggling activities.
english: Reyes also clarified that no official of their agency is involved in smuggling activities.

text: Sa subong suno kay Reyes, ginaimbestigaran na ini sang Department of Agriculture.
english: Reyes said the Department of Agriculture is investigating the incident.

text: Kabahin sang mga gina-smuggle nga mga produkto amo ang mga utan, mga isda kag mangin ang mga processed meat.
english: Among the smuggled products are vegetables, fish and even processed meat.

text: Padayon man ang operation sang Department of Agriculture batuk sa smuggling activities kaupod ang Bureau of Customs (BOC).
english: The Department of Agriculture is also continuing its operation against smuggling activities in collaboration with the Bureau of Customs (BOC).

text: Sa tion nga madakpan ang isa ka importer nga naga-smuggle sang produkto, gilayon ini nga gina-black list kag ginapasakaan sang kaso sang BOC kun makapila na ka beses nga ginsulit.
english: When an importer is caught smuggling a product, he is immediately blacklisted and prosecuted by the BOC if he has been repeated several times.

text:
“DAKO ANG MABULIG SANG X-RAY MACHINES”

Samtang, madugay na nga ginasuhestiyon sang Department of Agriculture nga dapat maggamit sang digital kag x-ray machines ang gobyerno agud nga machekyar sang maayo ang tanan nga mga naga-agi sa ports kag sea ports.
english:
“X-RAY MACHINES CAN HELP A LOT”

Meanwhile, the Department of Agriculture has long suggested that the government should use digital and x-ray machines to thoroughly check all those passing through ports and sea ports.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes, iya ginpahayag nga indi makita sa gilayon ang mga smuggled products kun manu-mano ang pag-inspect ang ahensya kag sang Bureau of Customs.
english: Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes said the smuggled products will not be immediately detected if the agency and the Bureau of Customs conduct manual inspections.

text: May yara man sang dalagko nga vans suno sa natungdan gani indi malantaw sang maayo kag posible yara sa pinakasulod sang salakyan ang mga illegally imported products.
english: There are also large vans, he said, so they cannot be seen properly and the illegally imported products may be inside the vehicle.

text: Imposible na suno sa natungdan nga ma-isa-isa chekyar ang sulod sang van ilabi na nga sa sagwa gid lamang ang ginalantaw sang inspector.
english: He said it is impossible to check the inside of the van one by one especially since the inspector is only looking at the outside.

text:
“WALA SANG FORMALIN NGA GINABUTANG SA UTAN”

Indi matuod nga may yara sang formalin ukon iban pa nga sahi sang kemikal nga ginabutang sa mga smuggled products.
english:
“NO FORMALIN ADDED TO VEGETABLES”

It is not true that there is formalin or any other kind of chemical being put in the smuggled products.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes, wax gid lamang ang ginabutang sa mga produkto agud nga maghining ang panit kag mag-extend ang shelf life kag wala ini sang hilo.
english: According to Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Noel Reyes, only wax is added to the products to smooth the skin and extend the shelf life and it is free of toxins.

text: Nagbaskog liwat si Opong kag nagbalik sa Typhoon Category samtang nga yara ini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Opong strengthened again and returned to Typhoon Category while it was in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Base sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin, Septyembre 27, ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 505 km nakatundan sang Indang, Cavite.
english: Based on the 5:00 am weather bulletin, September 27, the center of the typhoon was last seen at a distance of 505 km west of Indang, Cavite.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 120 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 150 km/h. Nagahulag ang bagyo sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 30 km/h.

Sa subong, ang mga lugar nga napaidalom pa sa Signal Number 1 amo ang lunsay yara sa Luzon area nga amo ang masunod: western portion sang Pangasinan, Zambales, Bataan, ang western portion sang Cavite, ang western portion sang Batangas, ang northern portion sang Occidental Mindoro lakip na ang Lubang Islands, kag ang Calamian Islands.
english:
It brought winds of 120 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 150 km/h. The storm is moving in a west northwest direction at 30 km/h.

Currently, the areas still under Signal Number 1 are all in the Luzon area as follows: western portion of Pangasinan, Zambales, Bataan, the western portion of Cavite, the western portion of Batangas, the northern portion of Occidental Mindoro including the Lubang Islands, and the Calamian Islands.

text: Alas otso kagab-i sang ginbawi na ang tanan nga wind signal sa tanan nga porsyon sang Iloilo.
english: At 8 pm last night, all wind signals were withdrawn in all portions of Iloilo.

text: Sandig sa track forecast sang weather bureau, magaguwa ang Bagyo Opong sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) subong nga aga ukon karon sa udto.
english: According to the track forecast of the weather bureau, Typhoon Opong will exit the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) this morning or this afternoon.

text: Sa guwa sang PAR region, magahulag ini pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan pakadto sa direksyon sang northern Vietnam.#
english: Outside the PAR region, it will move west northwest in the direction of northern Vietnam.#

text: Dead on the spot ang Assistant Schools Division Superintendent (ASDS) sa Ministry of Basic Higher Technical Education sa Sulu matapos nga gintiro sa sulod mismo sang compound sang iya opisina.
english: The Assistant Schools Division Superintendent (ASDS) at the Ministry of Basic Higher Technical Education in Sulu was shot dead inside his office compound.

text: Ang biktima amo si Sonatria Dandon Gaspar, residente sang San Raymundo, Jolo, Sulu.
english: The victim was identified as Sonatria Dandon Gaspar, resident of San Raymundo, Jolo, Sulu.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon sang kapulisan, nagalakat ang biktima padulong sa iya nga opisina sang hinali lang nga ginluthang sang suspek sa iya nawong kag sa likod.
english: According to initial investigation, the victim was walking towards his office when the suspect suddenly shot him in the face and back.

text: Narekober sang otoridad sa crime scene ang duha ka basiyo sang caliber .45 pistol.
english: Police recovered two rounds of a caliber .45 pistol from the crime scene.

text: Gindala pa ang biktima sa Sulu Provincial Hospital apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sang doktor.
english: The victim was rushed to the Sulu Provincial Hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang Jolo Municipal Police Station sa krimen.
english: The Jolo Municipal Police Station is still investigating the crime.

text: ILOILO CITY – Isa ka welcome development ang pagdugang ni San Miguel Corporation sports director Alfrancis Chua sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP).
english: ILOILO CITY – The addition of San Miguel Corporation sports director Alfrancis Chua to the Philippine Basketball Association (SBP) is a welcome development.

text: Ini ang suno kay Gilas Pilipinas head coach Chot Reyes.
english: This is according to Gilas Pilipinas head coach Chot Reyes.

text: Suno sa iya, si Chua ang gin-appoint bilang executive advisor sang Gilas Pilipinas sa ginpatigayon nga pagsinapol kun sa diin, gintalakay ang roadmap sang national team sa 2023 FIBA World Cup.
english: He said Chua was appointed as executive advisor of Gilas Pilipinas in a meeting where the roadmap of the national team for the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup was discussed.

text: Bilang executive advisor, si Chua ang magabulig sa masarangan niya kadungan sang pagpanghanda sang Gilas para sa world cup subong man sa Asian Qualifiers kag 2023 SEA Games.
english: As executive advisor, Chua will help as much as he can as the Gilas prepare for the world cup as well as the Asian Qualifiers and the 2023 SEA Games.

text: Si Chua ang nangin key figure sa Philippine basketball nga nagserbe man bilang Barangay Ginebra team governor sa PBA kag nangin consistent supporter sang Colegio de San Juan de Letran sa NCAA.
english: Chua has been a key figure in Philippine basketball who also served as the Barangay Ginebra team governor in the PBA and has been a consistent supporter of Colegio de San Juan de Letran in the NCAA.

text: Nagaplano ang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office nga panamion pa gid ang Iloilo Sunset Boulevard para sa mas maayo nga dalagan sang trapiko kag para masiguro man ang kaluwasan sang mga nagabisita sa lugar.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office plans to improve the Iloilo Sunset Boulevard for better traffic flow and to ensure the safety of visitors to the area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head sang opisina, iya ginpahayag nga isa sa mga plano nila amo ang paghimo sang mas maayo nga parking areas sa Sunset Boulevard agud malikawan ang pagpug-ok sang trapiko sa lugar ilabi na gid sa hapon kag gab-i, kun sa diin madamo ang nagabisita sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head of the office, said one of their plans is to create better parking areas on Sunset Boulevard to avoid traffic congestion in the area especially in the afternoon and evening, where many visitors visit the area.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, may yara na sang proposal ang Department of Public Works and Highways kag sa palaabuton nga committee hearing, maga-justify ang iya opisina kaangot sa husto nga plano sa parking areas.
english: Garbanzos said the Department of Public Works and Highways already has a proposal and in the upcoming committee hearing, his office will justify the proper plan for the parking areas.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Garbanzos nga plano man nila ang paglapta-lapta sang mga ambulant vendors sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang viewing deck sa Sunset Boulevard.
english: Garbanzos also said they also plan to disperse the ambulant vendors in different parts of the viewing deck on Sunset Boulevard.

text: Suno sa iya, ang mga vendor nga nagsulod sa lugar mahimo magamit sa mas husto nga mga area para malikawan ang mga paggutok sang dalan.
english: He said the vendors that have entered the area can be used in more correct areas to avoid traffic congestion.

text: Dugang sang opisyal, ang mga plano nga ini nagahingyo sang kooperasyon sang mga Ilonggo kag nagapakita sang seryoso nga commitment sang opisina sa paghatag sang maayo nga serbisyo sa mga nagabisita sa Iloilo City.
english: The official added that these plans require the cooperation of Ilonggos and show the serious commitment of the office to provide good services to visitors to Iloilo City.

text: Wala pa napasakaan sang kaso ang suspek sa pagpangawat sang cellphone sa isa ka pharmacy sa distrito sang Jaro sang Pebrero 6.
english: The suspect in the theft of a cellphone from a pharmacy in Jaro district on February 6 has not yet been charged.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Gimel Acuesta, Hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9, iya ginpahayag wala nahingagaw nga ipasaka ang kaso nga theft batok kay Roberto Salon bangud nag-lapse ang 18 ka oras nga reglementary period kay nagpauli ang cashier nga amo ang company representative kag otorisado nga tagreklamo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Gimel Acuesta, chief of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9, said the theft case was not filed against Roberto Salon because the 18-hour reglementary period lapsed because the cashier, who is the company representative and authorized complainant, returned home.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ipaidalom nalang sa regular filing ang kaso.
english: He added that the case will be submitted to regular filing.

english: According to the track forecast, Opong will leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) tomorrow morning or afternoon.

text: Nagpadayaw si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga madamo pa ini sang stocks nga missiles nga indi masarangan ma-intercept sang Ukraine.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has boasted that it still has many stocks of missiles that Ukraine cannot intercept.

text: Handa na ini nga panggamiton subong suno pa sa Russian leader.
english: It is ready for use now, the Russian leader said.

text: Dugang sini, may tropa sang militar nga padayon sa pag-test sang Oreshnik hypersonic ballistic missiles matapos ang madinalag-on nila nga initial test sang nagligad nga Huwebes.
english: He added that military troops are continuing to test Oreshnik hypersonic ballistic missiles after their successful initial test last Thursday.

text: “We will continue these tests, including in combat conditions, depending on the situation and the nature of the security threats that are created for Russia,” suno kay Putin sa iya televised comments.
english: “We will continue these tests, including in combat conditions, depending on the situation and the nature of the security threats that are created for Russia,” according to Putin in his televised comments.

english:
