text: Ini nga developments ang kasunod sang paggamit sang Kyiv sang missiles nga halin sa US kag Britanya sang nagligad nga semana agud nga iguon ang ila mga target sa Moscow.
english: These developments follow Kyiv's use of missiles from the US and Britain last week to hit its targets in Moscow.

text: ILOILO CITY- Istoryahan sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang natuhoy sa posibilidad nga nakasulod na sa Iloilo ang mga smuggled nga mga ulutanon halin sa iban nga pungsod kaangay sang China.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Iloilo Provincial Government will discuss the possibility that smuggled vegetables from other countries such as China have already entered Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay 3th District Board Member Matt Palabrica, member sang Committee on Agriculture sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, iya ginpahayag nga makahalangawa ini bangud indi lang ang palangabuhian sang mga magagmay nga mangunguma ang apektado kundi nabutang man sa peligro ang ikaayong lawas sang publiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, 3rd District Board Member Matt Palabrica, member of the Committee on Agriculture in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, said this is worrying because not only the livelihood of small farmers is affected but also the health of the public is put at risk.

text: Suno kay Palabrica, indi malayo nga ang iban nga ulutanon nga ginabaligya subong sa merkado sa Iloilo ang smuggled na kag ini ang dapat talupangdon gid sang gobyerno.
english: According to Palabrica, it is not far that some of the vegetables sold in the market in Iloilo are smuggled and this should be taken seriously by the government.

text: Dugang niya, kuntani, tungdan man sang Bureau of Customs(BOC) kag sang Department of Agriculture(DA) ang ila papel sa pagbantay sang mga produkto nga nagasulod sa Pilipinas bangud nagagwa subong nga ginapabay-an lang sang nasambit nga mga ahensya ang smuggling sang sini nga mga produkto.
english: He added that the Bureau of Customs (BOC) and the Department of Agriculture (DA) should also play their role in monitoring the products entering the Philippines because it appears that these agencies are neglecting the smuggling of these products.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa bahin sang Luzon, nagawangal ang mga mangunguma bangud nagapamierdehan na sila sang PHP2.5 million kada adlaw bilang resulta sang pagbakal sang mga konsumidor sang mga smuggled nga ulutanon kaangay sang carrots nga mas malawig ang kabuhi kumpara sa ila lokal nga patubas.
english: In Luzon, farmers are complaining that they are losing PHP2.5 million a day as a result of consumers buying smuggled vegetables such as carrots that last longer than their local produce.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang nasambit nga produkto ang ginabutangan sang formalin gani mas madugay ang kabuhi sini antes madunot.
english: The product is reportedly treated with formalin so it lasts longer before decomposing.

text: Game si Vice Ganda kag handa nga magsuporta sa iya boyfriend nga si Ion Perez bisan pa may yara ini sang daring scenes sa iya pelikula.
english: Vice Ganda is game and ready to support her boyfriend Ion Perez even though he has daring scenes in his movie.

text: Si Ion Perez ang napilian nga maga-partner sa showbiz newcomer nga si Sunshine Guimary sa isa ka sexy comedy film.
english: Ion Perez has been selected to partner with showbiz newcomer Sunshine Guimary in a sexy comedy film.

text: Si Sunshine ang kilala bangud sang iya no-bra series of challenges sa YouTube.
english: Sunshine is best known for her no-bra series of challenges on YouTube.

text: Antes ginpamangkot si Vice sa iya nga reaksyon sa pag-partner kanday Ion kag Sunshine sa amo nga film, una na nagpahayag si Sunshine nga nahadlok siya magperform sang intimate scenes kaupod si Ion bangud nahuya siya kay Vice.
english: Before Vice was asked about his reaction to partnering Ion and Sunshine in the film, Sunshine said he was afraid to perform intimate scenes with Ion because he was ashamed of Vice.

text: Suno naman kay Vice, wala naman ini sang problema sa iya kag na-excite siya kag proud gid para sa iya nga boyfriend.
english: According to Vice, he has no problem with her and she is excited and proud for her boyfriend.

text: Nahangpan man ni Vice nga trabaho lang ini kag amo gid sini ang dalagan sang showbiz.
english: Vice also understands that it’s just a job and that’s just how showbiz works.

text: Regular nga ginapatuman sang Iloilo City Police Office ang pila ka mga mental health programs para sa tanan nga mga police personnel.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office regularly implements several mental health programs for all police personnel.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Kim Legada, City Director sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga may regular nga medical officer sang Regional Medical and Dental Unit sang Police Regional Office 6 ang nagalibot sa kada istasyon diri sa probinsya kag siyudad sang Iloilo agud mag-check sang mga ikaayong lawas sang kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Kim Legada, City Director of the ICPO, said that a regular medical officer of the Regional Medical and Dental Unit of the Police Regional Office 6 is patrolling each station in the province and Iloilo City to check the health of the police.

text: Suno kay Legada, gina-monitor man diri kun sin-o ang makitaan sang mga senyales; kag kun may yara, gina-istorya kag gina-refer sa PRO 6 agud madapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong sang ila nga psychologist.
english: According to Legada, it is also monitoring who will see the signs; and if there is, they are talked to and referred to PRO 6 for proper treatment by their psychologist.

text: Nagpalab-ot man sang mensahe si Legada sa mga kapulisan nga kun may problema, yara ang opisina sang City Director nga bukas kag nakahanda nga magbulig sa ila.
english: Legada also conveyed a message to the police that if there is a problem, the City Director's office is open and ready to help them.

text: Nagpalupad ang Russia sang intercontinental ballistic missile halin sa southern Astrakhan region pakadto sa Ukraine.
english: Russia launched an intercontinental ballistic missile from the southern Astrakhan region into Ukraine.

text: Santo ini sa kumpirmasyon sang Ukrainian air force.
english: This is according to the confirmation of the Ukrainian air force.

text: Ini man ang una nga tion nga naggamit ang Russia sang amo sini kagamhanan nga long-range missile sa tion sang giyera.
english: It is also the first time Russia has used such a powerful long-range missile during a war.

text: Ini nga strike sang Moscow ang kasunod man sang paggamit na sang Ukraine sang US kag British missiles agud iguon ang ila mga target sa teritoryo sang Russia subong nga semana.
english: Moscow's strike follows Ukraine's use of US and British missiles to hit targets on Russian territory this week.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang Russian officials nga kun maggamit ang Kyiv sang amo sini nga missiles, magalala ang ila away nga subong nagalawig na sang 33 ka bulan.
english: Russian officials have previously warned that if Kyiv uses such missiles, the conflict, which has now lasted 33 months, would escalate.

text: Sa latest attack sang Russians, gin-target nila ang mga enterprise kag critical infrastructure sa central-eastern city sang Dnipro.
english: In the latest attack by the Russians, they targeted enterprises and critical infrastructure in the central-eastern city of Dnipro.

text: Indi pa klaro sa statement sang Kyiv kun ano gid ang gin-igu sang intercontinental ballistic missile kag kun may ginbilin ini nga damage.
english: It was not clear from Kyiv's statement what exactly the intercontinental ballistic missile hit and whether it left any damage.

text: “In particular, an intercontinental ballistic missile was launched from the Astrakhan region of the Russian Federation,” kabahin sang statement sang Kyiv Air Force.
english: “In particular, an intercontinental ballistic missile was launched from the Astrakhan region of the Russian Federation,” part of the Kyiv Air Force statement.

text: Ini nga missiles ang mahimo makalupad sang linibo ka kilometros.#
english: These missiles can fly thousands of kilometers.

text: Nagpaguwa ang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang warrants of arrest batok kanday Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, kag isa ka senior Hamas official.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued warrants of arrest against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, and a senior Hamas official.

text: Suno sa korte, may nakit-an ini nga rasonable nga mga basehan agud patihan nga may criminal responsibility si Netanyahu sa war crimes lakip na ang pagpagutom sa mga tawo kag crimes against humanity kaangay sang murder, persecution, kag iban pa nga indi makatawo nga mga aktwasyon.
english: The court said it found reasonable grounds to believe that Netanyahu had criminal responsibility for war crimes including starving people and crimes against humanity such as murder, persecution, and other inhuman acts.

text: Maragtason ini nga warrant bangud sa masobra pito ka dekada nga kumplikto sa tunga sang Israel kag Palestinians, si Netanyahu ang una nga Israeli leader nga gindagdagan sang kaangay nga order sang international court.
english: This warrant is historic because in the more than seven decades of conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, Netanyahu is the first Israeli leader to be supplemented with such an order by the international court.

text: Wala sang gahum ang ICC nga makaaresto, apang ang warrant ang mahimo maka-limit sang pagbyahe ni Netanyahu bangud indi siya pwede makatapak sa mga pungsod nga miyembro sang korte.
english: The ICC does not have the power to make arrests, but the warrant could limit Netanyahu's travel because he is not allowed to set foot in the court's member countries.

text: Ang Israel kaangay man sa Estados Unidos nga indi man miyembro sang ICC kag ginhangkat pa sini ang hurisdiksyon sang korte sa Gaza war.
english: Israel, like the United States, is not a member of the ICC and has even challenged the court's jurisdiction over the Gaza war.

text: Apang ginbasura sang court ang challenge sang Israel kag nag-claim nga may hurisdiksyon ini sa mga teritoryo nga ginasakop sang Israel lakip ang Gaza, ang East Jerusalem, kag ang West Bank.
english: But the court rejected Israel’s challenge and claimed jurisdiction over the Israeli-occupied territories including Gaza, East Jerusalem, and the West Bank.

text: Magluwas kay Netanyahu, may warrant man batok sa Hamas official nga si Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri ukon si Mohammed Deif nga isa sa ginatudlo nga masterminds sa atake sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: In addition to Netanyahu, there is also a warrant against Hamas official Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri or Mohammed Deif who is one of the alleged masterminds in the attack in southern Israel on October 7, 2023.

text: Gin-anunsyo anay sang Israel nga napatay na nila si Deif sang Septyembre paagi sa airstrike apang wala ini ginkumpirma sang kampo sang Hamas.
english: Israel had previously announced that it had killed Deif in September with an airstrike but the Hamas camp did not confirm this.

text: Suno sa ICC, responsable si Deif sa “crimes against humanity” lakip na ang murder, extermination, torture, kag rape kag iban pa nga porma sang sexual violence, amo man sa war crimes sang murder, cruel treatment, torture, taking hostages, outrages upon personal dignity, kag rape kag iban nga porma sang sexual violence.
english: According to the ICC, Deif is responsible for “crimes against humanity” including murder, extermination, torture, and rape and other forms of sexual violence, as well as war crimes of murder, cruel treatment, torture, taking hostages, outrages upon personal dignity, and rape and other forms of sexual violence.

text: Nahibaluan nga kun ma-isyu na sang ICC ang arrest warrant, nagapadala ini sang requests for cooperation sang member states.
english: Once the ICC issues the arrest warrant, it sends requests for cooperation to member states.

text: Wala ini sang kaugalingon nga police force agud nga makapangdakop gani nagasalig ang korte sa member states agud ma-execute ini kag legally obliged ang state parties nga himnuon ini.
english: It does not have its own police force to make arrests so the court relies on member states to execute it and the state parties are legally obliged to do so.

text: Nahibaluan nga 13 ka bulan na ang gyera sang Israel sa Gaza bilang balos sa pagsalakay sang Hamas sang October 7, 2023.
english: Israel is now 13 months into its war on Gaza in retaliation for the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023.

text: Sa ila paglunsar sang pagtimalos, 44,000 ka Palestinians ang nagkalamatay.#
english: In their launch of revenge, 44,000 Palestinians were killed.#

text: Ginatun-an sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) kun aprubahan ang request nga pasakaon ang presyo sang 33 ka basic necessities and prime commodities (BNPC) sa pungsod.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is studying whether to approve the request to raise the prices of 33 basic necessities and prime commodities (BNPC) in the country.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, lakip sa 33 ka mga produkto amo ang gatas, canned goods kaangay sang sardinas, kag meatloaf.
english: According to Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, among the 33 products are milk, canned goods such as sardines, and meatloaf.

text: Ginalantaw na sang Consumer Protection Group sang ahensya ang posible nga adjustment sa presyo.
english: The agency's Consumer Protection Group is looking into possible price adjustments.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lopez nga ginhingyo ang price increase bangud sang epekto sang pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo.
english: Lopez said the price increase was requested due to the impact of the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Halin sang nag-umpisa ang Russian invasion sa Ukraine, apisar nga naglala man ang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong sa Pilipinas, wala pa sang nagsaka sa presyo sa basic necessities and prime commodities suno sa DTI.
english: Since the beginning of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, although the price of fuel in the Philippines has also worsened, there has been no increase in the price of basic necessities and prime commodities, according to the DTI.

text: Enero 2022 sang ulihi nga naghatag ang DTI sang updated nga suggested retail prices (SRP) para sa BNPCs kaangay sang canned goods, food products, bottled water, dairy, kag komon nga mga galamiton sa balay kag sa kusina.
english: The DTI last provided updated suggested retail prices (SRP) for BNPCs such as canned goods, food products, bottled water, dairy, and common household and kitchen appliances in January 2022.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni DTI Assistant Secretary Ann Cabochan nga wala sang ginalantaw nga ipatuman nga price freeze sa basic necessities.##
english: Earlier, DTI Assistant Secretary Ann Cabochan said there is no plan to implement a price freeze on basic necessities.##

text: Ginakabig na sang Department of Justice bilang isa ka ‘protected witness’ si former Department of Public Works and Highways Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo.
english: The Department of Justice now considers former Department of Public Works and Highways Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo as a ‘protected witness’.

text: Kadungan sang pag-abot nanday Sec.
english: Along with the arrival of Sec.

text: Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla kag former Department of Public Works and Highways Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo sa Department of Justice, ginpakigbahin sang tiglikom ang pagka- protected witness na sini.
english: Jesus Crispin 'Boying' Remulla and former Department of Public Works and Highways Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo in the Department of Justice, the secretary shared that he is a protected witness.

text: Buot silingon sini nga ikonsiderar sa ebalwasyon kun mabutang sa Witness Protection Program sang ahensya ang former official sang DPWH kasunod man sang mga impormasyon nga ginbuyagyag niya sa hearing sang Senado.
english: This means that the former DPWH official will be considered for evaluation whether to be placed in the agency's Witness Protection Program following the information he revealed in the Senate hearing.

text:
Ginhiwat ini sa Pototan, Iloilo nga kilala bilang “rice granary of Panay.”

Ini ang una nga rollout sang programa sa rehiyon kag ika-anom na sa bug-os nga Pilipinas.
english:
It was held in Pototan, Iloilo known as the “rice granary of Panay.”

This is the first rollout of the program in the region and the sixth in the entire Philippines.

text: Ang Agrisenso ukon Strategic and Enhanced Delivery of Support and Opportunities isa ka komprehensibo nga financing initiative nga nakabase sa value chain nga ginpatigayon sang Land Bank of the Philippines kaupod ang Department of Agriculture, Department of Agrarian Reform, Agricultural Credit Policy Council, kag pila ka mga pribado nga sektor.
english: Agrisenso or Strategic and Enhanced Delivery of Support and Opportunities is a comprehensive value chain-based financing initiative conducted by the Land Bank of the Philippines in collaboration with the Department of Agriculture, Department of Agrarian Reform, Agricultural Credit Policy Council, and several private sectors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Agriculture Undersecretary Asis Perez, iya ginpahayag nga ang programa nagatuyo nga maghatag sang mas masangkad kag mas madinalag-on nga access sa pondo, insurance, kag teknikal nga bulig para sa mga mangunguma, manugpangisda, kag agri-enterprises sa rehiyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Agriculture Undersecretary Asis Perez said the program aims to provide broader and more successful access to funding, insurance, and technical assistance for farmers, fishermen, and agri-enterprises in the region.

text: Sa subong nga tuig, target sang programa ang 10,000 ka mga benepisyaryo, kag subong, halos 7,000 na ang nakabaton sang bulig halin sa programa.
english: This year, the program targets 10,000 beneficiaries, and so far, nearly 7,000 have received assistance from the program.

text: May yara ini sang fixed interest rate nga 4% para sa mga magagmay nga mga mangunguma, manugpangisda, kag mga mga benepisyaryo sang agrarian reform.
english: It has a fixed interest rate of 4% for small farmers, fishers, and agrarian reform beneficiaries.

text: Ginahatagan man sang interest rate ang mga asosasyon, MSMEs, mga daku nga negosyo, anchor firms, kag mga nagtapos sa agrikultura nga gusto magnegosyo.
english: Interest rates are also given to associations, MSMEs, large enterprises, anchor firms, and agriculture graduates who want to do business.

text: Luyag ni Senador Manny Pacquiao nga islan ang pangalan sang Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) nga tuigan nga kapistahan sang mga ”pelikulang Pilipino” sa Metro Manila.
english: Senator Manny Pacquiao wants to change the name of the Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) to the annual festival of “Filipino films” in Metro Manila.

text: Sa Senate Bill No.
english: In Senate Bill No.

text: 2017 nga gindihon sang senador, luyag ni Pacquiao nga tawgon ini nga “Philippine Film Festival” ukon PFF.
english: 2017 launched by the senator, Pacquiao wants to call it the “Philippine Film Festival” or PFF.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang MMFF ang ginapatigayon kada Disyembre 25 sa Metro Manila nga nagalawig tubtob isa ka semana.
english: The MMFF is held every December 25 in Metro Manila and lasts for up to a week.

text: Sang Disyembre, sa streaming app ginpaguwa ang mga pelikula nga kabahin sa 2020 MMFF bangud sirado ang mga sinehan tuga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In December, the streaming app released the films that were part of the 2020 MMFF because theaters were closed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ang mga Pinoy nga biktima amo sanday Janvi Maquindang kag Christine Asa-Ca.
english: The Filipino victims were identified as Janvi Maquindang and Christine Asa-Ca.

text: Gintiro man ang nobyo ni Asa-Ca nga si Edwin Garcia.
english: Asa-Ca's boyfriend, Edwin Garcia, was also shot.

text: Ginluthang-patay man ang tatlo ka mga ido sang mag-utod.
english: The brothers' three dogs were also shot dead.

text: Gintiro man ang partner ni Maguindang nga si Matthew Montebello nga sa ospital na ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: Maguindang's partner, Matthew Montebello, was also shot and died at the hospital.

text: Ginpahayag man nga sang nag-abot ang mga pulis sa lugar, may yara man sang mga bombero nga nagapalong sang kalayo.
english: It was also reported that when the police arrived at the scene, there were also firefighters putting out the fire.

text: Wala pa sang naaresto nga responsable sa krimen kag wala man sang impormasyon tuhoy sa ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: No one has been arrested for the crime and there is no information on the cause of the fire.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Asa-Ac ang nagaserbe man nga legal guardian sang mag-utod nga yara sa balay sang natabo ang trahedya.
english: Asa-Ac was also the legal guardian of the brothers who were at home when the tragedy occurred.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, naglunsar naman ang Maquindang family sang GoFundMe page agud makabulig sa gasto sa pagpalubong kag sa nabilin nga mga utod.
english: Following the incident, the Maquindang family launched a GoFundMe page to help with funeral expenses and the remaining siblings.

text: Gintawag naman nila nga “senseless act of gun violence” ang krimen.
english: They called the crime a “senseless act of gun violence”.

text: Ginsurpresa sang sexy actress kag vlogger nga si Ivana Alawi ang iya iloy sang brand-new car.
english: Sexy actress and vlogger Ivana Alawi surprised her mother with a brand-new car.

text: Suno kay Ivana, antes niya baklan ang iya kaugalingon, unahon anay niya nga baklan ang iya iloy sang salakyan kag iya mga utod nga sanday Mona kag Hashim.
english: According to Ivana, before she buys herself, she will first buy her mother and her siblings Mona and Hashim a car.

text: Sa video nga ginpost ni Ivana, ginprank nila ang ila iloy kag sang nagguwa ini sa ila balay, didto kag ginsurprise siya sang iya mga kabataan sang bag-o nga salakyan.
english: In the video posted by Ivana, they pranked their mother and when she came out of their house, there and her children surprised her with a new car.

text: Nangin emosyonal naman ang iloy kag suno sa iya apisar wala sang salakyan nga ginhatag, ang importante sa iya amo sanday Ivana , Mona kag Hashim.
english: The mother became emotional and said that although no vehicle was given, the important thing for her was Ivana, Mona and Hashim.

text: Natalana nga ipatawag sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) ang pito ka mga pulis sang Sibalom Municipal Police Station lakip na hepe sang police station kasunod sang sila ang ginpa-Bombo bangud sa ginapahayag pagpangkastigo sa mga manogbulang.
english: The National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) is scheduled to summon seven policemen of the Sibalom Municipal Police Station including the chief of the police station following their alleged beating of doctors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Michelle Yotoko, spokesperson sang NAPOLCOM Region VI, iya ginpahayag nga gin-cater man sang talatapan ang reklamo kag ginahulat na lang presensya sang mga kapulisan agud masugoran ang asessment.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Michelle Yotoko, spokesperson of NAPOLCOM Region VI, said the office has also catered to the complaint and is waiting for the presence of the police to begin the assessment.

text: Suno kay Yotoko, nakapadala na sila sang mensahe sa Sibalom Municipal Police Station agud atubangon nila ang ginaalegar nga pagpanakit sa mga manogbulang.
english: Yotoko said they have already sent a message to the Sibalom Municipal Police Station to deal with the alleged harassment of the healers.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga duha ang nagkadto sa ila nga complainant kag isa diri ang pursigido gid nga magpasaka sang reklamo.
english: He also explained that two people came to them as complainants and one of them was determined to file a complaint.

text: Ginalauman nga sa Myerkules sang aga, Pebrero 12, 2025 magaatubang ang pito ka mga pulis sa nasambit nga talatapan.
english: The seven police officers are expected to appear before the office on Wednesday morning, February 12, 2025.

text: Kon mapamatud-an naman nga may kapaltahan ang mga pulis, mahimo sila magapangatubang sang administratibo nga kaso.
english: If the police are found guilty, they could face administrative charges.

text: Una na nga ginpa-Bombo sang isa sa apat ka mga biktima sang ginapahayag pagpangkastigo kag indi makatarunganon nga pagtratar sa ila sang kapulisan.
english: Earlier, one of the four victims of alleged beatings and unfair treatment by the police reported to Bombo.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang apat ka manogbulang ang alegasyon nga nagapangbali sila sang manok agud magdaog sa bulang.
english: The four hunters also denied the allegation that they were breaking chickens to win the game.

text: Pormal nga nagpungko ang bag-o nga mga Officer-in-Charge sang Iloilo City Police Stations 2 kag 3 sa isa ka Turn-Over of Command Ceremony nga ginhiwat sang Hulyo 9, 2025 sa ICPO Headquarters, Camp Achilles D. Plagata, General Luna Street, Iloilo City.
english: The new Officers-in-Charge of Iloilo City Police Stations 2 and 3 formally took office at a Turn-Over of Command Ceremony held on July 9, 2025 at the ICPO Headquarters, Camp Achilles D. Plagata, General Luna Street, Iloilo City.

text: Sa idalom sang liderato ni City Director, Police Colonel Kim P. Legada, ginbasa ni Police Lieutenant Colonel Lindley T. Barrientos, Deputy City Director for Administration (DCDA), ang opisyal nga mga mando sang termination kag designation.
english: Under the leadership of City Director, Police Colonel Kim P. Legada, Police Lieutenant Colonel Lindley T. Barrientos, Deputy City Director for Administration (DCDA), read the official orders of termination and designation.

text: Ginpangunahan ni PCol Legada ang seremonyal nga pag-turn-over sang command symbol kag sang Property and Equipment Inventory Book sa mga bag-o nga ginpili nga opisyal.
english: PCol Legada led the ceremonial turn-over of the command symbol and the Property and Equipment Inventory Book to the newly elected officers.

text: Si Police Captain Mavin R. Larano, anay Chief sang City Tactical and Operations Center (CTOC), amo na karon ang Officer-in-Charge sang Iloilo City Police Station 3.
english: Police Captain Mavin R. Larano, former Chief of the City Tactical and Operations Center (CTOC), is now the Officer-in-Charge of Iloilo City Police Station 3.

text: Iya gintal-osan si PCapt Mary Jane P. Panes nga magapungko naman subong bilang Chief sang CTOC sa ICPO Headquarters.
english: He replaces PCapt Mary Jane P. Panes who will now take over as Chief of CTOC at ICPO Headquarters.

text: Samtang si Police Captain Jeffrey S. Delgado, nga anay Officer-in-Charge sang City Intelligence Unit (CIU), amo na ang bag-o nga Officer-in-Charge sang Iloilo City Police Station 2.
english: Meanwhile, Police Captain Jeffrey S. Delgado, former Officer-in-Charge of the City Intelligence Unit (CIU), is the new Officer-in-Charge of Iloilo City Police Station 2.

text: Iya gintal-osan si Police Major Tranquilino P. Querubin Jr., nga yara na sa non-duty status bilang preparasyon sa iya pagretiro.
english: He replaced Police Major Tranquilino P. Querubin Jr., who is now on non-duty status in preparation for his retirement.

text: Si PLT.
english: The PLT.

text: Romel Tabuyoc, anay Officer-in-Charge sang ICPS1, ang pagabuslan ni PCPT.
english: Romel Tabuyoc, former Officer-in-Charge of ICPS1, will be replaced by PCPT.

text: Melchor Tolentino ang Officer-in-Charge sang ICPS 3.
english: Melchor Tolentino is the Officer-in-Charge of ICPS 3.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Legada, iya ginpahayag nga padayon nga magahatag sang mayo nga serbisyo publiko ang mga bag-o nga station commanders kag ang tanan nga mga opisyal sang ICPO.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Legada said the new station commanders and all ICPO officers will continue to provide good public service.

text: Suno kay Legada, ginaduso liwat ang implementasyon sang 5-Minute Response Time Protocol sang syudad para sa epektibo nga lihok sang mga kapulisan.
english: Legada said the implementation of the city's 5-Minute Response Time Protocol is being proposed again for effective police action.

text: Nag-upod man sa seremonya sanday Police Lieutenant Colonel Lorenez G. Losaria, Deputy City Director for Operations (DCDO), mga staff sang ICPO unit, mga station commanders, police non-commissioned officers (PNCOs), kag non-uniformed personnel.
english: Also present at the ceremony were Police Lieutenant Colonel Lorenez G. Losaria, Deputy City Director for Operations (DCDO), ICPO unit staff, station commanders, police non-commissioned officers (PNCOs), and non-uniformed personnel.

text: Gindalahig na ang pangalan ni former House Speaker Martin Romualdez sa anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez has been implicated in anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Ginsaysay sang anay suldado nga si Orly Regala Guteza kun paano ginadala ang ginatawag nga “basura” ukon maleta nga may unod nga kwarta sa mga balay nanday Cong.
english: Former soldier Orly Regala Guteza explained how the so-called “garbage” or suitcase containing money was brought to the houses of Cong.

text: Zaldy Co kag anay Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Zaldy Co and former Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Si Guteza isa ka anay Philippine Marine Member nga nag-atubang sa hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee subong nga adlaw.
english: Guteza is a former Philippine Marine Member who appeared before the hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee today.

text: Gin-veto sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang resolution sa United Nations Security Council nga nagaduso sang ceasefire sa giyera sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: The United States of America has vetoed a resolution in the United Nations Security Council proposing a ceasefire on Israel's war in Gaza.

text: Lakip sa ginpanawagan kuntani sang tikang sa 15-member council amo ang “immediate, unconditional and permanent ceasefire” kag separado nga nag-demand para sa paghilway sang iban pa nga mga bihag.
english: Among the measures the 15-member council would have called for was an “immediate, unconditional and permanent ceasefire” and separately demanded the release of other hostages.

text: Isahanon lamang ang US nga nag-veto apang bangud isa ini ka permanent council member, bastante na ini nga tikang agud mabalabagan ukon indi mapasar ang resolution.
english: The US was the only one to veto but since it is a permanent council member, this is enough to block or not pass the resolution.

text: Suno kay Robert Wood, deputy U.S. ambassador to the U.N., suportahan lamang nila ang resolution nga maathag nga nagasaad nga nagapanawagan ini sang gilayon nga pagpaguwa sang mga bihag bilang parte sang ceasefire.
english: Robert Wood, deputy U.S. ambassador to the U.N., said they would only support a resolution that explicitly pledges it calls for the immediate release of hostages as part of a ceasefire.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga tion nga gin-veto sang Biden administration ang resolution nga nagapanawagan nga tapuson ang kumplikto sa Gaza.
english: This is the fourth time the Biden administration has vetoed a resolution calling for an end to the conflict in Gaza.

text: Gilayon naman nga gin-ulan sang kritisismo ang US bangud sa pag-block sa resolution nga ginhimo sang 10 ka elected members sang council nga amo ang Algeria, Ecuador, Guyana, Japan, Malta, Mozambique, South Korea, Sierra Leone, Slovenia kag Switzerland.
english: The US was immediately criticized for blocking the resolution made by the 10 elected members of the council, namely Algeria, Ecuador, Guyana, Japan, Malta, Mozambique, South Korea, Sierra Leone, Slovenia and Switzerland.

text: 13 ka bulan na ang ginlawig sang giyera sang Israel sa Gaza kun sa diin 44,000 na ka mga tawo ang napatay kag halos bilog nga populasyon ang nadulaan sang puluy-an.
english: Israel's war in Gaza has lasted 13 months, killing 44,000 people and displacing almost the entire population.

text: Ginlunsar nila ang giyera bilang pagtimalos sa Hamas fighters nga nagsalakay sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023, nagpatay sang 1,200 ka mga tawo, kag nagdala sang masobra 250 ka hostages sa teritoryo sang Palestine.
english: They launched the war in retaliation for Hamas fighters attacking southern Israel on October 7, 2023, killing 1,200 people, and taking more than 250 hostages to Palestinian territory.

text: DAKU gid nga halit ang natuga sa kalibutan sang COVID-19, pati na sang mga variant sini.
english: COVID-19, including its variants, has wreaked havoc on the world.

text: Una ini na-diskubrihan sadtong Disyembre 2019 sa Wuhan, China.
english: It was first discovered in December 2019 in Wuhan, China.

text: Gindeklarar ang outbreak sini sang World Health Organization sa pagsulod mismo sang tuig 2020.
english: The World Health Organization declared an outbreak at the beginning of 2020.

text: Kag ginpatuman na ang mga travel restriction, mga lockdown.
english: And travel restrictions, lockdowns have been implemented.

text: Ginpatuman man ang mga bagay nga mga health measures.
english: Appropriate health measures were also implemented.

text: Nagsara ang madamo nga establiciemto kag mga eskwelahan, pati ang mga territorial borders.
english: Many establishments and schools closed, as did territorial borders.

text: Ginpasarhan man ang pila ka barangay diri sa aton pungsod nga na-suspetsahan nga may COVID-19 scare.
english: Some barangays in our country that are suspected of having a COVID-19 scare have also been closed.

text: Ginpatuman ang isolation sang mga may masakit sang COVID-19.
english: Isolation of those with COVID-19 has been implemented.

text: Sa ospital, bisan ang myembro sang panimalay indi makaduaw sa sa ila pasyente nga daw isa ka aruon.
english: In the hospital, even family members cannot visit their patient as if he were a leper.

text: Ginapaamlig ang publiko sa close contact bisan sa sulod sang panimalay, kag ang matugutan makagwa sa publiko, katulad sang mga mapasugtan nga mga empleyado, gina-requirer sa paggamit sang face mask.
english: The public is protected from close contact even inside the home, and those allowed to go out in public, such as allowed employees, are required to wear face masks.

text: Ginapa-practice man sang personal hygiene ang tanan, kag ang pagpatuman sang iban pa nga health measures.
english: Everyone is also encouraged to practice personal hygiene, and the implementation of other health measures.

text: Samtang nagpatuman man sang ayuda ang gobyerno sa mga nalisdan nga mga pumuluyo.
english: Meanwhile, the government also implemented assistance to the affected residents.

text: Nahingagaw ang pangbakuna kontra COVID-19 sugod sadtong Disyembre 2020 nga amat-amat naman nagpatahaw sang pagpanghalit sini sa ikaayong lawas sang publiko.
english: The vaccine against COVID-19 has been in short supply since December 2020, which has gradually increased its impact on public health.

text: Amat-amat man bangon sang mga ekonomiya.
english: Economies are also slowly recovering.

text: Samtang, gin-atake naman sang Russia ang kasilingan sini nga Ukraine sang Pebrero 24, 2022 kay kuno threat ini sa ila seguridad.
english: Meanwhile, Russia attacked its neighbor Ukraine on February 24, 2022 as a threat to its security.

text: Nga indi naman mapatihan!
english: Which is unbelievable!

text: Paano abe mahalin ina sa Ukraine batok sa isa ka nuclear-powered nga Russia samtang halos madepensahan gani sini ang kaugalingon?
english: How can that leave Ukraine against a nuclear-powered Russia when it can barely defend itself?

text: Kag nagluntad ang dugang nga “devastation” sang ekonomiya tungod nagpiut ang importasyon sang fossil fuel sang madamo nga mga pungsod lakip ang Filipinas.
english: And there was further devastation of the economy because fossil fuel imports from many countries including the Philippines were restricted.

text: Mayor ini nga kinahanglanon sang mga pungsod sa transportasyon, mga power plant nga naga-generate sang elektrisidad nga fossil fuel ang gatong, kag kon ano pa nga makapahulag sang mga makinarya sang mga industriya.
english: It is a major need for countries in transportation, power plants that generate electricity fueled by fossil fuels, and anything else that can run industrial machinery.

text: Labi na gid kay nagbayluhanay na sing sanction ang Russia kag ang Estados Unidos kag mga kaalyado sini, nga apin sa Ukraine, agud ipiton ang ekonomiya sang isa kag isa.
english: Especially since Russia and the United States and its allies, pro-Ukraine, have exchanged sanctions to squeeze each other's economies.

text:
***

Kag tungod indi man lubos makabulig ang gobyerno, kon ano na lang ang nadumduman sang mga tawo diri sa Filipinas nga himuon agud maibsan ang kapuraot sang pangabuhi.
english:
***

And since the government is not fully helpful, what do people here in the Philippines remember to do to alleviate the poverty of life.

text: Katulad sang pagtanom sang mga ulutanon sa mga libre nga lugar sa ila palibut nga indi na kinahanglan baklon ang tanan nga ini para sa ila linuto.
english: Like planting vegetables in free spaces around them without having to buy all of them for their cooking.

text: Pati na ang pagbakal sang mga mas barato nga substitute products.
english: Even buying cheaper substitute products.

text: Lakip man ang paglakot sang mas barato nga bugas mais sa tinig-ang nga bugas humay.
english: It also includes mixing cheaper corn rice with stalled rice.

text:
***

Parti naman sa mga health conscious, may panugyan nga pagkaon ang Food and Nurition Research Inatitute (FNRI) sang Dept.
english:
***

As for the health conscious, the Food and Nutrition Research Institute (FNRI) of the Dept.

text: of Sicence and Technology (DOST) agud makakinot sa galastuhon nga makabulig pa sa ikaayong lawas katulad sang pagpataas sang intake sang dietary fiber.
english: of Science and Technology (DOST) to save on health expenses such as increasing the intake of dietary fiber.

text: Isa sa panugyan sini ang pagpanubo sang calorie intake halin sa karne (meat), nga ang sobra nga pagkaon sini pwede bangdan sang diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cancer kag bisan sang sobra nga katambok (obesity).
english: One of its recommendations is to reduce calorie intake from meat, which can lead to diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cancer and even obesity.

text: Ginapanugyan sini ang pagkaon sang sausage (chorizo ukon kasubong nga meat product), nga galakip sang dietay fiber sa meat preparation, tungod popular nga kalan-on ang sausage sa pamahaw ukon snack ang sausage nga himo sa giniling nga karne.
english: It recommends eating sausage (chorizo ​​or similar meat product), which includes dietary fiber in meat preparation, because sausage is popular for breakfast or snack.

text: Indi lang sang mga adults kundi sang mga kabataan nga pwede mapalaman sa sandwich.
english: Not only adults but children who can be stuffed into sandwiches.

text: Ang tinaga nga “meat”, sa masami, nagatumod sa unod (flesh) kag iban pa nga parti sang sapat, katulad sang mammals kag birds, nga ginaluto sang tawo agud kan-on.
english: The word “meat” usually refers to the flesh and other parts of animals, such as mammals and birds, that are cooked by humans for food.

text: Nagalakip ini sang iban nga edible tissues, katulad sang organs (liver, kidney, brain kag tinae (intestines).
english: This includes other edible tissues, such as organs (liver, kidney, brain and intestines).

text: Sa nasiling na naton sa ibabaw, ang sobra nga pagkaon sang karne indi makapaayo sa ikaayong lawas kay mabangdan ini sang madamo nga balatian nga lakip diri ang nasambit na naton sa ibabaw.
english: As mentioned above, eating too much meat is not good for your health because it can lead to many diseases, including those mentioned above.

text: Gani, sa mahuyog sang sausage, ginapanugyan sang FNRI ang paglakip sa preparation sang sausage ang dietary fiber, nga plant-based, ukon kuha sa grains, vegetables, kag prutas.
english: Therefore, for sausage lovers, the FNRI recommends including dietary fiber, plant-based, or derived from grains, vegetables, and fruits, in the preparation of sausage.

text: Makapanubo ini sang calorie content sang sausage preparation.
english: This will reduce the calorie content of the sausage preparation.

text: Luas sina, syempre makakinot ka pa sa napanubo nga presyo sini.
english: Besides that, of course you can save money with its reduced price.

text: Kon wala kita magsala, pwede ini mabakal ining enriched preparation – meat kag dietary fiber – sa mga groceries kag supermarkets./PN
english: If we are not mistaken, this enriched preparation – meat and dietary fiber – can be purchased in groceries and supermarkets./PN

text: Ginpabilin ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang iya hands-off policy sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: his hands-off policy on the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

english: In his podcast, Marcos said these proceedings are already between the House and Senate.

text: Ginpamangkot ang punong ehekutibo sa iya nga komento sa ginaalegar nga delay sa trial, apang suno kay Marcos, trabaho ini sang Kongreso; kag siya bilang presidente ang masako sa isyu sa transportasyon, bugas, kag iban pa nga mga problema sang pungsod.
english: The chief executive was asked for his comment on the alleged delay in the trial, but Marcos said it was the job of Congress; and he as president was preoccupied with the issue of transportation, rice, and other problems of the country.

english: It’s between the Congress (House of Representatives) and the Senate,” it said.

english: “I’m busy with the transport, with the rice, all of the different things we are doing.

text:

english:
