text: “Wala naman akong papel sa impeachment… If a president chooses to do that, I choose not to,” dugang sini sa podcast.
english: “I have no role in the impeachment... If a president chooses to do that, I choose not to,” he added on the podcast.

text: Pebrero sang gin-impeach si Sara sa Kamara bangud sa alegasyon sang kurapsyon kag bangud sa “kill order” sini batok kay Marcos, First Lady Liza Marcos, kag House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.
english: Sara was impeached in the House of Representatives in February over allegations of corruption and for her “kill order” against Marcos, First Lady Liza Marcos, and House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.

text: May gin-cite naman nga technicalities sang yara na ini sa Senado, kag tubtub subong, wala na-umpisahan ang trial bisan nga ginpasumpa na ang senator-judges.
english: There were cited technicalities when it was in the Senate, and so far, the trial has not started even though the senator-judges have been sworn in.

text: Una naman nga nagpanindugan si Marcos sa iya public statements nga indi niya luyag nga masipa sa posisyon ang second-highest official sang Pilipinas nga iya man anay running-mate sang 2022 elections.
english: Earlier, Marcos insisted in his public statements that he does not want the second-highest official of the Philippines, who was also his running-mate in the 2022 elections, to be kicked out of office.

text: Valentine’s Day subong gani may kaangtanan man diri ang aton balita espesyal.
english: It's Valentine's Day so our news special is related to this.

text: Didto bala sa Miao sa South West China, may yara sang isa ka festival nga ginatawag nga Sister’s Meal Festival.
english: Was it in Miao in South West China, there was a festival called the Sister’s Meal Festival.

text: Sa sini nga adlaw, nagaluto ang mga babaye sang nanari-sari nga mga maduagon nga rice dishes nga naputos sa silk kag gina-offer sa mga lalaki nga nagapadulong sa ila balay agud mangaluyag.
english: On this day, women cook a variety of colorful rice dishes wrapped in silk and offer them to men who come to their house to court.

text: Kun ano ang labot sang rice dishes sa mga lalaki nga nagapangaluyag?
english: What do rice dishes have to do with men in love?

text: Sa rice dishes mahibaluan nila ang ila kapalaran bangud ang rice dishes, may yara sang palaman.
english: In rice dishes they will know their fate because rice dishes, have stuffing.

text: Kun ang rice dish may yara sang nakatago nga chopstick sa sulod, buot silingon, palangga man sang babaye ang lalaki.
english: If the rice dish has a hidden chopstick inside, it means that the woman loves the man too.

text: Apang kun ang unod sang rice dish ang ahos ukon garlic, buot silingon, wala ka na sang tsansa sa iya gani magpauli ka nalang kag dal-a ang ahos agud may remembrance ka man sa iya.
english: But if the contents of the rice dish are garlic or garlic, it means that you have no chance with him so just go home and bring the garlic so that you have a reminder of him.

text: Yara lamang sa 65% sang 4,810 ka farm-to-market roads ukon FMR projects ang natapos halin sang tuig-2021 tubtob 2025.
english: Only 65% ​​of the 4,810 farm-to-market roads or FMR projects have been completed from 2021 to 2025.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture Sec.
english: According to Department of Agriculture Sec.

text: Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., 3,135 ka mga proyekto palang ang nahuman sang Department of Public Works and Highways samtang pila pa ka mga proyekto ang wala pa sagihapon masugudan ukon ginahimo palang tubtob subong.
english: Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., 3,135 projects have been completed by the Department of Public Works and Highways while several projects have not yet been started or are still being done.

text: Ang FMR projects amo ang may ara sang allocated budget nga ₱76.52 bilyon kun sa diin nakahimo na ini sang 2,400 kilometers nga mga dalan nga nangin dako gid ang bulig para sa kapin 721,000 ka mangunguma halin sa nagkalain-lain nga mga komunidad sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: The FMR projects have an allocated budget of ₱76.52 billion where they have already constructed 2,400 kilometers of roads which have been of great help to more than 721,000 farmers from various communities across the country.

text: Agud nga mas mapatuman ang transparency sa mga farm-to-market road projects, plano nga ilunsyar sang ahensya sa bulan sang Pebrero ang FMR Watch, isa ka online platform para sa real-time nga pagmonitor sang mga proyekto.
english: In order to better enforce transparency in farm-to-market road projects, the agency plans to launch in February FMR Watch, an online platform for real-time monitoring of projects.

text: Ang ahensya naman sang Department of Agriculture ang magakapot subong sa mga natuhoy nga proyekto bangud sa kontrobersiya angot sa corruption scandal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: The Department of Agriculture agency will now take over the projects due to the controversy over the corruption scandal of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Dugang pa sang ahensya nga pagatapuson nila ang nasambit nga proyekto sini nga tuig kun sa diin may ara sang ₱33 bilyon budget para sa farm-to-market roads.
english: The agency added that they will complete the project this year where there is a ₱33 billion budget for farm-to-market roads.

text: Kabahin ang Philippine National Police ukon PNP sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga nalakip sa direktiba sang Department of the Interior and Local Government ukon DILG sa Memorandum Circular No.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) is one of the government agencies included in the directive of the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) in Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2026-006 ukon Anti-Epal Policy.
english: 2026-006 or Anti-Epal Policy.

text: Madumduman nga ang nasambit nga direktiba amo ang pagdumili kag pagkakas sang mga pangalan, litrato, logo, initials, color motif, slogan officials, ukon ano man nga maangut sa public officials lakip na ang proponent mismo sa mga government funded projects.
english: The directive prohibits and removes the names, photos, logos, initials, color motifs, slogans of officials, or anything related to public officials including the proponent himself in government funded projects.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Lailyn Sencil, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga bilang pagsunod sa nasambit nga direktiba, gina-monitor na sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 ang ila mga personnel agud masiguro nga wala sang nagalapas sa ginapatuman nga Anti-Epal Policy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Lailyn Sencil, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said that in compliance with the said directive, the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 is already monitoring its personnel to ensure that no one violates the Anti-Epal Policy.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Sencil nga nagapangayo pa sila sang klaripikasyon halin sa Department od the Interior and Local government natuhoy sa mas detalyado nga aplikasyon sang polisiya sa bahin sang PNP.
english: Sencil said they are still seeking clarification from the Department of the Interior and Local Government regarding the more detailed application of the policy on the part of the PNP.

text: Ini bangud nga ang PNP may yara na sang ginapatuman nga standard kag institutional identity base sa national guidelines sang organisasyon, lakip na ang disenyo sang ila mga pasilidad, markings sang mga police station kag police vehicles, kag amo man sa paggamit sang opisyal nga kolor kag logo sang PNP.
english: This is because the PNP already has an implemented standard and institutional identity based on the national guidelines of the organization, including the design of their facilities, markings of police stations and police vehicles, as well as the use of the official colors and logo of the PNP.

text: Dugang pa ni Sencil nga wala pa sang may na-monitor nga kaso sang paglapas sa nasambit nga polisa bangud padayon ang pagpatuman sang disiplina kag pagsunod sang mga police personnel sa mga patakaran sang organisasyon.
english: Sencil added that no cases of violation of the policy have been monitored as the police personnel continue to enforce discipline and follow the rules of the organization.

text: Iloilo – Nagpanugyan ang Department of Education sa mga estudyante nga mag-obserba sang proper sanitation kag personal hygiene kadungan sang padayon nga pagtaas sang kaso sang hand, foot, and mouth disease sa Probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo – The Department of Education has advised students to observe proper sanitation and personal hygiene amid the continuous increase in cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease in Iloilo Province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson sang Department of Education, Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nakipag-angot na sila sa mga local government kag rural health units sang mga kabanwahanan nga apektado sang amo nga balatian agud matapna ang paglaton sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson of the Department of Education, Schools Division of Iloilo, said they have already contacted the local government and rural health units of the towns affected by the disease to prevent the spread of the disease.

text: Suno kay Salvilla, lapnagon ang kaso sang nasambit nga balatian sa banwa sang Tubungan, San Dionisio, Tigbauan, kag Pavia, Iloilo.
english: According to Salvilla, cases of the disease are widespread in the towns of Tubungan, San Dionisio, Tigbauan, and Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Matandaan nga sa data nga ginpagwa sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office, may ara sang 224 nga kaso halin sang Enero 1 tubtob 21 sang hand, foot, and mouth diseases.
english: According to the data released by the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, there were 224 cases from January 1 to 21 of hand, foot, and mouth diseases.

text: Suno sa natungdan, wala sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga estudyante bangud may mga intervention ang Department of Education agud masolbar ang problema paagi sa pag-shift sa distance learning method nga sarang ginhimo sang ahensya sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: He said the students have nothing to worry about because the Department of Education has interventions to solve the problem by shifting to the distance learning method that the agency can do in the midst of the pandemic.

text: Ini amo ang nakabutang sa Department of Education Order No.
english: This is stated in the Department of Education Order No.

text: 39 bilang pamaagi agud malagas sa gihapon sang mga estudyante ang ila mga leksyon kag indi makalaton sang kaangay nga estudyante.
english: 39 as a way for students to continue their lessons and not infect other students.

text: Tatlo ka menor de edad ang patay sang mabungguan sang isa ka van ang ginasakyan nila nga motorsiklo sa Sta.
english: Three minors were killed when a van hit their motorcycle in Sta.

text: Barbara, Pangasinan.
english: Barbara, Pangasinan.

text: Sa mga biktima, isa diri ang naga-drive sang motorsiklo kag duha ang nagaangkas.
english: Of the victims, one was driving a motorcycle and two were riding.

text: Sa kabaskog sang pagbunggo, nagtabog ang mga biktima kag nasunog ang motorsiklo.
english: The victims fled the scene and the motorcycle was burned.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, ginpahayag nga nagsulod ang closed van sa lane sang motorsiklo rason nga natabo ang aksidente.
english: According to the investigation, the closed van entered the lane of the motorcycle causing the accident.

text: Nahibaluan man nga wala sang lisensiya ang solterito nga rider kag wala naglisensya sa iya ginikanan sang gin-gamit ang motorsiklo sang ila nga himata.
english: It was also learned that the young rider did not have a license and did not ask his parents for a license when he used the motorcycle of their relative.

text: Ginpasakaan naman sang panumbungon ang driver sang van.
english: The driver of the van was charged.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Atty. Raymond Fortun nga mas madamo pa nga senador nga ginapahayag involved sa iskandalo sa mga flood control projects sa Bulacan ang posible nga mapangalanan sa mga masunod nga adlaw.
english: He revealed that Atty. Raymond Fortun said more senators allegedly involved in the flood control projects scandal in Bulacan are likely to be named in the coming days.

text: Suno kay Fortun, nga nagaserbe nga legal counsel ni anay Bulacan 1st District Engineering Asst.
english: Fortun, who serves as legal counsel to former Bulacan 1st District Engineering Asst.

text: Chief Brice Hernandez, nabusisi na niya ang iban sa mga sensitibo nga dokumento nga nauyatan sang iya nga kliyente nga nagaunod sang mga impormasyon tuhoy sa lapnagon nga network sang korapsyon sa mga flood control project sa nasambit nga probinsya.
english: Chief Brice Hernandez, he has already leaked some of the sensitive documents held by his client containing information about the widespread network of corruption in flood control projects in the said province.

text: Kalakip diri ang pangalan sang anom nga senador kun sa diin apat sa ila ang yara sa posisyon (incumbent) samtang ang duwa ang wala na sa serbisyo.
english: This includes the names of six senators, four of whom are incumbents while two are no longer in service.

text: Una na na naulamid ang pangalan nanday Sen.
english: Earlier, the names of Sen.

text: Jingoy Estrada kag Sen.
english: Jingoy Estrada and Sen.

text: Joel Villanueva sa mga nauna nga hearing sang Senado tuhoy sa flood control scandal.
english: Joel Villanueva in previous Senate hearings on the flood control scandal.

text: Apang sa testimoniya naman ni anay District Engineer Henry Alcantara, namitlang man ang pangalan ni anay Sen.
english: However, in the testimony of former District Engineer Henry Alcantara, the name of former Sen.

text: Ramon ‘Bong’ Revilla.
english: Ramon ‘Bong’ Revilla.

text: Sa bahin naman sang mga kongresista, magluwas kanday Rep.
english: As for the congressmen, besides Rep.

text: Zaldy Co kag iban pa nga una na nga napangalanan, may pila pa gid nga wala pa mabuyagyag apang nalakip sa mga dokumento nga yara kay Hernandez.
english: Zaldy Co. and others already named, there are several others that have not been disclosed but are included in the documents in Hernandez's possession.

text: Ang mga nasambit nga dokumento, suno kay Atty. Fortun, ang pareho nga ihatag sa Independent Commission on Infrastructure kag sa Senado, agud mangin ebidensiya sa madalom nga imbestigasyon kag dalayon nga pag-file sang kaso.
english: The said documents, according to Atty. Fortun, the same will be given to the Independent Commission on Infrastructure and the Senate, to become evidence in the in-depth investigation and constant filing of the case.

text: Pahayag niya, ang mga ini ang lunsay sa isa ka distrito lamang sang Bulacan nga sakop sang opisina ni Hernandez kag indi pa kaupod ang mga flood control project sa bilog nga pungsod nga mahimo ginapanginpuslan man sang iban pa nga mga mamalidha.
english: He said these are all in one district of Bulacan under Hernandez's office and do not include flood control projects nationwide that may also be benefited by other lawmakers.

text: Base sa mga dokumento nga yara kay Hernandez, ang mga nasambit nga mamalidha ang lunsay nakabaton sa kickback system nga natabo sa nasambit nga distrito.
english: Based on the documents in Hernandez's possession, the said lawmakers were all recipients of the kickback system that occurred in the said district.

text: Gin-ako sang Asia’s Nightingale nga si Lani Misalucha nga tatlo ka bulan ini nagtinir sa balay sang host nga si Willie Revillame.
english: Asia’s Nightingale Lani Misalucha admitted that she spent three months at host Willie Revillame’s house.

text: Suno kay Lani, kaupod ang iya bana sang nag-tinir sila temporaryo sa balay ni Willie kadungan sang pag-umpisa sang coronavirus pandemic sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Lani, she was with her husband when they temporarily stayed at Willie's house during the onset of the coronavirus pandemic in the Philippines.

text: Gindayaw man ni Lani ang host kag ginpahayag nga ini ang tuman ka maalwan kag matatap nga sahi sang tawo.
english: Lani also praised the host and said that he is a very generous and caring type of person.

text: Wala naman gindetalye pa sang singer kun ngaa sa balay sila ni Willie nagtinir sang iya nga bana.
english: The singer did not elaborate on why she and Willie stayed at her husband's house.

text: Si Willie , Lani ang bana sini nga si Noli ang suod nga mag-abyanay.
english: Willie, Lani and her husband Noli are close friends.

text: Subong na nga adlaw kaslon ang Olympic champion nga si Hidilyn Diaz sa iya nga coach kag longtime boyfriend nga si Julius Naranjo.
english: Olympic champion Hidilyn Diaz will marry her coach and longtime boyfriend Julius Naranjo today.

text: Patigayunon ang seremonya sa Philippine Military Academy sa Baguio City.
english: The ceremony will be held at the Philippine Military Academy in Baguio City.

text: Mapakasal si Diaz apang una na ini nagpahayag nga maga-intra pa siya sa 2024 Paris Olympics nga amo na ang iya ika-lima nga pagpasakop sa Olympiada.
english: Diaz is getting married but has previously said she will participate in the 2024 Paris Olympics, which will be her fifth Olympiad.

text: Ginpahayag man sang 31-anyos nga Zamboangueña nga gusto na nila makaangkon sang mga anak kun matapos na ang Paris Games.
english: The 31-year-old Zamboangueña also said that they want to have children after the Paris Games.

text: Nagkitaay sanday Diaz kag Naranjo sa 2017 Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games sa Turkmenistan kun sa diin nagpasakop man si Naranjo bilang weightlifter sang Guam.
english: Diaz and Naranjo met at the 2017 Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games in Turkmenistan where Naranjo also competed as a weightlifter for Guam.

text: Nagsulod si Naranjo sa Team HD – ang term nga ginagamit ni Diaz para sa iya nga grupo – kag siya ang nagserbe bilang kusog kag conditioning coach ni Diaz sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Naranjo joined Team HD – the term Diaz uses for his group – and served as Diaz's strength and conditioning coach at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Bangud nagbalik na sa iya pamilya sa China ang Chinese mentor ni Diaz nga si Gao Kaiwen, si Naranjo na subong ang head coach samtang target naman ni Diaz ang isa pa ka Olympic gold medal.
english: With Diaz's Chinese mentor Gao Kaiwen returning to his family in China, Naranjo is now the head coach while Diaz targets another Olympic gold medal.

text: Lakip sa principal sponsors sang kasal amo si former Vice President Leni Robredo, former senator and boxer Manny Pacquiao, dermatologist-to-the-stars Vicki Belo, award-wining actress Judy Ann Santos, business moguls nga sanday Manny Pangilinan kag Ramon Ang, Philippine Olympic Committee president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino kag Bo Sanchez.
english: Among the principal sponsors of the wedding were former Vice President Leni Robredo, former senator and boxer Manny Pacquiao, dermatologist-to-the-stars Vicki Belo, award-winning actress Judy Ann Santos, business moguls Manny Pangilinan and Ramon Ang, Philippine Olympic Committee president “Bambozino” Abraham Bolzino and Tolentino.

text: Yara man sanday Angel Locsin, Atom Araullo, kag Iza Calsado.
english: Also present are Angel Locsin, Atom Araullo, and Iza Calsado.

text: Espesyal ni nga adlaw sang ila kasal bangud sa sini man nga adlaw sang nagligad nga tuig, naghimo sang maragtas si Hidilyn Diaz sang nagdaog ini sang gold medal sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: This is a special day of their wedding because on the same day last year, Hidilyn Diaz made history when she won a gold medal at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Nangibabaw si Diaz sa women’s 55 kg.
english: Diaz won the women’s 55 kg.

text: weightlifting competition sa Japan matapos ang iya nga record-breaking 127 kg.
english: weightlifting competition in Japan after his record-breaking 127 kg.

text: lift sa clean and jerk event.
english: lift in the clean and jerk event.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga gold medal sang Pilipinas sa Olympiada.
english: This is the Philippines' first gold medal at the Olympics.

text: Patay ang pinuno sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) sa Pikit, Cotabato matapos nga gintiro sa sulod sang iya salakyan sa Barangay Inug-ug, Pikit, Cotabato.
english: The head of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in Pikit, Cotabato was shot dead inside his vehicle in Barangay Inug-ug, Pikit, Cotabato.

text: Ang biktima amo si Johnson Edil, nga nagaserbe man nga political chairman sang Moro Islamic Liberation Front-Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (MILF-BIAF).
english: The victim was identified as Johnson Edil, who also serves as the political chairman of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front-Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (MILF-BIAF).

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, nagpalapit ang mga suspek sa salakyan sang biktima kag ginluthang sang pila ka beses.
english: According to initial investigation, the suspects approached the victim's vehicle and shot him several times.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon agud hibaluon ang motibo sa krimen kag makilala ang mga tawo sa likod sang pagpangluthang.
english: Investigation is ongoing to determine the motive of the crime and identify the people behind the shooting.

text: Ginkondenar ni Pres.
english: Condemned by Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang mga indibidwal nga nag-umpisa sang gamo sa isa ka matalunsay nga hublag-protesta sang Setyembre 21.
english: the individuals who started the trouble in an otherwise smooth protest-movement on September 21st.

text: Ginpasiguro man sini nga manabat ang tanan nga may kahilabtanan sa amo nga kinagamo.
english: He also assured that all those involved in the violence will be held accountable.

text: Ginpahayag ni Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary kag Palace Press Officer Claire Castro nga kadam-an sa mga nag-intra sa hublag-protesta malinong nga ginpalab-ot ang ila mga hibubun-ot, apang pila sa mga grupo ang nanggamo, partikular sa bahin sang Mendiola, Manila.
english: Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary and Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said most of the protesters peacefully expressed their wishes, but some of the groups became violent, particularly in the Mendiola, Manila area.

text: “Peaceful rally, nasamahan lang ng iilang nais manggulo, mananagot ang lahat.
english: “Peaceful rally, just joined by a few who want to cause trouble, everyone is responsible.

text: Iyan ang nais ni Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: That's what President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. wants.

text: sa lahat ng sino mang gumamit ng karahasan sa naganap na peaceful rally noong Linggo,” pahayag ni Castro.
english: to all those who used violence in the peaceful rally last Sunday,” Castro said.

text: Suno kay Castro, indi nangin upang ang kinagamo sa lapnagon nga hublag-protesta, kag ginkilala niya ang lehitimo nga kaakig sang Pilipino batok sa korapsyon, ilabi na sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: Castro said the unrest did not hinder the widespread protest movement, and he acknowledged the legitimate Filipino anger against corruption, especially in government projects.

text: Apang, ginpunto niya nga ginkondenar sang administrasyon ang paggamit sa mga kabataan sang mga grupo nga suno sa iya nagapanago sa likod sang itom nga maskara agud manggamo.
english: However, he pointed out that the administration condemned the use of children by groups that he said hide behind a black mask to cause trouble.

text: “‘Team Itim’ kung maituturing — hindi sila raliyista na may lehitimong adhikain laban sa korapsyon kundi gumawa lang ng karahasan, magnakaw, manunog at manira,” dugang ni Castro.
english: “‘Team Itim’ if you can consider it — they are not rallyists with a legitimate aspiration against corruption but just commit violence, steal, burn and destroy,” Castro added.

text: Nag-warning man si Castro sa mga yara sa likod sang mga makatilingala nga hulag.
english: Castro also warned those behind the bizarre moves.

text: “Hindi kayo makakalagpas sa kamay ng batas at ang mga tao sa inyong likuran na gumamit sa inyo – mga gahaman sa kapangyarihan.
english: “You cannot escape the hand of the law and the people behind you who use you – the powerful.

text: Hindi kayo dapat paligtasin.
english: You should not be saved.

text: Hustisya ang uusig sa inyo,” dugang pa.
english: Justice will pursue you,” he added.

text: Pahayag ni Castro, padayon ang administrasyon sa kampanya sini batok sa korapsyon, sa pagpanguna mismo ni President Marcos nga una na nag-mando sang imbestigasyon sa mga iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: Castro said the administration continues its campaign against corruption, under the leadership of President Marcos himself who earlier ordered an investigation into irregularities in flood control projects.

text: “Magpapatuloy din ang Pangulo sa naumpisahan na ito, at sa tulong ng taumbayan na magiging matapang sa pagbunyag ng katotohanan, ang pang-aabuso sa kaban ng bayan ay mailalantad at malalabanan,” pahayag ni Castro.
english: “The President will continue what he has started, and with the help of the people who will be brave in revealing the truth, the abuse of the public treasury will be exposed and fought,” Castro said.

text: Nagkasugtanay subong nga adlaw ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) upod ang pila ka ahensya kag organisasyon.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) reached an agreement today with several agencies and organizations.

text:
Upod sa mga nagpirma sang Memorandum of Agreement ang mga masunod:

Philippine National Police (PNP) sa pagpanguna ni Acting Chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr., Mayors for Good Governance sa pagpanguna nanday Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto kag Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte, Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) sa pagpanguna ni Executive President Atty. Allan Panolong, Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers (PICE) sa pagpanguna sang National President Engr.
english:
Among the signatories of the Memorandum of Agreement were the following:

Philippine National Police (PNP) led by Acting Chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr., Mayors for Good Governance led by Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto and Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte, Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) led by Executive President Atty. Allan Panolong, Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers (PICE) led by National President Engr.

text: Frederick Sison.
english: Frederick Sison.

text: Tinutuyo sang Memorandum of Agreement nga siguruhon ang transparency, accountability, kag mas malapad nga sakop sang imbestigasyon.
english: The Memorandum of Agreement aims to ensure transparency, accountability, and a broader scope of investigation.

text: Ginpunto man ni ICI Chairperson Ret.
english: ICI Chairperson Ret.

text: Justice Andres Reyes nga kamatuoran lamang ang ila gina-uyatan, kag wala sang bisan sin-o man ang mas mataas ukon powerful kaysa sa layi.
english: Justice Andres Reyes said they hold only the truth, and no one is higher or more powerful than the law.

text: Nasekyar na sang Iloilo City Engineers Office ang kable kon sa diin nakuryente ang isa ka lalaki sa Center Island sang General Luna St., Iloilo City Proper.
english: The Iloilo City Engineers Office has checked the cable where a man was electrocuted in Center Island of General Luna St., Iloilo City Proper.

text: Ang biktima amo si Danny Boy Glumalid, residente sang Barangay Sinikway, Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: The victim was identified as Danny Boy Glumalid, resident of Barangay Sinikway, Lapuz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Electrical Inspector II sang City Engineers Office, iya ginpahayag nga underground ang mga wires nga yara sa lugar kon sa diin, nakalubong ini sang one-foot ukon isa ka tapak.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Electrical Inspector II of the City Engineers Office, said the wires in the area are underground where they are buried one-foot or one foot.

text: Suno kay Gerasmia, ginpanglubong ang mga kable bangud may mga insidente nga ginakawat ini kag ginabaligya.
english: According to Gerasmia, the cables were buried because there were incidents of them being stolen and sold.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang pila ka underground wire sa Esplanade ang mas madalom nga ginlubong kon ikumpara sa Center Island sa amo nga dalan.
english: He also explained that some of the underground wires on the Esplanade are buried deeper compared to Center Island on that road.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga namentenar sang ila talatapan ang mga wire sa lugar bangud sa nagligad nga Dinagyang Festival, wala man sang may nasamaran ilabi na sa mga nagalabay sa lugar.
english: He also believes that their office maintained the wires in the area because during the last Dinagyang Festival, no one was injured especially those passing by the area.

text: Nagpanindugan man si Gerasmia nga nahunos lang ang linya sini (live wire) rason nga naglabaw kag naglapat ini sa alambre nga nakaptan sang biktima.
english: Gerasmia also insisted that the live wire was broken and it crossed the wire that the victim was holding.

text: Naghimo sang panibag-o nga maragtas si EJ Obiena bilang labing-una nga Pinoy nga nakakuha sang medalya gikan sa World Athletics Championships.
english: EJ Obiena made new history as the first Filipino to win a medal from the World Athletics Championships.

text: Nadala pauli ni Obiena ang bronze medal matapos gin-reset ang Asian record kag ang iya nga personal best paagi sa 5.94-meter clearance sa world championship stage sa Hayward Field sa Eugene, Oregon, United States.
english: Obiena took home the bronze medal after resetting the Asian record and his personal best with a 5.94-meter clearance on the world championship stage at Hayward Field in Eugene, Oregon, United States.

text: Matandaan nga ang previous personal record ni Obiena ang yara sa 5.93 meters nga amo man ang previous Asian record.
english: Obiena's previous personal record was 5.93 meters, which is also the previous Asian record.

text: Nagtinguha pa si EJ nga ma-clear ang 6.00 meters apang napaslawan sa tatlo niya ka attempts.
english: EJ tried to clear 6.00 meters but failed in all three of his attempts.

text: Ang world record holder nga si Mondo Duplantis sang Sweden ang nakakuha sang gold samtang si Chris Nilsen naman sang Estados Unidos ang nakakuha sa silver.
english: World record holder Mondo Duplantis of Sweden won gold while Chris Nilsen of the United States won silver.

text: Todo ang performance ni EJ subong nga tuig bangud anum na ka mga gold medals ang iya natipon.
english: EJ has performed well this year as he has already collected six gold medals.

text: Antes ang worlds, bag-o lang gid nakuha sang 26-anyos nga Pinoy vaulter ang bulawan nga medalya sa Jump and Fly meet sa Germany.
english: Before the worlds, the 26-year-old Filipino vaulter recently won a gold medal in the Jump and Fly meet in Germany.

text: Naglunsar ang Ukraine sang airstrike sa Russia gamit ang US missiles sa labing una nga tion sa pagpang- atake nga ginkabig sang Russia bilang isa ka major escalation sa ika-1,000 nga adlaw sang giyera kahapon.
english: Ukraine launched an airstrike on Russia using US missiles for the first time in an attack Russia viewed as a major escalation on the 1,000th day of the war yesterday.

text: Suno sa Russia, na-shot down sang ila pwersa ang lima sa anom ka missiles nga ginpalupok sa isa ka military facility sa Bryansk region.
english: Russia says its forces shot down five of the six missiles fired at a military facility in the Bryansk region.

text: Suno sa Ukraine, naigo nila ang Russian arms depot kapin 110 km (70 miles) sa sulod sang Russia kag nagtuga sang secondary explosions.
english: Ukraine says it hit a Russian arms depot more than 110 km (70 miles) inside Russia and caused secondary explosions.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghatag sang go- signal si President Joe Biden subong lang nga semana para sa Ukraine nga gamiton ang medium-range US missiles para sa atake nga suno sa Moscow, isa ka escalation nga nagahimo sa Washington bilang isa ka direkta nga combatant sa giyera kag mahimo magresulta sa pagtimalos man sang Russia.
english: President Joe Biden gave the go- signal just this week for Ukraine to use medium-range US missiles for the attack, which Moscow says is an escalation that makes Washington a direct combatant in the war and could result in Russian retaliation as well.

text: Nagpa-Bombo ang apat ka mga manogbulang matapos nga ginapahayag ginkastigo sang katapo sang pulis sa Sibalom, Antique.
english: Four healers reportedly beaten by a police officer in Sibalom, Antique.

text: Ang apat ka mga manogbulang ang lunsay taga-Iloilo kag nagpangayaw lamang sa Antique.
english: The four healers are all from Iloilo and only traveled to Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alin Diaz, nagpa-Bombo kag residente sang Rumbang, Pototan, iya ginpahayag nga tubtob subong, nagasuprer sila sa gihapon sang sakit kasunod sang pagpangkastigo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alin Diaz, a resident of Rumbang, Pototan, said they are still suffering from pain following the beating.

text: Suno kay Diaz, gin-akusaran sila sang iya kaupdanan sang mga pulis nga nagapangbali sang tiil sang manok agud nga magdaog sa bulang.
english: According to Diaz, he and his fellow policemen accused them of breaking chicken legs to win the bulang.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga anom ka mga pulis ang nagsaputi sa ila, kon sa diin, nag-angkon sila sang lagob sa guya, baba, lawas, kamot, kag lakip na ang ila alatrasan.
english: He also revealed that six policemen beat them, where they sustained bruises on their faces, mouths, bodies, hands, and even their backs.

text: Indi man mabaton sang natungdan nga gintayaan sila sang 9mm nga armas-luthang kag ginpakaon man sang ila kaugalingon nga higko.
english: He also said he could not accept that they were given a 9mm pistol and fed their own feces.

text: Gintuad man sini nga antes ang insidente, ginkuha sila sang salakyan kag ginpasakaan sang mga kaso kaangot sa ginabato sa ila nga alegasyon.
english: He also admitted that before the incident, they were picked up by a vehicle and charged with stoning.

text: Nakapyansa naman si Diaz kasunod sang pagbayad sini sang bail.
english: Diaz was released on bail after paying his bail.

text: Ginaalegar man ni Diaz nga ginkuha sang kapulisan ang ila mga kagamitan, lakip na ila bracelet, kulintas, kag mga kwarta nga indi magnubo sa P150,000.
english: Diaz also alleged that the police took their belongings, including their bracelets, necklaces, and money worth at least P150,000.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi magnubo sa P100,000 ang dala sang tagsa isa sa ila kon sa diin, tanan ang ginkuha sang kapulisan.
english: It was learned that each of them was carrying at least P100,000, all of which were taken by the police.

text: Plano naman nila nga magpa-medical agud matumod kag mapamatud-an ang ila nga mga alegasyon.
english: They plan to undergo a medical examination to identify and prove their allegations.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala sila nagreklamo sa Sibalom PNP bangud nagapati sila nga indi sila pag-i-cater sang kapulisan.
english: He also said that they did not complain to Sibalom PNP because they believed that the police would not cater to them.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang mga nagpa-Bombo nga may involvement sila sa pagpamago ukon indi pagbayad.
english: The Bombo suspects also denied any involvement in the theft or non-payment.

text: Napalaab-ot naman sang mga natungdan ang ila nga reklamo sa National Police Commission ukon NAPOLCOM.
english: The concerned have forwarded their complaint to the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM).

text: Bukas naman ang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa pagpaathag sang Sibalom PNP.
english: Bombo Radyo Iloilo is open to the explanation of Sibalom PNP.

text: Handa na nga mag-atubagn sa imbestigasyon si Sen.
english: Sen. Rodrigo Duterte is ready to face the investigation.

text: Joel Villanueva para klaruhon ang mga alegasyon batok sa iya matapos siya nga gin-ulamid sa flood control scandal.
english: Joel Villanueva to clarify the allegations against him after he was involved in the flood control scandal.

text: Nalakip ang senador sa mga indibidwal nga ginpasakaan sang criminal charges nga ginrekomenda sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), mangin ang freeze order nga ipagguwa ang Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC).
english: The senator was among the individuals who were charged with criminal charges recommended by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), as well as the freeze order to be issued by the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC).

text: “Nakahanda po akong bigyang linaw ang mga bagay na ito sa anumang forum o lugar,” pahayg ni Villanueva.
english: “I am ready to clarify these things in any forum or place,” Villanueva said.

text: Determinado si Miss Iloilo Binibini 2020 Karen Laurrie Mendoza nga makabulig agud makilala ang Iloilo City ukon ang City of Love sa national beauty pageants.
english: Miss Iloilo Binibini 2020 Karen Laurrie Mendoza is determined to help make Iloilo City or the City of Love known in national beauty pageants.

text: Si Mendoza amo ang official candidate sang Iloilo City sa Binibining Pilipinas 2020-2021.
english: Mendoza is Iloilo City's official candidate for Miss Philippines 2020-2021.

text: Siya man ang isa sa ‘recognized beauties among the new faces’ sa amo nga national pageant.
english: She is also one of the 'recognized beauties among the new faces' in the national pageant.

text: Sa exclusive intereview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mendoza, iya ginpahayag nga kaangay ni Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo, plano man niya nga tapuson ang madugay na nga tion nga wala nakasulod ang Iloilo City sa top spots sa pageant industry.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Mendoza said that like Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo, she also plans to end the long time that Iloilo City did not enter the top spots in the pageant industry.

text: Madamo ang nagapamangkot kun pressured bala si Mendoza matapos nakuha ni Rabiya ang korona sa iya nga kompetisyon sang Oktubre 25.
english: Many are asking if Mendoza is pressured after Rabiya won the crown in her competition on October 25.

text: Sabat naman ni Mendoza: “Actually, even before, pressured na gid ko because wearing the sash of Iloilo is a pressure itself.
english: Mendoza replied: “Actually, even before, I was pressured because wearing the sash of Iloilo is a pressure itself.

text: But I’ve told myself, if mag-join ka man lang sang pageant and your purpose is not to win, why would you join in the first place?
english: But I’ve told myself, if you’re going to join a pageant and your purpose is not to win, why would you join in the first place?

text:
Amo na ang akon gid nga goal — to do my best and make Iloilo proud.”

Suno sa Ilongga beauty queen nga tumandok sang Concepcion, Iloilo, nagdaku siya bilang “independent” kag madamo siya sang naagyan nga mahimo man maka-inspire sa iban nga mga tawo.
english:
That's my real goal — to do my best and make Iloilo proud.”

According to the Ilongga beauty queen who is originally from Concepcion, Iloilo, she grew up as “independent” and she went through many things that can also inspire other people.

text: Ini suno sa iya ang iya edge sa Binibining Pilipinas nga posible patigayunon sa Abril 2021.
english: This, he said, is his edge in Binibining Pilipinas which is likely to be held in April 2021.

text: “I’ve always described myself as a warrior and damo na gid ko naagyan in life and I could inspire a lot of people through my learnings.
english: “I’ve always described myself as a warrior and I’ve been through a lot in life and I could inspire a lot of people through my learnings.

text: I hate studying, I mean, like, with books… but I love learning from people.
english: I hate studying, I mean, like, with books… but I love learning from people.

text: And…ako, Karen Laurrie… I’ve known myself, I’ve lived with myself alone, I’ve known myself too much and I always have a vision and I always turn my vision into reality.
english: And…me, Karen Laurrie… I’ve known myself, I’ve lived with myself alone, I’ve known myself too much and I’ve always had a vision and I’ve always turned my vision into reality.

text: Amo gid na guro ang edge ko,” pahayag ni Mendoza.
english: I guess that’s my edge,” Mendoza said.

text: Ini man ang rason suno sa iya kun ngaa wala siya nagasapak kun may yara sang bashers.
english: This is also the reason why he doesn't care if there are bashers.

text: “Since college ko, independent na ko.
english: “Since college, I’ve been independent.

text: My Mom, since four years old ko, ara na siya sa iban nga bansa.
english: My Mom, since I was four years old, she's been in another country.

text: Basically, I’ve been molding myself to be a warrior — to know and how to fight life.
english: Basically, I’ve been molding myself to be a warrior — to know and how to fight life.

text: If there’s a basher online, I really won’t mind about it because I know myself better.
english: If there’s a basher online, I really won’t mind about it because I know myself better.

text:
The only criticism that matters is from my Mom, my family, and my closest friends.”

Isa man ka mental health advocate si Mendoza.
english:
The only criticism that matters is from my Mom, my family, and my closest friends.”

Mendoza is also a mental health advocate.

text: May yara siya sang social media page nga Project Sunrise nga amo ang iya designed platform agud makabulig sa iban ilabi na bangud limitado ang hulag sang mga tawo subong nga madamo ang restrictions dala sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: He has a social media page called Project Sunrise which is his designed platform to help others especially since people's movements are limited now that there are many restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Luyag ni Mendoza nga mabuligan ang mga tawo nga may yara sang mental health problems.
english: Mendoza wants to help people with mental health problems.

text: “Don’t enclose yourself in the four corners of your room.
english: “Don’t enclose yourself in the four corners of your room.

text: It’s okay if you don’t wash your dishes.
english: It’s okay if you don’t wash your dishes.

text: It’s okay if pirme ka lang nagatulog but at some point, stand up and do things nga consistent and it’s going to make you happier and if indi na gid kaya, we can go to the doctor.
english: It's okay if you're always sleeping but at some point, stand up and do things that are consistent and it's going to make you happier and if you can't, we can go to the doctor.

text: Indi ta ni dapat ikahuya kay they have been trained for that and damo gid tawo nga mabulig,” mensahe sang beauty queen.
english: We should not be ashamed of this because they have been trained for that and there are many people who can help,” the beauty queen said.

text: Matandaan nga originally scheduled ang Bb Pilipinas pageant sang bulan sang Mayo apang gin-postpone bangud sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Bb Pilipinas pageant was originally scheduled for May but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: May mga na-post na nga mga laragway ang organization sang mga kandidata sa ila nga national costume apang wala pa sang pinal nga anunsyo kun san-o ang pageant date.
english: The organization has already posted pictures of the candidates in their national costumes but there is no final announcement of the date of the pageant.

text: Sa iya national costume, gindayaw man si Mendoza bangud sang iya bulalakaw-inspired costume nga gin-design ni Tata Pinuela.
english: In her national costume, Mendoza was also praised for her butterfly-inspired costume designed by Tata Pinuela.

text: Sa subong, nagatutok si Mendoza sa iya pagpanghanda para sa pageant.
english: For now, Mendoza is focusing on her preparation for the pageant.

text: Nadepensahan sang Australia ang titulo sa 2022 Fiba Asia Cup matapos ginpyerde ang Lebanon, 75-73, sa championship game sa Istora Senayan sa Jakarta, Indonesia.
english: Australia defended the 2022 Fiba Asia Cup title after defeating Lebanon, 75-73, in the championship game at Istora Senayan in Jakarta, Indonesia.

text: Ginpangunahan ni NBA veteran Thon Maker ang kadalag-an sang Australia nga may 14 points, eight rebounds, three assists, three blocks, kag two steals sa gold medal game.
english: NBA veteran Thon Maker led Australia’s win with 14 points, eight rebounds, three assists, three blocks, and two steals in the gold medal game.

text: Nag-amot man sang 12 points si Mitch Carron kag may 10 points namna si Tyrese Proctors.
english: Mitch Carron also contributed 12 points and Tyrese Proctors had 10 points.

text: Ang New Zealand naman ang nagapangatlo sa pwesto matapos ginpierde sini ang Jordan, 73-75.
english: New Zealand are in third place after beating Jordan, 73-75.

text: Luyag nga suguran sang gobyerno ang implementasyon sang expanded Libre Sakay program sa Abril suno sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB).
english: The government wants to start the implementation of the expanded Libre Sakay program in April, according to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB).

text: Suno kay LTFRB Executive Director Maria Kristina Cassion, ginahulat na lang sang ahensya nga matapos ang pag-download sang pondo nga allocated sa third tranche sang Service Contracting Program (SCP).
english: According to LTFRB Executive Director Maria Kristina Cassion, the agency is waiting for the download of funds allocated to the third tranche of the Service Contracting Program (SCP) to be completed.
